tei:div.tei:p: gas/: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las bum pa'i lhan thabs bsdus pa rin chen mjes rgyan bzhugs rja: na mo pad+ma kro ta rā dza ya: 21rgya/41— — bum pa bkrab bdug rdzas blugs sogs ji ltar phyag bzhes legs par bkod ldi khri'i khar bkod nyer spyod bkram de nas bskyed bzlas rim pa ni oṃ swā bha wa sogs ye nas spros bral chos sku'i rol pa las: rnam rtog mtshan mas ma gos ye shes mdangs: zla gam dgu rdzogs pad+ma dbang gi dal: brda rtags bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus: bde stong zung 'jug pad zla nyi ma'i khar: rig pa hrī:dmar spro bsdus zhu ba las: bum la pad+ma dbang chen sku mdog dmar: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi gyad stabs bsgrad khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs sdang mig gzir: rtsa phyag gri thod 'khyud stobs tshul du 'dzin: de 'og ral gri dbang gi zhags pa bsdam: tha mas lcags kyu zal gnon sdigs mdzub mdzad: dur khrod chas rdzogs bskal pa'i me klong 'gyingaḥ pad+ma gsung gi dkyil 'khor sku la rdzogs rjes chags bshad pas rta skad

dbang bsdud sgrogs: gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon yi ge las: 'od 'phros gsung gi rdo rje sras 'khor bcas: pad+ma dbang gi rnam par spyan drangs bstib: pad+ma krom ya dza dza: dzaX/ baṃ ho: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo na ma ho: 〉 hrīX yid sprul ting nge 'dzin las byung ba yi: phyi nang gsang gsum bde stong mchod pa'i sprin: dpag yas na dang mnyam pa yis: pad+ma gsung gi rdo rje gtso 'khor mchod sa badz+ra pu dza sa ma ya ho: / trī: chags pas ma gos bde ba chen po'i sku: ye shes dbang gi gzi byi zhal rjes chags bzhad pas khams gsum mnga' dbang bsgyur dbang chen gsung gi rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod: bdag thugs pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru hrī:yig las:zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can 'phros: mdun bskyed bum pa'i lha tshogs thugs rgyud bskul: sku las byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas: bum pa'i nang bshes rgyas: 'dza ra 'das kun khyab ye shes gcig chenags bsre: bsnyen bsgrub las gsum bzlas pa gtong mthar ni mchod cing bstod pa'i rjes skye tsas:hūṃ lha rnams bde stong chen po

'tshan bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur: rmi: de nas las bum sgrub pa na oṃ swā bha wa sogs las kyi bum pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las ྅༷ ljang nag yongs su gyur pa las: dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus su: pad nyi rū tra'i gdan la khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil ba g.yas sna tshogs rgya gram dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad par gsal ba'i thugs gar nyi ma'i dal la /:ljang spus bris pa tsam gyi mtha' bskor du sngags phreng ljang sngon g.yon du 'khor bar dmigs la hūṃ a snyisnen ta krita tshin+ta tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa: ci nus brjod mthar sngags mchod phul rjes bstod pa na hūṃ rdi rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las sku: 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i mthu stobs can khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil: las rnams mdzad la phyags 'tshal bstod: lha 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsi'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur sgrub pa che phran gang gi dus nye bar mkho ba'i bum bzlas ni skal ldan sgrub pa po yis phyir rin chen shog skyar gsal bar byas sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gurgya snyi ces pa 'di'ang lu zin sku skyes pa d+ma'i mtshan can zung nas skul ngor nusaldan pasaspel ba masgo le/

ba:tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi dbang gi khog phub byin rlab gter bum zhes bya ba bzhugs so:a na lnga gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: 1017dzo ḍa pad+ma dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor las khyed shes dad pa drag pos phyag bgyi'o las can skal bzang pho mo smin grol phyir zab lam dbang gi khog phub gter bum bsngan sa ma phu de yang dkyil 'khor bkod mdzes zla gam pa sgo gru rta babs mtshan nyad phun tshogs dbus bum pa sku dang bhasnyo gsung gi rten thugs byon rig ma ka dag dwangs ba'i shel yon tan phrin lasagator chen tsaka li sogs gzhung mthun ma 'dres gsal bar legs bkod rte rnam lnga nyer spyod tshogs ston rgya cher spro bdag mdun bum bzlas bzhu btul 'od zhu bya tshogs cher bsags cing chos skyo srung ma gsol bdag nyida'ajug cing rig pa'i me tog dor dab bzhi blang la thugs yid ro gcig bsre de nas slob ma gral bsdu dbye bsal bya sgo gsum khrus kyis sbyang bar bya ba ni hūṃ rdi dri med skurashes 'o lnga'i bum pa dza bde gshegs phrin las rdzogs pa'i bcud chen basmil: skal lngan smob ma khyod la dbang bsnar bsaḥ smo gsum cha mnyam smib pa san bkra'o: badz+ra sa ma ya bi tharje a yi ge brgya pa bzla bzhan kha

chab 'gyed phyag dang zhe sa bcas te grwal la 'khod de nas bar chad bgegs tshogs skrad pa na hrī:bdag nyid gazlogalas bsaskrun ma'i lha mchog pad+ma he ru ka sku mdog dmar po g.yas lcags kyu dngagayon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa dur khrod dpal chas kyi mdzes par brgyan zhing gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa:ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du gtum drag 'jigs surung bar bskyed do:thugs ga'i trī:las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bur spros pa dang:spyi gtsug nas rta skad drag por bton pas phyogs mtshams steng 'og byi nag phyogs gdug pa'ilha srin ma rung srin po'i rigs can thams cad dang:bdud bgegs dam sri 'byung po kun mdun du bkug cing zil gyis gnon par bskyed do:na mo:dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal loḥmachog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang:dbang chen pad+ma drag po bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi lha sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin zab mo' bden pa'i mthus:gsang chen dbang gi dngos grub kyi skal ba zab mo la bar du gcod cing tho mtshams pa'i 'byung po thams cad len chags sbyang ba'i glud

btsarnya gtor rgya chen po len pa'i slad du 'dir 'dus shig ma sarba bhu ta a bgre ya dzaḥ dza:hūṃ baṃ ho: saṃ bha ra dang a ka ro yin spel: len chags kyi 'gron rigs rnams la rang rang gi yid spyod dang mthun pa'i 'dod yon phun sum tshogs par gyur: ces ā:hūṃ: bka' bsgo mtshams gcod gzhu da mthun par bya drag sngags hūṃ bzhi brjod cing thun gyis brab de nas bsrung ba'i gur khang gzhu mthun bya khyad par dmigs pa 'i gur kha phub pa ni bgegs tshogs log par 'dren par thams cad ye shes thun mtshon 'bar bas tshar bcad: chur 'dus pa las steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad ye shes lnga yi gur khang chen por dkrig pa'i dbus su skal ldan slob ma thams cad dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi rol par bsam moḥ dz+nyā na dhartu rak+ta rak+ta dhi: de nas bden don bshad la ma ṇ+ḍal phul gsol gdab nas bzu ngo sprod bar gtang de nas thun mo dab bskur rim pa ni rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyi: dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba sras dang bcas: rigs lnga yab yum rnam pa na mdun gyi nam mkhar sa ma ja: sngags kyi mchod ca bstod pa ra bya de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni de bayin bta/gabashapa thams cad la:

'gro ba yongs kyi ched du ni yon tan 'byung gnas rin chen dbang deng 'dir stsol bar mdzad du gsol: zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab pa'igasheg pa rnam kya dgo sa pa mdzad gshegs ma rnams kyis glu blang bya chub sems dpa 'a rnams kyis shis pa brjod sems ma rnams kyis gar bsgyur khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bsgrad khro mo rnams kyis bro brdung kun kya gsung mchog dbang gi bya ba las dgongs par bsam de na slob marnams rdo rje mi bskyod par gsal la bum pa thogs pa te hūṃ trī: rnam shesazhe sdang rnam dag cing: me long ye shes ngo bo nyid: mngon gyur rdo rje chu yi dbang: skal lhan slob ma khyod la sbyin: thugs mchog dgongs pa mngon gyur re ga hūṃ :badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: de nas slob ma rnams rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum mtsho dpes spras pa re bskyed la dbu rgyan thogs te hūṃ hrī tshor kung nga rgyalarnam dag cing: mnyam nyid ye shes mngon gyur byir: rin chen dbu rgyan mnga' dbang bskur: bshad sgrub bstan pa 'dzin nus shog: swā:rat+na a bhi ṣiñca tram̐ de nas slob ma rnams snang mtha' yab yum mab dpes spras pa re bskyed la: rdo rje thogs te hūṃ trī: 'du shes 'dod chags rnam dag cing: sor rtog ye shes mngon gyur phyir chags med rdo rje'i mnga' dbang

—4( bskur: sgrub pa mthar phyin byang chub shog ma:pad+ma a bhi ṣiñca hrī: de nas slob ma rnams don grub yab yum ma' dpes spras pa re bskyed la dril bu thogs te ཿ ༷ 'du byed phrag dogarnam dag cing bya grub ye shes mngon gyur phyir chos dbyings dril bu'i mnga' dbang bskur: byang chub sems mchog mngon gyur shog: hā:karma a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas slob ma rnams rnam par snang mdzad yab yum mtha dpes spras pa re bskyed la hūṃ hrī gzugs phung gti mug rnam dag cing: chos dbyings ye shes mngon gyur phyir: ming gi dbang mchog khyod la bskur: don gnyis lhun grub mthu thob regag: 31 ba a bhi ྅༷ sa: 'o skal ldan sems kyi bu rnams khyod la dbang chen bkod pa'i rgyal po zhes ming gdag go de nas rdo rje rgyal po 'a dbang bskul ba ni hū trī de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyis: bsgrub bya'i dkyil 'khor nga yin pas: dam tshig gsum kyi phyag rgyar spyod oṃ ma hā badz+ra :: dz+nyā na dhartu rlu: dharma gas ā: dza:hūṃ baṃ ho kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: de nas spyor lo gtad la ṭ+wāṃ hrī ma rig 'khor ba'i rba 1nga kun: ye shes thugs kyi 'khor lo rtsa dag smin rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir: chos kyi 'khor lo khyod la gtad:

dharmā tsakra a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ de nas dung dkar gto la hūṃ hrī: bkra shis rgyang grags chos kyi dung: mi 'gags gsung mchog bde ba'i sgra: gang 'dul gdul byar 'gyed pa'i phyir: rtagasakyi dbang bskur bu la sbyin: dharmā shabha a bhi ṣiñca ma de nas po ti gtad la hūṃ phyi rgyu yi 'bras bu bde ba'i dbang: gsang sngags rdo rje snying po yi: bstan pa rin chen dpal 'bar ba: skal ldan skyes bu khyod la gtad: dharma gasnye tan+t+ra a bhi ༷༷ ā: de ltar thun mong dbang thams cad thob pa 'i yon du tshogs ston 'bul dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur rim pa rnams gzhu bzhin legs paramatshangs ldan bya de nas mtha' rten dbang bskur ni bkra shis rtags brgyad gtad la hūṃ trī 'dod 'byung bum pa chags bral ka ma la: phun tshogs dpal be'u bkra shis dung dkar dang: thugs rje'i gdugs chen mi nub rgyal mtshan sogs: mtshan dpe'i yon tan thob phyir bu la sbyin rat+na maṅga lam̐ a bhi ṣiñca tre: de nas bkra shis rdzas brgyad gtad la hūṃ nyi 'dod ster bil ba dbang bsngad li khri dang: nad sel snyi waṃ bgegs 'joms yungs dkar rdzasaḥ bkra shis ku sha tshe rdzas dur wa sogs: yon tan 'byor phyir rigs ldan bu la sbin ratā masgo

gtsasdo: lam e me a bhi ṣiñca /: de nas sna bdun gtad la hū ༷ bde ster btsun mo dpa la ldan khyim bdag dang: rdzu 'phrul rta mchog rab brgal glang po che: bsam 'phel nor bu bkra shis rtsibs stong ldan: dmag dpon rin chen rgyal srid khyod la gtad: aṣ+ṭa ma lam a bhi ṣiñca /: de nas dab gi phan yon bstan pa na de ltar dbang sgob lus ngag yidasgrib dag sku gsung thugs su sman rung nus pa bzhag mthar thugs rdo rje gsum du rdzogs par byedaḥ tshogs dang sbyor lam spyod pa 'i skal ba can rnam smin tshe dab sa la rim gyis sbyor phyag rgya chen po mi slob mchog thob 'gyur sprul ba' sku dang longs spyod rdzogs pa 'i sku chos kyi sku mchog gegs med yid bzhin thob bskyed rdzogs bde stong ka dag bsgom pa yas sngon du dab mchog de nyid med mi rung 'ad 'bral ye shes kun gyi stong pa'o gnad dang ldan na mchog thun dngos grub thob yon tan byin rlabs nam mkha'i mtha' da mnyam bden rdzun lag tu lo da nges shes gsal dkon mdo rgyal khams 'grams la stos da mthong rdo rje zeg pa'i sman bye srog gtar 'chong de ya dam tshig spyi da khyad par lhag ma lus thams cad srog dang sbrel nas sru sa dam tshag can rnams dpa 'a bo ḍak+ki dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lus da grab bzhin bsrung mchog thun dngos grub thob po skal ba can sa ma mā ye ma

rgyal ba' dbang po pad+ma sa bha wa'i ma 'ongasa'agro la lhag bar thugs brtse bas mtha' dbus thamasacad rin chen gter gyi bkang shin tu zab pa rdo rje snying po' skor thub ba' dbang phyug 'brog ban khyod lagatad dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la bstemasashig ra bye mdo khams bkra shas rdzongs der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon gyi gzengs pa lang pa'i tshe yin rgyan rgyal pa yis gsang chen 'di bkrol bstan pa 'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug 'gro don phrin las byang gi phyogs su rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pa d+ma 'od du 'god don gnyisalhun gyis grub pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' 'di thu btsan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor rtag pa ra srungs sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya drag po' dbang gi khog phub zab mo rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyis slob dpobaka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda tham lha ces pa 'di yang lu zin chos kyi bdag po sku skyesapad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rje bkra shis dge ba'i jos du ma dang bcas te yang yang bskul ngor/kho bo rgya rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni ches kyi bdag po nyid kyas bgyis pa dge legs 'phe la/ sarba maṅga la/
badz+ra cha zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyis:mas rgyus rab gsal me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

ba tshu na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: the 11lhos khamasagasum dbang bsgyur pad+ma nye ru ka bdud dpung zil gnon rta ya brtul zhugs can rgyud sde rab 'byams sprin gyi tshom bur bcas mi 'bralabade chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du rol ma 'o sa las can skal bza pho mo rnams smin byed dab gi lam las drangs ba'i tshe dad pa mos gus dag snang bskyed pa'i phyir dbang chen gsung ga lo rgyus mdo tsam bshad sa ma wā nam mkha'i mtha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi rgyal sa mchog la 'god par bya de yi ched du dbang chen pad+ma bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi bskyed rdzogs zab mo la rtag tu brtson par bya de'i sngon du smin byed dbang gi dkyil 'khor du gzhug nas sgo gsum smin par bya ba la yid ches kyi dad pa bskyed phyir lhag pa'i lha yi tshul te mdo tsam brjod na: dus bskal pa grangs med mang po'i sngon rol nas: srin yul ling ka pu ri bya ba na smad tshong ma kun tu rgyu dang wa klu bdud gsum bshos pa'i bu smon log rā tra zhes bya ba mgo bo gsum lag pa drug rang 'khrungs kyi ga rteg pa zung te yod pa: skyes ma thag tu lar+sha'i yul la bkra mi shis pa'i ltas mang po byung ba: kha rlangs las

bar gsum gyi gdon thams cad rtag tu rgyu zhing ma rung de la sru ba byed pa: btsas ma thag tu dur shing nag po'i rtsa bar bskyal de: sha za dang srin po lce spyang gcan ga tshogs la gnyer du gtad kyaja bza' bar ma nus: kho yis ma ros brgyag byas te zhag po zhe dgu na lang tsho dar zhing bkrag mdang stobs dang ldan te: phan tshun du bltathamakha' 'gros mi ro za ba mthong nas ro rnams zas su zos rak+ta skom du btung: glang po'i lngags bshus te stod g.yog: mi lpags kyi sked chings stag lngags kyi smad sham:gyi rkang gdub da lag gdub do shal: mi mgo rkam rlon rnyid gsum tshal bsgrigs te mgul phreng byas nas: khams gsum la mnga' dbang bsgyur zhing gnas yul tham la khyab par rgyu zhing dbang du mdzad pa: pho mthong thams cad sgrol zhing mo mthong thams cad dbang du byas nas sbyor bar byed cing: drag po'i yul de dag la bdag po mi

ma byed re bskos nas kho yi 'bangs su khas blangs nas bran g.yog bzhin las byed par gnyer bcol sum cu rtsa gsums yul nas lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar la gshe de nyid kyang sku mya ngan las 'das ba'i tshul bstan te mnyam med thub pa'i dbang por byang chub par mdzad do: de'i tshe ma tram̐ du tra kho khengs sems rab tu rgyas te gtum kyi nga ro bsgrags tshe skye 'gro yongs kyi shes blo rmongs bar 'gyur ro: dus mtshan mo'i shedabaskyed kyi dpa' phyungs la: phyi ltar srin po'i rgyal po ma ṭaṃ kha ru ṭa gnas yul zhi la dbang bsgyur ba: nang ltar lha min rgyal po ma ṭaṃ shrī gtum rngams can yul chen dgu yi dpung sma phab cing dbang du mdzad pa: gsang ba khams gsum gyi rgyal po ma tram̐ da gtum 'bar zhes lha gnas thams cad la'ang dbang brgyur nas mi srun pa'i rigs can re re bdag por bskos nas gnas so 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan rnams

ba tshu gnas so:de'i dus su 'og min gyi gnas su rgyal ba thams cad bka' yi bsgro gleng mdzad nas gdul byed kyi gnyen po gang la babs zhes ye shes spyan gyis gzigs tshe bde mchog pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang kun khyab gyis dgongs pa can gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la bka' bab brin las gcig rdzogs kyi dbang bskur:mthu stobs nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par dbugs dbyung khams gsum rol rtsed chen po'i brtul zhugs kyis gdug pa bran du bkol bar gzengs bstod:rgyal kun thams cad phrin las gcig rdzogs kyi rol bar byin gyis brlabs nas:rdzu 'phrul chen pos ri ma la ya gnam lcags yod pa'i rtse mor byon nas rta phag gyi skur bzhengs thabs chen pad+ma he ru ga'i dbus gtsug nas rta skad dgu gton pas sa gsum g.yo zhing bskyod:du tra'i 'khor thams cad 'dar yed yed byed cing dpa' 'khrum yum

de tshe rū tras nga ro bsgrags pa ni: khams gsum 'di na che ba'i dbang phyug dang: lha dang gnod sbyin dri za kun gyi btud: dregs pa yongs kyi mgo bos gtugs shing brtse: nga lasache btsan srid na ma mchis pa'i: bde gshegs bka' yi phrin las dus la bab zhes gsungs nas rta mgrin rū tra'i 'og sgor zhugs te rta mgo spyi gtsug nas rgyang gyis thon te rdul dang tshul gyi tshos nas ljang gur gyur pad+ma gzi ldan chung ma'i bha gar zhugs nas phag dbu spyi bo nas byung te rdul dang tshul khus tshos la nag por gyur ro: rū tra pho mo'i lus rab tu brgyang sems gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i yid chad skye ba'i gdung tshig gis: hu ya: thod mkhar sgo 'gram g.yas g.yon gyi: bdud srin gshan rje ma yam tshogs: rū tra'i grogs su da chos shig: mdangs sum rmi lam ngan tshul dang: de rang rta phag rdzu 'phrul gnyis: rtag dang rten 'brel shin tu ngan: gnas yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas: bdag po mi bzad 'jigs byed rnams rang rang 'khor g.yog dpung dang bcas: thogs med stobs kyi 'dir shog la: rā tra'i dpung su ma g.yel zhig: ces brjod tshe khams gsum gyi

bas/: gnas yul so so nas bdag po dbang phyug chung ma dang bcas pa skad cig gis sleb pa la rta phag yab yum gyi thugs ka nas khro bcu yab yum spros te phyogasaskyong gtso 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi snying lcags kyus drangs:ske zhags pas bcing:yan lag sgrog gis bsdams:sems dril bus myos par byas te:zhabs 'og tu phornams kha rbubs mo rnams gan skyal gyi tshul du mnan tshe rū tra gtso 'khor yongs kya dpa' zhus ste smre sngags gton pa:pha ma hu yu:sangs rgyas kyis ne+e bdud rnams pham:chos mayin rnams chos kyis pham:dge 'dun gyis ni mu stegs pham:rta phag gnyis kyis rū tra pham:las nai lus kyi grib ma bzhin du 'grogs:sngon chad rang gis gang byas rang gisamyong:bsags pa'i lus ni nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam:dug gsum rmo sa pa'i 'khrul 'khor bsam mtha' yas:gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags bdag gi lus 'di gdan du bzhes su gsol:rnam smin sbyor mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo sdig sgrib bsal mdzad khyed la phyag 'tshal lo:ngan song dong sprugs khyod la phyag

'tshal lo: zhes gsol ba btab po: de nas chung ma sogs 'khor rnams kyis zhus pa:teru ka dpal dgongs su gsol: mi dge'i las sgrib bzod par gsol: dkyila'akhor dbus la mi spyod kyang: nged rnams mtha' la 'jog par zhu: phud la 'tshal ba'i skabs med kyang: lhag ma'i zhal chas nged la zhu: gtso bos tshogs gral mi 'tshal yang bka' nyan 'bangs su 'jog par zhu: zhes gsol ba btab po:denas dbang chen yab yum gyi bde chen rol ba'i brtul zhugs chen pos gad rgyang sgrogs tshe: rū tra'i las nyon gyi 'dam rdzab thams cad rab tu lud de rgya mtsho che ltar 'khyil ba rnamasadabang chen yab yum gyis sras mchog rme bar brtsegs par sprul te 'dam rdzab thams cad rol bar mdzad: las nyon bag chags kyi dri ma thams cad sangs bar byas so:denas rta phag yab yum rgyu bde lam bde 'bras bu bde ba'i rol rtsed sna tshogs mdzad bzhin du 'og min chos kyi dbyings su bzhud to: ma rung de yi sdig sgrib dri ma thams cad dag par byas nas lus dwang mar snang ba cig rū tra thar ba nag po zhes ming btags nas dregs pa'i gtso

066 bor bskos so: 'khor rnams kyi lce la dam tshig gi bdud rtsi bzhag nas gsang sngags kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i gnyer byang gtad zag pa'i lus so sor kha phral te gsang sngags kyi bstan pa byung ba'i gnas brgyad du byin gyis brlabs: zag pa tshal gcig klu yul tu lhung ba bdud rtsi a pra ta 'byung ba'i rdzas khyad par can du byin gyis brlabs: skye mched phran bu thams cad 'dod 'byu rin chen gter gyi 'byung gnas su rgyas btab: de nas bde bar gshegs pa thams cad nam mkha'i skar tshogs 'khyug pa bzhin byon nas gsang sngags rdo rje snying po'i bka' yi bsgro gleng mdzad: de tshe rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i bka' yis bsdu ba mdzad cing gsang sngags 'byon pa'i gnas brgyad du gter du sbas shing mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gnyer byang bcol lo: de nas bar gyi bskal ba la rig 'dzin chen po brgyad kyi mchod rten bde byed brtsegs par sgrub sde dgu'i zab mdzod mnyes tshe: dbang chen gsung gizab rgya nā gardzu nas bkrol te: bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung bsrangs skabs dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha rtsa ba dang yan lag thams

cad kyi zhal gzigs:'gros dgu rta yi brtul zhugs chen pos rgyud kyi de kho na nyid bsgrags:zab pa'i gnyer byang pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la gtad yi dam dbang chen gsung gi lha dang thugs dgongs ro gcig tu gyur dpal chen po rnams kyi byi ltar du tra'i skye brgyud bshad:nang 'dul byed dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul gyi rol brtsed thams cad ngo sprad gsang ba don dam mchog tu mi 'gyur ba dbang chen yab yum gyi bkod pa dbyer med bde ba chen por gsang bkrol denasa.o rgyan chen po'i man ngag kha cig dur khrod chen po brgyad dang rgya bal gyi mchod rten rnams su gter rgyas btab:gnyer byang mkha' 'gro ma rnams la bcol te dus dang dus su gsang sngags rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa'i rgud pa gso ba'i btsas su bzhag go:phyis su gangs can bod kyi yul gru 'dre ma sang gdug pa can gyi bzungs pa'i sa cha srin po'i yul gling lta bu'i ljongs 'dir:'jam dbyangs sprul pa mi yi rgyal po khri sgong lde'u btsan gyis:o rgyan gyis slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa spyan drangs sde brgyad ma rungs dregs pa can thams cad dam la

ba:tshu btags bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lags khang gling bzhi gling phran nyi ma zla ba'i tshul du legs par grub: sprul pa'i lo tsā ba rgya rtsa brgyad bsdus te rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du brdzang nas dam chos ma lus pa bod skad du bsgyur nas gdan drangs: bka' rnams thams cad glegs baṃ la bkod nas paṇa chen nyer lnga gdan drangs te dag ther zhib tu bton: mkhan slob lo paṇa thams cad kyis bsam yas la rab gnas me tog 'thor tshe ya mtshan ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung: skyid pa'i glu mo che dang bro gar rta rgyug g.yo 'bog rgya chen po mdzad: paṇa chen be+e ma la mi tra'i 'od gsal snying thig gi dgongs pa'i sgol bzung: bka' bab chen po las can snying gi bu dgu la bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal phyes nas man ngag gi mdzod chen gtad: rang rang gis sgrub pa lhur len tshe bskyed rdzog kyi drod rtags thon:yi dam lhag pa'i lha yi zhal gzigs bka' rnams thams cad mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul yig la drangs nas rin po che'i sgrom du gzhugs ste: gnas chen rnams la gter

rgyas btab bstan 'gro'i rgud pa skyobs phyir smon lam chen po dbang bskur bar mdzadaḥ gter srung pho nya rnams la gnyer byang bcol: dus rtag mtshan kyi rnam grangs dang bcasate 'byin par lung bstan khyad par gyi gdams pa 'di nyid byung tshul zur tsam spyos na gang can bod kyi dge slong mi lnga'i nang tshan ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs zhes bya ba slob dpon nā gardzu na 'jig rten bod kyi yul gru skyong phyir mi'i brdzu ru pheb pa de nyid kyis dka' ba khyad du bsad nas rgya chos mang po bod du drangs: ngal ba dang len byas tebasgrub pa'i drod rtags khyad par can ma byung gi bar du bsnyen cing ting nge 'dzin bskyangs: lus srog 'ben du btsug nas dbang chen lhag pa'i la dang gnyis su med par dbugatsug nas rta zhal snang bar mdzad do bla ma mig bzhin brten cing zhabs tog gsum gyis mnyes pa'i bya ba mthar phyin par byas nas dus re zhig dgos skal gyi rten 'brel dang mthun par: bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dbus su 3 rgyan chen po pad+ma saṃ bha wa bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar byin te phyag dang maṇ+ḍal gus 'dud kyi zhe sa dang

ba tshu bcas te:rje thams cad mkhyen pa lags:spyir sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa dgos su dbang chen gsung gi chos sde'i bab so:ma 'ongs 'gro ba skyobs nus pa'i man ngag yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu zhag gnang bar mdzad du gsol:zhes zhus tshe:gu ru rin po che zag med thams cad mkhyen pa'i ting nge 'dzan las bzhengasate nyon cig dam ldan gyi rig 'dzin chen po:bdag ni ngo bo chos skur ye sangs rgyas kyang:rang mdangs ma 'gags par gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgron me phyogs thams cad kun du spel zhing:khyad par mi mjed 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya na mdo ltar rgyal ba shākya thub pa bye ba phrag brgyas 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing:sngags ltar gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas bye ba phrag brgyas gsang sngags snying po'i bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad pa las:stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten gyi zhing 'dir bdag nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas gu ru mtshan brgyad 'gro 'dul chen po drug rig 'dzin brgyad grub chen brgyad cu la sogs pa'i bstan 'gro'i don chen mdzad pa la:bka' sde snod rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i

chos rnams thams cad ma rmongs par mkhyen pa las:gang la gang 'dul kyis man ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig rje 'bangs so sor 'akrol kyang:'dir nisangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa 'dus pa dbang chen he ru ka yi gsang mdzod kyi bab so:man ngag thams cad kyi rgyal po:dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la brtsal ba:de nyid kyis rin chen gter dusbas te mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo cher gnyer du bcol pa:slob dpon nā gardzu nas spyan drangs te bdag nyidapad+ma se bha wa la bka' stsal ba dur khrod chen po pad+ma brtsegasapa na da lta yang bzhugs so bdag nyid dgongs pa'i mthil na yang lhag par gab cing sbas tshul du yod do:din bod yul sa 'og gter rnams kun gyi snying khu:man ngagathams cad kyi rtsa ba:sgrub sde thams cad kyi yang bcud bka' gter thams cad kyi rgyal po bya sla la don che ba 'brel tshad don ldan du byed pas zab mdzod dam pa 'di:da ltakhyod la gces nor du sbyin no:da lta yi dam lhag pa'i lhar brten te bzhan la mi spel bar dam rgyas bcing nas:phyis su bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel zhing rgud pa gso phyir rin

ba:tshu chen 'phrul gyi brda mi 'gyur rang bsrel chen por bkod nas:mdo khams bkra shis tsā ri trar sbas rgya sdoms shig:dus snyigs mar nad mtshon mu ge 'khrugs rtsod kyi rgud pa ldang tshe:dbang chen gsung gi bka' bab grub chen rgyas ba mchog dbyangs khyod nyid gdul bya'i 'dren ston dam par bzhengs nas:bod khams sa 'og gter gyi snying khu 'di nyid spyan drangs te:tshogs smon las 'phro 'dzom pa'i skal bzang pho mo la spel cing sbyin pa'i byin rlabs kyis rgud pa 'khrug rtsod sogs zhi bar byed pa dang sde brgyad dregs pa bran du bkol zhing gsang chen snying po'i bstan pa'i sgron me gsal bar byed do:gdul bya 'brel tshad thams cad smin zhing grol bar byas te rnga yab srin po'i tshogs rje bdag nyid pad+ma rgyal po'i spyan sngar rig 'dzin gyi tshogs gral du 'khod par byed do:de bas na dbang chen gsung gi chos sde 'di ni:mthong grol dang thos grol dran grol yin pas yid ches par gyis shig:nges shes gti nas rted par gyis shig:zhes gsung te rgyal ba mchog dbyangs rjes su yid rang nas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal tshogs ston rgya

cher phul la log ste sgrub gnas dbang chen zla gam phug par byon nas sgrub pa mdzad tshe yul gsum gyad du gyur:spyo gtsug nas rta mgo byung ste skad theng dgur bton pas dregs pa thams cad dbang du bsdus:ma rungs kun gyi snying khrag lud:sde brgyad thams cad dam la btags:pho nya dmu long rgyab sbrel gyi tshogs thams cad lus dang grib ma ltar du 'grogs:phrin las gang brtsams thams cad thogs med yid bzhin du sgrub par byed do:lha mi kun gyis bsngags pa brjod cing snyan pa'i thams cad mnga' dbang du bsgyur b.rabyed do:de nas bka' rnams thams cad mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul yig du bkod nas mdo khams bkra shis tsa ri trar gter rgyas btab po:phyis su o rgyan chen po'i smon lam gyis mthus:gling pa rnam lnga gter chen brgya rtsa gter phran bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas bstan 'gro'i rgud pa bsal te rdzogs ldan gyi lang tsho lta bu'i snang ba gsal bar mdzad pa'i nang tshanatsa( rgyan chen po'i thugs kyi 'od zer las spros pa'i rig 'dzin chen po dbang chen gsung gi bka' bab rgyal ba mchog dbyangasartsal gyi zlos gar:rgyal

bsnye: mchog bshad pa'i rdo rje 'dzam gling dbang rgyan rtsal lam mkha' 'gro 'bul sprin 'byil ba'i rdo rjes gdan drangs ba'o: de yang rten 'brel gyi sna kha ma log byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma yal: dngo sa grub kyi rno myur ma sdur: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs tho le ba: dpe gangs seng dkar mo'i 'o ma las kya bcud che ba: 'di nyid mthong thos dran reg 'brel tshad thams cad don ldan du byed pa'i man ngag: rtog ge'i blo yi dri mas bslad ma zhugs pa yid dpyod kyi blo yis bsre slad gang yang ma byas pa: zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i chos sde dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi nye lam zab mo'o: 'di la smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi gdams pa phrin las mtha' brgyan dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mchis pa las deng skabs su bab pa rgyu gnyis rkyen bzhi'i yan lag tshangs pa'i sgo nas: smin byed dbang gi dkyil 'khor du bcug par bya ba la bdag slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams yongs su grub nas khyed ra slob ma rnams kyi ro skal du gyur pa'i maṇ+ḍal zhig phul mdzod: zhes pas brda sprad maṇ+ḍal tshog ston spro chos gsung bskul bar

gsol ba nan gyis gdab de nas dbang gi go rim ma 'chol bar gzhu sa ltar legs bar bskur thob don gnyis 'grub sa ma mā i ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'o sa 'gro la shin tu thugs brtse bas sa 'og thams cad gter gyis bkang nas brtsal khyad par zab gsang rdo rje snying po' skor grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung lo tsā da dbangachen rgyal ba mchog dbyas sa rtsal la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab bas ran chen brda la bstems shig sar phyo mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'o sa snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gzengs pa lang pa'i tshe dpa' bo khyed zung sprul ba las ldan dang 'phrad nas bstan pa'i rgyas mtshan 'dzug par byed 'gro don phrin las rma smar byang rong rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pa d+ma 'od du 'god bka' 'di srung shig gnod sbyin yang le ber dam nyams lag tu ma shor thub par skyongs las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya lo rgyus rab gsal me long rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu h+ya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma sa bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim ñcā zhes pa 'da'ang lung zin snangagakyi bdag po sku skyes pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shis dge ba'i rdzas du ma dang bcas te bskul ro ra/ khobo dbang chen gsung ga bka' bab 'dzam gling dbang rgyan rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba' 'phrul brda

gakhyon 111rmatshoklosnyamathi slo1skuzakra khrislo1 gam thecha khrim༄/sgo zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:dbang chen zil gnon rtsal gyi rtsa ba'i dbang rdzong bde chen ye shes mthong byed zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

ba rte na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye sgo2tshe smosgo ngas stong go dbyingasakyi mkha' klong spros dang bral bde za rig pa'i rdo rje gzi byin 'bar gnyis med gar dbang gzi yis du tra 'thar rtaphag bde ba'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo la can skal ba bzang po'i bu rnams la smin byed dbang gi dngos grub sbyin pa'i thabs phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang zab gnad bcas bdag 'dra pad+ma rgyal pos bstan par bya sa ma mā doyang dben gnas bkra shis byin chags su phyi nang nyer 'tshe rkyen snang dben byas te bde ba' dkyil 'khor dbang chen zla gam pa rab gsal 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma'i thig bgyi'o thabs shes tshogs zan phya nang gsang mchod sprin bde chen bum pa bla med so lngas gtams dum gcig bhastor dza gad byang sems bskyol dkyal 'khor lha tshogs gsal snang sku gzugs bkram rdo rje'i rig ma 'dzum sgeg lang tshos 'khrud brtul zhugs cha gabazang dpa 'a ba'i yo byad dang rdo rje'i tshogs ston sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dar chen dung dkar rnga bo che dang ni rol mo' rigs byed ji rted tshogs tshad bkod rnal 'byor lha grangasadang mthun las can rnams dam tshig bshad cing las dbang rten 'brel brtags phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rgya legs par bcad mdzod lan chu bo ོgas pa'i slob dpon gyi bdag 'dun bum bzlas tshogs bsags srung ma gsol rig pa'i me tog dor zhing nang dbang len de dag sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa'o sa ma

gtsakhri rwa slob ma sgo drung la tshogs khrus kyis sbyangs bgegs tshogs sprad la bsrung ba'i gur du bcug thal sbyar me tog bcas te sgo zhus ni snyan pa'i dbyangs la drangs te 'di skad do rkye: mi bzad 'jigs pa'i sku mchog khro rgyal bzhi: tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa: phrin las rgya mtsho'i gsang mdzod 'chang ba po: ye shes thugs rjes bdag la dgongs sugasol: bdag ni 'jig tshogs srid pa'i chos la sun: yang dag snying po'i lam la spro ba che sgo gsum ltos med bla mar 'bul lags na: byin rlabs dbang gi dngos grub zhu ba'i phyir: nang du 'dong ba'i bka' drin gnang bar zhu: lan gsum zhus sa gzungs mas lan gnang ba kye ho: 'jig rten mi bden srid par gdung thag che: le lo'i thang la gom 'byel kha gsags mkhas: thos chung bag med gzeng sa bstod spyod ma 'chol: de lta bu rnams 'jug pa'i skal ba med: gtong phod che zhing mos gus dam tshig dag: phu dud bkur sti zhe sa mchod par brtson rgyu 'bras chos dang ya dag snying po' lam: kun la yid ches 'bad pas lhur len zhing: sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla mar bsten mkhas rnams: bde

sa kyi dal 'dir 'jug rung ngo: skal ba mchis sam ma mchis khyod la rag: nan du dpyod la dbye bsal ma nor zhig badz+ra sa ma yu: de nas slob ma'i zhu ba ni kyi:ma bzang ngom pa'i gzungs ma dgongs: srog 'di dor dgos byung yang bla mar 'dzin: bdog pa gang 'byor bla ma'i phyogs su 'bul: mig 'bras phyi ru 'byin kyang da nas 'khor bar mi ldog dam bca' yin: lan gsum zhus rjes bla ma'i lan gnang ba 'o de ltar yin na 'ong ngo legs soḥ rig goX 'jug pa'i skal ba dang ldan noX nang nga zhe sabacas sgo gsum stos med maṇ+ḍal rgya chen 'bul chos 'khor bskor ba'i gsol ba gdab pa' rjes bla mas lo rgyus legs par bshad par bya de nas 'jug pa'i gsol gdab na kye rdeste riga'(dang 5dus zhal bla ma dgongs bdag cag las can skal bzang pho mo la: dbang chen bde ba chen po'i byin rlabs sgo da ltar nyid du gnang ba'i sku drin stsol: lan mas bka' sa ba kye hoX pad+ma dbang chen gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di bod yul sa 'og gter chos kun gyi bcud mthong thos dran reg 'brel tshad don ldan

086 yin: dad pa mos gus bskyed la gtsug tu 'chong: de nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni na mo: mthu stobs dbang phyug pad+ma he ru ka rgyal kun gsung gi rdo rje che ba'i mchog 'bar ba'i gar mdzad rta phag dkyil 'khor la: bya chub mchog thob bar du skyabs su mchi: lan gsum de nas sems bskyed ni ho: sna tshogs snang ba chu zla'i rdzun ris bzhin: rten 'brel 'khor ba bsgal dka'i rba klong las: rig stong sku gsum klong du ngal bsos phyir: dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi dkyil 'khor sgrub: lan gsum zhu de nas tshogasabasags ni na mo khams gsum zel gnon pad+ma he ru ga: mngon gyur rang ngo rig pas phyag 'tshal lo: snang srid ma spang dag chen dgongs pas mchod: 'dzin rtsol sems kyi nongs pa mthol lo bshags: sku gsum mnyam nyid bzhugs la rjes yi rang: bde stong spros dang bral ba'i chos 'khor bskul: zag med bde chen 'pho med chen por bzhugs dge kun gcig bsdus 'khor gsum dag par bsngo: phyam gcig gdod ma'i sprul gzhi mngon gyur shog: lan gsum de nas sdom bzung ni ho: dbang chen pad+ma bde ba'i dkyil 'khor

dgongs: bdag ni gsang chen sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas so thar sdom bzung gzhan gnod bya ba spang byang sems sdom bzung g.yin phan 'ba' zhig sgrub: gsang sngags dam sgog lha sngags chos skur blta: bde mchog rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig tu: thabs mchog rdo rje shes rab dril bu 'dzin: byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor rtag tu skyongs 'dod 'byung rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig tu: sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin par byed: kun khyab ye shes snying po sgom par bya: dgyes mchog pad+ma rigs kyi dam tshig tu: theg pa gsum dang chos rnams ma 'dres bshad: bde ba'i gzi byin mkha' 'gro yongs la stobs: las rnams rab rdzogs gar gyi dam tshig tu: phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i don chen sgrub:phar phyin drug spyod 'khor ba dong sprugs brtson 'ub chub de bzhin rigs kyi dmatshig tu 'khor 'das mnyam nyid dkyil 'khor gsum du spyod: spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig 'dzin: nam yang sdom las mi 'da' sa ma mā: lan gsum rjes su dam chu sbyin pa ni hūṃ hrī: gsang ba mchog gi dam rdzas las kyi chu: rdo rje gnod sbyin 'bar ba'i rang bzhin can

badz+ra: dbang chen bde ba'i rdul 'khrigs dam tshig rten: gsang mchog rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin: dam chig mchog 'jin rdo rje lce la sbyar 'chad nyan chos kyisnod phyir rna bar gtugs: sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug phyir thugs dkar reg: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs phyir legs par sbyar: srid pa dbyings su gnon phyir zhabs lagatugs: don gnyis lhun gyis grub phyir myang bar byos: bde chen rdo rje'i gdan sar mnga' gsol lo: yi badz+ra sa ma ya na ra gan: ud+dha ja wa slar yang rdo rdzeslob ma rnams kyiganas gsum du yi ge gsum dam tshig gi rten du gsal: de las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros te: dbyings nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sku gsum yeshes kyi rnam par byon te sib sib bstim:badz+ra sa ma ya dza: dza:hūṃ baṃ ho: gnyis su med par gyur rnam lnga' mchod cing rol mo sgrogs ye shes thugs kyi bstod pa bya de nas mig dar sbyin byas te 'o dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi dkyil 'khor du: ma zhugs pa'am zhugs kyang slad nas yang 'jug pa'i brdar: dbang gi cod pan res gdong pa bcing pa'i mos pa mdzod oṃ pad+ma

tsak+ṣu bhasto wa ra ma ṇa ye swā hā: de nas me tog sbyin la 'o: dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi dkyil 'khor ye shes kyi 'khor lo dang mjal ba'i tshe: phyag stong par mjal mi rung pa'i:phyag rten gyi slad du: me tog u dum wa ra'i chun po re sbyin pa'i mos pa mdzod: hṝ ā khaṃ we ra /: de nas slom ma lha gsal ni skye ma hā shu n+ya ta sogs ko3nya gzungs ba'i yul dang 'dzin pa sems kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad gzhi med rtsa bral chos sku thig le nyag gcig gi rol bar gyur: de'i ngang las lhun grub dbang chen ye shes kyi zhing gi bkod pa:bde chen pad+ma rol ba'i dkyil 'khor dbang chen 'bar ba chen po'i gzi byin 'byug pa'i 1 du: rngam brjid thod pa'i sku mkhar 'jigs rung bzod par dka' ba gtum drag dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba: ye shes 'od kyi tshang khang 'khrigs pa'i klong du: bdud bzhi sde brgyad phyi chings bsnol ba'i khri steng: nyi zla 'od stong 'khrigs pa'i ze'u 'brur rig pa trī dmar nag me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba gcig tu gyur: de la 'khor 'das kyi dwangs bcud thams cad dang: sde brgyad dregs pa'i gzi byin thams cad gcig tu bsdus te gnyis

ba tshu med du bstim pa'i mthu yis thug sgog yongs su gyur ba las: slob ma dbang chen bde ba mchog gi sku: gzhung bzhi lha bskyed yongs rdzogs rgyas par gar+ṣa de nas ye shes pheb pa'i dmigs pa ni de ltar dbang chen lhar gsal thugs ka phu bde chen chos 'byung dmar po'i lto ba la: 'od lnga'i dga' 'khyil snying po srog gi mtshan: 'dab ma rlung gi snying po yi gis brten: dga' 'khyil steng du gser 'khor rtsibs drug pa: de dbus he ru ka pa tshon gang ba: dmar gsal rus pa'i rgyan rdzogs ḍā dril 'khrol: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin 'khyug: gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon yig 'bru dang: srog gi snying po las spros 'od zer gyis: rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa: bde chen dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi: rnam par spyan drangs slob mar sib sib thim: sha chen spos bsregs tshul chen dud pa bdug thod rnga'i sgra dang snyan pa' dbyangs dang bcas hū hrī dbang chen pad+ma brtsegs pa'i bde klong nas: rgyal kun gsung gi rdo rje che ba'i mchog: 'bar ba'i gar mdzad rta phag gtso 'khor bcas: dga' bzhi'i rnam 'gyur gnas yul mkha' 'gro'i

'khor ye shes gsang mdzod rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bde ba'i zhal bzang zil gnon bka' 'khor bcas: rnal 'byor mos gus gdung ba'i 'bod lags na: ye shes gzigs pa'i bde chen phyag rgyar bzhengs: 'dir 'tshogs lus la sku yi gzi byin phob: ngag la bde stong 'bar ba'i gzi byin phob: sems la rig stong ye shes gzi byin phob khams gsum zil gnon yon tan gzi byin phob 'khor ba dong sprugs brin las gzi byin phob: rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa'i gzi byin phob dregs pa las la 'chun pa'i gzibyin phob dug gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i gzi byin phob: dbang dang dngos grub ma lus mchog stsol zhig hrī:pad+ma kro ta shrī he ru ka ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ dz+nyā na pañca kro ta sarba sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: dz+nya na a we sha ya a ā: rol mo'i sgra bcas ye shes byin chen dbab dam ye gnyis med bde ba chen por bsre dz+nyā na dhartu dza:hūṃ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: pheb pa'i lha de brten par bzhugs su gsol sngags kyas mchod cang dgyes pa bskang bar bya de nas me tog dor ba ni hūṃ hrī dbang chen bde ba mchog gi da la na rigs dang dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i thig le'i

bsgotshu klong: ye shes gsang ba lhag pa'i lha mchog der: rig pa'i me tog gus 'bul thugs rjes bzhes gri puje byu dza ho: de nas gsang mab btags pa ni 'o: me tog dbus su bab na gsang ba'i mtshan kun bzang rta mchog bzhad pa shar du rdo rje 'gyeng 'gro'i: lho ru rin chen bde bsgrod: nub tu pad+ma gar 'gro'i: byang du ye shes 'phyong rtsal: mtshams bzhir rdo rje bde rgyu: de ltar btags pa'i mtshan te yid la zung dang rigs de dang mthun pa'i lhag pa'i lha yis rjes su bzung zhing byin gyis rlabs par 'gyur ro ming ston bya zhing bkra shas rol mo sgrogs de nas mig dar dbye ba ni hūṃ trī: srid pa'i gnas su lhung byed ma rig smag ye shes spyan ras lkog gyur ling tog skyon thabs mchog shes rab gser gyi thur mas bsal: rang byung don gyi lha sku mthong bar shog: yo dzā na tsanyu pra we sha ya phaṭa: de nas lha ngo sprod pa mi e ma ho: dbus ches 'byung zla gam e yi dkyil 'khor ni rang byung bde ba chen por don mtshon pa'i brda'o ye shes 'khor lo rtsibs dgu ni grub sde ma 'dres rang chas su rdzogs pa'i brda'o bde chen pad+ma 'dab bcu ni dbang gi dkyil

'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i brda'oX gru char glo 'bur gyi bkod pa dang ldan pa niX tshad med bzhi dang ye shes kyi gsang lam lhun gyis grub pa'i brda'o:ni phrin las chen po'i mdzad pas gdul zhing thabs kyis bskyongs ba'i brda'o: sgod pa ra ri gsum gyi rtsig pa ni dug gsum dbyings su grol zhing sku brda'o bde chen rak+ta 'khyil ba'i 'dod rnam ni: phyi nang gnas yul mkha' 'gro'i dga' bzhi ye shes kyi gzi byin stobs pa'i brda'o: tshul zhun gyi ga gdos mtshan gyi rtog pa ka nas dag cing 'khor 'das mnyam nyid du ston pa'i brda'o: mig 'bras kyi phreng ba'i drwa ba dang drwa phyed lag pa'i mdo 'dzin da rgyu ba gnas su dag cing ye shes kyi gzigs pa mtha' yas pa'i brda'o: mi rkang gi shar bu ni rgyu ba'i rtogs pa dbyings su gcod cing chos dbyib sa bya pa'i brda'o rgal tshig gi mda' yab ni 'khrul ba'i dpa' bsko zhing dbang phyug chen po'i dpal thob pa'i brda'o: rta babs rnam pa bzhi ni rdzu 'phrul 4

ba:: lam thod rgal du bsgod pa'i brda'o: chos kyi 'khor lo ni 'khor ba dbyings su gcod cing ye shes gabor lor spyor ba'i brda'o: ri dwags chos nyan pho mo brtseb ni gdul bya'i yul la sku gnyis kyi mdzad pa bskul ba'i brda'o: mdzes pa'i gdugs chen ni thugs rje phyogs lhung dang bral zhing phrin las mtha' yas pa'i brda'o: mdzes pa'ibla bre ni 'gro drug nyon mongs gi tsha gdung skyobs pa'i brda'o 'ja' gsum dar gyi 'phur ma can ni sku gsum gyi ye shes rang la chas rang su rdzogs pa'i brda'o: tshon skud sna lnga'i drwa ba bran pa ni: 'khor 'das gnyis med mnyam pa nyid du ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i brda'o rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa ni pha rol du phyin pa drug dang ye shes lnga rang la rang chas su rdzogs pa'i brda'o: mdzes pa stag gzig gi lpags pa'i smad sham ni ma rig rmongs pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi bkod pa kha lo bsgyur ba'i don no: phrin las bzhi'i phur bu'i brten pa ni: bdud bzhi lam du sgong zhing thar 'byin gyi dgongs par bsre ba'i brda'o: rno mtshon ral gri bzhi ni skye bzhi dbyings su gcod cing phyogs 'dzin gyi spros pa ka nas dag par

byed pa'i brda'o mdzes pa'i mda' dar bzhi ni skye 'chi gnyis med kyi dgongs pas gnyug ma'i btsan sa la spyor ba'i brda'o:'od gsal me long bzhi ni mtshan 'dzin gyi spros paka nas dag cing ye shes sgyu 'phrul gyi dga' ston 'gyed pa'i brda'o: dar gyi rgyal mtshan bzhi ni phyogs kyi g.yul ngo las rnam par rgyal zhing tshad med pa'i thugs rje mtha' yas pa'i brda'o:dpal gyi gtor chen ni 'dod yon gyi zhen 'dzin ka nas dag par byed pa'i brda'o:bdud rtsi sman phud ni chos can chos nyid du rgyas gdab par byed pa'i brda'o dpa' skyems rak+ta ni rten 'brel gyi mtshan ma ka nas dag par byed pa'i brda'o:mdzes pa'i bum pa ni snang stong gnyis med kyi dgongs pa'i gzi byin 'bebs pa'i brda'o:bde skyongs bhan+ta byang chub sems bcud kyis bkang ba ni:lhan skyes dpa' bo yab yum gsal stong gnyis med kyi dgongs pa la rol bar byed pa'i brda'o:bcu drug 'dzum bzang

ba tshu 'khor ni rang ngo ka dag la rang chas lhun grub kyi dkyil 'khor don du dbyib sa rig gnyis su mi byed pa'i ye shes chen por ston pa'i brda'o: dpal gyi gtorachen ni lhag pa gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas rang chas rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du don ngo sprod pa'i brda'o brtul zhugs kyi rdzas rnams he ru ka lam du byed pa'i brda'o: 'bar ba'i rdzas rnams shes rab chen po'i gzi byin gyi dbang phyug gnas nas bskul ba'i brda'o: gzhan yang ngo mtshar gyis bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad nges pa lnga ldan gyi mdzad phrin mtha' yas pa gdul bya'i don du rang byung rang shar chen por shar ba'o: des na bu khyod kyas de don thams cad ngo rang shes: ngang mngon gyur rtog pa shar grol kun bzang dgongs mnyam chen po las ma g.yo zhig: ma 'khrul bar thad gar skyongs shig: a phaṭa: de nas daro sa gzhi zhu ba'i yon maṇ+ḍal tshogs ston rgya cher 'bul slobabu'i gsol ba gdab pa ni e ma: sku gsum 'dus zhal pad+ma he ru ga: byin rlabs sprin 'khrigs rdo rje bla ma dgongs: bdag la bde chen rol pa'i dngos gzhi'i dbang yongs

rdzogs dam ldan rnams la gnang bar zhu: lan gsum zhus la bla mas bka' gnang na e ma bde ba mchog gi snod rung skal ldan gson: bdag nyid ma rtsal bde chen dbang gi dal:dros rnams snang stong gsal stong bde stod dang: rig stong ye shes nyid du ye sangs rgyas 'khrul rjes ma 'brang de don shes mdzod dang: bdag gis rgyal thabs spyi blugs dbang bskur ro de nas bum pa thogs la hū hrī mtha' bral bde ba chen po'i bum pa na 'khor 'das gnyis med ye shes bcud kyis gtams dbang chen bde ba mchog gi gzi byin phab:snang stong gnyis med ye shes lha yi dbang: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la bdag gis sbyin: lus dang rtsa yi sgrib pa kun dag nas: bskyed rim sgom rung rdo rje'i sku mchog 'grub tshe ridir rnam smin rig 'dzin sa la sbyor: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal thob 31ga: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṇiñca tshe de nas dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi sku gtad la hūṃ tī gsang chen rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa 'di: rang byung rang shar 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu: dbang chen bde ba mchog sbyin he ru ga: rta skad bzhad pas rū tra'i gdon tshogs

066 'dul: sde brgyad dam 'dogs ma mo las la bskul dbang phyug kun gyi zhing rnams gnas la bskul: dgos dgu kun gyi gter chen he ru ga: bde ba'i dpal sbyin pad+ma gzi ldan yul: phag gdong ngur bab dus mtshan dbyings su sbyor: ma rig rmongs pa'i 'khrul 'khor kha lo bsgyur: gnas yul thams cad gsang sngags chos kyis 'dul: rdo rje 'byung gnas rta phag yab yum gyi: dbang mchog dam pa skal ldan bu la sbyin: gsang sngag snying po'i dgongs pa mngon gyur nas: rta phag bde ba'i gzi byin rab 'bar ste: gnas yul dbang bsgyur gdos po rab zhig nas: spang rtogs yon tan mthar phyin 'thu thob shog rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a snyi ṣiñca tshe: de nas rigs bdag pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi sku gtad la hū trī mi mjed 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing: rdo rje bla ma gu ru gang can mtshos: gsang chen bstan pa'i sgron me rab tu sbar: don la gnyis med pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: bde ba chen po' dbang rnams 'byung ba'i gnas: byin rlabs gter mdzod skal ldan khyod la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a snyi ṣiñca sa: de nas rdo rje rta mgrin yab yul gyi sku

gtad la hūṃ trī bde chen rdo rjes zhe sdang gdon tshogs 'thar: thugs mchog phag mos dag gsal ye shes ston: bde gshegs dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'khrigs skal ldan khyod la thugs gsang dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ḍiñca sa: de nas rin chen rta mgrin yab yum gyi sku gto la hūṃ trī 'dod 'byung bde bas nga rgyal mtshan ma 'joms:rin chen phag mos mnyam nyid dgongs pa ston: bde gshegs yon tan dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dbang skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñca tshe: de nas garma rta mgrin yab yum gyi sku gtad la hūṃ trī bde chen dga' bas 'dod chags 'khrul ba bzlog: pad+ma phag mos gsal stong ye shes ston: bde gshegs gsung mchog dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dbang: skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a bhi ṣiñca tshe: de nas rmā rta 'grin yab yum gyi sku gawa la hūṃ hrī: bde chen thabs kyisaphrag rdog mtshan ma gcod: karma phag mos dag grol gnyis med sngon: bde gshegs phrin las dkyil 'khor rba mtsho'i dbang: smal lngan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sprin: rtsa sngags mthar

badz+ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñca tshe: de nas zal gnon khro bo brgyad kya sku gtad la hū nyi dbang chen bde ba chen pa'i brtul zhugs kyis pho rgyud mo rgyud gza' klu khyung sa bdag 'byung po zil gnon khro rgyal he ru ka gar dbang bde chen yum dang gnyis med 'khril: las mdzad pho nya'i bkod pa bsam mtha' yas: ma lus mnyam nyid ye shes gcig rdzogs dbang: skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñca tshe: de nas khro rgyal sgo bzhi'i sku gtad la hū nyi bde chen dga' bzhi'i rol rtsed 'bar g.yos te: bdud bzhi'i mtshan ma chos nyid dbyings su 'thar: brin las bzhi yis 'khor ba dbyings su 'dren: bka' nyan pho nya bzhi yi dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya.a bhiṣañca ma: de nas khyi spyang r+sā drug gi sku gtad la hūṃ phyi bde chen 'bar ba dbang gi bka' nyan pa: dpal gyi khyi brgyad rngam brjid 'bar ba'i gar: gdug pa'i spyang brgyad za rngamasaglal ba 'byugs: las byed pho nya rnams kyi dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar ka ya a bhi ṣiñca tshe: de nas drwa ba slog 'gyu ma'i sku gto la hā rje bde chen rab 'bar bka' yi pho nya ba

'byung bzhi'i 'brug chen rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan: dam nyams dbyings sgrol drwa ba glog zhags can: ye shes dam can sgog dbang khyod la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a dhi ṣiñca tsho de nas dmu long rgyab 'brel gyi sku gtad la hūṃ trī bde chen gar dbang dpa' bo'i dka' nyan pa: dmu long tshul gyis ma rig 'gro ba sgol: rdzu bag rgyab 'brel 'khor 'das mnyam nyid ston: thabs mkhas pho nya'i srog dbang khyod la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi shikwa skyod: skabs 'dir them med sgrub sde'i dbang yang spro na bskur ro gnyas pa gsang dbang bskur ba ni bharnya bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag la hūṃ hrī bde skyong bharnya ka pā la yi nang: dbang chen yab yum sbyor bas bdud rtsi'i rgyun: kun+dha byang chub sems kyi bcud chen po dbang chen bde ba'i gzi byin nus mthu dbab: snang stong dbyangs gsal snying po'i sngags phreng 'phro bde gshegs kun gyi dgyes bskyed a dṛ ta: las can skal ba bzang po'i lce la bzhag: gsal stong ye shes gnyis med nyams myong zhing: rdzogs rim sgom pa'i snod gyur longs skur spror: tshe 'di nyid la tshe dbang rig 'dzin 'byub: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal thob

ba tshu shog rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas sngags 'khor gto la hū hrī 'khor 'das bde chen rol ba'i mkha' dbyings su: ye shes thugs kyi gsang gsum gcig tu 'khyil don la gnyis med bde chen 'khor lo'i daphyid: gdul bya'i dpal du chos nyid mnyam par bskur: rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas rin pho byu ru' phreng ba gtad la hū hrī: bde gshegs gsang ba gsum bskul ye shes rdzas rin chen byu ru'i phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad: dam pa rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i brten: gsang sngags bzlas pa lhun grub dbang bskur sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca ā de nas dung dkar gam la ཿ trī bkra shis dge ba'i rdzas mchog chos kyi dung: gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po'i sngags mi nub gdul bya'i dpal du lhun gyis grub rten 'brel rtags kyi dbang 'di khyod la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas po ti gam la hā hrī 'bum phrag drug bcu rtsa bzhi'i nying khu mchog: ye shes gcig rdzogs rgyud sde'i glegs bam gyi: bka' dbang dam pa rig 'dzin khyod la sbyin: gsang chen bshad

sgrub bstan pa 'dzin skyongs spel: rtsa sngags mthar wak+ka a de nas 'khor lo gto la hūṃ hrī 'khor ba'i 'khor lo dbyings su rab bsgral nas: gsung gi 'khor lo'i gang 'dul mdzad pa skyongs: mi nub thugs kyi 'khor lor sgrol byed dbang: skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas trī yig gam la hūṃ hrī: 'khor 'das kun gyi byed po ye shes srog: rig darje ma rig rten 'brel byed las tsam: don la ka dag dbyings su sgog gcig pa: dbang chen bde ba'i sngags gzer khyod la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhi ྅kwa ā: de nas slob ma dbang chen gyi bskyed rim ting 'dzin gdengs ldan pas bzlas lung sngags kyi 'byul 'khor na hūṃ hrī: bde chen dbang gi dkyil 'khor mngon gyur pa'i: las kyi slob bu he ru ka dpal gyi: spyi gtsug rta skad mtsher ba'i 'dur glu yis: pho rgyud dregs pa dbang du gyur bsam la sto sgra nyi shu rtsa gcig glu dbyangs len hūṃ hrī: bde chen dbang gi dkyil 'khor mngon gyur pa'i: las kyi slob bu he ru ka dpal gyi: spri gtsug rta skod mtsher ba'i 'dur gla yis: mo rgyad mkha' 'gro dbang du gyur bsam la: trī sgra nyer ༅ga rdo rje'i

ba:tshu dgongs pas sgrogs hū hrī bde chen dbang gi dkyil 'khor mngon gyur pa'i: las kyi slob bu he ru ka dpal gyi: spyi gtsug rta skad mtsher ba'i 'dur glu yis gza' klu dge bsnyen dbang du gyur bsam la: hrī sgra nyer gcig rdo rje'i dgongs pas sgrogs hūṃ nyi bde chen dbang gi dkyil 'khor mngon gyur pa'i las kyi slob bu he ru ka dpal gyi spyi gtsug rta skad mtsher ba'i 'dur glu yis dregs pa sde brgyad dbang du gyur bsam la hrīḥsgra nyer gcig rdo rje'i dgongs pa sa sgrogs hūṃ ༷ bde chen dbang gi dkyil 'khor mngon gyur pa'i las kyi slob bu he ru ka dpal gyi: spyi gtsug rta skad mtsher ba'i 'dur glu yis: pho gdon 'byung po skye med ar la gtad ni sgra nyer gcig rdo rje'i dgongs pas sgrogs hūṃ ༷sa bde chen dbang gi dkyil 'khor mngon gyur pa'i: las kyi slob bu he ru ka dpal gyi: spyi gtsug rta skad mtsher ba'i 'dur glu yis: mo gdon dam sri skye med ar la gtad: hrī sgra nyeragacig rdo rje'i dgongs pa sa sgrogs hūṃ trī bde chen dbang gi las kyi spri gtsug gti mug las byung gla gnyan ar la gtad: trīḥsgra nyer gcig rdo rje'i dgongs pas sgrogs hā rdi bde chen

dbang gi bde chen dbang gi dkyil 'khor mngon gyur pa'i: las kyi slob bu he ru ka dpal gyi: spyi gtsug rta skad mtsher ba'i 'dur glu yis: gri bo gshed 'khyams skye med ar lagatad: trīḥsgra nyer gcig rdo rje'i dgongs pas sgrogs hūṃ nyibadochen dbang go dkyil 'khor mngon gyur pa'i: las kyi slob bu he ru ka dpal gyi spyi gtsug rta skad mtsher ba'i 'dur glu yis: rgya 'dre srin po skye med ar la gtad: gisgra nyer gcig rdo rje'i dgongs pas sgrogs hūṃ nyidapa' bo'igadong ba bshad pas khams gsum g.yo dpa' mo'i phag gdong ngur bas srid gsum bskyod: dbyer med dgongs pas sde brgyad dbyings su ba na mi g.yo bde klong thig le gcig tu bsre: gisgrapho sgra nyi shu rtsa gcag brjod 'khor 'dasaganyis med dgongs pa'idabyingasasu bsre rol mo sgrogs shing chos nyid don la bzhag gsum pa shes rab ye shes dbang bskur ni rig ma lang tshos 'byud pa gto la hūṃ rdi bdobalidapal sbyin 'dzum pa'i yid 'ong ma: pad+ma dung can ri mo glang sna can: rigs lnga'i rtags 'dzin bcu drug dga' ster ma: mthong bas yid 'phrog badz+ra wa ra hi: gnyis med mnyam pa'i sku can dza na mo: dam ldan rig pa 'dzin pa

bsgotshu khyod la gtad bud med ma spang bde ba dang du longs dbab bskyil 'dren bkram sngags kyi lta dgongs la: brten te yid dang thig le'i sgrib pa bcom bde stong tsan+d+ra sur+ya sgom la dbang: chos kyi sku mchog thob pa'i skal ba ldan tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin 'grub don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal thob shog: rtsasngagasamathar pra dz+nyā dz+nyā na a nu rā ga a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: de nas ska shad gto lahwa phyi 'bar ba'i rang bzhin bde ba'i dbang phyug ma: bskyod pa'i rang bzhin dga' ba'i 'dzum bzang ma 'khril ba'i rang bzhin bskul ba'i rnga sgra ma: bde mchog gzhi nas slong phyir khyod la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar pra dz+nyā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: de nas rtoyig gto la/ nyingo bo sprosadang bral ba'i bcom ldan 'das rang bzhin mchog tu mi 'gyur he ru ka rol ba kun khyab brdal ba byang chub sems bde mchog sprin phung spro phyir khyod la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar pra dz+nya dz+nya na a bhi ṣiñca /: de nas ye yig gam la hū ༷sa dbang phyug lnga la spyod pa'i stob po che: 'khor 'das gnyis su 'gro ba'i brtul zhugs can: thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba'i shugs

ldan pa: ye shes ste/nga nas 'char phyir casad la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar bra dz+nyā dz+nya na a bhi shi mi hūṃ: zem med phyag mtshan gyi dbang rnams 'dir bya bzha pa ka dag tshag dbang ni 'ja' shel mdangs ldan gtad la hūṃ trī gdod nasamatshan ma mi dmigs ka nas dag: bsam brjod rtogs pa'i spros pa kun kyang grol sangs rgyas sems can gnyis med ye sangs rgyas: don dam lhan skyes rangabyung ye shes zhal: dpe yis mi mtshon tshig gi spros pa dag: brjod bya las 'das khas len kun dang bral skyon med nyag gcig gsang ba chen po 'di: rtogs na skad cig kun bzang dgongs pa mthong: dri ma med pa'i brda thabs shel gong la: lhun gyis grub pa'i 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul mdzod brda rgyud tsam du khyod la bdag gis gtad: dgongs pa dbyer med mchog gi don mthong ste: cha mnyam sgrib pa chos nyid mkha' la sangs: ka dag skye med dgongasapa skyongasal dbang: ngo bo nyid kyi sku mchog thob par byed: tshe 'di nyid la lhun grub rig 'dzin 'grub: khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po'i dbang thob regag: rtsa sngags mthar a a ā de nas me longs gtad la hūṃ hrī rtogabasapa'i grwa zur kun bral thig le che

bsgo/: bag chags nog ma'i ma gos dwang zhing gsal: sna tshogs ma 'dres rab gsal a dar+sha: don dam rtags kyi dbang mchog bu la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar a abhi ṣi hrī: de nas rma bya'i sgro mdongs gtad laju nyi dug gis dug 'joms mdongs ldan bkra ba'i gzugs: bag chag dri mas ma gos ye shes gsang: 'pho med dgongs pa'i brdadabang bu la sbyin: ye grol dgongs pa mngon gyur dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar a a snyi ṣiñca hrī: de nasag mtha gtad la hū nyi skye med dbo ngas pa ka dag spros dang bral 'gag med rang sgra brjod bral don gyi gsung: yig 'bru kun gyi rgyal po ā:mthing 'di: don dam rtogs phyir rigs ldan bu la spyin: rtsa sngags mthar ā a bhi 〉〉 hrī: de nas 'odalnga'i thig le gtad la hūṃ nyi rang byung rang gsal kun nas zlum pa che: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phro ba 'di: don dam lhan skyes gsang gsum mtshon pa'i brda: rtags kyi dbangabaskur rigs ldan bu la gtad: rtsa sngags mthar ā a sti ṣiñca hrī: rtsa dbang thig le stong sgron gyi brda thabs la brten nas ngo sprad pa ni hā nyi tshogs sgroX lasa'adza 'dzom pa'i skal ba can

'khor 'das gshis lugs rig stong thad gar skyongs: rtog pas bsam tu med de nam mkha' che: blo yis dpyad du med do zang ma thal: sems kyis dmigs su med do ka nas dag tshig tu brjod bya bral lo dngos po dag: dpe yis mtshon du med do yul las 'das don gyis ston bya bral lo khyab brdal klong: yin pas rtsis gdab bral lo chos kun zad min pas phyogs 'dzin mi dgos kun bzang klong re dogs spros pa bral lo gdengs bzhi'i ngang: 'di don rtogs na mtshan ma'i sbubs las grol: rang byung ye shes don gyi rtogs pa 'char: phun tshogs lnga ldan zhing gi bkod pa 'byung: nyag gcig don gyi sangs rgyas zhal ras mjal: khyad chos drug ldan rgyal sar mnga' dbang bsgyur: mtha' bral rta phag dkyil 'khor mngon du gyur: sku gsum mdzad pa phrin las gter chen spyod: don gnyis lhun grub chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur: 'khor ba dong sprug mdzad pa mthar phyin sgo ga: rtsa sngags mthar a phaṭa: a phaṭa sa phaṭa ma bcos rig ngo thad gar sprod rtogs ldan myong ba'i rgyud tshul lo sa ma yā de nas mtha' rten gtor dbang rgya mtsho ni spros par dga' na zur bkod ltar du bya

badz+ra 'on kyang 'ad ltar byas kyang rung ba'o oṃ ātu brdal khyab ka dag dbyings kyi bhan+ta rtsa brtan g.yo'i dpal bcud rdzogs pa'i gtor chen bshams: nyi zla 'odazer 'bar ba'i rgyan gyis spras: 'dod yon lnga ldan lha mos spro bsdu 'gyed:rtsa brgyud reg 'j-in bla ma'i gzi byin 'byug: yi dam rgyud sde rab 'byams sprin phung 'khrigs 'bum phrag ḍāk+ki rgya mtshos bde stong stobs: rdo rje'i srog ldan bo nya'i phrin las spel:ye shes 'od lnga'i 'ja' gur mdzes pa 'di: skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin: sgrubadang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dpal dbang thob: bar do drug grol sku gsum btsan sa zin: g.yin phan phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam shog: rtsa sngags mthar maṇ+ḍal bha thang ta a bhi shi rdzog āhūṃ nyi gnas gsum la gams smon lam bya ba ni yin āhūṃ rgyal ba dgonges brgyud kyi bla ma: rig 'dzin brda brgyud kyi bla ma gang zag snyan brgyud kyi bla ma shog ser tshig brgyad kyi bla ma: bka' bab don brgyad kyi bla ma: smon lam 'bras smin gyi bla ma: rdzogs chen brgyad pa drag ldan gyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyis:rdo rdzelislab ma

rnams la dbang bskur du gsol: byin gyis brlab tu gsol rtogs pa spar du gsol: brtul zhugs bskyed du gsol nyams snang 'phel bar mdzad du gsol: mi g.yo dgongasapa'i btsan sa zin nas tshe lus 'di nyid la dbang chen bde mchog rol pa'i gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul gyi 'khor lo la longs spyod par gyur cig sarba a snyikhiñca saswa :hrī mtha' rten bkra shis rdzasartags dang rgyal srid sna bdun gtad par bya dam tshig khasalen sgo gsum 'bul rjes su sdom pa srog ltar 'chang de mthusanyams rtogasozla ltar 'phel tshe ri nad med lang tsho rgyas lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du'agyur dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'bral med 'grogs dam can pho nyas phrin las sgrub rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin gyis brlabs yi dam rgya mtshos daro sa grub stsol lhan skyes ḍazhisabade sto bskyed rigs 'dzin lnga yi gsang lam bsgrod dbangachen he ru'i btsan gzin 'di yo yon tan bsam mi khyabaḥ kun gyi 'byung gnasadabang zab mo srog gi dam tshig dang bcas pa mi nyams thugs kyi dkyal du 'chong gzu bor gnas bzhin rtag tu srungs sa ma yu yim rgyal bamidabangapo pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongasa'agro la shin tu thugasabartse bas mtha' dbus thams cad gter gyis yongs su bkang las can bu dang 'phrad pa'i smon lam btab khyad par zab gsang rdo nge snying po'i skor grub pa' dbang phyuga'abrog ban

ga ji: lotsad dbang chen bga' bab rgyal ba mchog dbya sa la bka' brtsisabatab te dam tshig gnyer byang sbyin da lta spel ba'i du la ma bab pas rin chen brda la bstims shig sa ra phyo mdo kham du dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon cha'i gzengs pa lang pa' tshe dpa' bo khyed zung sprul pa las can rgyas zab gsang 'di 'byed bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel 'gro don phrin largyas 'brel chad don ldan pa d+ma 'od du bkod don gnyas lhun gyis grub pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' 'di srungs shig gnod sbyan btsan rgod rgyal snod min lag tu ma shor spu gri mched gdams bcud zagasasu ma 'jug las can bu la sprod cig dregasapa'i tshogs sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya bde chen zil gnon rgyal po'i dbang ོnga ye shes kyi gsang mdzod rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu gye yo rgyan gyi slob dpo bka' bdag 'dramakhar chen bza bkod pa'o bdo zim snyi zhes pa 'ad yang lung zan chos kya bdag popad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rje bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du ma dang bcasate 'bad rtsol lhur len gyi sgo nas bskul ngor chen dgyes 'i rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gas ba'i 'phrul bdo las zhal bshusate chosabadag 'gyur med rgya mche tshogs chen yul ba'i thun gseng du dag par phab pa 'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa'o/sarba masgo le/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi them med go cha'i lha dbang zab mo bzhugs so:a: na 3 gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: sgo—141 bdud dpung zel gnon dbang chen rtsa ba'i lha mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du rol las can skal bzang rig pa 'dzin pa yis sgo gar dbang gi smin par bya ba'i phyar drag po' dbang rdzo byan rlabs ba mdzod kyi: go cha'i la dbang them med rim pa bstan sa ma yā lasaldan gral bsdu dri ma khrus kyis sbyangs bgegs tshogs bsal la bsrung ba' rwa gur phub shes dbab bsnyim snang sto bum dab rjes zu 'jug la sku'i dbang rnams rdzogs par bskur de nas go cha'i dbang bskur zab mo ni maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gdab pa na kye rdo rigs dang dkyil 'tshogar bdag bla ma dgongs: sangs rgyas dngos grub bde ba mchog gi dbang: ye shes sgyu 'phrul dgongs pa rdo rje che mi 'gyur go cha'i dbang bskur stsal du gsol: gsol ba lan gsum bawa nas bde chen yon to gyi go cha bgo ba ni hū niye nas ma bcos bde ba chen po'i klong: rin chen rigs kun gsang mdzod yon tan rgyal: sku mchog ya man+ta ga'i dbang bskur ro:

rgyal gdon gyi g.yul las rab rgyal shog: rtsa sngags mthar ya man+ta ka ya ma ra tsa rat+na a bhi ṣiñca tre: de nas chags bral bde ba'i go cha bgo ba ni3 nyi chags pas ma spyodas pad+ma ltar dgapa'i: bde ba kun gyi gsang mdzod gsung gi rgyal: che ba'i dbang phyug mchog gi dbang bskur ro: bar chad bdud kyi g.yul las rab rgyal shog: rtsa sngags mthar ma hā kro ta shrī heru ka pad+ma a bhi ṣiñca trī: de nas ye shes thugs kyi go cha bgo ba ni hūṃ nyi dre med thugs nimakha' ltar dag pa'i klong: gzhom bral rdo rje'i rwa gur bde chen ngang: ye shes thugs mchog yangadag dbang bskur ro: zhe sdang gdon gyi g.yul las rab rgyal shog: rtsa sngags mthar:sho ma hā ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa badz+ra a bhi ṇiñca hūṃ de nas rab 'bar brtul zhugs kya go cha bgo ba ni hūṃ sdi gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i gar: bdud dpung zil gnon rdo rje'i sku mnga' ba: brin las mi zad stobs kyi dbang bskur ro: chags 'khrul gdug pa'i g.yulalas rab rgyal shog: rtsa sngags mthar snyikro ta rku li ki la ya badz+ra bhi dza a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas bde rol mi 'gyur mchog gi go cha bgo ba ni hūṃ nyi bdochen grer pa 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i

badz+ra gsang: 'char ga'i gzi 'bar dbang phyug dga' chen klong: za byed ma mo yongs rdzogs dbang bskur ro: kheng zhing rtsod pa'i g.yul las rnam rgyal shog: rtsasngags mthar gu h+ya dz+nyā na pañca ma hā dṛ hūṃ a bhi ṣiñca swā: de nas zal gajon drag po 'a go cha bgo ba ni hūṃ nyi mtshan ma mi dmigs bde ba chen po'i slong: gnyis snang rū tra'i dpa' bskongabartul zhugs can: dregs pa kun 'dul nus pa'i dbang bskur ro: mthu ldan dregs pa'i g.yul las rab rgyal re ga rtsa sngags mthar badz+ra tsartse sarba dus ma hā su kha a bhi ṣiñca hā de nas nus mthu stobs kyi go cha bgo ba ni hū nyi ma rig bdud dpung dbyings su tshar gcod cing: gang 'dul mdzad pa phrin las thabs mkhas pa'i: stobs ldan zil gnon rtsal gyidabang bskur ro: log 'dren bar chad g.yul las rgyal bar shog: rtsa sngags mthar sarba du ca e dza bh+yo: tig na badz+ra rak+ṣa a bhi ṣiñca hā: de nas sra brtan phrin las kyi go cha bgo ba ni hū ༷ 'gyur med gnam lcags go khrab mig mang ris: bka' sdod sdig phag khyung nag tsha tshwas gtams: rab 'bar pho nya'i bka' dbang bu la sbyin: nus mthu dpal dang yon tan

stobs 'byor shog: rtsa sngags mthar ka la ru pa garma a bhi ṣiñca t+t+waṃ: de nas dam tshig 'gyur ba med pa 'i go bgo ba ni hūṃ nyi ma chags pad nyi zla ba rgyas pa'i khar: chos sku mi 'gyur ye shesathugs kyi gsang bde chen rdo rje gar gyi brtul zhugs can: dgongs pa mi 'gyur rtogs phyir khyod la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar dz+nyā na sa twa a bhi ṣiñca hrī: de nas ye shes srog ga go cha bgo bani hūṃ hrī bde chen rdo rje 'pho 'gyur mi mnga' ba: dwangs ma ye shes sgog gi go ru can skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la gtad: ting 'dzin 'gyur med rtogs pa'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar dz+nyā na tsit+ta sa ma dhi a snyi ṣiñca hūṃ de nas dur khrod dpal chas gtad la hūṃ nyi thal chen khrag thig zhag gi zo ris dang: ko rlon g.yang gzhi stag gi sham thabs dang thod phreng sbrul chen rus rgyan dpa' ba'i chas deng 'dir rdo rje slob ma khyod la bgo: tshogs yul rang grol he ru ka thob nas: gdul dka' nyon mongs 'dul ba'i dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar garma duṣ+ṭan ka la k+ta bh+yo a snyi ṣiñca hūṃ: de nas me tog 'thor la bden brjod ni hūṃ shrī gdul dka' 'dul mdzad drag po mthu yi dbang: smon lam stobs rdzogs

'a tshu gzhan phan mtha' yas pa: mngon spyod drag po'i yon tan rab 'byams kyi: byin rlabs dbang mchog nus mthu stobs rdzogs shog: rtsa sngags mthar maṅga le gu ṇa a bhi ༷do/ ces ā:hūṃ trī: dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo bsgor des ni dbang da dngos grub thob bar chad bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal don gnyas lhun grub ze tshom med sa ma yu ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang bo pad+ma saṃbha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro 'a lag par thugs brtse bas mtha' dbusathams cad rin chen gter gyis bkang khyad pa ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po' chos grub pa' dbang phyug las ldan zung la gtad da dung spel ba' dus la ma babapas rin chen brdar bstims bkra shis rdzong du sbos ma 'ongs snyigs ma nad mtshon gzengs lang tshe rgyal tshab las lan bu yi gsang bkrol nas 'gro don phrin las byang gi phyogs nas spel 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god bka' gsang 'ad srung btsan rgod yang le ber dam nyams lag tu ma shor thub par srungs las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya them med go cha'i la dbang rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gya slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa 'a bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o brda zim snyi zhes pa 'di yang lung zin cho kyi bdag po pad+ma'i mtshan can gya bskul ngor/ kho bo dbang chen bzhad pa rtsal
gyis mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod dag pa ra phab pa' yi ge pa'ang chosabadag nyid kyis bgyis pa'o/ sarba masgo le/ dge'o bkra shis/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi: brtul zhugs drag po mtshon cha'i dbang zab mo bzhugs so:rmi: na 31 gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: 'a // dbang chen pad+ma bde ba' gzi byan can rta mgran rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal lo ma 'ong sa las ldan smin zhing grol ba'i phyir brtul zhugs drag po mtshonacha'i dab la 'jug sa ma wā slob ma grwal bsdu sgrib tshogs khrus kyis sbyangs bgegs tshogs glud kyis brngan la srung 'khor phub ye shes dbab bstim pa tshogs ro gcig bsre de nas maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol gdab ni tshurme rdo sangs rgyas kun 'dus rdo rje slob dpon dgongs bdag gi sgo gsum smin zhing grol ba dang: dregs pa zil gnon nus mthu phun tshogs phyir brtul zhugs nus pa'i dbangamachog stsal du gsol: lan gsum zhus la bla mas bka' stsal ba ho: thabs mchog bde ba lam byed rnal 'byor la brtul zhugs nus mthu mngon spyod dpal thob phyir thabs mchogabade chen rgyal po che ba'i dbang: he ru ka dpal bdag gis rtsal bar bgyi:rnam gsum gcig bsre dam tshig dag pa yis drag po brtul zhugs phrin las dbang la sprod: don

gnyis lhun grub chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur:bsod nams skal ba ldan no rigs kyi bu: de nas brtul zhugs mtshon chas dab bskur phyar dbang chen yab yum gsal ye shes dbab bstams brtanapar btsos thog mar ral gra gto byas te hūṃ nyigazung 'ardzan mtshan ma dbyings su gcod byed cing:ma rig 'khrul 'khor chos skur bshigs pa'i phyir:rtags kyi dbang mchog shesarab ral gri 'di:skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin:rtsa sngags mthar karma duṣ+ṭan a bhi ṣiñca nyu:de nas thod khrag gto la hūṃ nyim reg gnyes snang dbu mar rol byed cing sridapa'i rtsa ba bde chen klong du sbyor:rtags kyi dbang mchog thod khrag 'khyil ba 'di skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin:rtsa sngags mthar garma duṣ+ṭan a bhi ṣiñca 〉:de nas zod gagato la hūṃ nyidu tra bsgral b.lidapa' rtags che ba'i rdzas:brdung byed thod dbyug 'bar ba'i gzi ngar can:rtags kyi dbang mchog bde chen phyag mtshan 'di:skal ldan rig pa'adzin pa khyod la sprin:rtsa sngags mthar garma da na a sdi 〉〉 ྅:de nas sbrul zhags gtad la hūṃ dzilog par lta ba'i'akhyang po tshar gcod cing:ma rig rmongs pa'i 'khyal snang dbyings

gas/: sbyor phyir:rtags kyi dbang mchog sbrul zhags rngam pa 'di skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyan rtsa sngags mthar garma duṣ+ṭan a bhi ṣiñca nyu:de nas rdo rje rtse lnga gtad la hūṃ trī bde chen rdo rjes rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba 'dren:ye shes rdo rjes nyan mongs dbyings su bcom rtags kyi dbang mchog gnam lcags rdo rje 'di:skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin:rtsa sngags ma thar garma duṣ+ṭan a bhi ṣiñca lha:de nas gri gug gtad la hūṃ hrī ma rig nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i rgyun gcod cing:bde chen ye shes gar gyi dgo sa par bsre:rtags kyi dbang mchog gri gug 'bar ba 'di:skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin:rtsa sngags mthar garma duṣ+ṭan a bhi ṣiñca lha:de nas 'od 'bar nyi ma gtad la hūṃ hrī ma rig mun khams dbyings su sangs byed ci :drag po'i gzi byin nus mthu'i stobs mnga' ba'i:rtags kyi dbang mchog rta bdun 'bar ba 'di:skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sprin:rtsa sngags mthar garma duṣ+ṭan a ji ṣiñca hūṃ:de nas bsil ldan zla ba gtad la hūṃ hri nyon mongs las kyi tsha gdung kun sel zhang:ye shes bde ba mchog gi bsil

sbyin pa'i rtags kyi dbang mchog ri bong 'dzin pa 'di: skal ldan rig pa dzin pa khyod la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar garma duṣ+ṭan a snyi ṣiñca (: de nas lcags kyu ga༅ la hūṃ trī tshad med thugs rjes 'gro ba gnas nas 'dren: ye shes gzigs pas gdul bya'i mthun snang bkod: rtags kyi dbang mchog lcags kyu 'bar ba 'di: skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin: rtsa sngagasamathar garma duṣ+ṭan a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: de nas lcags sdig nag po gto la hū trī: rgyal bsen dam sri'i snying khrag lhud byed cing sde brgyad dregs pa ma lus las la 'jun:rtags kyi dbang mchog lcag sdig 'bar ba 'di: skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar garma duṣ+ṭan a bhi ṣiñca nyu: de nas spu gri dang snyi zhags gtad la hūṃ trī:mtshan 'dzin rtog pa rab gcod spu gri dang: zhing bcu'i don snying 'byin pa'i dpa' rtags rdzas: thabs dang shes rab 'grel ba'i rtags dbang 'di: skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar garma duṣ+ṭan a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: de nas dgra stu gas pa gam la hūṃ hri ma rig mtshan 'dzin rtsad gcod dgra sta dang: byad ma 'ching byed byams pa'i zhags pa

ba tshu ste:gnyis med phyag rgya bde ba'i rtags dbang 'di skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin:rtsa sngags mthar garma duṣ+ṭan a snyi ṣiñca (:de nas rdo rje dang dungakhrag gtad la hūṃ trī:thabs kyi rdo rje snang ba zil gnon rdzas:shes rab bde sbyor dmar chen bhan+ta zung:gnyis med bde klong rtags kyi dbang mchog 'di:skal ldan rig pa 'dzinapa khyod la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar game duṣ+ṭan a bhi ṣiñca nyu:da nas 'bor lo dang bhasnye gtad la hūṃ nyichos nyid mi 'gyur thugs kyi 'khor lo dang:snang ba thabs la bde sbyin bhan dmar bcas:zung 'jug gar gyi phyag rgya rtags dbang 'di:skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin:rtsa sngags mthar garma duṣ+ṭan a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ:de nas rdo rje dang phur pa gtad la hūṃ nying bdag zil gnon gnam lcag rdo rje dang:du tra'i snying 'byin ri rab phur pa te:gnyis med phyag rgya rtags kyi dbang mchog 'di:skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin:rtsa sngagasamathar garma duṣ+ṭan a snyi ṣiñca hūṃ de nas wāg to dang bhasto gtad la hā trī:bdud bzhi dbyings su 'thar byed dbyug to dang:srid pa'i ma mo 'bul rdzogs bhan dmar bcas thabs

shes bde sbyor rtags kyi dbang mchog 'di skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin:rtsa sngags mthar garma duṣ+ṭan a snyi ṣiñca nyu:da nas la chan gya mgo bo dang tri shul gtad la hūṃ trī:khengs sems gdung pa'i dpa' dkong wa chen mgo:dug gsum 'khrul ba rtsad gcod tri shu la:mngon spyod drags po rtag kyi dbang mchog 'di:skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin:rtsa sngags mthar garma duṣ+ṭan a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ:de nas klu chen gya tsit+ta da tho ba gtad la hūṃ hrī:gti mug rmongs pa'i 'gro ba rab sgrol zhing:mtshan 'dzin 'byung po'i mgo lus 'thag byed 'di rtags kyi dbang chen tho ba nā ga'i snying:skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin:rtsa sngags mthar garma duṣ+ṭan a snyi ṣiñca /:de nas rgya gram dang spu gra gtad la/ hrī tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro khams kha lo 'asgyur:mngon spyod drag pos zhing bcu dum bur gtubs:rtags kyi dbang mchog rgya gram spu gri 'di skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin:rtsa sags mthar garma duṣ+ṭan a bhi ṣiñca 〉:da nas mtshon cha sna tshogs gtad la hūṃ trī:ye shes rang gdangs las kyi mtshon cha ni:rno zhing ngar ba'i nus mthu phun tshogs ldan:

bsgolho zhing bcu thal bar brlag byed rtags kyi dbang: skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar garma duṣ+ṭan a bhi ṣiñca nyu: de nas thun rdzas sna tshogs gtadal hū hrī las nyon ma rig 'khrul ba'i rū tra rnams: rdul du brlag byed thun rdzas zor cha rnams: zhing bcu rjes su 'dzin phyir rtags kyi dbang skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar garma duṣ+ṭan a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: de nas brtul zhugs zhus pa'i dbang ḍa dril 'grel la 'di skad do hū rdi snang ba 'di ni bde chen zhing: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor ste: mtshan 'dzin gdon gyi ming yang med: dbang chen zla gam a la la: hū nyi snang ba 'di ni mkha' spyod zhing: dbang chen pad+ma brtsegs pa'i dal: gnyis chos mtshan mtha gar grol: zang thal ye shes a la la: snang ba 'di ni chos kyi dbyings: ka dag bde chen spros dang bral: gti mug rtog pa rnam par dag: chos dbyings ye shes a la la:snang ba 'di ni mngon par dga': dri med 'od gsal thig le'i klong: zhe sdang rtogs pa rnam par dag me long ye shes a la la: snang ba 'di ni dpal dang ldan: mnyam nyid

rol pa chen po la:nga rgyal mtshan 'dzin rnam par dag:ro mnyam ye shes a la la:snang ba 'di nipad+ma brtsegs:bde chen dga' bzhi'i rol ston rdzogs:'dod chags mtshana'adzin spros dang bral:kun gsal ye shes a la la snang ba 'di ni las rab rdzogs thams cad dag mnyam chen po la:phrag dog rtog pa rnam par dag:bya ba lhun grub a lal:hrī:bdag tu lta ba'i rū tra 'di:sprul sku dbang chen he ru ga'i:yul med zang thal klong bsgral nas:bde chen rdo rje a la la:bdag tu rtog pa'i du tra 'di:longs sku rtamachog he ru ga'i gzhi med rtsa bral ngang bsgral nas:'bar 'khrugs bde 1nga a la la bdag tu 'jin palirū tra 'di:chos sku dbang chen rgyal po yis:'khor 'das kunakhyab ngang bsgral nas:mtha' bral 'gag med a la la ye:dbang chen zla gam bde ba'i klong:thogs bcas bdud tshogs thabs kyis bsgral:thogs med shes rab rnon posa'abigaḥdaga' brod rig pa'i gar gyis 'joms:snyems byed 'od gsal dgongs par bsres:ma rig rba 1nga thad gar sangs:sku gsum 'khor lor longs spyod cing:bde

ba tshu chen rdo rje'i mdzad pa skyongs: 'khor 'das dag mnyam a la la: zhe brjod la rtog pa hur byung sems rtog dbying sa la bor rig pa 'od gsal skyongs sku gsum ye shes kya 'khor lo la longs spyod par bya'o de ltar mngon spyod drag po'i dab brtul zhugs nus pas gzi byan phabs nyams rtog yon tan zlo ltar 'phel don gnyis lhun grub the tshom med sa ma yā ye ma rgyalaba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la shin tu brtse sems kyi snyi dang 'dra ba'i yang zab rmad byung ba grub pa'i dbang phyug 'brog ban lo tsa da dbang chen bka' bab rgyal ba mchog dbyangs la man ngag bka' dbang yid bzhan nor bu stsal da dung spel ba'i dul la ma bab pas rin chen brda la bstims shig ra bye mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgong pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyig ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gzengs pa long pa'i tshe dpa' bo khyed zung sprul ba las ldan gyis gsang chen 'di bkrol bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug 'gro don phrin las lho bya phyogs su 'byung 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god don gnyas sdun gyis grub pa 'i rten 'brel yod sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya brtul zhugs mngon spyod kyi dbang rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda zim snyi zhes pa 'di yang

chosakyi bdag po sku skyesapad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rje bkra shis dge ba'i rdzas du ma dang bcasate ya yang bskul ro ra/ kho po dbang chen bshad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bzhus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi bdag po nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma la/

lo1 4thernamarnami3rna zun steshezurnamab tshugusna'i r+shasgyugyes khri76 zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:dbang chen zil gnon rtsal gyi dgos dbang dregs pa las la khrun pa'i dbang rdzong gdug pa'i snying chun bzhugs so:

ba tshu na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: misabye〉〉 bde po 'bar ba dbang gi bdag nyid can rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal lo sde brgyad dreg pa bran du bkol ba'i phyir zab mo dbangamachog gdug pa'i snying 'byin bstan sa ma yu bdag mdun bum bzlas tshogs bsags rig me dor slob ma grwal bsdu khrus dang bgegs tshogs bsgrad bsrung gur bsgom la bden don lo rgyus bshad maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol bgadab pa na kyi: rigs dang dkyil 'khor bdag po bla ma dgongs mos ldan bdag cag sgrub mchog pho mo la: dregs pa las la 'chun pa'i brtul zhugs dbang: da lta nyid du gnang ba'i bka' drin zhu: lan gsum zhu de nas bla mas lan gnang ba ho: 'dir 'tshogs rigs can pho mo skal ba bzang: yang gsang sgo 'di 'phrad pa bsod nams che dregs pa las la 'chun pa'i dbang dgos na: dam tshig sgog gi khas len 'di dgos so: de na slob bus khas len ni ho: dgongasapa mchog tu mi 'gyur gsang sgog 'dzin: dam tshig kun gyi rgyal po sgog dang sbrel: sde brgyad snying po rdo rje gsang bar gcun: 'byung khams dang blang ye shes gzi byin dbab dgyes zas dpa' zas rngams zas gang 'os 'bul: gnyer

—41 gtad gnyer bskul regs phung las rnams bcol:gnyis med bde ba'i las mchog rab sgrub na:gsang chen sgog dbang zab mo bdag gis sbyin:de nasaskyabs sems tshogs bsags rgya cher bya gsang ba las kyi sdom pa 'dzin pa na ho:gsang chen rdo rje snying po'i sgor zhugs nas:spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig 'dzin:so thar sdom bzungasnying nas gzhan gnod spangs:byang sems sdom bzung don gyi gzhan phan sgrub:gsang sngags dam srung snang srid dag mnyam spyod:bstan pa'i gnyer blang sbyor sgrol dang du len sems can don phyir sha khrag spyod par byed:snying rje chen pos zhing bcu rjes su 'dzin:de ltar ldan na drag po'i dbang bskur stsol:lan gsum zhus rjes dam chu sbyin pa ni ho:bla med gsang ba mchog gi mna' chu 'di:sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i bcud:rdo rje khro bo rdul chen 'khrigs pa'i skyems:dam ldan slob ma khyod kyi lce la bzhag:dmatshig srung na dbang byin nyams rtogs bskyed:nyams par gyur na bka' yi chad pa gcod:phung 'chings nus pa gsang chen khyad chos can:gzu bor gnas mdzod dam ldan rig
