pa 'dzin: badz+ra sa ma ya na ra gan: gtor mar bran zhang slob ma'i lce la bzhag de nasaslob ma lha ru gsal ba ni oṃ ma hā shuh+ye ta sogs ko3 nya: gzung 'dzin mtshan ma chos kyi dbyings su sbyang stong pa'i ngang las dag chen zhing bkod ni: bde chen dbang drag rol pa gsung gi dal rngam brjid thod mkhar me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus bza' klu dregs pa sde brgyad bsnol ba'i steng stsadamar las byung slob ma dbang chen sku dmar nag khro gtum rngam brjid gar dgus 'khyud: zhal gdengs ljags 'dril drag po'i gad rgyang sgogs: phyag g.yas ral gris 'byung po'i phung khams gtubs: g.yon pas sdigs mdzub lcags kyus sde brgyad 'gugs: dbu gtsug rta dbu bzhad pa'i pho nya 'gyed: gtum drag me ltar 'bar ba'i gzi mdangs ngom: sku dbyings dwangs gsal rgya mtsho lta bu'i klong: rgyud sde rab 'byams til gong phyur bzhin gtams: rang rang bka' nyan pho nya las la gcun:khyad par snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo phu gser gyi mchod rten bang rim bum tog rdzogs de 'og gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsib bcu la: dregs pa sde bcu'i srog yig thur bstan

badz+ra gnas:bum pa tshad med sdig khyung phag seng 'phro:ye shes rang mdangs mtshon cha'i gzi byin 'byug:bum nang gza' the' dregs pa sde brgyad steng gu ru drag po dmar nag me phreng sku:khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs me klong 'gying:phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs 'da' 'khu ldogs pa'i sde brgyad ar la gtad:g.yon pas lcags sdig nag po'i snying nas gtser:rgyal bsen dam sri'i snying khrag lhud par byed:dri ma mi zhim dpag tshad rgyang grags 'phro dus mtha'i ma rung gdon rgod 'bog brgyal byed lta stangs gzir ba'i 'od kyis dregs tshogs 'gugs:stangs stabs bsgyur bas sde brgyad las la bcun:sgeg bzhad glu yis 'khor ba kha lo bsgyur 'od 'bar me yis ma rig mun khams bsregs:thugs ga'i 'od zer tsha la rtsub pa yis:sde brgyad snying po btson du bzung ba gcun:rang rang dregs tshogs dbang med rdul ltar 'tshubs sgog snying lhud byung he ru ka la phul:kun kyang mgos gtud phyag phul dam khas blangs:pad+ma dbang gi bran du khol bar dmigs slar yang gnas gsum rdo rje'i

sa bon las: 'od 'phros rgyal kun spyan drangs dbyer med bstim: sha chen dud gtang rol ma'i sgras bskul te hūṃ nyi dbang chen me ri 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas: rta mgrin bde ba'igazi 'bar rū tra'i gshed: gar dbang phag mo ma rig gdon 'dul yum: gnyis med bde ba chen por spyan 'dren gshegs bder gshegasakun 'dusi dpal chen sgrub sde dgu ye shes gcig la rnam rol bsam mtha' yas: gtso 'khor sprul ba dpon g.yog mdzad tshul gyis: mos ldan byin gyis brlabs phyir gshegs su gsol rngam brjed rnga yab lho nub dpal ri nas: 'gro ba'i mgon po o rgyan chos kyi rje: lo paṇa rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams: dam ldan byin gyis brlabs phyir gshegs su gsol stong khams skus gang lus la gzi byin phob grags stong sngags kyis sgra mtshan rang sar grol: ye shes thugs kyis rtogs pa mngon gyur mdzod: skal ldan sgrub pa po la dbang bzhi bskur log 'dren 'byung po zil gyis gnon pa dang dregs pa las la 'khrun pa'i gzi byin phob hrī pad+ma kro ta mahā shrī he ru ka ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo ha he phaṭa: badz+ra ma hā gu ru : ma ha ri ni

ba tshu sa ra tsa trī ya tsit+ta hrī hrī dza:dza: sarba sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: e a ra li trī hri dza dza: badz+ra a we sha ya a ā ye shes dbabs stam nan du bya pheb pa de nyidabartan par bzhugs de nas bum dbang bskur ba ni hūṃ rdi brdal khyab lhun grub bum pa bzang po na dbang chen bde ba'i gsang gsum bcud kyis bkang: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbangabaskur bas dregs pa las la 'khrun pa'i dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a snyi ṣiñca sa: de nas rta mgrin gyi sku gtad la hūṃ rdi 'khor 'das dbang bsgyur pad+ma he ru ka zhing bcu'i srog 'dren sde brgyad dregs pa'i srog: snang srid zil gnon rta 'grin rgyal po yi: sku gsung thugs dbang rig 'dzin khyod la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a bhi ṣiñca tshe: denas dregs pa'i gtso bo gza' sku gtad la hūṃ trī nga ni dbang chen pad+ma drag po rtsal: dregs pa yongs kyi spyi rje rta mgrin rgyal: phrin las gza' bdud rgyal po las la 'chun: de yis srogadabang rig 'dzin khyod la sbyin: gza' gdong rgyu skar lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs: zhing bcu ming med brlag pa'i dam tshig zungs: rtsa sngags mthar ratu la tsit+ta shag a bhi ṣiñca

oṃ de nas dam can gyi sku gto la hūṃ hrī: nga ni dbang chen pad+ma drag po rtsal: dregs pa yongs kyi spyi rje rta mgrin rgyal: phrin las dam can dge bsnyen las la 'jun: de yi sgog dbang rig 'dzin khyod la sbyin: bya seng ra skyes zhon rnams bran bkol nas: zhing bcu ming med brlag pa'i dam tshig zungs: rtsa sngags mthar tritshobadz+ra sa dhu tsit+ta shag a bhi ṣiñca sa: de nas lha yi sku gam la hū trī: nga ni dbang chen pad+ma drag po rtsal: dregs pa yongs kyi spyi rje rta mgrin rgyal: phrin las lha dmag 'bu sde las la 'khrunaḥ de yi srog dbang rig 'dzin khyod la sbyin: lha khams thams cad dbang bsdus bran bkol nas zhing bcu ming med brlag pa'i dam tshig zungs rtsa sngags mthar a:de wa tsit+ta shag a snyi nyi 〉 tshe: de nas gshin rje' sku gam la hū hrī: nga ni dbang chen pad+ma drag po rtsal: dregs pa yongs kyi spyi rje rta mgrin rgyal phrin las las kyi gshin rje las la 'junaḥ de yi srog dbang rig 'dzin khyod la sbyin: ya man+ta ga'i sde tshogs bran bkol nas: zhing bcu ming med brlag pa'i dam tshig zungs: rtsa sngags mthar ya:ka la ru ya tsit+ta shag a bhi ྅྅mi sa: de nas ma mo' sku gtad la hūṃ

ba tshu hrī nga ni dbang chen pad+ma drag po rtsal: dregs pa yongs kyi spyi rje rta mgrin rgyal: phrin las srid pa'i ma mo las la 'khrun: de yi sgog dbang rig 'dzin khyod la sbyin: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams bran bkol nas: zhing bcu ming med brlag pa'i dam tshig zungs: rtsa sngags mthar ma45 ma ro ru phu ru tsit+ta shag a bhi ṣiñca tshe: de nasabadud rgyal gyi sku gtad la hūṃ hrī nga ni dbang chen d+ma drag po rtsal: dregs pa yongs kyi spyi rje rta mgrin rgyal: phrin las bdud kyi sde tshogs las la 'jun: de yi srog dbang rig 'dzin khyod la sbyin: skos rje drang dkar sde 'khor bran bkol nas: zhing bcu ming med brlag pa'i dam tshig zungs: rtsa sngags mthar durte khur nag po tsit+ta shag a bhi ṣiñca tshe: de nasabatsan rgyal gyi sku gto la hūṃ hrī nga ni dbang chen pad+ma drag po rtsal dregs pa yongs kyi spyi rje rta mgrin rgyal: phrin las btsan rje yam shud las la 'khrun: de yi srog dbang rig 'dzin khyod la sbyin: dmar po btsan gyi sde tshogs bran bkol nas: zhing bcu ming med brlag pa'i dam tshig zungasaḥ rtsa sngags mthar ru tsa tri shu la tsit+ta shag a bhi ṣiñca tshe: de nas be

tha gyi sku gtad la hūṃ trī: nga ni dbang chen pad+ma drag po rtsal: dregs pa yongs kyi spyi rje rta mgrin rgyal: phrin las sgog bdag be har las la 'chun: de yi sgog dbang rig 'dzin khyod la sbyin: sku lnga ru 'dren yongs rdzogs bran bkol nas: zhing bcu ming med brlag pa'i dam tshig zungs: rtsa sngags mthar tsa:rā dza snyi hur tsit+ta shag a bhi ṣiñca tshe: de nas ka la yakra'i sku gtad la hūṃ hrī: nga ni dbang chen pad+ma drag po rtsal: dregs pa yongs kyi spyi rje rta mgrin rgyal: phrin las gnod sbyin rgyal po las la 'chun: de yi sgog dbang rig 'dzin khyod la sbyin: gnod sbyin gtso 'khor sde brgyad bran bkol nas zhing bcu ming med brlag pa'i dam tshig zungs: rtsa sngags mthar sha yak+ka pra dun tsit+ta shag a bhi ṣiñca tshe: de nas klu bdud mgo dgu' sku gtad la hūṃ trī nga ni dbang chen pad+ma drag po rtsal dregs pa yongs kyi spyi rje rta mgrin rgyal: phrin las nā ga rwa dza las la 'chun: de yi srog dbang rig 'dzin khyod la sbyin: klu chen brgyad sogs 'khor bcas bran bkol nas: zhing bcu ming med brlag pa'i dam tshag zungs: rtsa sngags mthar na0 nā ga phu shrī tsit+ta shag a snyi ṣiñca ma: de nas bdud

bsko rgyal spu gri' sku gtad la hūṃ nyi nga nai dbang chen pad+ma drag po rtsal dregs pa yongs kyi spyi rje rta mgrin rgyal: phrin las bdud rgyal thod phreng las la 'byun: de yisgog dbang rig 'dzin khyod la sbyin: bka' sdod bdud kyi spu gri bran bkol nas: zhing bcu ming med brlag pa'i dam tshig zungs: rtsa sngags mthar tre+esdong ka la tsit+ta shag a bhiṣiñca ma de nas btsan gyi spu gri' sku gtad la hūṃ nyi nga ni dbang chen pad+ma drag po rtsal: dregs pa yongs kyi spyi rje rta mgrin rgyal: phrin las bcan dmar me phreng las la 'jun: de yisgog dbang rig 'dzin khyod la sbyin gter srung btsan rgyal spu gri bran bkol nas zhing bcu ming med brlag pa'i dam tshig zungs: rtsa sngags mthar tsasang rak+ka tsit+ta shag a bhiṣiñca oṃ de nas klu'i spu gri'i gtad lahā nyi nga ni dbang chen pad+ma drag po rtsal: dregs pa yongs kyi spyi rje rta mgrin rgyal: phrin las dbang chen klu rgyal las la 'byun: de yi sgog dbang rig 'dzin khyod la sbyin: bka' nyan klu yi spu gri bran bkol nas zhing bcu ming med brlag pa'i dam tshag zungs: rtsa sngags mthar nardo nga pha la tsit+ta shag a dhi ṣiñca tshe: de nas rgyud

mgon legs ldan gya sku gtad la hūṃ nyi nga ni dbang chen pad+ma drag po rtsal: dregs pa yongs kyi spyi rje rta mgrin rgyal: phrin las laṅka'i bdag po las la 'jun: de yi sgog dbang riga'adzin khyod la sbyin: legs ldan lcam dral bka' sdod bran bkol nas: zhing bcu ming med brlag pa'i dam tshig zungs: rtsa sngags mthar bhurkur mahā kā la kro ti shwa ri laṅka sarba dharmapā la trig shag tsit+ta a dhi ṣiñca sa: de nas gnod sbyin tsi ma ra'i sku gtad la hūṃ phyi nga nai dbang chen pad+ma drag po rtsal: dregs pa yongs kyi spyi rje rta mgrin rgyal: phrin las rgyal btsan yongs rje las la 'chun: de yi srog dbang rig 'dzin khyod la sbyin: gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po bran bkol nas: zhing bcu ming med brlag pa'i dam tshig zungs: rtsa sngags mthar tsa tu shu la tri pra dun shag tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca sa: de nas dregs pa 'a gsung dbang ni ra yig gtad la/ nyi nga ni rgyal kun dbang phyug he ru ga: dregs pa yongs kyi sgog bdag rta mgrin rgyal ma g.yel dam la 'dus shig ra hu la: ma bul phrin las nus stobs bu la sbyin: mngon spyod bskul las ma g.yel sa ma ya: hi ya dza: rwa a snyi 144 ā: de nas tra yig gtad la hūṃ ༷

ba:tshu nga ni rgyal kun dbang phyug he ru ga: dregs pa yongs kyi sgog bdag rta mgrin rgyal: ma g.yel dam la 'dus shig rdo rje legs: ma bul phrin las nus stobasabu la sbyin: maro na spyod bskul las ma g.yel sa ma ya: hi ya dza: tri:a d+ngha ṣiñca ā: de nasapa yig gam la hūṃ nyi nga ni rgyal kun dbang phyug he ru ga: dregs pa yongs kyi srog bdag rta mgrin rgyal: ma g.yel dam la 'dus shig lha dbang rgyal: ma bul phrin las nus stobs bu la sbyin mngon spyod bskul las ma g.yel sa ma ya hi ya dza: a a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas ya yig gtad la/ hrī nga ni rgyal kun dbang phyug he ru ka dregs pa yongs kyi sgog bdag rta mgrin rgyal: ma g.yel dam la 'dus shig gshin rje tshogs: ma bul phrin las nus stobs bu la sbyin mngon spyod bskul las ma g.yel sa ma ya: nyi ya dza: ya a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas ma yig gto la hūṃ nyi nga ni rgyal kun dbang phyug he ru ga: dregs pa yongs kyi srog bdag rta mgrin rgyal: ma g.yel dam la 'dus shig ma sman tshogs: ma bul phrin las nus stobs bu la sprin: mngon sgod bskul las ma g.yel sa ma ya hi

ya dza: ma:a snyi ṣiñca ā: de nas du yig gam la hūṃ trī nga ni rgyal kun dbang phyug he ru ga: dregs pa yongs kyi srog bdag rta mgrin rgyal: ma g.yel dam la 'dus shig bdud gyi rje: ma bul phrin las nus stobs bu la sbyin mngon spyod bskul las ma g.yel sa ma ya: nyi ya dza: du:a snyi ṣiñca ā: de nas ru yig gam la/ ༷ nga ni rgyal kun dbang phyug he ru ga: dregs pa yongs kyi sgog bdag rta mgrin rgyal: ma g.yel dam la 'dus shig btsan rgyal tshogs: ma bul phrin las nus stobs bu la sbyin: mngon spyod bskul las ma g.yel sa ma ya: nyi ya dza: ru a bhi ṣiñca a: de nas tsa yig gto la hūṃ trī: nga ni rgyal kun dbang phyug he ru ga: dregs pa yongs kyi sgog bdag rta mgrin rgyal: ma g.yel dam la 'dus shig be ha ra: ma bul phrin las nus stobs bu la sbyin mngon spyod bskul las ma g.yel sa ma ya: hi ya dza: tsa:a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas sha yig gto la/ ༷ nga ni rgyal kun dbang phyag he rtsa ga: dregs pa yongs kyi srog bdag rta mgrin rgyal: ma g.yel dam la 'das shig gajod smin sde: ma bul phrin las nas stobs bu la smin: mngon smod basmal

ba tshu las ma g.yel sa ma ya: nyi ya dza: sha:a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas na yag gtad la hū nyi nga 2 rgyal kun dbang phyug he ru ga: dregs pa yongs kyi sgog bdag rta mgrin rgyal: ma g.yel dam la 'dus shig klu rgyal tshogs ma bul phrin las nus stobs bu la sbyin: mngon spyod bskul las ma g.yel sa ma ya: nyiya dza: na a bhi ṣiñca ā: denas tri yig gtad la hūṃ nyi nga ni rgyal kun dbang phyug he ru ga: dregs pa yongs kyi sgog bdag rta mgrin rgyal: ma g.yel dam la 'dus shig bdud rgyal tshogs: ma bul phrin lasanus stobs bu la sbyin: mngon spyod bskul las ma g.yel sa ma ya: nyi ya dza: tri a bhi ṇiñca ā: de nas tsa yig gtad la hūṃ nyi nga ni rgyal kun dbang phyug he ru ga: dregs pa yongasakyi srog bdag rta mgrin rgyal: ma g.yel dam la 'dus shig btsan rgyal rje: ma bul phrin las nus stobs bu la sbyin: mngon spyod bskul las ma g.yel sa ma ya: nyi ya dza tsa a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas na yig gtad las nyi nga ni rgyal kun dbang phyug he ru ga: dregs pa yongs kyi srog bdag rta mgrin rgyal: ma g.yel dam la 'dus shig klu rgyal rje: ma bul

brin las nus stobs bu la sbyin: mngon spyod bskul las ma g.yel sa ma ya: hi ya dza: na a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas gri yig gam la hūṃ hrī nga ni rgyal kun dbang phyug he ru ga: dregs pa yongs kyi sgog bdag rta mgrin rgyal: dam la 'dus shig rgyud mgon lcam dral tshogs: ma bul phrin las nus stobs bu la sbyin: mngon spyod bskul las ma g.yel sa ma ya:hi ya dza: bhurkur mahā kwa la kro ti shwa ri gri rlu a snyi ṣiñca ā: tsahusnyiyig brtsegs ma gtad la hūṃ trī nga ni rgyal kun dbang phyug he ru ga: dregs pa yongs kyi srog bdag rta mgrin rgyal:dam la 'dus shig btsan rgod yang le ber: ma bul phrin las nus stobs bu la sbyin: mngon spyod bskul las ma g.yel sa ma ya: hi ya dza: tsan sa triro/ la a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas dregs 'i thugs dbang ni mda' gzhu gtad la hūṃ hrī: pad+ma'i bka' nyan gza' bdud ra hu laX sgrub la brtse zhing zhing bcu'i sgog la gshe: bstan pa srung zhing 'jig rten phan bde spel:

badz+ra: skyes mchog rdo rje legs sgrub la brtse zhing zhing bcu'i sgog la gshe: bstan pa srung zhing 'jig rten phan bde spel: dam can sgog rten 'bar ba khyod la gtad: bstan pa 'dzin dang srung la ma g.yel cig: hrīḥbaṃḥtriḥtsit+ta a sti ṣañca hūṃ: de nas gri shul gtad la hū hrī pad+ma'i bka' nyan srid pa lha yi rgyal sgrub la brtse zhing zhing bcu'i srog la gshe: bstan pa srung zhing 'jig rten phan bde spel: lha yi srog rten gri shul khyod la gtad: bstan pa 'dzin dang srung la ma g.yel cig: hrī thamasaḥtsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: de nas khram dbyug gam la hūṃ hrī pad+ma'i bka' nyan las gshin ga gang tshogs: sgrub la brtse zhing zhing bcu'i sgog la gshe: bstan pa 'dzan zhing gshin rje'i srog rten khram dbyug khyod la gtad: bstan pa 'dzin dang srung la ma g.yel cig: hrīm0yaXtsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca 〉: de nas mda' dar da nad rkyal gto la hūṃ hrī: pad+ma'i bka' nyan srid pa ma mo'i tshogs: sgrub la brtse zhing zhing bcu'i srog la gshe: bstan pa 'dzin dang grang la ma g.yel cig: ma mo'i sgog rten mda' dar khyod la gtad: bstan pa mong zhing 'jig rten phan bde spel

trīḥrba yatsot+ta a bhi ṣiñca /: de nas dgra stu gtad la hūṃ nyi pad+ma'i bka' nyan bdud po srog len tshogs: sgrub la brtse zhing zhing bcu'i srog la gshe: bstan pa srung /phan bde spel: bdud kyi sgog brten dgra stu khyod la gtad: bstan pa 'dzin dang srung la ma g.yel cig: hrīmalatshet+ta a snyi ṣiñca hūṃ de nas mdung zhags gtad la bka' nyan nyan myur mgyogs btsan rgyal rje: sgrub la brtse zhing zhing bcu'i srog la gshe: bstan pa srung zhing 'jig rten phan bde spelaḥ btsan gyi sgog brten mardal gtad: bstan pa 'dzin dang srung la ma g.yel cig: trī maḥya6)t+ta a bhi ṣiñca :: de nas spu gri mkhar sil lhung bzed gtad la hūṃ ༷ pad+ma'i bka' nyan sgog bdag snyisgrub la brtse zhing zhing bcu'i srog la gshe: bstan pa 'dzin dang 'jig rten phan bde spel: srog bdag thugs rten spu gri khyed la gtad bstan pa 'dzan g.yel cig: trī thaḥya(sgot+ta a bhi ṣiñca shā: de nas ral gri dang zhags pa gtad la hūṃ trī: pad+ma'i bka' nyan ka la yak+ka'i sde: sgrub la brtse zhing zhing bcu'i sgog la gshe:

badz+ra: zhing 'jig rten phan bde spel gnod sbyin srog rten ral gri khyod la gtad: bstan pa 'dzin dang srung la ma g.yel cig:hrīboyartset+ta a bhi ṣiñca shā: de nasadalnga la dang sbrul zhags gtad la hūṃ nyi pad+ma'i bka' nyan klu bdud gnyan sa bdag: sgrub la brtse zhing zhing bcu'i sgog la gshe: bstan pa srung zhing 'jig rten phan bde spel klu yisgog rten sbrul zhags khyod la gtad: bstan pa 'dzin dang srung la ma g.yel cig:hrīboyacet+ta a bhi ṣiñca lha: de nas tho ba da zhags pa gtad la hūṃ nyi pad+ma'i bka' nyan gter srungabadud rgyal tshogs: sgrub la brtse zhing zhing bcu'i sgog la gshe: bstan pa srung zhing 'jig rten phan bde spel: bdud kyi sbu gris thugs rten khyod la gtad bstan pa 'dzin dngasrung la ma g.yel cig: hrīzalacet+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: de nas mdus dang zhugs pa gto la hūṃ nyi pad+ma'i bka' nyan gter srung btsan rgyal tshogs: sgrub la brtse zhing zhing bcu'i srog lagashe: bstan pa srung zhing 'jig rten phan bde spel: btsan gyi spra gri'i thugs rten khyod la gtad: bstan pa 'dzin dang sprang la ma g.yel cig: tre+ezalacetā a snyi 〉〉 hūṃ: de

nas chu gri dang sbrul zhags gtad la hūṃ rdi pad+ma'i bka' nyan gter srung klu rgyal tshogs: sgrub la brtse zhing zhing bcu'i srog la gshe: bstan pa srung zhing 'jig rten phan bde spel: klu yispu gri'i thugs rten khyod la gtad: bstan pa 'dzin dang srung la ma g.yel cig: hrīXbaṃḥya tsit+ta a snyi ṣiñca /: de nas bing dang ru mtho gra thod gtad la hūṃ nyi pad+ma'i bka' nyan legs ldan lcam drag tshogs: rgyud kyi bdag po laṅka'i dpu dang bcas: sgrub la brtse zhing zhi bcu'i srog la gshe: bstan pa srung zhing 'jig rten phan bde spel: rgyud mgon lcam dral thugs rten khyod la gtad bstan pa 'dzin dang srung la ma g.yel cig: trīḥbaṃḥyamibyeḥbhurkur mahā kwa la kro ti shwa ri sarba dharma pā la tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: de nas btsan mdung dngazhags pa gto la hū rdi pad+ma'i bka' nyan gnod sbyin tsi ma ra: 'bod pa tsam gyis phrin las glog ltar 'khyug: rbad pas dam tshig rno nus thogs las che: bsad bskul phul bas dgra sde skad cig rlog: mthu stobs nus ldan gnod sprin yang le ber: sgrab la snying brtse zhing bcu'i sgog la gshe: bstan pa srung zhing 'jig rten phan bde spel: gnod smin sgog

pa:tshu rten mdung zhags khyod la gtad: bstan pa 'dzin dang srung la ma g.yel cig: trīḥbaṃḥtsahwa tri shu la tsit+ta a snyi ṣiñca hūṃ: de nas phrin las dbang bskur ni liṅga gto la hū nyi sngags 'chang pad+ma'i dam 'dzin bu khyod kyi: gsang sngags sbyor sgrol skyon du mi blta bar: zhing bcu tshang rnams khyod la bdag gis gtad: de rang phyin chad mngon spyod drag las skyongs: rtsa sngags mthar ru tra a mu ka sarba a bhi ṣiñca hrī: de nas sgrol phur gtad la hūṃ ༷ rdo rje khros pa'i brtul zhugs khyod kyis bskyed: ma rig nga bdag rū tra khyod la gtad thal 'byen phrin las mtshon chen rno la drangs: mngon spyod khyad chos ston pa'i dus la babs: rtsa sngags mthar du tra bisnan ta krita mā ra ya phaṭa: a snyi ṣiñca hrī: de nas me tam gto la hū nyi gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i las nyon 'bud shing kun: shes rab me yi bsregs pa'i gzi byin 'byug: mnyam nyid bde ba chen po'i don stsol ba'i: ye shes rab 'bar bde ba'i dbang bskur ro rtsa sngags mthar ja la reshirnye puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: a bhi ṣiñca tri: de nas srog spyor gtad la hā nyi phyi 'byung kun gyi srog rten nam mkha' che: nang 'byung

'dus pa'i ngo bo sems nyid dbyings: gsang 'byung mi 'gyur spros bral thig le che: kun 'dus dregs pa'i srog gcig mtshan ma rdzas: deng 'dir rigs ldan bu mchog khyod la sbyin: srung ma lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs par shog rtsa sngags mthar dharmā pā la tsit+ta tsakra a bhi ḍiñca hrī: de nas gtor ma gtad la hūṃ ༷ mtshan ldan bhasto ka pā la yi nang: drag po'i gtor chen sha khrag rus pa'i brgyan: 'dod yon lnga yi'i bkod pa rab 'dzes 'di dam ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la gtad srung ma lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs pa dang mngon spyod las kyis dgra bgegs tshar gcod mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar bha ling ta a bhi ṣiñca oṃ āX hūṃ : de nas dza gad drangs la hūṃ hrī: bla med mi spang gsang ba'i dam tshig rdzas:dpa' bo dgyes bskyed dza gad a dṛ ta: gsang chen spyod pa rab skyongs khyod la drangs sngags kyi dga' ston bzhes la dam tshig zungs: bshad sgrub gnyis kyis bstan pa'i sgon me sbor sbyor sgrol dgongs pa'i 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzod rtsa sngags mthar dza gad a mṛ ta a bhi ṣiñca a la la ho: dmod bcol bya zhing gtor ma dgra phyogs rdebs des ni mngon spyod phrin las

bas/: nye par 'ong dregs pa sde brgyad las la 'chun par 'gyur nus mthu byan rlabs yon tan bsam yas 'byor sa ma yu nyi ma rmi dbang stobasapo che la 'di ma shor dgra mang zhe sdang can la 'di ma shor zog po g.yo rgyu can la 'di ma shor kha bsags yid gnyis can la 'di ma shor phyug po 'dod sred can la 'di ma shor gyong po log lta can la 'di ma shor gnas min la sbyin mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'ong sa ma mā nyi ma sangasargyas bstan pa'i bdag por bka' 'di gtod sems can phan bde spel la bka' 'di gtod gsang sngags zab khrid skyongs la bka' 'ad gtod dam log zhing bcu bsgrol la bka' 'di gtod smon log mtha' dmag bzlog labaka' 'ad gtod mngon spyod tshul bzhin byed la bka' 'di gtod drag po rno ba'i las 'di med gyur na sngags pa mthu sdug grong bar phyi bzhin du nye ring kun nas brdung la nyam thag mnar de phyar dreg tshogs srog gi gta' ruzungs sa ma yu shar phyog rgyang grag dkar po'i 'od khyim nas rgyu skar bkra ba rlung gi rta la drangs phag gi zhing sar dug gi char ba 'bebs de yi dus su 'di zab sa ma ya lho smad dug stong nag po'i 'bras bu gsum chu tho nazhes lho nas lho ru smin tra bam tsi drag byang gi phyogs su bskyod kha ru k+ṣe ṭaṃ khro yi ril bur brten dug gas brgyag che rang phyogs rgyal khams 'jigs de dag kun la 'ad zab sa ma wā 'dzang thegs khyu nas rwa ngar ldan pa zhig

lcagasakyi mkhar rdzong mang po'i pha mthar brgal gser gyi me long thod par gtags nas sdog de yi srog shi 'di yin sa ma yu sha sgokhyu nasarwa dar 'dzom pa zhig shar nas bskyed cing lho ru smin par 'gyur smad nas dug chu nag po' dbang thang bsgrib de yi gnyen po 'di yin sa ma yā lcags kyi sdong por gser gyi me long btags bkra ba ngar ldan sa 'dzan re'i mos yin lcags dkar ri la khrag gi thig le bsgom de dus skyobs byed 'di yin sa ma mā ma mo'i mda' dar lha ldan phyogs nas 'byung bdud po'i thod pa dza yi phyogs nas ro mas gza' bdud mda' gzhu dru du tshogs dang rnyed rno ngar bskyed byed 'di yin sa ma yu yos bu 'jab mkhasa'adabs nas 'phyo la gzigs rgya stag ngar ma'i ri bkra ngom la dpyod tam bu snyan ba'i rgyun thag chad la ltos kha ta'i lce bzlog 'di yin sa ma yu khu byug sngon po'i glu yi brad la dpyod g.yu 'brug tshang la blo rtse 'chor la ltos srin bya ser po'i kha chu bslad skabs bdog de dag kun la 'di zab sa ma shā bcu gnyisargya yi tshang sgo khyung gis gtor spug po mkhar kyi kha bad ne tsos 'bri ru rbal sto gzhung ral ba dug gis 'jor kun la zab gnad 'di yin sa ma yu sgosaring dad pa tshul khrams phyag na bsnams dngul dkar me long rgya mtsho'i thod par gtags snang gsal sgon me ga 'i lag na 'dzin ba dan lce gsum g.yung drung gtsug na spud shel gya bum pa mu tra' thugs gar 'chang lcags kya spar bu rdo rje'i phyag mtshan

gtsar+sha mdzad rlung chen g.yab mo dbang chen drag po 'i 'dzin gser gyi rdo rje dga' ba'i rtag tu bsnams de dag rang skal gtod la rang gnas skyongs bstan ba'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug go sa ma wā e ma rgyal ba'i dbang bopad+ma saṃ bha wa' ma 'o sa 'gro la rtag par thugs brtsebs mtha' dbus thams cad gter gyis bkang ba las snying po'i yang bcud rdo rje snying po'i skor grub pa'i dbang phyugakhye'u chung lo tsa dang ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyings dbang chen mdzod smon lam 'phro bza na pa bcu gsum la pha nor snying gi dpal kha 'ad sbyin no da dung spel ba' dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la bstims ga sa ra bye mdo khams bkra shis rdzong du dgongs pra sdom ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon gyis gzengs pa lang pa' tshe dpa' bo khyed zung sprul ba las ldan gyis gab gsang 'di 'byed bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug 'gro ba' bde skyid nyi ma gsal bar byed phan bde'i dga' ston myo byang gnyis su rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pa d+ma 'od du 'god don gnyis lhun gyas grub ba' rten 'brel yod bka' 'di thub par srungs shig btsan rgod rgyal bka' log lag tu ma shor sa ma pā las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya dregs pa' srog dbang zab ba'i rno mde'u rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya yo rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar

chen bzasabakod pa'o brda thim lja zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin chos kyi bdag po sku skyes pa d+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du ma dang bcas te 'bad rtsol lhur len gyi yang yang bskul ngor/ kho bo rgyal mchogabashad pa phyol gyis mkha' 'gro gas ba' 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi bdag po nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/sarba ma le/

bsnye 0 zab gsang rdo rje snyingapo las: dbang chen bdud dpungazil gnon rtsal gyi mtha' rten gtor dbang dngos grub rgya mtsho bzhugs so:rmi: na rmo gu dzagapad+ma ka ra ye: rwa sgo 12ni bde cen 'bar bdab ga gzi brjad can rta phag dkyil 'khor bde chen 'khor lor mchod las can skal ba bzang po' skyes bu la phrin las dzom phyar mtha' brten gtor dbang bstan sa ma yu pad+ma dbang chen bde ba chen po yi gsang gsum 'dus mdzod sgrub gtor pa d+ma spungs: rab mdzes dkar rgyan dmar gyis rtsi gsol ba yi dam lha dang gnyas med byin mthu thob na nyid phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i mchod slob ma rnams gyis dga' ston me tog phul de nas gsol ba gdab par bya ba ni (1 dbang chen bde ba'idakyil 'khor bdag po dgongs bdag la las bzhi kun gyis grub pa dang: mchog thun dngos grub 'bad med thob pa'i phyir: dbang chen dpal 'dus gtor ma'i dbang mchog zhu: lan gsum rjes su bla mas lan gnang ba kyeho las dang skal ba'adzom pa'i bu mchog la: mi bzad rab 'bar gtor ma'i dbang dgos na: sgrub chen brgyad kyi phrin las skyongs nus sam: 'gro la phan bde'i mdzad pa spel nus

sam don gnyis lhun grub thabs la 'bad nus sam: de ltar ldan na dbang gi dngos grub sbyin: mi nus pa rnams skal med phyir dengs shig: de nas dam chu sbyin pa ni hūṃ ༷ gsang ba las kyi khro rgyal 'dus pa'i zhal: ma rig gdon tshogs mthar byed dam tshig chu: nus ldan slob ma khyod kyi lce la bzhag: dam srung dngos grub thob la nyams na mnar: de phyiragazu bor gnas mdzod dam tshig can: gzhan don phrin las ma brjed sa ma yā: snyed badz+ra sa ma ya na ra gan: dam chu lce la sbyar zha khong du btang de nas slob ma lha ru gsal ba ni mi dmigs ngang las snod bcud snang ba ni dag chen bde mchog zhing gi bkod pa rdzogs: rab 'bar thod mkhar bdud bzhi sde brgyad steng: shānamar las byung slob ma dbang chen sku dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum bsgrad: mche ba rab gtsigs gar dgu'i nyams kyis 'khyud: dmar ser ral gsebarta ma〈sna ljang zhun mtsher: dregs pa'i tshogs rnams dbang du bsdad par byed: phyag g.yas ral gris nyon mongs 'khyal rgyan gcod: g.yon pas lcags kyus dregs chen dbang du bsdad: 'dod 'bar me yis ma rig gnyis

ba tshu snang bsregs: zhabs gnyis bsgrad pas gza' klu zil gyis gnon: dur khrod dpal chas dpa' ba'i rtags su bgo: gar dbang phag mo gnyis med bde bar sbyor: phag skad ngur bas sa gsum 'gro ba 'dren: bde stong gar gyis pho nya las la 'gyed: rtsa khams thams cad rgyud sde'i sprin phung 'khrigs: 'khor 'das yongs kyi spyi dpal chen por bskyed: gnas gsum 'od kyis rgyal kun spyan drangs bstim: de nas sbyar spos bdug cing rol mo sgrogs snyan pa'i dbyangs su drangs te 'di ltar ro hūṃ nyi bde stong spros bral chos 'byung e yi dbus: gza' the'u sde brgyad zil gnon he ru ga: rngam brjid pad+ma gsung mchog sprul 'khor bcas: ye shes sgyu 'phrul gzugs kyi skur bzheng la: sgrub mchog byin gyis brlabs phyir gshegs su gsol phyi nang gsang rkyen nyer 'tshe mtha' dag sol: mchog thun dngos grub char ltar dbab tu gsol: bla pad+ma kro ta bibyu dha ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: dz+nyā na a we sha ya a ā: ye shes dbab ci de nyid brtan par bzhugs sman mchod phul la gtor ma'i dbang bskur ni gtor chen khrag 'thung sku yi rang bzhan gsal hūṃ ༷ dbyings nas rang byung ye shes

dbang gi sku: bde chen pad+ma 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi: sku yi dbang mchog rig 'dzin bu la sbyin: dregs pa zil gyis gnon pa'i mthu thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar maṇ+ḍal kā ya a bhi ṣiñca ma: slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la smon lam ni ho: sde brgyad dregs pa'i spyi rje dbang chen pad+ma he ru ga'i sku yi dbang mchog dam pa khyod la bskur ro: mtshan 'dzin lus kyi sgrib padag nas 'jigs med he ru ga'i mthu thob: sde brgyad dregs pa bran du bkol zhing dug gsum 'byung po ar la gtad nus pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig de nas shis brjodani he: rab 'bar dus me 'bar ba'i gzi byin kyis ma rig dug gsum 'byung po bsregs par byed bde stong ye shes mchog gi dga' ba sbyin: rta mchog brtul zhugs rol pa'i bde legs stsol: de nas gsung dbang bskur ba ni gtor chen pad+ma gsung ga rang bzhin du gsal la hūṃ ༷ dbyings nas rang byung ye shes dbang gi sku: bde chen pad+ma 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi: gsubhe gi dbang mchog rig 'dzin bu la sbyin: sde brgyad dam la 'dogs pa'i gsung thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar maṇ+ḍal wak+ka a bhi ṣiñca ā: slob bu'i mgrin par bzhag la smon

bsnye lam ni ho 'jig rten dregs pa yongs kyi spyi rje dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi gsung gi dbang dam pa khyod la bskur ro: sgra mtshan ngag gi dri ma rnam par dag te ma rig dug gsum 'byung po ar la gtad cing: gza' klu sde brgyad zil gyis gnon nus pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: de nas shis brngo da na hūṃ hrī: rab 'bar dus me 'bar ba'i gzi byin gyis: ma rig dug gsum 'byung po bsregs par byed: bde sto ye shes mchog gi dga' ba sbyin: rta mchog brtul zhugs rol pa'i bde legs stsol: de nas thugs dab bskur na gtor chen khrag 'thung rta mgrin yab yum gya rang bzhan du gsal la hūṃ hrī dbyings nas rang byung ye shes dbang gi sku: bde chen pad+ma 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis: thugs kyi dbang mchog rig 'dzin bu la sbyin: dam can las la 'khrun pa'i thugs thob sgo ga: rtsa sngags mthar maṇ+ḍal tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca /: slob bu'i snyang gar bzhag la smon lam ni ha bdud dpung 'dul mdzad bka' srung dregs pa'i phyi rje: dbang chen pad+ma zil gnon rtsal gyi thugs kyi dbang dam pa khyod la bskur ro: log rtog sems kyi dri ma dag te

ma rig bdud dpung ar la gtad cing dregs pa ma mo dam can las la 'jun pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: de nas shis brjod ni ( hrī rab 'bar dus me 'bar ba'i gzi byin gyis: ma rig dug gsum 'byung po bsregs par byed: bde stong ye shes mchog gi dga' ba sbyin: rta mchog brtul zhugs rol pa'i bde legs stsol: de nas yon ma dbang bskur ni gtor pho gar dab gzi ldan yab yum gyi rang bzhi du gsal la hūṃ ༷ dbyings nasarang byung ye shes dbang gi sku: bde chen pad+ma 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi: yon tan dbang mchog rig 'dzin bu la sbyin: dregs tshogs bran khol yon tan mthu thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar maṇ+ḍal gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñca / slob bu' ste bar bzhag la smon lam ni ho: gzi brjed sprin phung 'khrigs pa'i pad+ma he ru ga'i yon tan gyi dbang 'di khyod la bskur ro: khengs sems gdug pa'i sde tshogs thams cad ar la gtad cing: sa bdag klu gtod gnyan sogs las la 'chun pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: de nas shis brjod ni rji: rab 'bar dus me 'bar ba'i gzi byin gyis: ma rig dug gsum 'byung po bsregs par byed:

bsgolho bde stong ye shes mchog gi dga' ba sbyin: rta mchog brtul zhugs rol pa'i bde legs stsol de nas phran las zab dbang ni gtor chen khams gsum rol rtsed brgyud rgyal yab yul gyi rang bab du gsal la hūṃ ༷ dbyings nasarang byung ye shes dbang gi sku: bde chen pad+ma 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis: phrin las dbang mchog rig 'dzin bu la sbyin: pho nya las la khol ba'i mthu thob thegag: rtsa sngags mthar maṇ+ḍal garma a snyi ṣiñca trī slob bu'i gsang bar bzhag la smon lam ni ho: dmar nag brtul zhugasarol ba'i he ru ga'i phrin las kyi dbang 'di khyod la bskur ro: gdug rtsub rngams sems 'chang ba thams cad ar la gtad cing: smon log dam sri pho mo thams cad rdul du brlag nus pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: de nas shis badro da ni ho: rab 'bar dus me 'bar ba'i gzi byin gyis: ma rig dug gsum 'byung po bsregs par byed: bde stong ye shes mchog gi dga' ba sbyin:rta mchog brtul zhugs rol pa'i bde legs stsol: de nas go cha'i dab bskur ni hūṃ ka ra skra mtshams su gtad la hūṃ ༷ gza' dang rgyu skar gnod pa bzlog pa dang steng gdon dregs pa

bran du bkol ba'i phyir: khro chen hūṃ ka ra yi dbang bskur ro: dza lan+ta ra'i bde ba mchog thob shog oṃ badz+ra kro ta hūṃ ka ra hūṃ dz+nya na dhartu rak+ta a nu rā ga a snyi ṣiñca sa: de nas rnam rgyalathugs na'i cha smad du gto la hūṃ hrī: dri za pho mo'i gnod pa bzlog pa dang: shar gdon dregs pa bran du bkol ba'i phyir: khro chen rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang bskur ro: karnyi ka yi bde ba mchog thob shog oṃ badz+ra kro ta snyi dza ya hūṃ dz+nyā na dhartu rak+ṣa a nu rā ga a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: de nas gshin rje gshed po lte bar gtad la hūṃ nyi gshin rje pho mo'i gnod pa bzlog pa dang: lho gdon dregs pa bran du bkol ba'i phyir: khro chen gshin rje gshed po'i dbang bskur ro: tri sha ku na'i bde ba mchog thob shog: ma badz+ra kro ta ya man+ta ka shā: dz+nya na dhartu rak+ta a nu rā ga a bhi ṣiñca sa de nas rta mgrin rgyal po mgran pa ra gtad la hūṃ trī: chu lha pho mo'i gnod pa bzlog pa dang nub gdon dregs pa bran du bkol ba'i phyir khro chen rta mgrin rgyal po'i dbang bskur ro: lam pa ka yi'i bde ba mchog thob shog: o badz+ra kro ta h+ya kṛ wa hūṃ: dzā na 〉rta rak+ṣa a nu rā ga a snyi 〉〉 hūṃ: de nas bdud rtsi 'khyel ba gsang gnas su gtad la hūṃ hri

badz+ra: gnod sbyin pho ma'i gnod pa bzlog pa dang: byang gdon dregs pa bran du bkol ba'i phyir: khro chen bdud rtsi mabyil ba'i dbang bskur ro: hi ma la yi bde ba mchog thob shog: ma badz+ra kro ta a dṛ ta kun li hūṃ: dz+nyā na dhartu rak+ṣa a nu rā ga a snyi ṣiñca hūṃ: de nas dbyug pa sngon po rtsab g.yas su gtad la hūṃ phyi me lha pho ma'i gnod pa bzlog pa dang:shar lo'i dregs pa bran du bkol ba'i phyir: khro chen dbyug pa sngon po'i dbang bskur ro: ka ma ru pa'i bde ba mchog thob shog: gla badz+ra kro ta ni lan+tan tra hūṃ: dz+nya na dhartu rak+ṣa: a nu rā ga a bhi ṣiñca shā: de nas mi g.yo mgon po rtsib g.yon du gtad la hū nyi srin po pho mo'i gnod pa bzlog pa dang: lho nub dregs pabranadubakal ba'i phyir: khro chen mi g.yo mgon po'i dbang bskur ro: ma la wa brgyad bde ba mchog thob shog: o badz+ra kro ta ār+ya a tsa la hūṃ: dz+nyā na dhartu rak+ṣa a nu rwa ga a bhi kheñca / de nas 'dod pa'i rgyalapa brla g.yas su gtad la hū hrī rlung lha pho ma'i gnod pa bzlog pa dang: nub byang dregs pa bran du bkol ba'i phyir: khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal pa'i ma ru ya na'ibade ba mchog thob shog: o badz+ra kro ta

a pa ra tsit+ta / dz+nyā na dhartu rak+ṣa a nu rā ga a snyi ṣiñca hūṃ: de nas khams gsum rnam rgyal brla g.yon du gtad la hūṃ nyi dbang ldan pho mo'i gnod pa bzlog pa dang: byang shar dregs pa bran du bkol ba'i phyir: khro chen khams gsum rnam rgyal ra sa ji ṭa'i bde ba mchog thob shog: 3 badz+ra kro ta tre+e lo kya dhi dza ya hūṃ: dz+nyā na dhartu rak+ṣa a nu rā ga a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: de nasasnam mar+yā su stobs po che gto la hūṃ phyi sabadag klu gnyan gnod pa bzlog pa dang 'og gdon dregs pa bran du bkol ba'i phyiraX khro chen stobs po che'i dbang bskur ro: kṛrta dhe we'i bde ba dbang bskur ro: o badz+ra kro ta mahā ba la hūṃ: dz+nyā na dhartu rak+ṣa a nu rā ga a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: de nas smon lam gdab pa na ho: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la dbang chen khro rgyal bde ba'i go cha dang bcas pa gtad pas sku yi dbang thob po: grags stong 'gag med gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab par mnga' gsol bas gsang dbang thob po: thugs de bzhin nyid kyi ngang la bzhugs shing gnas yul mkha' 'gro'i bde ba mchog thob pas sher dbang thob po: sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba mnyam nyid bde chen gyi dgongs par ka dag su bzhugs

gas( pas tshig dbang thob po:de ltar sprosamed dbang bzha bskur rang byung ye shesango bo skyongs desan rtog pa mkha' ltar rgyas don gnyisalhun grub the tsho med:sam yā mi rgyasaponabangabo pad+ma bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la thugs rje' brtse ba yis dgongasapa'i yang bcud rdo rje snying po'i skor grub pa'i dbang phyug 'aprogag lotsadang dbang za bka' bab rgyal ba mchog dbyingasal zab ba'i chosamadzod gcesanor bgo skal brtan da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstims mdo khams bkra shisardzong la dgongasapra sdoms ma 'ong snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa 'a bo la ldan gcag gas da bstan pa'i 'gro don byang gi phyogasasu rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' 'di thub par sru sa shig yang le ber dam nyamasalag tu ma shor dam tshig ༅ sam mā rgya rgya rgya mtha' rten gtor dbang phrin lasargya mtsho rdzogasaso gter rgya gto rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gurgya o rgyan gyi slob dpo na pad+ma saṃ bha wa' bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa'o brda thim ñcā zhesapa 'di yang lungashan pad+madaga' ba' rdo rjes/bkra shisadage ba'i skye bzang du ma dang bcasaste nan tan gyisabaskul ngor/bdag 'dra mkha' 'gro'abum sprin 'khyal ba'i rdo rjesamakha' 'gro'i gsang brdazab mo lasazhal bzhusate dag par phab pa'icha'i pa chosabadag nyid kya bgyisapa dge legasa'aphel/sarba ma le/dge'o/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen zel gnon nā ga klu 'dul rtsal gyi dbang mchog bdud dpung tshar gcod bzhugs so:a: na 31 gu dza pad+ma kā ra ye mthachag pad+ma dbang chen bdud dpung zi pa gnon rgyal mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du rol las can skal bzang bsgrub mchog pho mo rnams bar chad bdudapas rgyal bye ra zab dbang bstan sa rma mā bdag mdun bum bzlas tshogs bsags rag me dor slob ma grwal bsdu khrus dang bgegasatshogs bskrad bsrung 'khor sgom la bden don lo rgyu bshad maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gdab pani kye: dregs pa zil gnon pad+ma dbang gi sku: bde ba'i zhal bzang ngom pa'i he ru ga: gtso mchog rdo rje rgyal po bdag la dgongs: nā ga klu 'dul drag po'i dbang mchog stsol lan gsum rjes su bla mas brda sprad kye gsang chen sgo spyod rnal 'byor skal ba can: dregs pa zil gnon dbang mchog sbyin dgos na: lus srog dngos po gang la mi sems par srog gi slad du yi dam mchog bzung nas bsnyen sgrub lhun len 'jig rten bya ba btang: chos brgyad bor la phyi ma kho nas rgyu: yang dag dge bar brtson na bdag gis sbyin: de

ltar mi nus pa la skal ba chung: sgod min rigs rnams rang rang gnas su dengs: de nas slob mas khas len ni ho: 'jigs rung srin po khros 'dra'i gzi brjed can: pad+ma dbang gi rgyal po bdag la dgongs: 'jigs tshogs ma rig rū tra kun sgol zhing: log 'khrul dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i brtul zhugs spyod thabs mchog bde chen ye shes dang du len:'khor ba ru bzlog khams gsum rol brtsed bsgyur: de ltar shin tu dka' ba'i dam tshig 'dzin: dngos grub dbang gi skal ba mchog stsol cig: lan gsum zhus la skyabs sems tshogs bsagasabya de nas sdoms bzung bya ba 'di lta ste ho: srog gcod mi spang zhing bcu dang du len: ma byin blang ba sde brgyad sgog chu 'phrog: mi tshang spyod ste pad+ma'i ze 'brur bsre: rdzun gyi rang bzhin 'khor ba'i chos rnams spyad: phra mar mkhas pas 'khrul pa'i mtshang kun rdol: rtsub mo'i tshig gis nga bdag yul med gcod: 'khyal tshig chos nyid stong pa'i dgongs par bsre: brnab sems tshul gyis gcor 'das bde bar len: gnod sems lta bus bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo bsal: log par lta bas kun rdzob chos skur sbor: de ltar smad dka'i

ba tshu dam tshig bdag gis spyad spyod par dka' ba'i rig 'dzin gsang lam spyod:mtshan ma thad gar gcod pa'i las ldan la:zab gsang mchog gi dbang mchog dam pa stsol:de nas dam chu sbyin pa ni ho:bla med rigs can bde ba mchog gi bu:yang gsang snying po spyod pa skal ba bzang:phung 'tshengs nus pa rig 'dzin sngags kyi lam:brtul zhugs mchog gi dam tshig bsgo ba rnams de ring phyin chad sgog gi gta' ru zu :nyams par gyur na bka' yi chad pas gcod:rnam dag bsrung na mchog thun dngos grub thob:de phyir gzu bor gnas mdzod dam tshig can:badz+ra sa ma ya na ra gan:dam chu 'thung zha sdom pa 'dzin mig dar bkab la me tog sbyin slob ma dab chen lar gsal ba 31 mahā shuh+ye ta sogasako3ste:gzung 'dzin gnyis chos mi dmigs stong par sbyang:ye shes 'od snang dag chen zhing bkod ni:rngams brjid dbang chen pad+ma he ru'i dal:bde stong thod pa'i sku mkhar mdzes pa'i dbus:bza' klu dregs pa phyi chings bsnol ba'i khar rab 'bar srog yig bde ba'i gzi byin can:'khor 'das bcud bskyil yongs gyur ye shes

sku: 'jig tshogs zil gnon pad+ma he ru ga: spros med 'am ni bskyed rim gang rung ltar de ltar dbang chen drag po'i thugs sgog hrī: rab 'bar bde ba'i gzi byin 'khyug pa'i 'og: sa bdag klu yi snying po stobs su gcun: phyi nang dregs pa zil gnon dngangs shing 'dar sgog snying lhud cing he ru ka la stobs: dam tshig 'bog bzhin phrin las sgrub bsam la:ye shes byan dbab dam tshag 'gyur med bsre me tog dor zhi mig dar gsal bar bya de nas bum pa'i dbang mchog bskur ba ni hūṃ hrī: khro rgyal stobs 'dus bde ba'i gzi byin can: nā ga klu 'dul byin rlabs bum pa'i dbang skal ldan sgrub mchog yongs la bskur bar bgyi: bde ba mchog thob gzhan snang zil gnon regag: rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a bhi ṣiñci tshe: de nas nā ga klu 'dul gyi sku gtad la hū dran pa tsam gyis bdud dpung zil gyis gnon: mthong bas mod la sa bdag klu gnyan 'dar: thos pas sgra tshig mtshan ma rang sar grol: nā ga klu 'dul rtsal gyi dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a bhi ṣiñca sa: de nas sngags 'khor gtad la hūṃ hri: bde ba mchog sprin 'bar ba'i gzi 'od 'khyug: gsang chen rgyad bskul ye shes

bsgo/: thig le'i dbyings: mthu stobs nus pa yon tan dpal rdzogs pa: dbang chen bde ba'i gsang dbang bskur bar bgyi: rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca ā: denas rdo rje rwa gdengs gtad la hūṃ nyi nga bdag mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i gdon tshogs kyis: mthong ba'i mod la snying khrag lhud par byed: dran pa tsam gyis dam tshig 'bog par byed rngam brjid rab 'bar ye shes rdo rje 'di: las can rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la gtad: rtsa sngags mthar rtsit+ta a bhi tsit+ta hūṃ: de nas khyu dmar gtad la hūṃ nyi khro rgyal phroṃn las mthu ldanag ru ṭā: bskul ba tsam gyis klu gnyan gtod tshogs 'dul: sa bdag 'byung po mthar zhing 'dul bar byed: drag po nus mthu 'bar ba'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar sarba.a bhi ṣiñca hrī: de nas dur phag mgo dgu gam la hūṃ nyi rang rgyud mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rgyal bsen bdud: 'byung po dam sri ma rig rū tra kun: brlag par byed pa'i pho nya phe khyi ma rdzu'aphrul mthu ldan chen po'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar: sarba gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñca 〉: de nas ral je gtad lahūṃ nyi byad gtad pha rol rbod gtong dbyings su gcod: gshed ma

log 'dren 'byung po dum bur gtubs:rno ngar mtshon cha 'bar ba'i gzi byin can: bar chad g.yul las rgyal phyir khyod la gtad: rtsa sngags mthar karmā a bhi ṣiñca phaṭa: de nas sbrulazhags gtad la hū trī mthong dang reg dang sbyor ba'i dug rnams 'joms: sa bdag klu gnyan 'byung po'i tshogs rnams 'dul: bde ba'i dpal byin mnyam nyid rol ba'i rdzas:dpa' rtags gzhan snang zil gnon khyod la gtad: rtsa sngags mthar duṣ+ṭan shrī hūṃ a bhi ṣiñca phaṭa: de nas gtor ma gam la hū rdo brdal khyab rat+na 'bar ba'i gzhong pa na khrag 'thung dpal gyi gtor chen brjed ldan bshams: nyi zla gza' skar snod bcud dpal gyis brgyan dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi dkyil 'khor rdzogs skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: dregs pa zil gnon nus mthu'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar maṇ+ḍal bha lirnya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ ā: hū 1 de nas smon lam gdab pa ni ho: dbang chen pad+ma drag po bdud dpung zil gnon nā ga klu 'dul rtsal gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan brin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang 'di: skal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyed rnams la bskur bar

badz+ra: bgyi'o: yongs su smin zhing grol bar gyur cig bdud dpung zil gyis gnon par gyur cig: bgegs dpung rtsad nas chod par gyur cig: dam can dregs pa las la 'chun par gyur cig: sa bdag klu gnyan bran du khol bar gyur cig: nus mthu thogs pa med pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: mtha' rten gtad cing dam khas len yon 'bul bkra shis rgya cher brjod dge ba bsngo zhi smon lam gdab de mthus dregs pa dab du 'du sa bdag klu gnyan zal gyis gnon nus mthu yon tan bsam mtha' yas the tshom med do sa ma yu ye ma rgyalaba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha wa' ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen ngo yis thugs kyi ya bcud rdo rje snying po'i skor thub pa'i dbang byug 'brog ban khyod la gtad da lta spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la bstims shig sa ra bye ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gze sa pa lang pa 'i tshe lasacan khyod spul dpa 'a bo mchog gis rnyed brtan pa 'a 'gro don lho byang gnyis nas 'byung gdul bya 'bum phrag bde chen zhing la 'god don gnyas lhun gyas grub pa 'a rten 'brel yod bka' 'ad thub par srung shig btsan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor a tham rgya las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya dbang chen nā ga klu 'dul gyi dbang

rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda tham sa du ma dang bcas te bskul ngor/ kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par
khru 144zamarnaklotrezlasgomaslothokupomaska nazlathe tho'i thomakhyepa( zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:rta mgrin dkar po'i tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

'amatshu na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: 3111rtenasgyurna ma/ za med thub pa' rdo rje tshe yi lha mi shig dwangs ma'i ze 'byur rtag tu mchod las can skal ba bzang ma bu mchog la tshe yi dbang mchog sbyin sa ma yā de ya bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum du bshad dang po bdag bskyed bsnyen par bya ba ni ā: bye da bcud bdag snang mi dmigs chos sku'i ngang: dag galongs sku 'gag med shar: ye shes rgyu ma gdos bral 'od kyi sku: dbang chen rta mgrin rdul bral dwangs ma'i sku dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi ma khro:dpyangs stag sham mdzes par gsol: phyag g.yas tshe bsod 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu 'dzin: g.yon pa 'chi med dpal bskyed bhan+ta bsnams: zhabs gnyis ba bzhi dbyings su gnon: bde ba'i rang bzhin phag mo dmar gsal 'khril: phyag g.yas pad phreng g.yon pa'i tshe bum stobs: rus pa'i rgyan rdzogs bde stongamadzad: rta zhal phag gdong gar gyi glu dbyangs sgrogs dwangs gsal gdos bral 'od kyi sku ru bsgom: gnyis med bde 1nga dpa' bo yab yum rnams: tshe yi da

bsgo(: bcud bkang 'dzan: kun gyi gnas gsum 'od zer dpag yas 'phros: bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams ma lus pa: tshe dbang rigs 'dzin lhag pa'i lha yi tshul: nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin byung te bdag mdun dang: sgrub pa'i rdzas la sib sib thim par bsam: khyad par thugs sgog hrī:la sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas 'khor 'das 'byung bzhi'i dwangs bcud bstims: 'chi med tshe yi byin rlabs dngos grub kun: yang yang bstim la rdo rje'i sgog thob dmigs: yo pad+ma kro ta tshe:bhe n+ni dza sarba sirnyi pha la nyu: bsnyen pa chu bo'i gzhu ltar bzla 'phro 'du brin las dmigs pa spro dwangs ma bdag da srung byar bstams 'chi med grub pa'i dmigs 'dun bya sa ma wā sgrub pa lha bum ril bu rnams tshe yi dal rtse dmigs pa ni snyen ka tim na ya hūṃ phaṭa: brdal khyab bum pa 'od lnga'i klong: ma chags pad sdong nyi zla'i khar: bcom ldan bla ma tshe dpag med: gsang ye 'khril sbyor bum pa 'dzin: longs sku'i rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs zhi tshul dgu'i 'khyud bde stong ngom: zag med ye shes bcud chen 'bebs: bdag dang bsrung bya'i gsos su dmigs: mtshan nyid phun chogs

gtor ma yang: dbang chen rtsa ba'i dal du gsal: za byed phag mo 'khril sbyor rol: bde dang stong pa'i gzi byin 'byug: rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i spro bsdu 'gyed: dbang gi 'od khyimagayo ba'i klong dbang dang dngos grub mdzod du dmigs: dri med shel gyi bum pa'i nang: ril bu rat+na rta mgrin rgyal: gser mdog zhi ma khro 'dzum rgyas: bde stong phag mo 'khril sbyor rol: phyag mtshan gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: rta phag zhal gyi thabs shes bskul sum bskor 'dod 'byil gtum rdul bral: ye shes rigs lnga'i zhing bkod ni rtenadang brten pa'i phyur bur bkang kun kyang bde ba chen po rtsa rol ston bsgyur ba'i gzi byin gyis: ril bu phyong grol gter du brlabs: dri med shel gyi gong bu la: dngos kun dwangs ma gcig tu bskyil: bharnya rang byung 'od lnga'i sang: bde ster gu ru ā tsar+ya: dkar dmar mdangs ldan zhi 'dzum sgeg: rnal 'byor dmar mo 'khril sbyor rol: gnyis med phyag rgya mda' dar dang: tshe yi bum pa bsgyur thabs 'dzin zung 'jug bde ba chen por bzhugs: paṇa grub rig 'dzin spro bsdu 'khrigs: kun kyang gnas gsum 'od zer

she(: gyis bde chen dbang gi dkyil 'khor dang: ma chags pad+ma brtsegs pa'i zhing: rngam brngid rnga yab dpal ri nas: ye shes lha tshogs rten brten pa: spyan ngas gnyis su med par bstim: bzlas pa sngags ༷khab bskul te: lha sngags bde ba chen por bskul kun kyang dga' bzhi'i rol ston gyis: rdzas rnams dngos grub phung rgor dmigs:trīḥyīḥphernyitrīrtsi.a nu ra ga ā yung na mahā su kha sirnyi pha la hūṃ ā: smra bcad nga nas bzlas gnad 'khyol spro bsdu 'od zer gzi byin phab skabs su stong tshag mchod bstod bya rdzas rnams dngos tub phu por bsams rig me dor zhing bdag nyid 'jug dbang blang 'cha med grub par dmags sa ma rwa gsum pa las 'phyor ba ni slob ma gral bsdu khrus bgegs bsal srung 'khor bsgom la bden don bshad maṇ+ḍal gyel rjes gsol gdab ni ༷ 'arags dang dekyal 'dzarabadag bo bla ma dgongs bdag cag dad ldan las can pho mo la: dus min 'chi bzlog tshe yi dbang bskur stsol don gnyis stun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub zhu: lan gsum gsol ba btab rjes bka' stsal ba de 46gas rdon las 'dza'adzom pa'i skal ba can: khyod la bdag gi 'chi med tshe dbang sbyin: bag

med skyon bsal sgrub pa lhur blang na: tshe bsrengs rnal 'byor don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur: dga' ba sgom la tshogs ston rgya cher spros: yon dang rin thang 'byor na bsod nams 'grub: de nas rgyud sbyang sdoms pa 'dzan pa ni na mo: dkon mchog gsum dngos 'chi med tshe yi lhar: snying nas skyabs mchi theg chen byang sems bskyed: lta ba'i phyag bgyi kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul: gzung 'dzin dri ma kun bshags g.yin phan gyi mdzad par rjes su yi rang chos 'khor bskul: mi 'da' bzhugs gsol dge kun gcig bsdus bsngo: phyam gcig 'chi med tshe yi dpal thob shog: phyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig 'dzin: sor byang sngags kyi sdom la rtag tu gnas: mdzad dka' sangs rgyas mdzad pa bdag gis bsgrub: spyod dka'i byang sems spyod pa bdag gis spyod: 'khor ba dong sprugs spyod par rtag tu brtson: de phyir 'chi med tshe yi dbang bskur stsol: lan gsum zhus rjes dam chu sbyin pa ni sto khro chen bdud rtsi 'byil ba'i rang bzhin chu: dam srung nyams rtogs yon tan 'di yis bskyed: nyes can 'di phyi gnyis gar 'di yis mnar de phyir gzu bor gnas bzhin

badz+ra: dam tshig srungs: rdo rje'i chu 'di khyod gyi lce la bzhag: rig pa 'dzin pa dam tshig mna' bor cig: 3 badz+ra sa ma ya na ra gan: dam chu lcer bzhag mig ras me togabakram de nas slob ma wa ru gsal ba ni snyed mahā shu h+ye ta sogs ko3nya slob ma'i phung khams skye mched stong par gyur: de yi ngang las dag chen zhing gi dbus: ma chags pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla'i steng: snying po hrī:las skyes pa'i ye shes sku bcom ldan mgon po 'chi med tshe mtha' yas: dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i gzi byin 'khyug: gsang ba ye shes gnyis med 'khril sbyor rol gnyis ka bum 'dzin longs sku'i rgyan gyis spras: rdo rje skyil krung mnyam nyid bde rol bzhugs: thugs 1nga he ru ka pa tshon gang ba: dkar gsal bde chen phag mo 'khril sbyor rol: lcags kyu bhan+ta gri thod khyud stobs rol: dar dang rus rgyan stag gzig sham thabs mdzes: gzhan yang rtsa 'khor bsam mi khyab pa'i klong: rgyud sde rgya mtsho gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bde stong gnyis med tshe yi dgongs par bzhugs kun gyi thugs srog rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros ye shes 'khor lo dbyer

med bsre: sbyar spos bdug cing thod rnga rol mo sgrogs mda' dar g.yab cang snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas te ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren bya ba ni hūṃ rdo mtha' dbus mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings nyid las rig stong mi shig bla ma tshe dpag med: ye shes sgyu 'phrul tshe dbang 'khor dang bcas: sgrub mchog byin gyis brlabs phyir gshegs su gsol: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chadabasal ba dang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol du gsol a pad+ma kra ta a yudz+nyā na sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza a we sha a ā: ye shes dbab cang de nyid brten bar bzhugs mag dar bsal zhing me tog phul bar bya mthong ba bstan la ye shes lha ngo sprad de nas mda' dar g.yab cing tshe 'gugs bya 'chi med dpal byin nus pa'i dbang bskur ni hūṃ shrī bum pa zlum po chos sku'i gzhal yas su ye shes rigs kun 'dus pa gsang ba'i mdzod: 'chi med dpal sbyin grub pa mthar phyin dbang: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la bskur 'gye'o: snang stong gnyis med ye shes mngon gyur nas: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzan mchog thob shog rtsa sngags mthar ka ya a bhi 〉〉 sgo de nas snang mtha' tshe dpag med yab yum gyi sku gto la hūṃ dzi ste 'chi med

btsa/: pa snang ba mtha' yas sku: bde chen gar dbang gsang ba'i yum dang sbyor gnyis med ye mnyam bde ba chen po'i sku: pad+ma gsung gi dbang bskur bu la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñca zho: de nas bla ma tshe dpag med thod phreng rtsal yab yum kyi sku gtad la hūṃ ༷ snang ba ma 'gags pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: stong nyid gar dbang bde chen mtsho rgyal ma: gnyis med zung 'jigag mnyam nyid ye shes gsang: las can skal bzang rig pa 'dzin la sbyin: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi /gas sa: de nas tshe bdag gtum drag dkar po yab yum gyi sku gtad la hū nyi dri med bde mchog rta mgrin he ru ga: bde klong phag mo pad+ma gzi ldan yum: gnyis med bde sbyor tshe yi dpal chen po: las can rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin: rtsasngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñca sa: de nas gsang dbang bskur ba ni bhasto bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag la hū ༷ dum gcig bharnya ka pā la yi nang bla ma yab yum sbyor bas bdud rtsi'i rgyun: mu ri tha ོ ma ོ ma mi da ze mi ngo za 2 ma ོ me mi me tsha mi rwa da me zo zi 7ri da

tshe yi dbang mchog thob par shog: rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas tshe chang gtad la hū hrī: dpa' bo dgyes bskyed dza gad a mṛ ta: rin chen rin thang bral ba sngags kyi rdzas: las can skal bzang khyod kyi lce la bzhag sngags kyi bzlos gar bsgyur la mnga' brnyes regag: rtsa sngags mthar wak+ka a bhiXng ā: de nas tshe ril gtad la hūṃ hrī(5 khams dag pa lus kyi gzhal yas su: lhan skyes dpa' bo yab yum gzhugs pa la zag med bdud rtsi dam rdzas ril bu stobs: bde ba chen po'i rtogs pa mngon gyur shog: rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka75 bhi ṇiñca ā: de nas sher dbang bskur ba ni rig ma lang tshos 'byud pa gam la hūṃ trī bde ba sbyin pa'i lha mo yid 'ong ma bcu drug 'dzum bzang lhan skyes dga' bzhi bskyed:de yi mthus drangs 'chi med grub la sbyor: thabs 'di spang na sangs rgyas dngos grub g.yel: snang srid rnam dag bha ga'i dkyil 'khor spyod 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rjer dbang phyag thob: rigs sngags zhing sges ṭasmi'i gsang chen stobs: bde chen mdzad pas 'khor ba dong sprags byed thabs mchog 'di smod skal lngan sems kyi bu: rtsa

ba tshu sngags mthar a nu ra ga mu tra a bhi ṣiñca 〉: de nas tshig dbang bskur ba ni 'ja' shel mdangs ldan gto la hūṃ hrī 'khor 'das chosarnams gdod nas rnam par dag ka dag kun bzang klong las dmigs su med: dmigs med ye shes zang thal so ma 'di: ma bcos thad gar shigs se khrol ler zhog: sgro btags mtshan ma'i spros pa kun chadan: sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa klong du 'gyur: bde gshegs thugs rje'i nyi ma nang nas 'char rdul snyed rgyal kun 'ub chub gsang ba mthong: srid pa'i drwa ba chos nyida'akhor lor sangs: kun bzang yab yum mnyam nyid rgyal sar spyod: 'khor ba dong sprugs sku gsum lhun gyis grub: spros med don gyi dbang 'di khyod la sbyin: ka dag dgongasapa skyongs shig skal ba can: a phaṭa: a phaṭa: a phaṭa: de nas mtha' rten gtor dab bskur ba ni hūṃ nyi snang ba snye da kyi 'jig rten gzhong pa dzasgyu srid pa bcud bsdus dpal gyi gtorachen bshams: tshe dang ye shes dbang gi gzi byin 'bar: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: mdzad pa phrin las yon tan rab rgyas te: don gnyis lhun grub chos kyi

rgyal por sgo ga: rtsa sngags mthar maṇ+ḍal bha lirnyi a bhi ṣiñca /: de nas tshogs rdzas gam la hū nyi dam chig nyams chags nyes lhung dag pa dang: nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel zhingargyas pa'i phyir bde chen ga ṇa tsakra'i tshogs ston 'di: dam ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin: mnyam nyid bde ba chen por dang blang nas: 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzad pa rtagatu spyod rtsa sngags mthar ga ṇa tsakra sirnyi pha la a la la ho: de nas bkra shas rdzas rtags rgyal srid rnams gam la hūṃ nyi phun chogs dge ba'i bkra shis rdzas mchog brgyad: rgyal ba'i mtshanadape las byung rin chen rtags: phul byung 'phags pa'i nor mchog rgyal srid bdun: deng 'dir rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyin srid gnyis dpal la dbang 'byor mdzad pa yis 'khor ba dong sprugs chos kyi mdzod 'dzin re ga: rtsa sngags mthar rat+na maṅga le a bhi ṣiñca ྅: shis pa brjod cang dga' ston 'bul dam tshig khas len gzhan don spyod des ni nyams rtogs yon to 'phel tshe bsrang don gnyis lhun gyas 'thub sa ma yu e maḥ rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha pa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la thugs rje brtse ba yis thugs kyi thig le zab gsang rdor snying skor grub pamidabang phyug 'brog ban khyod la gtad da dung

bsgo/: spel ba'i dus 'a ma bab pa'i rin chen brda la bstims shag sa ra bye ma 'o sa snyigs ma lnga yi dus skabs su yo rgyan rgyalatshab badzam gli dab rgyan dang bstan pa 'di 'phrad phan bde'i mdzad pa skyongs bar chad bdud 'dul mtha' yi dmag tshogs bzlog bstan pa'i 'gro don rma smar byang la rgyal 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god phrin las bsam mi khyab pa 'i rten 'brel yod bka' 'di thub pa ra srung shig yang leber dam nyams lag tu ma sgo ra tha tshig can las can rig pa 'dzan pa'i dpal du shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya dbang chen gsung gi mdzod las 'cha med tshe yi dbang bskur zab mo rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi ces pa 'di'ang lung zin chosakyi bdag po pa d+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shis dge ba' skyes ya mtshan can mang po sngaphyi thang gsum tu phul te 'bad rtsol lhur len gyi bskul ba don da ldan phyar / chos bdag 'gyur med rgya mtshos dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'bul sprin spros tshe bdag 'dra dbang chen gsung gi rdo rje rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyisamakha' 'gro gsang ba'i phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag pa ra phab pa 'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa'o/ sarba masgo la/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi chos skor bka' rtsis phyag rgyas btab pa them yig don gsal me long bzhugs so:rmi na mo gu ru shrī pad+ma kro ta ya: mazag2 11 1 bde chen rdo rje gar dgu'i gzi byin 'byugs: che ba'i dbang phyug khro tshogs gtsug na spa 'jags rung rngam brjid du tra yongs kyi gshed: 'bar ba'i rta skad bzhad la phyag mtshal lo: bsam yaba'ilhun gyisagrub ba'i gtsug lag tu: o rgyan chen po pad+ma saṃ bha was las can rje 'bangs rig 'dzin bcu gsum la shin tu zab pa rdo rje snyi po'i skor bkra shis dge ba'i maṇ+ḍal rgya mtshos bskul phyag dang zhe sa dad dam mos gus ro ra: rdo rje'i thugs las mgul gyi bum bzang brgyud ljags kyi pad mo las byu chos kyi sgra: las can rnams kyi snyan khung la brgyud de mi brjed gzu sa kyi rin chen brda la bstems: sa ma yā: dang po bka' rtsis phyag rgyas btab pa la lung byang shel dkar me long zab mo dang: rgyang grags 'od khyim bdun pa bcu bdun skor gsang ba'i don gtams nyi zla phra bkod do: dbang chen rtsa sgrub bdud dpung zil gnon dang gsol 'debs bde stong bum

pa bzang po'o: sgrub pa'i lhan thabs dngos grub char 'bebs dang sngon 'gro khog phub pad+ma'i phre ba dang: dbang chen bskang ba rin chen phreng mdzes dang brgyud bskang yid bzhin nor bu bya ba'o gnas yul srung ma'i bskang ba bde stong dpal: don bstod gzi byin gnad nas bskul ba dang: mdun bskyed bdud dpung zil gnon chen po'o: phyi nang gsang ba'i zab sgrub gsol 'debs bcas sgrub pa'i khog gzhung dpal be'u rgya can dang las smon ldan pa'i rnal 'byor spros med lugs yig chung gab gsal rno ba'i mde'u bstan bshags pa ye shes sgron me bya ba dang rdzas bskang tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho tshogs bsdus bcas: bskul ba rngam brjid 'bar dang seng ge'i sgra pho nya bskul ba glog zhags 'khyug ma'o: bsgral las khog phub mtshon cha'i 'khor lo dang: phur bskyed tshe khrus gnas gsum dgongs pa'o thun gdab cho ga spu gri ka ma la: gtor bzlog dbang chen rab 'bar dkyil 'khor dang: / mdzad rngams bzlog bong zhon than bzlog go khyung bzlog rtsang bzlog bden pa'i stobs bzlog rnams: drag po rngams pa'i brtul zhugs las rim mo phyi nang sgo dbye gtor ma zor bskul dang zor las thog mda' dbang chen gtor

badz+ra: bzlog go: me gtad sbru gri'i 'khor lo ar gtad rdzogs sde brgyad dam 'dogs spu gri 'bar ba'i rgya drag po'i dbang rdzong bde ba'i 'khor lo dang nā ga klu 'dul dbang dang sde brgyad kyi ar gtad dbang dang drag po mtshon cha'i dbang phyi nang gsang dbang yang tig 'bar ba'i dbang: lo rgyus don gsal dbang gi khog phub dang mtha' rten gtor dbang byin rlabs tshe yi dbang: las bzhi'i bsreg blugs phrin las lhun grub dang drag po'i sbyin sreg ye shes me yi las de dag zhi drag bskyed rim zab gnad do sa ma yā sa bdag klu gnyan gtod 'dul dbal chu'i las: kha bskang rgya mdud rdzas kyi spyor ba'o: gtor ma'i phrin las sngags kyi sde kha dang bye ma nus bskyed lcags zhun btso lugs bcas: shin tu zab pa man ngag nus ldan 'di: yal ga'i ri dwags lo ma ljang gur spel 'di la dus gnyan brgyad kyang mkho bar bshad: sa ma yā: dbang chen rta phag bde chen rol ba'i rgyud rngog ma le brgan me dpung 'bar ba'i rgyud: gsang chen don khrid mkha' 'gro rgyu ma'o: rtsa rlung gar gyi 'byul 'khor zab mo dang: bde stong rlung gi rdzogs rim chings lnga pa gtum mo me dbang ye shes gzi byin bskyed de dag

rdzogs rim don gyi rnal 'byor ro: sa ma yā: phyi yi chings ni sgrog 'gro'i gsum gyi tshul: nang gi chings ni gom pa'i dkyus 'gros gsum: gsang ba'i chings ni mdur rgyug sleb chog ste: 'gros dgus gar gyi brtul zhugs zab pa'i skor: rgya bod man ngag kun gyi snying po yin: sa ma lnga: btsan rgod 'bar ba rdo rje srog gi rgyud gzhung bsrengs gsol mchod drag bskang 'khrugs bskang dang mnga' gsol za ngu dregs bskul rno mdelu drag po zangs ging dmar po rā hu la: stobs ldan lcags king nag po rgyud mgon dang spu gri mched gsum rang rang mngon spyod las gzhung bsrengs kha bskang mtha' rgyan bcas pa'o sa ma yā: ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i: ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi yang bcud rdo rje snying po'i skor: grub pa'i dbang phyug bcu gsum sde la gtad: rin chen brda la bstims shag sa ra bye ston pa khye'u chung rgyal ba mchog dbyangs rtsal: ska ba dpal brtsegs chos kyi spyan ltar gsal: dkon mchog 'byung gnas bstan pa'i zab rgya bkrol: ldan ma rtse mang snying po'i mdzod du bzhugs: be+e ro tsa na bstan pa'i nyi ma spel: dz+nyā na ku ma nyams myong rtogs ba mtho: g.yu sgra snying po bshad sgrub bstan pa'i

ba tshu gzhi: a tsar sa le mthu stobs 'gran zla bral: dpal gyi rdo rje rten 'brel legs na dge: 'bri ban pukhye bsod nams skal ba bzang: 'o bran dbang phyug las dang smon lam 'dzom dbang gi bka' bab mi rje dam par bsngags: rma thog rin chen shes rab rtogs pa mtho bco lnga rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pas 'dzom: gdams bcud gangs seng 'o ma lta bu'i chos ma dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs tho le ba: rtog ge'i blo yis bsre bslad ma zhugs pa sor bzhag rdo rje'i gtan tshig 'gyur med 'di bstan dang 'gro ba'i dpal du 'byung ba'i phyir mdo khams gshams nas gegs med gsal bar 'byed: dus kyi 'byor rgud dmag 'khrug nad yams sel: bstan pa'i 'gro don rma smrar byang robhe rgyas: 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' gsang thub par srungs shig yang le ber: bka' log lag tu ma shor a tham rgya las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: bka' them byang don gsal me long rdzogs so: gter rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu h+ya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma se bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar

chen gzas bkod pa'o brda thim lha: ces pa 'di'ang lung zin chos kyi bdag po pad+ma dga' bamirdo rjes bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du ma dang bcas te yang yang bskul ngor/ kho bodabang chen dgyes pa'i rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda zab mo dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/ bkra shis/
badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bka' yi srung ma: btsan rgod 'bar ba rdo rje sgog gi rgyud shin tu zabapa'i bka' rgya can bzhugs so:

ba rte na mo gu ru pad+ma ko ta shrī he ru ka ya: tshwatsastu) 'bar ba' 'od zer phyogs bcu kun tu khyab ye shes gzags pa'i gdul dka' rjes su 'dzan sbyor sgrol thabs la mkhas pa' he ru ka 'bar ba'i rta skad bshad la phyag 'tshal lo ma 'ong sa snyigs mar bsgrub mchog pho mo la smon log bdud da dam sris 'tshe ba 'byung gtso bo che dgu bstan pa' gshed du sdang phal ba rnams na ar jag las la g.yengs zog pos khyim chen spang nas khyim chung 'dzin ming la bya btang ri khrod pa zhes brjod 'dzag rten chos brgyad las la rtag tu g.yengs yas kyi kha dpon mas kyi shag 'debs byed dgra la sdang zhing gnyen la chags pa che sems can mgo skor sgyu ma'i nor la 'jab rmongs pa de dag bstan pa'i chem pa 'o kha cag dred po spya ka rgyab ser re sngags zhes gzengs bstod dug lnga mchol snyog spyod lta bar rgyus med kha lta stong 'byams byed sgom don ma mthong mag ru gnam la gzengs spyod pa mi dge bcu la 'dzem bag bral de 'dra byu tshe mkha' 'gros 'khu ldog 'byu chos skyong srung ma' zhal kya dgongs la phyogs dkar phyogs skyong rnams ri rab zom la 'khorngo nag phyogs gdug pa'i mgo 'phang mtho zhing btsan zog por bsrung skyobs byed cing 'gro rnams phung phya ru dmag dang 'khrug rtsod kha dpon byed nang du ma rung na tsha zug ngu slongs gsang ba lta spyod phyan ci log tu ston tshe 'dar chags sdang rtsod cing go sa snyog phyi la

—41 rdo rje dmyal bar gnar zhi bcom de 'dra'i mun gling bdud dpung kha dar tshe skal bzang pho mo nyin skar tsam mchis na de yi bgo skal man ngag zab pa 'a bcud srung ma lus da thabs ya dam dbang chen gsang gsum mjal ba'i lam bod yul sa 'og bcud kyi snyi khu mchog tshegs chung don che 'grub pa'i gnad zab mo rdo rje snyang po'i chos skor mtha' yas pa 'i dbang gi man mthil bdud dpung zil gnon rta yi brtul zhugs le srog las 'phang kya bstan 'gro'i don phyir bstan sa ma yu skal bzang snyegabu sngags la mosagus can 'dod pa chung zhi sgrub la brtson nus pa don gnyer mkhan bstan pa 'dzin mkhas bshad sgrub gzhi 'dzug mkhan nye brgyud gter gyi chos la lag par mos pa d+ma bdag nyad 'di phyi'i re ltos 'cha' mos gus thang myod med pa'i dam tshig can ba rgyal ba dang tshe ring nad med bsam pa mthar phyin zhing mngon spyod drag po 'i phrin las 'grub pa da bar chad dgra yis rgol ba tshar gcod cing sangs rgyas bstan pa'i che ba bskyed pa dang sems can rna phyir bstan srung sgrub thabs man ga mdo chings sogs zab gnad 'dus pa srog rgyud 'bar ba bstan sa ma yā 'dil spyodon rnam pa bcu gsum te dang po skye brgyud srung ma'i mtshan nyid bshad ba

ba'i yo byad dang 'bod rbad bsad pa srog gzer nag po dang mngon spyod bsgral lasabazlog las bya ba'o sa ma yu drag shul gyi bdag po btsan rgod rdo rje yang le ber 'di nyid: dgongs pa chos nyid kyidabyings las ma g.yos bzhin du: rnam rol bstan pa'i dpal du bzhengs pa'i phrin las dus su bab tshe: sbyor sgrol mngon spyod kyi las la rngam pa'i dam tshig 'dzin phyir: byangaphyogs li yul lcang ra smug por mnga' thang gi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dzom der: li yi rgyal bo.āt+pa la'i sras po 'byor ldan bzang po zhes bya bar zol tshul bzung ste 'jig rten gyi chos la skyo ba skyes nas tshangs spyod rab byung mdzad de 'khor ba spang nas khyim nas khyim med par nags gseb tu nyul: bag yod dka' thub kyis spong ba la rtagatu gnas tshe yul khams de yi mi ring nye ba na srid rgyal kha drag dbang btsan zhig gnas pa'i bu mo lha lcam bde 'byen bya ba: bsil ldan pad+ma'i tshal khrus kyi rdzing bu la rtsedagar phyin tshe: dug sbrul gdug pa can gyis mthong nas bdas tshedage slong la skyabs zhus nas 'jigs pa med par mdzad: slar log nas khyim du phyin tshe smon lam log pa'i

blon po gcig gis de yi tshul rgyal po la smras: rgyal pos brtag dpyad med par dmag bsdus te li sras kyi steng du bsgran pa la:lha lcam nyid kyis skyon bral tha ra smras kyang bzlog ma thub: de tshe kho mos smon lam log par gtab nas g.yeng la lceb: re zhig gi tshe na gnod sbyin mo mi zan khrag gi ral ba can zhes byapa khams la nad yams kyi char phab nas phung la khad du thug tshe: dbang chen pad+ma he ru ga' tha tshig bsgrags nas dam la btags: gsang sngags kyi bstan gtad: ma 'ongs byang chub thob par lung bstan gnang: bstan pa la 'tshe ba'i bdud sde thams cad 'joms pa'i gnyer bcol: mtshan du srog len dmar nis btags so:li sras nyid srog gi 'jigs pa la bred nas kha ba can kyi ri la bros: log pa'i bya ba spu tsam ma bgyis pa la nyes med khrim du gtug pas sa te mo rnams dbang du bsdus te sbyor ba byas pho rnams bsad cing sgrol ba'i las la 'jug: de ltar re zhig 'gyangs tshe rgyas bo dharma shrī rab tu khros te:

/ brtsam tshe sha khrag drod dbugs rtsa rgyus rus pa rnams kyang smon lam log pa'i bdud du nges par 'byung ba'o: de yang re zhig gi tshe mu btsan gyi lhum las khrag gi tsas te: de nyid bde ba dang chags pas gsos te re zhig gi tshe na rdol tshe btsan rgod 'bar ba rdo rje yang le ber zhes bya ba lus khrag mdog ru 'dug pa: rang grub nga 'khor gsum 'dzom pa: rlung gi shugs can rta pho rgab nag la bcibs pa: dug sbrul gyi glo len dang gong smed byas pa dar dmar po'i stan la rin chen sna lnga'i dngul gyi yob lung dang zangs kyi yob chen byas pa: gser gyi srab dang g.yu yi mthur 'dzom pa: lag pa g.yas na btsan gyi zhags pa dmar po gang la bskor kyang thag pa mnyen la lhug ma de 'dzin cing: g.yon pa na mdung dmar rtse mtshon cha ngar ma ltar rno ba: gang la btab tshad rdul brlag gi nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa

badz+ra: dang ldan pa'i btsan rgod las kyi gshin rje srog bdud 'bar bar bzhengs so: de yi rjes su rang las byung ba'i gdug pa'i btsan drug gam btsan bdun thogs med du 'byung ba yang: sha khams las byung ba'i sku las lha rigs btsan dkar rdo rje thog gi bu yug 'tshub pa dang: khrag khams las byung ba'i ging ka thog rgyug dmar po khrag gi ral ba ba ga pa dang drod khams las byung ba'i rdo rje thod nag dmar nag spu gri so rnon can dang: dbugs khams las byung ba'i rtsa la rgyug 'gyel ljang sngon rlung gi 'khor lo can dang: rus khams las byung ba'i rdo rgyud khra bo can gdong ba sngo la lus po khrag mdog tu 'dug pa spu gri'i sen mo can dang: rtsa khams las byung ba'i grob da gdong dmar rje smug nag las kyi mtshon dmig can dang: cha mnyam las byung ba'i srin thang gi gri btsan 'bar ba spu gri'i 'khor lo 'dzin pa dang:rtsal gyi btsan bdun yang de'i rjes subyung ngo: gtso 'khor brgyad po sngon smon gyi dbang gi rje rigs la sdang zhing sbyor sgrol la shin tu chags pa: rtsal nam mkha'i dbyings su rgyu ba: stobs dregs pa yongs la 'gran pa

las gsod gcod reg phung gtong ba: ma nyes pa la ngan gtong byed pa'i yul sder nad mug mtshon 'khrug gi char phab nas yul khams phung la khad par thug tshe: dbang chen pad+ma te ru ka nyid dgongs pa'i dbyings las bzhengs te gdug pa'i btsan rnams dbang du bsdus: rdo rje'i phyag rgyas dam du bsdam: dang po tshangs spyod la zhugs pa'i yon tan bshad bar du rma 'byung ba'i nyes pa bsgrags: tha ma smon log btab pa'i 'bras bu yin par bstan te ngo sprad: phyir shakwa thub kyi bstan pa dang dgosatsan rgyan pad+malibastan pa srung ba'i gnyer byang gtad: spyi gtsug tu dam tshig gi rgya rdo rje gzhag: 'da' med kyi mna' chu lce la btab: dbang chen pad+ma nyaru ga'i bka' yi srung mar bskos so rdo rje'i sgog ldan rnams kyi grwal du bzhag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i nang du btsud: las kyisrin mo gdong dmar ma dang gnyis ka bde stong gi grogs su dam tshig bsres li yul dang

bcibs nas gu ru'i spyan sngar 'dug ste zhabs spyi bor blang gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab tshe: slob dpon chen po ting nge 'dzin las 'azhengs te zhal 'dzum pa nas: kye srog btsan 'bar ba mched bdun rnams: khyed cag sngon bsam pa dag pa bar du nyes pa med pa: tha ma sbyor sgrol la spyod pa'i mthu ldan cing smon pa du smin pa: pha btsan gyi rgyal po ma dmu yi dbang mo: sras btsan rgod 'bar ba rang las spros pa'i pho nya dang bcas pa khyed cag sngon yang pad+ma he ru ga'i /nas pa da ltar kyang pad+ma gsung gi tha tshig la 'dus pa rten 'brel dabhe mtshan ma bzang ngo: deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang: bye kyi bstan pa rin po che dang khyad par nye brgyud zab mo chos gter gyi sgo rtag tu srung zhing skyongs ba dang: yang snying pad+ma gsung gi chos sde der 'dzin gyi

jeg 'dzin bstan pa'i sbyin bdag dang bcas pa bsrung zhing skyabs nas phun tshogs kyi snang ba 'phel bar mdzad pa dang: smon lam log pa'i gtso bo che dgu dmang phal ba dang bcas pa thams cad mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis tshar bcad nas: ming tsam yang mi gnas par mdzad pa dang: khyad par du sngags kyi dbang phyug pho mos tsa du shu la tri shu la tri zhes brjod pa tsam gyis mngag pa'i las byed pa dang: brin las rab 'byams stsol ba'i gnyer skyongs shig: gzhan yang sgrub gnas dang gtsug lag bshad sgrub kyi 'khor lo gang na gnas pa der rtag tu mel rtses skyongs shig: zhes gsungs nas phyag mtshan rdo rje rtse lnga pa spyi bor bzhag dam tshig gi yi ge hūṃ sngon po lce la bzhag snying gar srog rdo rje tre ཿyig gi mtshan par shar nas gus 'dud kyi zhe sa dang bcas te rang gnas su gshegs so: de rjes 'jam dbyangs sprul pa khri sgong lde'u btsan gyis gangs ljongs bod khams sgongs tshe: rgya gar nas mkhan slob rnam gnyis gdan drangs bsam yas sa 'dul nas bzung ste ra rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi ma dang zla ba'i tshul du legs par bkod: phyi nang

gsang ba'i rten rnams kyang phun sum tshogs par grub tshe gtsugs lag khang gi gnyer kha bsrung ba'i pho nyar sgo ba dpon pad+mas lung bstan pa ltar bha dra hor / sa ka cha dang dkor nor 'phrog pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i chos rgyal sku lnga dang: blon chenardo rje btsan rgod 'bar ba be har dkor mdzod gling du phyi nang gsang ba'i.o rgyan chen posalha sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyis bstims shing 'gyur ba med par rgyas btab: bsam yas kyi gnyer bsrung ba'i pho nyar bskos rje blon re /na las bsgos ma 'ongs pa'i gtsug lag khang mchod rten bzhengs pa rnams kyang dregs pa 'di rnams la gnyer bcol bar zhal gyis bzhes: gsang mtshan nyid la gnas pa'i gsang sgog can zhes ming gnang: gzhan yang bshad sgrub kyi gzhi bzung tshe de dang de yi grogs su bcol bar mdzad do: rgyal chen 'di

dbab sogs bstan pa'i thabs la yang nas yang du zhus so: 'khu tshul dang ldog tshul 'da' lugs rnams gsum gsum du bstan tshethun rgyan chen pos de dag la log non gyi sgrubapa re re mdzad do: 'di dus nas gangs ljongs bod kyi gnyer skyongs las kyi pho nya rgyal btsan rdo rje thogs med rtsal zhes bsngags so: de'i phyis su sgrub gnasa.arnya pa lo'i dkyil 'khor du bka' bab las can snying gi bu dgu la bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal phyes te: bka' so sor bab pa ltar du lung bstan pa'i sgrub gnas rnamasasu sgrub pa mthar phyin la 'jug go: de dag gi nang tshan dbang chen rgyal ba mchog dbyangs sgrub gnas zla gam phug par pad+ma gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi zhal phyes nas sgrub pa'igrub rtags thon te: spyi gtsug nas rta zhal bzhad pa'i glu yis bskul te brag btsan mchedabargyad po dpung dang bcas pa skad cig gi 'dus nas gus 'dud kyi zhe sa dang bcas te gnas pa la: kyi brag btsan 'bar ba las kyi pho nya dang bcas khyed cag sngon nas dam tshig dag: bar dutsan rgyan chen po'i bka' tha tshig la gnas: tha ma rig 'dzin chen po

ba:tshu bdag gi spyan sngar dad gus dang bcas te 'dus pa lags pas:kho bo'i nyams kyi mthiladabang chen bdud dpung zil gnon 'di nyid da lta mi spel bar rin chen sa yi gter du sbas tshe gnyer skyongs kyi pho nya khyod nyid lags pas nyin mtshan rtag par 'tsho skyongs dang mel rtse la gnas par gyis shig:phyis subadag nyid dbang chen bzhad pa rtsal du bzhengs tshe grogs su khyod nyid bsgrub las su dgra gsod gos su sgrub khang gyon tshe ci bcol ba'i las thams cad khyed kyis byed dgos:gtang rag dang brngan pa bdag gis gtong nges pa dam tshig sa ma yā:spyir na tshogs brgyad kyi rang mdangs dregs pa sde brgyad du shar ba lags pas khyod nyid kyang yid kyi shes pa'i rang bzhin du gnas na yid ye shes su grol na srung ma'i sgog la dbang thob:bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin la mthun snang du shar:'gal zla dgra bgegs gnyis la gshed du shar nas bka' chad thog ltar 'bebs so:don la rang bzhin gyi dbyings las g.yos pa med kyang rten 'brel kyi snang ngor ma 'dres par shar ba ni chu zla dang 'ja' tshon lta bu'o:skal ldan rig

pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi dregs pa'i gsang rgyud mthong na phrin las rab 'byams su byed: gzigs pa'i zhal bzang mthong: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: don gnyis ngang gis 'grub pa'i grogs su 'gyur ro: sa ma yu: las rim dang po dregs pa'i skyed rgyud bshad pa'o: rgya rgya rgya dbang chen nyi ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo 'de nyid sgrub pa'i gnas ni dur khrod g.ya' gangasanag khrod mtsho 'gram sogs shin tu skyi gzengs ba'i gnas 'jig rten kyi rgyu 'grul dben par phyin te phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rgya bcad dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams la grogs su bcol nag phyogasabadud dang dam sri rnamasaring du bskrad bsrung ba'i gur khang rim brgyad phub rnal 'byor pa rnamasapad+ma dbang chen gsung gi gsang gsum gya dkyil 'khor la byin thob pa'i yon tan gzhir bzhag la dgos su bsnyen pa kha gso zhingatshogs ston gyi spros pa rgya cher btang ngo de nas maṇ+ḍal mda' gang ba dbang gi kha dog 'char bar byas pa'i khar zhun mar du byas pa'i brten gtor zhal shes ltar du bca' dar zab dang gdugs sogs kyis mdzes par bya de nyid dbus su bkod 'og nas bshad pa'i mda' dang bla rdo dang bla rten dang srog 'khor dang brten sgrub bskang ba'i dzos thams cad skyon gyis ma gos par yongs su tshang bar byas te mdzes pa'i tshul du bkod gser skyems dang g.yu skyems

khrag skyems sogasakyang mdzes par bya gzhan mang gamasasu ru mtshon phyar g.yon du mdung mar bkod go khrab mtshon cha ris su bris te gzhugs btsan rgod 'bar ba'i zhal brnyan kyi dar mdzes rnam lnga 'dod gzung sogs mchod rdzas rgya mtsho sgos bcas su bkod nas sgrub pa la 'jug go sa ma shā las rim gnyis pa btsan rgod 'bar ba'i phyi yi sgrub rten bkod pa'o rgya rgya rgya dbang chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal da 'bar ba'i srog rten bkod pa la dar dmar dbang gi kha dog 'bar ba'i ngos su dpa' bo g.yul du bsad pa'i snying khrag gisatre rwa tsa dung dung 'dus 'dus tra rwa tsa kwa ya dung dung 'dus 'dus tri rwa tsa wāk+ka dung du 2 tri rwa tsa tsit+ta dung dung 'dus 'dus tri rwa tsa gu ṇa dung dung 'dus 'dus tri rā tsa garma dung dung 'dus 'dus tri rā tsa tsa tu shu la dung dung 'dus 'dus tri rwa tsa yaku dung dung 'dusa'adus tri rwa tsa raku tsit+ta dung dung 'dus wasde sarba dung dung 'dus 'dus tri rwa tsa lo sarba dung dung 'dus 'dus tri rā tsa sarba dung dung 'dus 'dus tri rwa tsa ram̐ sarba dung dung 'dus 'dus tri rā tsa ye sarba dung dung 'dus 'dus tri rwa tsa ke sabo dung du 'dus 'dus sarba dung dung 'dus 'dus zhes dbu can tsheg med du bkod la ran chen sna lngas byug la nang du dril te rba dkar tshags gsum pa'i nang khung du gzhugs la sgrub pa'i rten du bya'o sa ma wā las rim gsum pa btsan

2bar ba'i nang gi sgrub rten bkod pa'o rgya rgya rgya dbang chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo btsan rgod 'bar ba'i srog rten bca' tshul ni za 'og gi khug mar dung shā mig med par trī yig brtsam pa dang byi ru mig med pa latu yi gipatshan par byas pa dang g.yu byang mig med la tsamamog bkod pa can dang dregs pa' bla rdo pha waṃ long bu la dpa' bo g.yul du bsad pa'i snying khrag gisashā drug bkod pa dang gro mar gyi sug bzhi'i spu rna bsdus te bsdum pa dang bhe tagro zhun gyi sug spun dang 'dab chags bya dmar po'i rke spu dang rin chen sna lnga dang bzang drug gi phye ma rnams dang gong gi bla rdo snams za 'og gi khug bur blugs kha sna lngas rgya chings gdab cingani yig gi mtshan pa'i rgyas gdab la sgrubarten du bkod na srung ma'i snying nye shad phrin las rab 'byams thams cad thog med du 'grub par 'gyur ro sam pā las rim bzha pa btsan rgod 'bar ba'i srog rten brtsam thabs kyi rim pa'o rgya rgya rgya dbang chen he ru ka la phyagaritshal lo btsan rgod 'bar ba'i khyad par gyi srog rten bri thabs ni dar dmar kha gang ba'i ngor mtshal dang bzang drug bsres pas mu khyud rim pa bcu ru bskor dang po' gnas subatsan rgod 'bar ba'i sku dang dpa' bo gri ru 'gum 'i snying khrag gis tsa duḥzi gsum dpral mgrin snying ga la bkod mu khyud gnyis pa ra tsadu shu 'angatri ma ma tsit+ta dung ya la rwa tsa kwa la du pa sarba sa ma ya hrī dza dza dbu can tsheg med yig mgo phyir bstan du sku yi mgo bo nas brtsam mo mu
