—41 khyud gsum par 'khor lo rtsibs bdun pa 'i nang rnams sus sam pa rak+ṣa rtsibs mchan rnams la tsā sa ma ya rasnya dbu can tshegs med du bkod do mu khyud bzhi par hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ pha ṭa phaṭa phaṭa a a ā tsa dushu la 4re snye bh+yo tsa du mu kha le bh+yo ya ma rwa tsa kwa la k+ṣe sa ma ya bh+yo ya ma dun ma ya la shrī ka ma du pa bh+yo dbu can tshegs med yig mgo phyir bstan du sku gzugs kyi mgo bo' steng nas brtsam mo mu khyud lnga paradabyang dang gas gabyed kyi mjug tu btsan rgod srog len 'bar ba'i sku brten par gyur cig gsung chags par gyur cig thugs gnas par gyur cig kwa ya wāk+ka tsit+ta tini badz+ra dbu can tshegs med yig mgo phyir brtan du gong ltar bkod mukhyud drugapar mdung zhags dang mda' gzhu bkod mu khyud bdun par pa ma tsa tre+e shu la spyo rbad sod ma kha le gzugs 'khrugs spyo rbad ya ma rwa tsa kā la k+ṣe cho cho bh+yo rbad sod e ye baṃ le ra tsa tri shu la bh+yo rbad sod ga5 saphu shagorbagabh+yo rji tri ma ra ya sod yi ya 'dzin byed kyi rlung gtor ram̐ ram̐ blta byed kyi mig gtor ba ba bsu byed kyi mchu chings la le skyod byed kyi rkang pa da lte ba gtor ma hūṃ tsa hūṃ shā ka la ru pa hūṃ dgra bo' snyingal bh+yo tsat+ta shag shag gtubs gtub mā ra ya tig khrol swā snya zhes dbu can chegs med yig mgo nang bstan du sku gzugs kyi gdan 'go nas brtsam te bkod do mu 'khyud brgyad par 'byung bzhi'i ra mo legs par bkod mu 'khrud

na gu par rten 'brel snying po'i mthar nad gdon 'jigasapa'i tshogs thamasacad zhi zhing stong par gyur cig tshe dpa la legs tshogs kyi dngos po thamasacad 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig khams gsum srid pa'i blo yid thams cad da bang du 'du bar gyur cig mi dang mi ma yin pa'i dgra bgegs log 'dren 'byung po thams cad tshar chod par gyur cig shirnye pu/ wa shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa swāsnya zhesadabu can tshegs med yig mgo phyi bstan du bkod do mu 'khyud bcu par ste ri pa tra bkod la dzos ni bzang drug dang rin chen sna lnga sbyar bsad sngags la gra khrag byug 'bod sngags la bdud rtsi chos sman mnye rbad sngags la rdo khab len dang sprel gyi khrag byug bla rdo gnas pa brten pa' rdzas pha wa long bu sgog 〉leg gi mtshan pa can snying por gzhug la rab tu gnas de nasalegs par lteb cang sna lngasargya changs gdab la dar dmar lja gisadral nas sgrub rten du bkod phyisasu lus kyi drod dang mi 'bral bar 'chang bas btsan rgod chen ོ lusadang grib bzhin 'grogasal bsrung skyobs dang mel rtse byed do sa ma mā las rim lnga pa btsan rgod chen po' gsang rten srog 'khor bcing thabs kyi rim pa bstan pa'o rgya rgya rgya dbangachen nyi ruka la phyag 'tshal lo skalangarma gyibatsan rgod rdo rje yang le par sgrub tshe mchod pa'i rdzas su nas khal gsum gyi mchod dzos bya sdig pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pa' sha khog gcig gas dga' ston bya mar srang brgya yis mun sel mar me dang phye mar gtong ro gzhan

btsakhri yang 'byu sman dar zab shing tog dkar gsum mngar gsum rgya ja bzang po'i skyems bod kyi 'o ma'i phud rong ba' nas bcud chang la sogs pa'i mdzes pa gzugs kyi bye brag snyan pa sgra ya dga' ston zhim pa bzang po' dra tshogs mngar skyur ro yi bye brag dar zab gosakyi rnam pa 'dod yon dkor nor bsam kyas mi khyab par dam tshag gi rdzas su bkod sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyas brlabs ti 'dzan kyi dbang bsgyur nas rgyu gtsang ning phud ma nyams pa rngam sems sar sna 'jur 'geg gi dri ma mtha' dag dang bral ba'i yid 'ong gi dga' ston rgya chen pos srung ma mchod ci bskang na las myur phrin las nye rtag tu brtse gdung chen po dam tshig gis bsrung skyobs byed tha ra gdon ma za'o sa ma yā las rim drug pa btsan rgod chen po'i dgyes bskang gi rdzas sna tshogs bsags pa 'i thabs bstan pa'o rgya rgya rgya dbang chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo dbang chen gsung ga bka' sdod zhi sgrub sngon du grub zen pa'i do gal chen da po bstun nas 'bod sgrub byed tshe 'bod bskul 'di nyid dus drug tu sbyar ro dmar gtor dang chang skyems bshams la 'gugs bstims nan du bya bsang dud rgya che bar spro snyan pa'i rol mo sna tshog sgrogs na bang chen he ru ga'i gsal sna dang ldan pa 'i ngang nas kye: nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na: btsan yul zangs thang dmar po nas: dmu btsan nga gas pas sras gcig pu: gnod sbyin rgyal po

/ ra sku mdog dmar nag khro zhing gtum:zangs kyi khrab rmog 'khor gsum brgyan:phyag g.yas btsan zhags dgra la skor:thar 'chor med par btson bzhin khrid:g.yon mdung dmar dgra la 'debs:zhing bcu'i don snying lkog mar 'byin:dbang gi dar ber lhub chen gsol:pad+ma gsung gi bka' sdod pa g.yas na stag ral mda' yis nga:rje bo nyams pa can la 'debs:g.yon du gzig shub gzhu mo bkod:phra ma mkhan kyi sgog la 'debs:sga gong phyed 'gyings tshul du rol:bstan pa gnyis kyi srung ma dpral ba'i dkyil na mig gcig shar:zab gter snying po'i drod 'dzin no chibs su bra bo rgab nag bcibs:bsam pa'i yul la skad cig slebs:gong thag glo smed sbrul byas:rmongs pa'i gdon tshogs brlag par byed:dar dmar stan la rin chen sga:dpa' bo bzhugs pa'i gdan du bkod:gser srab g.yu mthur mdzes par bkram

btsa/ gtong:rjes su ri khyi lcags spyang mdur sdang ba'i dgra bo'i bla tshe rku:khyed kyi g.yas kya ru 'dren pa dpa' bo de ni skyes pa brgya g.yas pas mda' 'phen sha ra ra:g.yon nas gzhu brdung khrigs se khrig:g.yon kyi ru sna 'dren mdzad pa'i:nyan sgos de nai dgra bcom brgya:kha nas mdo 'don 'u ru rnga rgyab tu ka li mdzes shing brjid:khyod kyi sngon nas shul mtshon pa:bud med nag mo mche gtsigs brgya:g.yas pas dar nag rubs se rub:kha nas ngu 'bod 'u ru na khyed kyi slad nasarjes 'brang ba:badhe de ni sngags pa brgya:g.yas nas lcags phur 'dril zhing gzir g.yon nas rakā'i phreng ba 'dren:ngag nas gsang sngags bden tshig brjod:gzhan yang gar ging 'bag seng tshogs:a tsa ra da byis pa'i sde:khyed kyi sku la 'dud cing 'khor:gzhan yang las kyi btsan bdun dang sha za chen mo srog len ma:'byung ba lnga yi btsan rgod sogs da mu btsan rgyal gyi tshogs rnams kun dad pas 'bod do da tshur byon:snyan pa'i gla yis bskul lo byon rol mo'i sga yis mchod der byon dpa' ston mchod rdzas bkod la

dbang chen pad+ma'i bka' la byon:'dzum pa'i zhal bzang bstan du gsol:nyes can dgra la chad pas chod:sgrub pa po rnams byams brtses skyongs:du:dus la bab po sa ma yā:zhes bskul la 'bod dmigs ni bdag nyid dbang chen du gsal ba'i sku'i cha thams cad nas:'od zer dmar po rab tu sprorten gyi khams thams cad khyab nas dregs pa can thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus nas bskyed pa'i dam tshig pa la bstem pas dregs pa kun gyi shā na du gyur bar dmigs yang 'byung ba lnga yi khams nas kyang btsan dmag bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs nas bskyed pa'i lha la bstim:yang dbang rje

gas/: bzlas na khri phrag gis bskul 'bum phrag gis nye bye ba bzlas pa sa rab tu nye zhi phrin las ga brtsams thams cad 'grub pa ra the tshom med do skabs su bskang bsol dang 'khrugs bskang la 'bad mnga' gsol dang bstod pa rgya cher bya des bar chad med pa ra srung ma las la 'du zhi bran du khol bar 'gyur ro sa ma wā las rim bdun pa btsan rgod 'bar ba'i 'bod bskul kya rim pa bstan pa 'o rgya rgya rgya pad+ma dbang chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo btsan rgod chen po sgrub pa 'a rnal 'byor la snying mi nye zhing 'khu ba'i rtags byung tshe srog 'khor gyi phyi rim mtshon cha sna tshogs bris pa'i rtse mo rnams kyis gzir zhang mal 'og tu dong brus pa'i nang du gtsud la rang dbang chen he ru na' bskyed rim la rtag tu brtson sngags 'go mjug bzlog nas rbad chod pa bzlas pas tshe daro sa nyams rma lam gang ru la brnye dang a tsa ri phyag 'tshal ba mgo bos btud pa da gla dmar da khyi dkar bya la phyi ba rnams bcar zhi kha nas khrag lhud pa tsam du byung ba da rta bra bo nyal nas mgo sa la sbyar ba sogs gnad dbab tshad la thebs pa'i rtags so 'di dus su srog 'khor mal 'og nas byu bsang khrus da gtsang sbra bya dal dbus su bkod nas sgrub pa la 'bad pas rtags mtshan nges pa ra 'byu— ngo sa ma yā las rim brgyad pa btsan rgod 'bar ba 'khu tshe gnad dbab kyi rim pa bstan pa'o rgya rgya rgya pad+ma dbang chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo tshogs na la 'gro

dang ldan pa rnams kyis btsan rgod rdo rje yang le ber sgrub tshe rtags kyi rim pa sna tshogs su 'byung bas shes par bya'o dang po sgrub pa 'i dus su 'od 'khyil ba dang sgra sgrogs pa dang rta yi mtsher skad byung ba dang mang po' gtam sgra thos pa dang gtor ma la 'od 'bar ba sogs 'byung tshe rtags tshad them pa'o 'bod pa' dus su mgron po rgyang ring nas thon pa rma ba dang khyung chen nam mkha' nasas la 'bab pa dang mi chen rang ga 'dabs su 'dug pa dang sde chen gyidapon du mnga' gsol ba dang khyim 'od dmar gyis gang ba dang dri 'thug por bro ba dang lus la 'phar g.yo 'byung ba dang 'ur sgra thug tshom du yir ba dang sgrub khang gi sgo brdung ba dang gtor ma la me stag 'phro ba rnamasani 'bod pa tshad du 'khyol ba'i rtags so nor sgrub kyi du su phyugs las rwa ba gang ba dang rin po che'i dkor nor la longs spyod pa dang lus la 'dam rdzab 'go ba da thang chen la rtsi thog lo 'bras rgyas pa dang char chen po 'beb pasogs rmi ba ni nor dang bsod nams la mnga' dbang 'byor ba'i rtags so rbad pa'i dusasu se chen la zhon nas g.yul du 'gro ba stag gzig skyang 'brong sogs bkol dka' ba rnams zhen nas 'gro ba dang dmag chen dang bsdongs nas yul mang kha lo bsgyur ba dang sad dang ser ba phab nas rtsa thog lo bcud mang po brlag pa da rlung chen lda nas nags klung chen po bcom pa sogs rbad pa 'i rtags lam du so ba'i tshad do khyad par ba gtor ma las

gtsaX me zhags 'phro ba skyems khol bsgrub khang la dud rlangs 'khrigs pa rnal 'byor ba'i shes nyams gze sa pa sogs 'byung ro bsad pa'i du su dgra bo' gro snying nang khrol khrag 'dzag bzhan du rang la sterab rmi na yun 'khyangs nas gsod pa 'i rtags so gtor rdzas dang skyems kyi nang du ko ro tsa na khrol bur byung na yas de ltar roḥ ja chang gi skyems khrag tu bskyil nas sob sob khol na myur du sod rtags dgra bo'i ro gzugs rnying pa'i tshuladu rang la ster na lo la mi 'khya— sa bar thub so lngags skam mnye bzhin du byung na glo bur thog bab tu 'chi ba'i rtags so rus pa khral khrol du byu ba'ang de ltar ro khyad par gyi rtagasagator ma me ru de sa ba dang skyems khrag tu kholab dang hom khung du khrag 'khyel ba dang dgra bo'i lo dang bla dwags gang rung dang mthun pa' gzugs can 'dar yed yed byed bzhin dal 'og tu 'khrum pa da brub khung la thim pa sogs bla 'gugs rtags dang bsad pa'i rtagasabashad pa'o zhakhru ba' rtags gong du bshad bzhin — ltar la mngon spyod kyi las rjes su byung na drag bskang la 'bad rang bzhin gya dus su byu na 'khrugs bskang la brtson bsnyen sgrub kyi dus su byung na gnad dbab la 'jug go rbadabasad kyi dus su byung na za ngu la rtse gcig tu 'bad pas las gang dang gang brtsams thams cad gdon mi za bar 'grub po sa ma yā las rim dgu pa btsan rgod chen po zhi drag gi sgrub pa byed tshe rtags la brtag pa'i thabs bstan pa'o

rgya rgya rgya dbang chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo bstan 'dzan skyes bu rnams kyi sku tshe dang mdzad phrin la bar chad dgra yis rgol ba brtsam tshe rbad pa gnam lcags thog ga mde'u da 'dra ba 'di la brtson par bya'o de yang phung shul gyi sa sna bsres pas gru gsum sum rim bya de rgyab 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi dang de rgyab 'khor lo rtsab bdun dang bcas par dmar gtor g.yon gcus re re rtsabs la bkod par bya rtsibs mchan la yang de lta bu' gtor chung re re dkod steng gi sding khrar gtso bo yab yum gya gtor ma rngams shing brjid par bya de nas khrag skyems dang dmar gtor bshams la 'gugs bstem nan du bya gtum rngam kyi shugs bskyed la rol mo sna tshogs kyi sgra sder zhing gdung ba'i dbyangs 4sa 'ad skad do hūṃ bh+yo dza nub phyogs gri thang dmar po nas: btsan gyi rgyal po tsi ma ra: gnad nas bskul lo da tshur byon: dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung: byang phyogs li yul spug po nas sha za ḍāk+ki srog len ma gnad nas bskul lo da tshur byon: dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung: shar phyogs khyung tshang brag dkar nas: lha btsan dkar po mthu rtsal can:gnad nas bskul lo da tshur byon: dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung: lho phyogs srin po'i spar rjes nas: bdud btsan nag po mche ba can: gnad nas bskul lo da tshur byon dgra

bsgo/: la rbad do mthu ma chung:nub phyogs se chen brag dkar nas:klu btsan ser po rdzu 'phrul can: gnad nas bskul lo da tshur byon: dgra la rbad do mthu ma zung: byang phyogs sbu ba can gyi mtshor: dbang mdzad srin btsan 'bar ba rje:gnad nas bskul lo da tshur byon dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung:shar lto 'ja' tshon brag steng nas:rdo rgyud khra bo las kyi btsan:gnad nas bskul lo da tshul byon dgra la rbad do lho nub ljon shing gel pa nas:gri thang mtshams kyi btsan rgod ni:gnad nas bskul lo da tshur byon: dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung:nub byang byang shar mtshams kyi gnas:srin brag me rlung dbang byed btsan: gnad nas bskul lo da tshur byon: dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung:bzhan yang 'byung bzhir brten bcas pa 'i:rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan las kyi btsan dmu dang drang sgong rgyal gyi tshogs:kun kyang sgrol la rngam tshul du:gnad nas bskul lo da tshur byon: dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung: dbang chen pad+ma he ru ga'i: bka' sdod rdo rje yang le ber gtso 'khor sprul pa g.yog dang bcas: dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung: bgegs la

da do rtsal ma zhan: dgra bo'i yul du las la chas: than dang ltas ngan mig 'phrul cig: ming tsal med par rdul du rlog: mngon spyod drag po'i las mdzod cig: dus la bab po ma yā: bdag nyid dbang chen he ru ga'i mdun du bka' sdod gnod sbyin btsan rgod yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa mngon sum du bzhugs par gsal gdab: kun kyang drag po ngon spyod kyi las la rab tu rngams shing gdug rtsubs kyi mtshon cha brdar bzhin ha hi bzhad pa'i rnam 'gyur dabhe ldan par bzhugs pa'i srog nas dbang chen he ru ga'i thugs 'i 'od zer gyis bskul te bdag gi gang 'dod kyi las rab 'byams sgrub par bsam la: sna hūṃ hūṃ: a a ā: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa yakru rak+ka skṛ wa dun bh+yo: tsa tu shu la tri dung dung dza ya ma ra dza ka la k+ta dgra la rbad rje : smra bcad ting 'dzan ldan pa yis bdun zhag sgrub pas rtags mtshan 'byung dgra dbu thal ba rdul brlag 'gyur ze tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yu las rim bcu pa rdon rgod 'bar ba dgra la rbad pa'i gnad bstan pa'o rgya rgya rgya dbang chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo mngon spyod drag po sgrub pa 'i rnal 'byor ba rnams kyis btsan rgod 'bar ba'i las gzhung 'dir brtson tshe dgra bo bsad pa'i dam

—49 tshag gi gnad la dbab na: dmar gtor dang khrag skyems bshams la 'gugs gzhug nan du bya gtor ma sha ri khrag gi rgya mtshor dmigs nas 'dod yon mi zad pa' dpa la du spros te bsad bskul 'di nyidal brtsan par bya de yang rol mo sna tshog sgrogs shi rngam yus bskyed la 'di skad do hūṃ bh+yodza: nyam nub phyogs btsan gyi yul: gri thang dmar po'i yar steng nas: zangs brag ldem pa'i sku mkhar1nga mi rta bsnol ba'i khri steng nas: btsan rgod rdo rdzeyang le ber: sku ni dmar nag khros pa'i gzugs: e gtsigs bsdams shing gad rgyang sgrogs: khro gnyer brjid chagasagayon 'gying sgeg phyag g.yas btsan zhags dgra la bskor: dmu yi dmag dpung bu yug 'tshubs: g.yon pas btsan mdung ngar ldan thogs: rgyal po'i dmag dpung thog ltara'abebs: chibs su bra nag 'phur shes bcibs: bsam pa'i yul la thog ltar 'bebs: sku la 'khor gsum rgyan gyis brgyan: zhing bcu'i don snying lkog mar 'byen: sha khragadaga' ston dpal la sgod: mngon sgod las kyi mdzad pa smongs: drag rtsal rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i lha: gnad nas bskol lo da bzhengs shig: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di'i:

bla tshe srog gsum so sor phyes: phu nu nye ba gshed du bsgyur nang dme gri thabs sna tshogs ston: than dang ltas ngan char ba phob ming gi lhag tsam med pa rtsa mngon spyod dragapos dgra sde rlog: bh+yo: rab 'jigs rngam pa'i dur khrod nas: sha za chen mo sgog 'phrog ma: gnad nas bskul lo da bzhengs shig: dmar gtor khrag skyems 'di bzhes la dgra bo'i yul du las la chos: bsad rtags don snying mngon sum sprod: sha khrag rus pa dum bur gtubs: ming tsam med par rdul du rlog: mngon spyod phrin las 'grub paramadzod: bh+yo: gnas pa 'o dzagayul na gnas: rgyu ba rgya gar yul du rgyu: 'jug pa dur khrod gnas su 'jug rnal 'byor pa yi las kun byed: dgra yi sha khrag rus par dgyes mngon spyod drag po'i las la 'jug: bsam pa'i yul du thogs med bsgod spyor sgrol thabs la mkhas pa yi: btsan rgod rdo rje dgra 'joms kyi phyag brten sprul ba'i btsanachen bdun: re 'ga' nyi ma'i zer la rgyu: re 'ga' mun pa'i smag la cha: re 'ga' skya rings dus su nyul: dgra srog len pa'i mthu bo che: gnad nas bskul 'i da bzhengs shig:

badz+ra: dmar gtor khrag skyems 'di bzhes la bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di: dkon pa'i tshe srog gnyis dang phrol bla tshe sgog dbugs so sor gtor bsad rtags don snying bdag la sprod spyo 'bog na dme dgra la thongs ming gi lag tsam mi gnas par: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yo sgrub gnasayongs la dbang bsgyur zhing:tshe sgog 'phrog pa'i mthu bo che nyams pa yongs kyi gshed gyur ba: btsan rgod 'bar ba mched bdun po:mngag pa'i las la myur mgyogs can dam ldan yongs kyi grogs gcig pu: gnad nas bskul ma da bzhengs shig: dmar gtor khrag skyems 'di bzhes la: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo yi: bla tshe sgog dbugs so sor phyes: dgra yul than gyi char ba phob: dgra sde nang dme gri thabs sod: phung brlag nus mthu'i brtul zhugs kyis:ming tsam med pa'i phrin las mdzod:63 badz+ra tsa tri shu la dza dza:tri ye du pa dza bh+yo: dgra bgegs gnod byed kyi tshe bla srog gsum la mā ra ya rbad rbad sarba dun bh+yo tsit+ta shag khrol swāhā:zhes brjad la dus drug tu bskul bar bya des ni dgra sde pha lam yin kyang 'ari ga pa ra nus

sa ma yu las ram bcu gcig pa btsan rgod 'bar ba dgra bo' tshe srog la bskul ba' rim pa sbu gri ngar ma'o rgya rgya rgya pad+ma dbang chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo bstan pa srung ba' rig 'dzan rnams kyi sku tshe mdzad phrin la dgra gas kyis rgol tshe de nyid mngon spyod drag po'i phren las la drangs phyir ligi dbang tshang man ngag rnams da mthun par bris nas zag rdzas byug ste e kha nang du gzhugs mchog gsum la gser skyems pa zhing phrin las bcol ba ni hūṃ trīḥ dkon mchog gsum po gzu dang dpang la dgongs: chos skyong bsrung ma gzu dang dpang la dgongs: nor lha gter bdag gzu dang dpang la /ngas: btsan rgod chen po gzu dang dpang la dgongs: srog len chen mo gzu dang dpang la dgongs: rol pa skya bdun gzu dang dpang la dgongs: 'bar ba spun bdun gzu dpang la dgongs: 'byung lnga'i btsan rgod gzu dang dpang la dgongs sprul pa g.yog bcas gzu dang dpang la dgongs: yul gzhi'i bdag po gzu dang dpang la dgongs:ga ni ma nyes rang bab 'dug pa la: dam nyams dgra bo 'di yis ma ster ro: las su lha sgrub mgon du dkon mchog brten: gos su sgrub khang gyon la bstan pa srungs:

badz+ra 'jig rten blos btang phyi ma dang du blang yang dag don gyi nye lam sgom pa la: bar chad bdud dang dgra yis ma ster ro: mkhyen ldan rnams kyi gzu dang dpang po mdzod: nyes pa can la bka' yi chad pa chod: nyams pa can la mngon spyod nus mthu ston: brngan pa'i dpa' skyems mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: do nub drag po'i las 'di 'grub par mdzod thugs dam ma g.yel badz+ra sa ma yā: zhes brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar mchad la dgra yi ste du dmod mo bya'o ling bskyed ni rang gi mdun du nyams pa can rnams bsgral ba'i gzhi shin tu 'jigs shing rab tu skye g.ya' ba'i brub khung rgya che la gting zab pa: kha khyer mtho zhing nad mtshon dug gi bu yug 'tshubs pa: sod sod dang chod chod kyi sgra sgrogs pa: las byed kyi pho nya mang po nyi ma'i zer ltar 'khrugs zhing: dgra bgegs 'gugs bstim gyi las la nyul ba: gzhan yang bla 'dzin gyi drwa ba bkram zhing: bla rkun gyi gcan spyang dang khyi nag ngu ba: bskal ba'i me 'bar zhing srid pa'i rlung nag g.yo ba: de'i nang du dṛX dang triḥyongs su gyur ba las bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba: sku dgra rnam lngar

nyams pa bdun la gtogs pa'i dgra bo de shin tu nyam thag pa'i gzugs can: rkang lag lcags gzer gyis thebs pa bu ga dgu nas rnag khrag 'dzag pa: nyam thag da nga bral la khad 'dar bri li li byed par gsal gdab: de'i snying gar dra dang triḥgasal ba las 'od 'phros pa'i dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad rang dbang med ga nas ru pa la yang yang bstim: gzhan yang las byed sprul ba'i pho nya mo lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgogs dril bu can dpag tu med pa 'phros nas dgra bgegs ) rang dbang med par stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams nas bsdus te liṅga la bstim mo bden brjod ni na mo: dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo mchog gsum sku gsum bden gnyis baspu ba med pa'i bden mthu dang:rdo rje chos skyong ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang: bden pa chen sa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la snga dgra lag gis brdar ba: phyi dgra yid la sems pa: da dgra thad du bsdo ba'i gzugs

ba tshu can gzugs med gang dang gang yin pa thams cad rang dbang med par bkug nas liṅga la phob cig: bstims shig dzaḥ/ baṃ ho: bdun gsum nyer gcig la sogs brjod nas 'gug pa'i rtags thon par bya'o gzhan yang 'gugs 'chang sdom myos kyi las ni dza dza: dam tshog can gyi pho nya rnams: gnad nas bskul lo da bzhengs shig: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams: las kyi liṅga 'di la phob dgra bgegs sarba dzaḥ( be ho: dgra bgegs gnod byed rnams kyi bla sha re ma ti grim grim: sha ma ru ti thul thul: myog myog: yed yed: sha ma ru ti khug khug ling myog ling shag: ling thum tsa mun tri dza hūṃ baṃ ho: brgyad rtsa sogs 'gugs bstim nan du bya'o dza dza dam tshig can gyi pho nya rnams: gnad nas bskul lo da bzhengs shig: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di: skyobs byed lha srung kun dang phrol: a dri trag rakru mā ra ya phyes phyes: ma ma trag du tra mā ra ya phyes phyes: dgra bo skyob byed kyi lha dang phyes phyes badz+ra pra we sha ya phaṭa: sngags de ci nus su brjod cangadagra bo lha srung dang dbye ba'i las la phra men ma thams cad 'jug par bsam dza dzaḥ dam tshig can gyi pho nya rnams: gnad nas

bskul ma da bzhengs shig bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di'i: lus ngag yid gsum bcings zhing sdom dgra bgegs sarba dza— rba ho: dgra bgegs gnod byed rnams kyi lusaching ngag chings yid chings mā ra ya thum ri li li chings shig: badz+ra bhan+ta baṃ: sngags te ci 'grub brjod nas dgra bo'i lus ngag yid gsum byad thag sngo dmar gyis bcing ba'i dmigs 'dun bya'o dza dza:dam tshig can gyi pho nya rnams gnad nas bskul lo da bzhengs shig bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo la las kyi mtshon cha'i char ba phob e tsakra rbad rbad sod: re tsakra rbad rbad sod baṃ tsakra rbad rbad sod: snye tsakra rbad rbad sod: ye tsakra rbad rbad sod: sngagasate ci 'grub brjod cingadagra bo'aganasalnga la mtshon cha'i 'bor lo bskor zhing phu khams rdul du brlag par bsam mo dza tshu dam tshig can gyi pho nya rnams: gnad nas bskul lo da gzhengs shig: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo yi: snying nas gnam lcags phur dbal thobs bla badz+ra gī li gī la ya: ma ma rak+tapra dun gī li ki la ya: aḥdriḥtriXmā ra ya phaṭa: rnam she phur rtser blang nas 'og min gyi dbyings su spar phung khams la thun char dbab pa ni dgra bo'i steng gi nam mkhar btsan rgod chen po gtum rngam khros pa'i brtul

btsagri zhugs kyi ngang nas mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char phab pa da gzhan yang phyogs mtshams la gnas pa'i las kyi btsan rgod rnams kyas mtshon cha' char phab cing dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las la zhugs par dmigs la dza dza dam tshig can gyi pho nya rnams: gnad nas bskul lo da bzhengs shig: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo la: thun dang mtshon cha'i char ba phob: 31 badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan kā la du pa gnod byed gdug pa'i snying rtsa la yi ye: sgog rtsa la tshal tshal: sha khrag rus pa dum bur gtubs dum bur gtubs: mā ra ya rbad sod: zhes brjod la thun rdzas sna tshogs kyi char dbab po lang ga te chos skyo srung ma rnams la stabs tshul byas te dza dza: dam tshig can gyi pho nya rnams: gnad nas bskul lo da bzhengs shig: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo rnams: bsgral ba'i phung khams khyod zhal bstabs: gnod byed ming tsam mi gnas par: mngon spyod drag po'i stobs kyis rlog: dgra bgegs kyi me sa rak+ta tsit+ta ko ro tsa na ki ni ri ti la kha ram̐ khā hi bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs rnams kyis bstan pa'i dgra bo'i phung khams khyur mid du rol nas ming med mdzad pa ra bsam mo des ni dgra dpung rdul du rlog cing rtsad gcod par 'gyur ro sa ma yu las ram bcu gnyis pa btsan

ོ da 'bar ba'i drag las la brten nas dgra bo rdul du brlag pa' rim pa'o rgya rgya rgya dbang chen pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo de ltar drag las byas pa'i rjes su srin zhal gya so bar lta bu'i sa gnad la liṅga bkod de chos skyongabarten sgrub kyi gtor ma lag tu thogs nas hūṃ bh+yo nga ni 'khor 'das yongasakyi spyi rje bo che btsan 'gran bral pad+ma he ru ga: mngon spyod drag po'i las la stobs shugs bskyed zhing bcu bsgral ba'i dam tshig mchog la gnas: dza: mi mngon bde chen rol ba'i gting klong nas dregs pa yongs kyi spyi rje yang le ber bka' sdod dregs pa'i dmag tshogs dang bcas te: mngon spyod drag po'i las la rab bzhengs shig: do nub bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di'i: dkon pa'i tshe sgog gnyis po so sor phyes: phung khams skye mched tshal ba nu ma bur gtubs: kha nas khrag skyugs gdong nas mchi ma phyungs: ngag nas spyo 'bog gtong zhing tshal bar rol than gyis yul khong nang dme mtshon rtse ston: thal ba rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: dgra bgegs gnod byed mtha' yi dmag dpung smon log du ru ṣa dam log slob ma zhing bcu tshang ba rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la phob dza phob

gas/: dza: dmod pa bor bzhan gtor zor brdab nas dgra bgegs rdul du brlag par bsam mo de nas tsher hom la me bsregs de yo nang du ling ro rnams bsregs te dza dza: dam tshig thugs dam chen po'i dus la bab ging gi rgyug bgyel byed rnams gnad nas bskul: 'bar ba me yi las la da bzhengs shig: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo las ngan gyi: phung khams skye mched ma lus bstabs par bgyi: snga dgra lag bdar byed rnams myur du sod da dgra dngos su bsdo rnams thal bar rlog phyi dgra yid la shom rnams ming med mdzod: mngon spyod phrin las drag po'i dus la bab ma g.yel ma 'khyangs btsan rgod dam tshig can: dgra bgegs gnod byed sarba dza la ram̐ ram̐: mā ra ya rbad swāhā: brgya rtsa la sogasaci 'grub brjodanas dgra bo' phung khams bstabs pas hur thum rgyug 'gyel du bsad par bsam mo de nas klu bdud nag po' pho brang la gtad du bcol te dza dza: dam tshig can je lnga/ gnyan gshested rigs rnams tha tshig bsgrags nas 'bod do da tshur byon: bdag la sdang byed bstan pa'i dgra bo rnams: pho nya khyod la gtad du bcol bar bya: ming tsal med par mdze nad char ba phobs: yul sde

stong nas grags pa rgyas par mdzod nā ga rā dza dgra bo khur sum̐ bhan+ta bhan+ta sha hūṃ mā ra ya rbad sod: grangs mang brjod la shul mi mngon par bya'o de nas dmod bcol gdab pa ni ho: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di ming tsam yang mi gnas par mdzod cig: btsan rgod rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal khyod la mthu dang nus pa yod na sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di: lo zlar ma 'khyangs bar rdul durlog cig: yum mchog sgog lam chen mo khyod la mthu dang nus pa yod na sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di: lo zlar ma 'khyangs bar rdul du rlog cig: skyes mchog rol ba skya bdun khyod lamathu dang nus pa yod na sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di: lo zlar ma 'khyangs bar rdul du rlog cig: las byed 'bar ba sbun bdun khyod la mthu dang nus pa yod na sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di lo zlar ma 'khyangs bar rdul du rlog cig: 'byung ba lnga yi btsan rgod khyod la mthu dang nus pa yod na sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di lo zlar ma 'khrungs bar rdul du rlog cig: bka' nyan ru 'dren sde bzhi'i dmag tshogs khyod rnams la mthu dang nus pa yod na sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di lo zlar ma 'gyangs bar rdul du rlog cig: zhag za mar ma 'gyangs bar rdul du rlog

gas/: cig: sdang ba'i dgra bo de'i kha nas khrag skyugs su chug cig: mig nas sdug gi mchi ma 'bab tu chug cig: lag pa gnyis kyil brang rdung du chug cig: kha g.yas su gcus shig mig ltag par 'then cig lus gzer nad kyis thob cig: tsha grang rlung gsum 'thab tu chug cig 'du ba rnam bzhi khong nas sgongs shig: mda' gri na nga mdung grir sod cig: me gri dang chu grir sod cig: g.yang gri dang lceb grir sod cig: 'gags gri dang sbos grir sod cig: dgra bgegs ming tsam yang yi gnas par thal ba rdu44 du 11ga cig: ces dmod pa bor la bden pa bdar nas drag las bya'o des ni dgra dpung pha lam yan kya 'jig nus pa dang bgegs dpung rdo rje yin kya brlag par the tshom med do sa ma mā las rim bcu gsum pa btsan rgod 'bar ba'i maro na spyod las kyis dgra bo rdul du brlag pa'i man ngag bstan pa 'o rgya rgya rgyaḥye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi thig le zab gsang rdor snying skor de kun bcud dril dbang chen gsang ba'i chos man ngag mtha' brgyan srung ma'i sgrub skor rnams grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstoms mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongasapra

sdoms ma 'ongs snyigasamar nad mtshon gzengs lang tshe dpa' bo khyod nyid 'dus pa rtsal du bzhe sa skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas bstan pa'i 'gro don byang gi phyogasasu 'byung 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god bka' 'di srung shig gnod sbyin btsan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum thugs sras tshogasal sprod cig ging dmar nag sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya btsan rgod 'bar ba rdo rje srog gi rgyud rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya spus rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gurgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin sog sprul pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shis lha reg shin tu dge ba'i skyes ya mtshan can du mar bcas te nan tan chen po' bskul ngor/ 7 kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 2phel/ sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo dze+esnying po las: dbang chen teru ga'i: bka' sdod btsan rgod 'bar ba'i las kyi mtha' rno mde'u gnam lcags thog 'dra bzhugs so:mi na 31 gu na pad+ma 11 dha rā dza ya: sgo/jin // mibazad 'aram̐gs pa'i sku mchog he ru ka gsung gsang gar gyis dregs pa dbang du sdud ye shes gyas ni phyogs ris med par snyoms pad+ma dbang gisku gsung thugs la 'dud ma 'ongs las can sgrub la snying rus can dad pa dam tshig mos gus 'byor ba thob sgrub tshugs 'dzin cing nges med ri la brten tshe 'di blo gtang phyi ma dang len mkhan skye 'gro'i phan bde rtag par spelab yi las can skal bzang rig pa 'dzin pa la nyer 'tshe dgra dang bgegs kyis gzir ba na phan pa'i thabs mchog yid bzhin nor lta bu dgra bgegs brlag pa'i mtshon cha ngar ma bstan sa ma yu de yang lcang ma'i byang bu mthogang ba g.yon du 'khor ba'i thabs su legs par bzo leb la dgra gzung ming rus mkhan gsum bkod mtha' nas mtshon cha ngar ma'i spu gri ni sto hur tsa 'jumu kha rbad tsa tra shu la trag shag dgra la spyo tsa tri shu la 'ur 'ur dgra la rgyug tsa tri shu la cho cho dgra la rbad tsa tri shu la rgyug rgyug dgra la spyo tsa tri shu la rbad rbad dgra la dza rtsegema'isnying tshal pa tshal pa srog shag pa shag pa bla ye ye khrag skem skem rus tshal tshal sha tru mā ra ya rbad sod dza ram̐ khaṃ khrol bur

gtor mā ra ya phaṭa dbu can tsheg med dag par bri phyi rim dza khram dmar nag bkod gri khrag byug la thebs zlog dang bstun nas bsad bskul rngam pa'i sgrogs phud dang gtor ma rgya cher spro de nas 'khor lo rlung la bskor nyinabazhin bskul ba'i rno ngar 'dog zla ba gcig gi tshad zin pas dgra dpung pha lam yin kyang 'jig shin tu zab pa' rno nus yod sa ma mā man ngag rno mde'u dang po'o rgya rgya rgya den zang khab sor bzhi pa'i mig la yug sgra'iskud pa gdags de nas sngags 'dis gzi byin bskyed hen shu tu nan sngags 'di 'bum phrag lnga bgrangs te jos la byin rlabs sngags phu btab de nas zan nam 'jim pa yis dgra gzugs lisgo dbang tshang bca' zag rdzasabyug pas mang rus bri shog dril lisgo'i snyang gar bcug de nas 'gugs gzhug nan du bya mchog gsum bden mthu nusapa brdar zangs khab thogs la 'bru lnga pa shub bur stong bzla gzugs la gzir mig la btab na long b.ra'agyur rna ba la btab 'on par 'gyur lce la btab na skug par 'gyur mgrin par btab na 'bog cing spyo rkang lag la btab zha bar 'gyur pho bar btab pas myur du 'chi mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las 'ad the tshom med doshin du myur bde rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal shin tu rno ba'i nus pa yod sam yu man ngag rno mde'u gnyis pa'o rgya rgya rgya de na phung shul sablang te sdig pa ra tsa'i gzugs su bca' gdol ba gnas pa' sa blang te sbal

gsaX ba nag po'i gzugs su bya dug shog la na gri khrag gis liṅga dbang tshang j-iḥr+sha'i mthar ming rus mkhan gsum zhag nyi ma zla ba chu tshod 'di dus su che ge mo phung thal sna dgu'i sgo nas thal ba rdul du rlogacig ces bri shi lngags ltar du dril e bskyed bden brjod 'gugs bstim bya nyes pa bsgrags shing las bzhi yi phyag rgya dang bcas sdig sbal gyi sto ba' sgrom du gtsud par bya byad thag sngo dmar chings rgyas gdab thang shinga'adzag pa'i khu bas sbyar de nas klu dang sa bdag ga zebs rtags dang bstun gnas pa'i sar phyin la snga 'gro'i klu chog gtong srung ma'i 'bod rbad bsad las bya drag tu bskul la dam bsgrags sgrogs de nas gtad du bcolabyas te nā ga dza: gangs ri'i shar nasargyal rigs klu: nag me'i lho nas rje rigs dang: rngam 'khrug nub nas bram zephu sha ma bde ba'i byang phyogs nas: gdol rigs klu yi tshogs rnams kun: rgyal ba gong ma'i bka' dam bzhin: rnal 'byor dam la da tshur 'dus: dga' bo 'jog po dung skyong dang rigs ldan nor rgyas pad+ma can: mtha' yas pad+ma chen po sogs: klu rigs brgyad kyi 'khor 'bangs dpung: rgyal ba gong ma'i bka' dam bzhin: rnal 'byor dam la da tshur 'dus: sa la dbang bsgyur sa bdag dang: gnyan

da kyi rigs byed ni: 'byung ba dbang bsgyur thams cad kun: rgyal ba gong ma'i bka' dam bzhin: rnal 'byor dam la da tshur 'dus: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshigs sems can nyes med bsgral ba'i dgra: dge 'dun dkor la rku ba'i dgra bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin gcod pa'i bdud: tshe srog bsod nams 'phrog pa'i bdud 'gab sri byed pa'i bdud thams cad gzugs la bstim pa'i rdzas sdig sbal lto sbyor drag po'i rgyar: btsud de klu bdud khyed la gtad lto ba dug gi tshang khang klong: ma shor sgyuzung rgyas thobs dgra bo mdze dang khrag nad kyis: ma 'gyangs myur du sgog la rgol bsad pa'i rtags mtshan bzang por ston dam tshig 'di las khyod ma 'da': sgog gi dbang por bab: rgyal ba'i bka' yis chad pas gzir: nā ga pak+ta su hūṃ na ra gan: ces brjod gtad de bcol bar bya de nas dmod bcol gdab pa ni na mo: kun tu rgyu mi bon mi bden: ban dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa chen po'i stobs kyis: dgra bo 'di lo zla zhag za mar mi 'khyangs bar dus da lta nyid du brlag pa'i brin las

bsgo/: mdzod cig: na mo: mi nag skye bo mi bden kun tu rgyu mi bden bon kyi bden pa chen pos dgra bo 'di lo zla ba zhag za mar mi 'khyangs bar dus da lta nyidadu brlag pa'i brin las mdzod cig na mo: 'jig rten gyi yos kha mi bden: kun tu rgyu'i bden pa chen pos dgra bo 'di lo zla ba zhag za mar mi 'khyangs bar dus da lta nyid du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: na mo: rten 'brel kun rdzob kyi bden pa: chos nyid rang bzhin gyi bden pa: 'jig rten kha smon gyi bden pa chen po'i stobs kyis dgra bo 'di ma zla ba zhag za mar mi 'gyangs bar dus da lta nyid du brlag pa'i brin las mdzod cig: ces thal mo brdab nas dmod bcol bya des ni maro na spyod phrin las lhun gyis grub par the tshom med sa ma yā rno mde'u gsum pa'o rgya rgya rgya mang cig sre mong rbos mthu bya 'dod na rdul sogs skyon gyis ma gos lpags ju btsal bu ga rnams ni phu rdzas bsres pa yi skyin nam la cas dam du bcad pa ra bya kha chings tshon skud sngo dmar yug sa'i skra sum bsgril a lo lugs kyi mgul du bskon gra lcags zu gu kha nas btsug par bya khong pa ra lir+sha dab cha ming rus bcas gzhugs la maro na spyod drag las 'gugs bstem bya de nas bden pa chen po 'i sngags brjod pa

che ge mochag trig sbos sbos ger ger thal thal shag tshal swā hā dmigs pa dgra bo rlung gis brgyang bar dmags bden pa'i rtags mtshan lpags pa rab sbos shing tshal bar gas na 'cha ba'i rtags mtshan no gcig brgyud las ni gzhan la 'chor ma rung spel rgya che na mkha' 'gros bka' tshad 'o sa ma yā rno mde'u bzhi pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas dgra bo gri ru gsod 'dod na phung shul sa yi glang po bca' khong par dgra bo' zag rdzas dang la dbang tshang ming rus bcas gzhugs la bden pa bdar ba ni na mo mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden mthu dang: gnod sbyin btsan rgod yab yum sprul 'khor bka' sdod dang bcas pa'i bden mthus: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo che ge mo'i tshe bla sgog gsum gzugs rten 'di la khug cig drems ba ya dza dza: brgya rtsa brjod la 'gugs cing bstam dṛḥbadz+ra ye gu sha dza dza: dzaḥrat+na pa sha hūṃ hūṃ: dṛX pad+ma spo ṭa baṃ baṃ: dṛX garma gaṇ+ḍi ho ho: dṛX a we sha ya a ā: dṛ pra we sha ya phaṭa phaṭa: zhes 'gugs 'chings sdom myos dbab dbye bya'o de nas gsod pa'i sngags rgod bzla ba ni trig trig shag shag tshal tshal dum bu shag du bu shi tsit+ta tshal bar gtubs khrol brgya stong la sogs gang skabs brjod chu grir gsod na chu la 'phen me grir gsod

gtsa(: na me la bsregs 'gas grir gsod na mgul bsdam mo mtshon grir gsod na mtshon chas gtubs zag rdzas lhag ma rgya gram lam ya na klu bdud kha ru gtad des ni dgra dpung rdul du rlog mngonaspyod drag rtsal khyad chos ni gzhan las ya mtshan grags pa rgyas ze tshom med do sa ma wā rno mde'u lnga pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nasadagra bo gsod pa'i las: gnam lcags thog la gtad pa ni dgra gzugs ri bong mgo bo can srog dang ming rus mkhan gsum 'god yan lag lcags zhags sgrog gis bsdams de las 'gugs bstim nan du bya dug khrag gri khrag mdze khrag byug de nas shin tu gnyan sa yi brag dmar cag cog la gtad de /ste: 'di na ba/natha pa'i klu bdud btsan: drag rtsal stobs kyis da tshur byon: brngan pa'i gtor skyems 'di bzhes la: gnyer gtad dgra bo che ge mo: gtad du bcol lo dam du zungs: lo zlar 'khyangs su ma sgo ra bar: gnam lcags thog gi mtshon gyis sod bsad rtags don snying bdag la sprod: ma g.yel ma 'khyangs sa ma yā: ces brjod phud skyems mchod pa ra bya tsa tram̐ 'ur 'ur slong slong gnam lcags thog slong 'brug mo'i sgra slong glog dang skar mda' slong dgra boche ge mo'i che bla srog gsum la rbad rbad brgya stong la sogs gang skabs brjod dur sol gyis na khram ris bya de nas dmod bcol bya ba ni

na mo: mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i stobs kyis: dam nyams pa'i dgra bo 'di gnam lcags thog gis sod cig glog gi zhags pas chings shig: skar mda' 'bar bas thob cig thal ba rdul du rlog cig: ming tsam yang mi gnas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: ral pa sprug cing thal mo rdebs 'jig rten tshag gi smre sngags 'don des na dgra bo ma 'khyangs bar gnam lcags ste 'og thog gis bsad mthu yi grags pas sa ste khyab bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal sa ma mā rno mde'u drug pa'o rgya rgya rgya den dgra la than 'gyed na wa da spre'u 'ug padang pha waṃ te lo srin bya yi spu dang sha khrag zan da bsre sprel dmar lag basbrel ro thogs bca' rdza ma'i snod du gzhugs pa ra bya re ba nag pos kha bkab ste btsan rgod 'bar ba'i bskul ba ni dus drug gtor skyems brngan bcas gtong lajug la sngags na 'di 'dog go tsa tu shu la tri dza dza 'ur 'ur rgyug rgyug breng breng rbad rbad: than rigs sum brgya drug cu ye ye zur zur rgyug rgyug dza dza: dgra bo tshegemolichu bur mig la sal sal tshe bla 11ga gasdo ma la rbad rbad: brgya stong la sogs ga skabs brjod thun phye re ba' kha ru brab nang nas 'ur ma na bsu sgra 'don de tshe dgra la than rtags ni nges pa ra 'byung ngo sa ma yu

bsgo/: skabs skabs dmod bcol gdab pa ni ho: btsan rgod rdo rje yang le ber gtso 'khor sprul pa dpung dang bcas pa khyod la mthu dang nus pa yod na da rgyug cig: drag rtsal khyad chos yod na dgra bo la than gyi char ba da lta nyid du phob cig: mthar gyi 'chi ba ni sems can kun la yod pas: dgra bo de lo zla ba zhag za mar ma 'khyangs bar: dus da lta nyid du rtags mchan dang bcas te sod cig: rang bzhin gyi 'chi ba ni sems can kun la yod pas: dgra bo des nyes pa sems la dran bzhin brjod pa ngag gis smras te rang sha rang gis za ru chug cig: rang khrag rang gis 'thung du chug cig: me ma mur bza' ru chug cig: bu dang chung ma gsod du chug cig: kha g.yas su gcus mig ltag par 'then mgo ltag dang skang rtings mnyam par sbyor cig: bgegs kyi cho sgra sgrogs shig: 'ug pas ha ha rgod cig: wa mo brgyal nas sgo brdung du chug cig: sprel dmag gis khyim 'gengs su chug cig: srin byas rkad 'don cing gza' mi'i sma la sbar du chug cig: spral nag mang po lus la 'khyad du chug cig: dgra bo de rtsad nas chod cig: drangs nas byungs shig

rdul du rlog cig: phu nu nye ba rtsa lag dang bcas pa ming tsam yang mi gnas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: ces brjod khrag skyems dgra phyogs bshar dmar gtor dgra bo'i phyogs su rdebs dar nag g.yab cing ral ba bsigs des ni dgra dbung rdul du rlog bgegs tshogs rtsad nas gcod par 'gyur sa ma yu rno mde'u bdun pa'o rgya rgya rgya e ma rgyal ba' dbang po pad+ma sa bha la' ma 'ongasa'agro la lhag bar thugs brtse bas mtha' dbus thams cad rin chen gter gyis gtams snying po' yang bcud rdo rje snying po 'a skor grub pa'i dab phyug rgyal mchog dbyangs la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la bstams shig sa ra bye mdo khams bkra shas rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus mtha' ma dbus bsdud mtshon chas gzengs lang tshe dpa' bo khyod nyid 'dus pa rtsal du bzhengs skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas bstan pa'i dgra sde thal bar brlag nus shang bstan 'dzin skye bu'i tshe sgrub mthar phyin te dwangs ma'i 'od lus gegs med 'grub pa da 'gro don phrin las byang nas byang du rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god skal bzang chos bdag nyi zla ltar du 'tshogs de dag rnams la man ngag zab mdzod spel dam nyam lag tu ma shor sbu gri gsum sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya man ngag spu gri reg gcod rno mde'u rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya

bsgo/ gsang rgya gurgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma sa wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda tham dzi ces pa 'di' lung zen chosakyi bdag po sku skyes pad+ma bsod nams grub pa'i rdo rjes bkrashis lha reg da shin tu dge ba'i skyes ya mtshan can du mar bcas te nan tan gyis bskul ngor /7kho bo rgyal mchog bzhed pa rtsal rgyas mkha' 'gro gas ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i ya ge pa ni chos bdaganyad kyas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba mgi le/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: pad+ma dbang gi bka' nyan: gnod sbyin btsan rgod 'bar ba'i srog dbang phrin las char 'bebs bzhugs so:a: na 3 gu n+dan pad+ma kro dha rā dza ya: 8)— 3rngo gtor ma sku tsaka mkho ba' chas thams cad da la'i dbus su bzhugs rnam lnga nyer spyod yo byad bkram las gzhu bsrang la bsnyen pa gto gsol mchod grangs gsog mchod ca bstod las bum sgrub cing 'od zhu bya slob ma gral sdu khrus bgegs bsal srung 'khor sgom rjes maṇ+ḍal phul de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni kye rdo gas nga ma31ga pad+ma dbang gi zhal: he ru ka dpal dgongs su gsol: bstan dang sgrub pa bsrung ba'i phyir: btsan rgod 'bar ba'i sgog dbang stsol: lan gsum zhu de nas bla ma'i bka' ni e ma tshur re ga skal ldan rig pa 'dzin: khyod la btsan rgod 'bar ba yi: srog dbang zab mo sbyin dgos na: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung nus sam: bshad sgrub mdzad pa skyong nus sam sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug nus sam: srung ma gsol mchod bskang nus sam: de ltar ldan na dbang mchog sbyin: mi nus pa rnams phyir dengs shig zhes bka' brgo 'o de nas slob ma'i dam khas

blangs ba ni kye: che ba'i dbang phyug he ru ga: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol nyid kyis ci ltar bsgo ba'i bka': rtag tu mi nyams bsrung bar bya: zhes khas blang ngo de nas dam chu sbyin pa ri ho: gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba: rdo rje snying po'i dam bsrung phyir sgog gi mna' chu lce la bzhag: khas blangs bzhin du legs gnas 'tshal: srung ma'i phrin las gang bcol sgrub: gnyis ka bka' las 'da' mi bya: 'das na bka' chad 'phral la 'bebs: rdo rje dmyal ba'i gnas su mnar de phyir gzu bor gnas mdzod cig: badz+ra sa ma ya na ra gan: āḥ 'i tha: zhes slob ma'i lce la bzhag cing gtor ma la yang bran no slob ma par gsal ye shes dbab de nyid brtan pa ra bzhugs su gsol de nas btsan gyi gtor ma gtad la na 31: da41na mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: mchog gsum sku gsum bden mthu dang: bden gnyis baspu med nus mthu yis: gnod sbyin btsan rgod yang le ber: yab yum 'khor bcas ma lus pa'i: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyis: srog dbang bu la yongs thob ste lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs pa dang: gang bcol phrin las myur 'grub 31ga: tsa tu shu la

badz+ra tri bha lirte a bhi ṣiñca oṃ āḥhūṃ hrī: de nas sku tsaka gtad la hū nyi pad+ma dbang gi bka' nyan pa: gnod sbyin btsan rgod yang le ber: dregs pa yongs kyi spyirje bo'i: sgog dbang rigs ldan bu la sbyin: gang bcol phrin las rab 'byams kun: thogs med 'grub pa'i dpal thob shog:tsa tu shu la tri kwa ya a bhi ṣiñca sa: de nas srog lenadamar mo'i sku gam la hūṃ nyi sangs rgyas bstan la lhag par mos sgrub pa po la brtse shugs ldan ma mo srog len chen mo yi: sgog dbang bu la thob par shog:tsa tu shu la tri kā ya.a bhi ṣiñca sa: de nas 'bar ba spun bdun gyi sku gtad la hū nyi phyi nang 'byung ba'i khams la rgyu: zhing bcu yongs kyi srog dbugs bsdus: dam can btsan rgod mched bdun gyi: srogadabang bu la thob par shog tsa tu shu la tri kā ya a bhi ṣiñca ma: de nas rol ba rkya bdun gyi sku gtad la hūṃ nyi dam chig gnyan la rtag gnas shing: zab gter yongs kyi gnyer 'dzin pa bka' sdod rol ba skya bdun gyi: srog dbang bu la thob par shog: tsā tu shu la tri kwa ya a snyi ṣiñca tshe: de nas khrung lnga'i ya ge gtad la hūṃ nyi 'byung ba lnga la dbang bsgyur zhing: ste

'gro'i sgog gi bdag po che ru 'dren sde bzhi'i dmag tshogs kyi: sgog dbang bu la thob par shog: tsā tu shu la tri kā ya a bhi ṣiñca tshe: de nas snying po tsa yig gtad la hū nyi chos rnamasarten 'brel rgyu las byung snying po yi ge tsāḥgacig ma: rgyal btsan yongs kyi 'byung khung ste: gsang ba sngags kyi dbang thob shog: tsā tu shu la tri wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas tu yig gtadal hū trī bstan pa bsrung ba'i gnyer gtad cing: dam tshig 'bog pa' khas blang sa srog: snying po yi ge tuX ru shar: brin las bsgrub phyir bu la gtad: ca tu shu la tri wāk+ka a bhi kheñca ā: de nas tri yag gam la hū hrī: srid na ya mtshan che ba yi: dregs pa yongs kyi sgog snying tri: rigs ldan bu mchog khyod la gtad: dregs pa'i sgog la dbang thob shog: tsa tu shu la tri wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas sde brgyad kya snyang po gtad la hūṃ hrī lha gshin ma bdud btsan rgyal srin: klu bdud yongs kyi srog snying po: kun 'dus sde brgyad dam srog dbang phrin las bsgrub phyir bu la sbyin: tsā tu shu la tri wak+ka a bha ṣiñca ā: de nas srog 'bar gtad la hu ༷ btsan rgod rdo rje yang le ber: yab yum 'khor tshogs dpung bcas kyi: sku

gtsaji: gsu thugs yon phrin las dpal: yongs 'dus srog gi 'khor lo yi: brten dbang rigs ldan bu la sbyin: srung ma lus dang grib ltar 'grogs: gnyer bcol brin las gang dang gang: thogs med 'grub pa'i dbang thob shog tsā tu shu la tri tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: de nas me tog 'thor la smon lam gdab pa na ho: dregs pa yongs kyi spyi rje:dkor mdzod gling gi srung ma: bha dra hor gyi dkor bdag: dbu ru zha yi gnas srung: sham bha la yi zhing skyo sa: gtsug lag yongs kyi gnyer 'dzin: zab gter yongs kyi bdagapo: yo rgyan pad+ma'i bka' nyan: gnod sbyin gter gyi bdag po rgyal btsan kun gyi gtso bo dam ldan yongs kyi srung ma: nyams pa can gyi gshed ma btsan rgod rdo rje yang le ber: yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur dam pa rigs ldan khyod la bskur bar bgyi'o: de nas byang chub snying po ma thob kyi bar du mi dang mi 'grogs pa bzhin du mngon sum dbang po'i yul du snang zhing mi 'bral ba'i grogs su 'grub par gyur cig: rtag tu gtam gyi lab grogs su mchis par gyur

cig:dbang du 'du zhing bran du 'khor bar gyur cig:'bangs su 'gyur zhing las la 'byun par gyur cig:'grub pa'i ltas mtshan mngon sum 'byung zhing phrin las rab 'byams thogs med du 'grub par gyur cig:rten 'brel snyang po dbyangs gsal byed brjod la rab gnas me tog 'thor bkra shis rdza brgyad gtad byas te yinar bu khyod byang chub mchog thob cing sgrub la bar chad med pa'i phyir:bkra shis rdzas brgyad 'di gtad pas:bsod nams yon tan mchog thob shog:maṅga le a bhi ṣiñca nyu:de nas rtags brgyad gto byas te (nyirgyal ba'i mtshan dpe las byung ba'i:bkra shis rtags brgyad 'ad gtad pas:bde legs yon tan srid thob nas:don gnyis lhun grub dbang thob shog aṣ+ṭa maṅga lo a bhi ṇiñca /:dam khas blang shing yon 'bul rjes shis brjod rgya cher spros byas nas mtha' rgyan dge ston yang dag bya de ltar sgog dbang thob pa yi rnal 'byor gang zag dam ldan la bsrung ma lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs phrin las gangabacol thogasamed 'grub the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yā yi ma rgyal ba'idabang la pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yi thugs kyi thag le zab gsang rdor snying chos grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod la

—41— gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la bstims shag sa ra bye mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs bra sdoms ma 'o sa snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chasagazengs pa la pa 'i tshe dpa' bo khyod nyid 'dus pa rtsal du bzhengs skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas bstan pa'i 'gro don byang nas byang ru rgyas rten 'brel legs na mdzad pa bsam mtha' yas rkyen dbang gyur na mdzadaphran 'bri tsam mo 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god bka' gsang 'di srungs gnod spyin btsan rgod rgyal bka' log lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum dam ldan bu la sprod cig gi dmar nag sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya btsan rgoda'abar ba'i srog dba'i phrin las lhun grub rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gurgya o rgyan gya slob da pon pad+ma saṃ bha wa' bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod ba'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'angalung zen chos kyi bdag po sku skyes pa d+ma bsod nams grub pa 'a rdo rjes bkra shis la reg bde bar gshegs pa 'i sku gsung thugs rten gzhan yang ya mtshan can gyi skyes du mar bcasate bskul ro ra/7 kho bo rgyal mchog ba'ad pa rtsal gyis mkha'a'agro gas ba' 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par pha ba pa' ya ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/sarba masgo le/
gtsa/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen pad+ma he ru ga'i bka' sdod zangs ging dmar po'i mngon spyod drag las zab mo bzhugs so:

ba tshu na mo pad+ma kro dha h+ya snyi wa ya: 4114/84 dbang ga zhal bzang bde ba'i rnam 'gyur can pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo las ldan sgrub la snying rus ldan pa yis bstan pa'i dpal duzos skyong sgrub par bya sa ma yā dang po bla rdo srog 'khor bcing thabs na rin chen shog dkar dri ma bral ba'i ngor mtshal dang bzang drug bsres la mu 'byud ni rim pa bdun smor dbus su sku gzugs bri srog phag dbu can rwa yi mtshan par bya gnyas pa la ni 'bod sngags legs par bkod drang grong bza' bdud rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo brten 'di la brten pa ra bzhugs su gsol blaganas par gyis shig srog chags par gyas shag rab tu 'du zhing rtag tu 'khor bar gyis shig badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma yu rak+ṣa rak+ṣe yig mgo phyar bstan dbu can tsheg med bkod mu 'khyud gsum ba la ni mig nyer brgyad bzhi pa la nirbad sngags bkod par bya lnga pa la yang bsad sngags legs pa ra bkod gnyis ka yig mgo nang bstan dbu can no drug pa la na dbyangs gsal rten snying mjug nad gdon 'jigasapa brgyad shirnye ku ru ye swāhā tshe bsod dpala'abyor nyams rtogs yon tan pu ku ru ye swā1 khams gsum srad gsum mos bzhi wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā1 gnod byed dgra bgegs log 'dren 'byung po rwa ra ya phaṭa swā1 bdun pa la na me ra pa tra bkod rdzas ni tsan+da dkar dmar sbal

gtsa(: sbrul sha gza' sdum mgo dgu dang bcas legs pa ra gzhugs rnam lngas chi sa gdab dar dmar dbus su dral sgrub pa'i brten 'dzug rab gnas me tog 'thor mgul du 'chi bas srung ma grogs su 2grogs sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya thog mar 'bod pa 'i bskul ba 'di ltar rgya hūṃ bh+yo:srid gsum sgog gi mnga' bdag po:gza' dang rgyu skar yongs kyi rje drang sgong chen po ra hu la 'bod do gnas 'dir da tshur byon:dgyes bska gdong mo mched bzhi po:'bod do gnas 'dir da tshur byon:dregs pa gza' chen mched sde brgyad 'bod do gnas 'dir da tshur byon rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni:'bod do gnas 'dir da tshur byon:dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis na:'bod do gnas 'dir da tshur byon yang g.yog bsam dang grangs las 'das:'bod do gnas 'dir da tshur byon brtse bas zhal bzang gzigs pa ngom sgrub pa ngo la rtags mtshan ston:'gal rkyen dgra bgegs chom la phobs:dus la bab po sa ma yā:bdag nyid pad+ma he ru shar gsal ba' thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can 'phros mdun du drang sgong gza' bdud rgyal po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs

srog la reg pa tsam gyis dam tshig gnyan po'i srog thob: mthu nus pa bkrag gzi mdangs nyams bde ba dpag tu med pa 'bar: kho yi srog snying lhud kyis byung ste bdag he ru ga'i rkang mthil du thim pas dregs pa'i srog la dbang thob cing: ci bcol ba'i las thams cad thogs med du 'grub par bsam la: 'bod sngags chu bo' gzhugs ltar bzla ting 'dzin 'gyur med gzer gyis gdab de tshe grub pa'i rtags mtshan 'byung the tshom med do sa ma mā de nas rbad bskul 'di ltar bya drag po'i phyag bzhes zhal shes ltar dmar gtor khrag skyems 'gugs bsnyims bya sbyangs spel nam mkha' mdzod du spro rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyas rol mo sna tshogs sgra bcas te hūṃ bh+yo: theg chen bka' yi bstan srung ba srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur zhing: dam ldan yongs kyi grogs gcig bu: dam nyams srog la dbang za ba'i drang sgong smug nag 'od 'phro khyod: rdo rje 'chang dang pad+ma 'byung: rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bka' dam bzhin: 'bod cing rbad do dgra la rgyug:ltas ngan cho 'phrul sna tshogs thongs shar gyi stag srin zor ba gdong 'bod cing rbad do dgra la rgyugs dpa' skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ltas ngan cho 'phrul sna

'amatshu tshogs thongs:lho yi skong srin ba glang gdong:'bod cing rbad do dgra la rgyug dpa' skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes la:ltas ngan cho 'phrul sna tshogasinub kyi 'grog srin chu srin gdob :'bod cing rbad do dgra la rgyug:dpa' skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes la:ltas ngan cho 'phrul sna tshogs thongs:byang gi bam srin gdong:'bod cing rbad do dgra la rgyug:dpa 'a skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes la:ltas ngan cho 'phrul sna tshogs thongs:zla ba lhag pa chu yi gza':'bod cing rbad do dgra dpa' skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes la:lta sha ngan cho 'phrul sna tshogs thongs:spen pa pa sang sa yi gza':'bod cing rbad do dpa' skyems ltas ngan nyi ma mig dmagaza':'bod cang rbad do dgra la rgyug:dpa' skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes la:ltas ngan cho 'phrul sna tshogs thongs:phur bu sgra gcan rlung gi gza':'bod cing skyems ltas ngan smin drug snar ma la sogs pa'i:'byung bzhi'i khams la rgyu ba rnams:'bod cing rbad do dgra la rgyug:dpa' skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes la:ltaja

'phrul sna tshogs thongs: dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga ni: lha srin dregs pa'i dmag tshogs bcas 'bod cing rbad do dgra la rgyug: dpa' skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes la ltas ngan cho 'phrul sna tshogs thongs: dgra la bab na mthu ma chung bgegs la bab na rtsal ma zhan: las pa las la ma g.yel zhig: mngag pa'i pho nya lag ma sdum: mngon spyod phrin las dus la bab: ma g.yel ma 'khyangs dus la bab: bdag nyid pad+ma he ru ga'i thugs ga'i hūṃ:las 'od zer tsha la rtsub pa'i rnam par 'phros te: mdun du chos skyong dregs pa'i dmag tshogs gsal ba'i thugs gar phog: sngon gyi bka' tha tshig dran nas drag po mngon spyod kyi las la bzhengs par dmigs nas: rbad sngags ca nus su bzla'o de ya tshe 'od 'byug pa dang me stag 'phro ba 'ur sgra thug chom su 'byung ro sa ma yu de nas do gal che gyur na bsad pa 'a las la 'dug par bya dang po e bskyed rim pa ni phaṭa: rang nyid pad+ma he ru ga'i: mdun thad drang 17nga spug nag 'od 'phro mngon sum du gsal ba'i mar 'og phyi rim gdong mo bzhi dang gza' chen brgyad sogs rgyu skar dregs pa'i dmag tshogs kyis sod sod dang chod chod kyi sgra sgrogs pa

'tshan de yi dbus su gru gsum dmar nag gshin rje'i bsha' gzhi nag po: zhe sdang gi rang mdangs me 'bar ba: 'dod chags kyi ra mdangs khrag mtsho 'khyil ba:gti mug gi rang mad sa mun nag 'thibs pa nga rgyal gyi rang mdangs mtshon cha 'jubs pa phrag dog gi rang mdangs rlung mar 'phyo ba: stebhe bla 'dzin gyi drwa ba bris shing bar na sha zan gyi gcan spyang sna tshogs pas ngu zug byed pa: de yi dbus su spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan dgra: dgos rnal 'byor ba'i sku dgra: khyad par du sgrub mchog bdag gi bka' la 'khu zhing dam la 'gres pa: do bsdo phod btsug ya gzung ba'i dgra bo de yi rū pa mdog sngo la mdangs nyam pa: skya ba nyam pa red pa dbugs ma thal ba tsam nyam thag bu ga dgu nas rnag khrag 'dzag pa: rkang lag lcags gzer gyis theb par gsal gdab: de yi sa bon gro:las 'od 'phros pas dngos skog la nye bar 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par bkugs nas gzugs rten la yang yang bstams: yang mdun gyi sku yi cha thams cad nas las kyi pho nya mtshon cha thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te

gzes pa po thams cad lus pa med par bkug nas gzugs liṅga la yang yang bstem mo: 'gugs bstim ni na mo: dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal 41: mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa ba gsum dang bden gnyis baspu ba med pa'i bden mthu dang: rdo rje chos skyong ba'i srung ma drang srong gza' rgod yab yum bka' sdod dregs pa'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa'i mthus: spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan dgra rnal 'byer ba'i dam dgra: dgos su sgrub pa po bdag gi tshe sgog la kha smras btang zhing nyams rtogs la bar chad byed pa: dngos su do bsdo zhing skog tu 'jab bu byed pa: mi brdzu dgu brdzu zhing nyes pa sna dgur bslong ba'i dgra rkun jag gsum dmag mi dmag dpung blo ya gros rogs dang bcas pa thams cad rang dbang med par bkug nas gzugs liṅga la bstim cig: dṛms ga ya dza: dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: lan grangs ca nus brjod pa ra bya dgra bgegs 'gugs bstim yang yang byed sa ma yu de nas bsad bskul gtong ba ni gtor ma la ni 'gugs bstims bya sha rus khrag ga rgya mtshor dmags pad+ma drag po'i rgyal gyis rol mo sna tshogs sgra bcas te hūṃ bh+yo dza: steng dre gas nam

ba tshu mkha'iklong dkyil nas:nga rgyal dbyings kyi gza' rgod rgyal 'degs byed rlung gi dkyil 'khor nas:phrag dog bskyod pa'i gza' chen dang:dag gsal chu yi dkyil 'khor nas:zhe sdang rlan gyi gza' rgod dang:'bar ba me yi dkyil 'khor nas:'dod chags g.yo ba'i gza' chen po:pha ni srin po'i rang bzhin can:mig stong ldan pa'i rā hu la:ma ni klu yi lcam gcig ste:ro smad sbrul du 'khyil ba'i tshul:'byung ba yongs la dbang bsgyur ba'i:sgog bdag drang sgong mthu rtsal can:sngon gyi bka' dam dran gyis la:sdang ba'i dgra la myur du rgyug:srog dbugs bsdud pa'i dus la bab:las kyi mtshon cha'i char ba phob:gnags phyugs dkor la za ngu gyis:dgra dang zin du ma nor cig:mtha' rtsa skye rgyud lhag med thongs:chog shes med par rngam zas kyis:gnad nas bskul lo da bzhengs shig:mngon spyod phrin las grub par mdzod:dza:theg chen bka' yi bya ra ba:dam log mna' zan dgra bgegs kyi:tshe srog gcod pa'i mthu mo che shar gyi stag srin zor ba gdong mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs bdag la

sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di:'gro bzhin pa la sdod long dang:sdod bzhin pa las ldang long dang:bza' btung phyid khom mi byung bar gzer rgod khra tsha glo bur rgyob:mig rtsa gcus la ltag par 'then khong khrag skyugs la rbad kyis sod:nus mthu ma g.yel dam tshig can dza:a ti'i bka' yi bya ra mkhan sku dgra dam ma ga yongs kyi gshed:nyams pa'i snying 'byin mthu mo che lho yi skong srin ba glang gdong:mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs:bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di:'gro bzhin pa la sdod long dang:sdod bzhin pa las ldang long dang:bza' btung phyid khom mi byung bar:gzer rgod khra tsha glo bur rgyob mig rtsa gcus la ltag par 'then khong khrag skyugs la rbad kyis sod:nus mthu ma g.yel dam tshig can:dza:snying po thugs kyi bstan srung ba dam nyams yongs kyi sgog gi gshed:dgra sgog gcod pa'i mthu mo che:nub kyi 'brog srin chu srin gdong mngon spyod drag po' las la bzhengs bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di:'gro bzhin pa la sdod long dang:sdod bzhin pa las ldang long dang:bza' btung phyid khom mi byung bar:

btsa/: gzer rgod khra tsha glo bur rgyob:mig rtsa gcus la ltag par 'then:khong khrag skyugs la rbad kyis sod:nus mthu ma g.yel dam tshig can:dza:kun bzang thugs kyi bstan srung ba:'gal zla byed pa'i dgra yi gshed:nyams pa'i sgog len mthu mo che:byang gi bam srin dred mong gdong:mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs bdagal sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di:'gro bzhin pa la sdod long dang:sdod bzhin pa las ldang long dang:bza' btung phyid khom mi byung bar:gzer rgod khra tsha glo bur rgyob:mig rtsa gcusal ltag par 'then:khong khrag skyugs la rbad kyis sod:nus mthu ma g.yel dam tshig can dza:'byung ba chu la dbang bsgyur ba'i:zla ba lhag pa dkar po ni:bstan la gdungazhing sgrub la brtse:nyams pa can gyi sgog gi gshed:gnad nas bskul lo da tshur byon:dgra sgog dmar po rbad kyis chod:dgra snying rlon byung bdag la sprod ltas ngan than gyi char ba phob:drag rtsal khyad chos rmad byung ston:mngon spyod phrin las grub par mdzod:dza:'byung ba sa la dbang bsgyur ba'i spen pa pa sang ser bo ni:sgrub la brtse zhing dam

la gdung:'gal ba can gyi sgog gi gshed:gnad nas bskul le da tshur bzhengs:dgra sgog dmar po rbad kyis chod:dgra snying rlon byung bdag la sprod:ltas ngan than gyi charab phob:drag rtsal khyad chos rmad byung ston mngon spyod phrin las grub par mdzod:dza:'byung ba me la dbang bsgyur ba'i nyi ma mig dmar sku mdog dmar dam la gnas shingabastan la gdung:dgra dang bgegs kyi srog bdud ni gnad nas bskul lo da tshur bzhengs:dgra srog dmar po rbad kyis chod:dgra snying rlon byung bdag la sprod:ltas nganathan gyi char ba phob:drag rtsal khyad chos rmad byung ston mngon spyod phrin las grub par mdzod:dza:'byung ba rlung la dbang bsgyur ba'i:phur bu sgra gcan ljang nag ni:dam laganas shing sgrub la brtse:bstan bshigs yongs kyi sgog bsdud pa gnad nasabaskul 'a da tshur bzhengs dgra sgog dmar po rbad kyis chod:dgra snying rlon byung bdag la sprod ltas ngan than gyi char ba phob:drag rtsal khyad chos rmad byung ston:mngon spyod phrin las grub par mdzod:dza:rgyu skar mgon po smin drug dang:snang ma la sogs nyi shu brgyad

gtsa/: sngon nas dam srog thob pa'i lha:da lta sgrub pa po yi grogs:bzhugs pa nam mkha'i dkyil du bzhugs gzigs ni sangs rgyas bstan la gdung:las su dgra dang bgegs tshogs 'dul:zas su bdud rtsi a dṛ ta:yar ngos dus su spyod cing dkar:dgra bo'i sha khrag rus gsum ni:mar ngos spyod cing dgra srog gcod:lha dang drang sgong char gtogs shing:zhi dang drag po'i phrin las sgrub:khyod cag dam ldan yongs kyi grogs gnad nas bskul lo da bzhengs shig:dgra bo'i pho rnams gri ru sod mo rnams mngal nas phrug gu skem:bdun rgyud rtsad nas gcod par gyis:nang dme shi chad 'ong du chug:ming tsam med par rdul du rlog:mngon spyod phrin las grub par mdzod dzayang 'khor lha srin sde brgyad ni:sngon nas dam sgog thob pa bzhin sgrub pa po la dgra byung na:shan pa khyod la las su gtad:lha bdud dkar pos skar mda' thobs:gshin rjes khram dang rtsis la phobs:ma mos khrag nad thebs par gyis:btsan gyis zhags pa dmar pos chings:bdud kyis tho chen 'bar bas bsnun:rgyal bos spyo 'bog rgyal nad

thongs gnod sbyin gyis ni spu gris gtubs: klu bdud dug gi rlags pas thobs: ming tsam med par rdul du rlog: drag rtsal khyad chos rmad byung ston: mngon spyod brin las grubapar mdzod: yo nā ga rakru rā hu la hrīḥtri shag ru ram nā ga tsit+ta gram ma ma yo za 'gram ha nye ge sha la dza dza: thun bh+yo thun bh+yo: yakra rak+ka sarba tsit+ta bh+yo: ma ma rak+ka rā hu la: shrī nag moti la bh+yo: dgra bgegs gnod byed kyi tshe grog la rbad sod: ci nus brngo da la gtor skyems ni dgra phyogs rdeb cing dmod mo bya sa ma yā de nas dgra bo'i bla 'gugs ri dza dza: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo yi: bla dwags sha skyang 'brong dang lug: ra yi rnam par liṅgar bsdus: bla ni tshoḥyi rnam par khug: bla gshed 'phar spyang gzig dang dred: spel gyi rnam pas rdul du rlog: do nub nam gyi gong thun la: dgra gshed 'phar spyang gzig dang dred: spel gyi rnam pas rdul du rlog do nub nam gyi gong thun la: dgra bo gnyid log byed tsa na: bla ni rang dbang med par khug: dgra bgegs sarba dzaX hūṃ baṃ ho: dgra bgegs gnod byed rnams kyi sha re ma ti grum grum:

bsnye: sha ma ru ti thul thul myog myog: yed yed sha ma ru ti khug khug ling myog ling shag ling thum tsa murnyi dzaḥs baṃ ho: brgya rtsa la pogs ci lasab brjod bla rtags bcas te 'gu /sa par 'gyur sa ma yā de nas bci ba'i las byed paḥ dza dza: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo yi: mgo lus byad kyi thag pas chings pho nya las mkhan bang ma bul mngag pa'i gnyer la rtsal ma zhan: dus la bab po sa ma yā dgra bgegs sarba chings shig chings shig pa sha hūṃ: lus chings ngag chings yid chings shig: badz+ra bhan+ta bhan+ta nan: sum̐ ri li li sarba jaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: brgya rtsa la sogs gang skabs brngo da bden pa chen po sa da gra de 'chang sa ma yā de nas dbye ba'i las byed pa dza dza dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: bka' sdod sprul pa'i dmag tshogs kyis bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di: mgon skyabs la srung kun dang khrol: gnod byed 'dre bgegs bdud dang sprod: dgra bgegs sarba pra we sha ya phaṭa: a 2ཿtrag rak+ṣa mā ra ya phyes phyes: ma ma trag du tra mā ra ya phyes byes: dgra bo skyobs byed kyi la dang phyes shig: gnod byed 'dre bdud dang sprod cig rak+ṣa rwa hu la dgra

bo'i tshe srog la rbad sod: brgya rtsa la sogs gang 'os brjod de yi dgra bo lha da dbye sa ma yā de nas spyo ba'i las byed pa dza dza: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: bka' sdod sprul pa'i dmag tshogs kyis bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'dis: nyes pa dran nas smra ru chug: sma bzhin 'bog la brgyal bar mdzod: trig trig dgra bo'i srog la trig: 'ur 'ur dgra bo'i snying la 'ur: shag shag dgra bo'i tsit+ta shag rmugs rmugs dgra bo'i lus ngag yid 'a rmugs: 'thibs 'thib dgra bo'i lus ngag yid gsum 'thibs: brgyal brgyal dgra bo'i lus ngag yid gsum brgyal: dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya kā wā tsi khung thum myog rbad: brgya rtsa la sogs skabs bstun brjod des ni dgra bo 'bog cang brgyal sa ma rwa de nas gsod pa'i las byed pa dza dza: drang srong chen po'i dus la la bab gdong mo mched bzhi'i dus la bab: gza' chen brgyad kyi dus la bab: rgyu skar nyer brgyad dus la bab: dpal mgon dregs tshogs dus la bab: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra po 'di stong gsum srid pa gar gnas kyang rang dbang med par 'dir khug la: zhe sdang me gza' stod nas rgyob: 'dod chags chu gza' smad

ba:tshu nas zhugs: nga rgyal sa gza' g.yas nas thobs: phrag dog rlung gza' g.yon nas dbob: nam mkha'i gza' rgod snying la rgyug: lta dbang nyan long mi gtad par: skad cig nyid du gzer nad thobs: za byed gdong mo mched bzhi yis: sha khrag drod dbugs chub kyis bzhes: dregs pa gza' chen rnam brgyad kyis rnam shes tshogs brgyad rten dang phrol rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis phung khams rtsa rgyus lhag med rol: dpal mgon dregs pa'i dmag tshogs kyis: dgra sde ming gi lhag mar bsgyur:mngon spyod phrin las dus la bab: hrīḥtri shag ru ram nā ga tsit+ta gram ma ma yo za 'gram ha he ge sha la dza dza: dgra bo'i tsit+ta shag shag: dgra bo'i rak+ta chil chil: dgra bo' me sa dun dun: tshal bar rlog: sha hūṃ nyung hūṃ dza mā ra ya rbad sod: brgya rtsa la sogs gang skabs brjod drang srong gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas pas dgra bo'i snying khrag de hub kyis bzhesanas rnam shes skye med chos kyi dbyings su rgyas gtab par bsam mo: des na dgra dpung rdul brlag 'gyur sa ma mā de nas bstab pa'i las byed pa tsher hom bsregs la 'di skad do dza srid pa

bsregs byedaye shes me yi klong rāsapas byung ba'i spug nag 'od 'phros ni sku stod srin po mig gis rnam par mdzes: ro smad sbrul 'khyil mi ro'i gdan la bzhugasaḥ thod sbrul phreng ba mgul 'phyang khro zhing gtum: rab 'bar me yi 'od zer 'phro bar bskyed bka' nyan gza' gdong sde brgyad las la 'gyed: rgyu skar dregs pa 'khor bcas mngon sum gsal: he dza rab 'jigs rngams pa'i lto zhal hom khung du: ma ga rtog bsgral ba'i phung khams skye mched bstabs: dgyes pas shub sgra dang bcas rab bzhes nas: dgra dpung phyod nas gcod cing brlag par bsam: —8tri shag ru ram nā ga tsat+ta kram ma ma yo za 'gram ha he ge sha la dza dza: dgra bgegs gnod byed kyi sha khrag rus gsum la kha kha khā hi kha te: brgya rtsa la sogs gang skabs brjod byas te dgra bo bsgral ba phung khams ma lus bstabs dmod bcol ni rdo bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo gnod byed 'di rnams med par mdzod cig: rings bar mdzod cig: bskrad par mdzod cig: gzir bar mdzod cig: bcing bar mdzod cig: gnan par mdzod cig: dbye bar mdzod cig: ming tsam yang mi gnas pa'i phrin las

btsan dam pa mdzod cig: skabs da skabs su sbyar bar bya des ni dgra dpung tshar gcod 'gyur sa ma yu rak+ka rā hu la e dam bha lirnyi kha kha khā hi khā hi: dzaḥdrang 17nga chen po 'byungaba'i rang gnas byon snyigs ma'i rdul tshogs gtad du bcol bar bya: badz+ra rak+ta ho thal sol rnams lam rgya gram da brag dmar klu yi pho brang gang ru la gtad du bcol te yis: rten 'brel baglu med bden pa dpang khur ba'i: 'dir gnas zo dor gnyan po dgongs su gsol: bdag ni dkon mchog rjes 'jug sgrub la brtson ma nyes rang khar 'dug kyang dgra yisargol: mngon spyod drag las mi byed thabs ma byung: las mtha' gtad 'di khyod la bcol bar bya: dgra sde ma the ra thal ba rdul du rlog: ming tsam med pa'i brin las mdzad dugasol: stam bha ya nan: mā ra ya nan: na sha ya nan: bhan+ta ya ya nan: gtad 'di ma regar badz+ra sa ma yā las kyi shul te gzhan gyis mi mthong phyir shin tu gtsang zhing spus dag bya ba'o sa ma yā shan tu rno ba'i man ga zab mo 'di gcig brgyud dam ni skal ldan las mi spel snod min la shor mkha' 'gros bka' chad 'byung sgrub pa po la gnad 'di shin tu gces gos su sgrub khang gyon la dben khrod 'grims las su

bstan srung grogs su chos skyong gsol zas su dgra zo skom du bdud rtsi spyod mngon spyod dregs pa'i ya mtshan srid na spa dgra brdung gzhan la snyan cing bstan pa bkur sa sa rgyas chos kyi che ba mi nyams phyir dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dregs lasathabs la brtson rang 'dod phug bcug gla brngan phyir btang na srung ma 'khu zhing yi dam lha yis 'grel mkha' 'gro bka' chad 'beb la gzir bar 'gyur sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya ye ma rgyal ba' dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi thig le rdo rje snying po' skor grub pa'i dab phyug rgyal mchog dbyangs la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen bdo la bstims shig sa ra bye mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyags ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gzengs pa lang pa 'i tshe dpa' bo khyod nyid bzhad pa rtsal du bzhengs skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas 'gro don phrin las byang nas byang du rgyas rten 'brel legs na ya mtshan rmad du byung 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god mtha' ma'i gnya' non 'gyur ba'i skal bzang pod bka' 'di srung shig gnod sbyin btsan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum chos bdag rnams la sprod cig ging dmar nag bstan pa dar zhi 'gro don mthar rgyas shog sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya drag po zangs ging dmar po'i mngon spyod kyi las 'bod rbad bsad gsum sogs kyi rim pa

gas/: rdzogs so gter rgya gaspyod rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gas rgya gurgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pa d+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lu zinadam pa sku skyesapad+ma bsod nams grub pa 'i rdo rjes bkra shis lha reg bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten ya mtshan can dang dri med ras gzan dkar po kha tshar ma nyams pa'i skyes bzang ngo du mar bcas te rtsol sgrub lhur len gyis bskul ngor/ kho bo rgyal mtshog bzhad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshu te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa na chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo le/

btsarnya zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen pad+ma he ru ga'i: bka' sdod sbu gri mched gsum gyi drag bskul dgra dpung rdul rlog zhes bya ba bzhugs so:mi: na 31 pad+ma 11 dha shrī sarba sa twa ya: 31sgodzo/ ma 'ongasasnyegasama'i smag rum du skal bza pho mo re mchis na de la dgra dang bgegs kyis rgol nyes pa sna tshogs ston 'gyur pa' rkyenabazlog shin tu zab pa 'i gnad drag bskul 'di la 'bad pa ra rigs dgra dpu rtsad nas gcod pa ra 'gyur bgegs tshogs rmi nas rkem par nges sa ma yu sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma bshams de la dgra bgegs 'gugasa'astim bya 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod du spro la gsal ting 'dzan brtan po yis hūṃ bh+yo dza bdud yul mun pa'i smag rum nas bdud dmag yongs kyi spyi rje bo: dgra sgog gcod pa'i mthu rtsal can: bdud kyi spu gri 'bar ba khyod gnad nas bskul ma da bzhengs shig: rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan rta la bcibs rno ba'i mtshon char ngar blud de: sdang ba'i dgra la dpa' rngam bskyed: brngan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: do nub nam gyi dgung thun tshun: dgra bo' bla ni 'gugs par mdzodaX sha khrag rus pa zan ltar zo: tshe dang sgog ni so sor phyes

dbugs kyi rgyun thag rbad kyis chod ming tsam med pa'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yo:btsan yul 'bar ba'i gling dgu nas:btsan kyi spu spri 'bar ba rje:gnad nas bskul lo da tshur bzhengs:btsan rta me bde ga chibs su bcibs rlung las mgyogs pa'i bang rtsal bskyed:sdang ba'i dgra la rngam mdangs phyung:btsan mdung 'bar ba ngar blud nas:zhing bcu tshang ba'i snying la thobs:btsan zhags dgra bo'i ske la bskor:brngan pa'i gtor skyems 'di bzhes la:dmar thag nyi ma'i zer da 'grogs:sdang ba'i dgra bo'i bla 'phrogs cig tshe dang sgog ni so sor phyes:sha khrag rus par za ngu gyis:mtha' rtsa skye rgyud lhag med mdzod:bh+yo:rgya mtsho chen po'i gting klong nas:klu rnams yongs kyis spyi rje bo:klu yi spu gri dug rlangs khol:gnad nas bskul lo da tshur byon:chu rta bya gshog chibs su bcibs:glog las mgyogs pa'i bang rtsal bskyed:rno ba'i mtshon char ngar blud de:sbrul zhags dam nyams ske la bskor:dpa' rngam sdang ba'i dgra la ston:dgyes bskyed gtor skyems 'di bzhes la dgra la shi chad nang dme thongs mthong reg kha rlangs dug gis

badz+ra: thobs: bsad pa'i rtags mtshan myur du ston: skya reng zer dang mnyam chas te dgra bo'i bla ni dam du longs tshe srog zung ni so sor byes:sha khrag rus pa zas su rol: dpa' rtags khyad chos dang bcas te dgra sde ming tsam med par mdzod: dus la bab po sa ma yā kyi: than gyi bya sdon mi skad smra: de nyid dgra bo'i phug tu rgyug:than sbrul nag po dug gi zer: de nyid dgra bo' khyim du rgyug: than khyi sngon po lcags spyang te: dgra bo'i sgo 'gram ngu zug thongs: klu yi ltas ngan sna tshogs bcas: dgra bo'i yul khams phung bar mdzod: kyi: than gyi bya dmar khyi skad 'don dgra bo'i pho yi steng du rgyug: than gyi mi dmar glog zhags can spre'u'i gzugs ston dgra la rgyug than gyi khyi dmar wa mo ste: dgra bo'i phug nas rgyal skad thon: btsan gyi ltas ngan sna tshogs pa sa: dgra dpu ming tsam med par rlog: mngon spyod phrin las grub par mdzod: kye than gyi bya nag ral pa can: lcags sder dgra bo'i sgra la thobs: than gyi mi nag ro gzugs can: dgra bo'i ming nas 'bod bzhin rgyug: than gyi khyi nag sram gyi gzugs dgra bo'i

khyim nas tsi sgra sgrogs bdud kyi ltas ngan sna tshogs pas: dgra bo'i yul khams phung du chug nyams pa can gyi srog rtsa chod: nyes 'byed pho mo spyo ru chug: bsad rtags don snying mngon sum sprod: ma bul ma 'gyangs sa ma yā: kyi: ltas ngan 'ug pas ha ha sgrogs: dgra bo'i bla la 'jab mkhas kyis: ltas ngan sbyang mo ngu zug thon: dgra bo'i bla la 'jab mkhas kyis: ltas ngan srin bya khyim du rgyug: skra nas 'then la 'ur skad sgrogs: ltas ngan bya rgod sder 'dzing chos: dgra bo'i sbra la dathu ngas su chug ltas ngan bung ba sbrulakhrid de: dgra yi ga cha'i nang du rgyug: ltas ngan cho 'phrul sna tshogs pas: dgra bo'i pho rnams gri ru sod: mo rnams 'gags shing spyo ru chug: byis pa mngal skems chung grir sod nye ba rtsa lag rdul du rlog: yul khams phung brlag sna dgus gtor: ming gi lhag tsam ma lus bar: spu gri gsum gyi zas skal gtad: mngon spyod phrin las dus la bab ma bul lam 'khyangs sa ma yā: duḥtsatshan56ra 'ur rgyug rgyug trig trig shag shag dgra la rbad rbad: grangs gsogs gtor ma dgra la rdebs dmod pa bor la thal mo rdebs des na dgra la than ltas 'byung

gsaX mngo na spyod drag ro 'i phrin las 'grub the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pa d+ma saṃ sto wa' ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen yis snyi dang 'dra ba'i ya zab med byung ba grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da du spel pa 'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la bstems shig sa ra phyo mardo khams bkra shas rdzong der dgongs pra sdom sa ma 'o sa snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon gyis gzengs pa lang pa 'i tshe dpa 'a bo khyod nyid 'dus pa rtsal du bzhengs skyes bu de da gdam pa 'di 'phrad nas 'gro don phrin las bya nas byang ru rgyas 'brel tshan don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god bka' 'di srungs shig skyes bu gang dmar nag dam nyams lag tu ma sgo ra sbu gri gsum thugs sras rnams la sprod cag spu gri gsum sa ma yu: rgya rgya rgya spu gri mched gsum gyi bskul ba dug mda' dmar nag rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu h+ya o rgyan gyi slob dpo na pa d+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o rda thim lja zhes pa 'di' lung zen sku skyesapa d+ma bsod nams grub pa 'a rdo rjes bkra shis ya mtshan can gyi skyes bzang po du mar bcas te nan tan chen po sa bskul ro ra/ 7kho bo rgyal mtshag bzhad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'aze la/ sarba masgo lam̐/
badz+ra cha zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi phrin las:drag po me yi las sbu gri reg gcod zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

bsgo/: na mo padha kro dha rgya sbyo wa sarba ma hā shrī sa twa ya za 〉〉 ma bzad bde ba' sku mchog he ru ka pad+ma 'bum rdzong zla gam 'dus pa' zhal ma tshogs rgya mtsho rtag par 'byel de la snyang dbus pad+ma' ze'u 'byur dgyes sha btud ma rtog 'byung po dug lnga a 'thas gdon nyon mongs las las skyes pa thams cad kun: drag po'i brtul zhugs me yi phrin las kyis tshad gcod byed pa'i dam tshag gces pa ra zu sa sam mā drag po'i shing gas me hom gru gsum brtsig rlung yab 'bar me bsregs rdzas gzhung ltar bsags sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyangs spel bdud rtsir bsgyur zad med nam mkha'i mdzod du sprul bsgyur bya sa ma yu me 'tshamasabacad pa ni hū hūṃ skye med dbyings las byung ba yi: las byed mkha' 'gro rnam pa bdun: sku ni ljang nag khro 'dzum sgeg: phyag na me yi 'khor lo thog: zla gam dbang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: pad+ma dbang chen sgrub pa la nye bar 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs rnams: rdul du rlog cig dz+wa la ram̐:hū hūṃ /: bi shā badz+ra kho mi tsakra dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐: me sbar bya ba ni hū phyibya ba grab pa'i dbyings nyid las las kyi mkha' 'gro don grab ma: ljang gsal 'bar ba'i gsal shing thogs: rnal 'byor mngon smod grab pa'i phyir za gam dbang gi

bsnye: dkyil 'khor 'dis: drag po'i me ni sbar bar mdzod: ha garma ḍāk+ki ni badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa: me lha bskyed pa ni e hūṃ maṇ+ḍal hūṃ: mi dmigs ngang las me dpung klong: ram̐X yig spro bsdus zhu ba las: drag po'i me lha sku mdog ljang: zhal gcig phyag bzhi khro 'dzum sgeg: dbyug to me dpung ril ba dang: bgrangs phreng 'dzin cing phyed 'byeng gis: skyin dmar me lce 'phro la bcibs: tshang skud ljang gu se ral byas: me lha drang srong 'khor gyis bskor: shar lho'i 'tshams nas de 'dra ba: dpag med spyan drangs ro gcig gyur: spyan 'dren ni hūṃ trī: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: shar lho'i 'jig rten skyong mdzad pa'i: asne rā tsa 'khor dang bcas: 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: ma asne ye de wa ri ṣi sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: bzhugs gsol na hū hrī dam tshig me yi dkyil 'khor 'dir mngon spyod phrin las lhun grub phyir asne rā tsa 'khor dang bcas: dgyes shing brtse ba'i bzhugs su gsol: o asne de wa ri ṣi sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan phyag 'tshal ni ṭ+wāṃ trī bsreg bya za ba'i dam tshig can: skyin

dmar bcibs shing phrin las sgrub asne ra tsa 'khor bcas la 'bar ba grub phyir gus phyag 'tshal: sarba a ti pu ho: pra ti dza ho: mchod pa na hūṃ hrī: drang sgong chen po mnyes pa'i phyir: nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga: sman gtor rak+ta ga ṇa tshogs: mchod pa'i bye brag dpag med 'bul: ma asne de wa ṛ ṣi sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra pung sogs shabha pra tits+tsha ā:hūṃ: mahā rū pa sogs sparnye pra tits+tsha ā:hūṃ: ma hā pañca a dṛ ta rak+ta bha lirnya ga ṇa tsakra khā hi: byon skyems ni hūṃ hrī dwangs ba da zhun gyi mar khu 'di: dgang gzar ram̐ gyi mtshan can dang : mnyam par sbyar nas phul lags na: me la'i ljags kyi sbu gus bzhes: skyed asne de wa ra ṣi ha bya ka bya bha ha wa na ye swā hā: bdun gsum nyer gcig gis phul lo phrin bcol na hūṃ hrī: drag po me yi phrin las la: gnas pa'i drang srong dam tshig can: sngon nas dam mnos zhal bzhes bzhin sgrub pa po yis 'gal rkyen bzlog: rgyal bsen 'byung po dam sri dang dri za gnas gdon lus gdon dang: 'byung po mkha' la rgyu ba'i tshogs: sbyin sreg me yis dbang du bsgyur: mngon spyod phrin las la drangs te: drag po'i

badz+ra: phrin las 'grub par mdzod nā ra ya ku ru ye swāhā: rdzas 'bul ba ni o bho dhi ṣ+ṭṛk+ta ye swāhā dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa: yin a sro ta khā hi: dgra bgegs mār ya phaṭa: bla sarba pa paṃ da ha na ye swāhā: dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa:bla sarba a sirnyi ye swā hā: dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa:snyen sarba saṃ bha dhe swāhā: dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa snyen badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swāhā: dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa: snyen mahā bhe ga ye swāhā: dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa: yin mahā bi dza ye swāhā: dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa:yin badz+ra ghasma ri swāhā dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa: snyen badz+ra bā la ye swāhā: dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa: tsan badz+ra a yu ṣe swāhā: dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa: tshan badz+ra a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swāhā: dgrabagegs mā ra ya phaṭa: sgo gha gha nigha gha ni bi lo ki ti swā hā: dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa: snyen badz+ra ma le puṣ+ṭa ye swāhā: dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa: blang badz+ra waṣ+ṭa ye swāhā: dgrabagegs mā ra ya phaṭa snyen asnyedadowa ta dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa swāhā yin asnetsan ā&: de ltar sngags da bstun byas te rdzas sna bcu drug 'bul bar bya re re bzhin du 'dod gsol gdab
