des ni mngon spyod lhun gyis grub sa ma mā bstod pa ni hū hrī: thugs rje che ldan me yi lha drang sgong chen po ra la bcibs: 'bar ba'i phrin las 'byung ba'i gzhi: de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal: bzod gsol ni ho: drang srong chen po me yi lha: thugs rje brtse bas dgongs su gsol: bdag rmongs mchod rdzas ma tshang zhing: cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa bshags bzod par bzhes la tshangs par stsol: yag brgya lan gsum bzla smon lam ni ho: dgongs su gsol 'o : drag po me yi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: ye shes kyi bsregs blugs rgya chen po phul ba'i byin rlabs la brten nas bdag sgrub pa po la yas kyi bdud g.yos pa dang: mas kyi sri ldang ba dang: rbod gtong ngan pa'i byad zor zug pa dang: dregs pa'i gdug rtsub ngan pa dang: dug gsum 'byung pos rgol ba sna tshogs pa: mngon spyod drag po'i sgo nas tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: snyan gsan phul ba ni ho: me lha'i rgyal po drang srong chen po khyod: me dang gnyis su med par bzhugs nas: drag po'i bsreg rdzas thams cad pad+ma dbang chen gyi zhal du stobs pa dang: mngon spyod phrin las kyis bskul ma

bsgo/: mdzad du gsol: de nas bsregs la gzhung bzhin du bskyed la spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod pa rgyas pa ra 'bul de nas byon skyems 'bul ba ni 31 āX:: 'byung ba'i dwangs bcud mar khu 'di: thabs shes phyag rgya las drangs te: pad+ma dbang chen zhal du 'bul: rdo rje'i ljags kyis bzhes su gsol sngags mthar a dṛ ta khahi nyer gcig gis phulaloḥ rdzas 'bul ba ni hūṃ ༷ thugs rje che ba'i bdag nyid can: pad+ma dbang chen 'khor bcas la: phrin las grub pa'i bsregs rdzas 'bul: bde chen ye shes 'bar bar mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar skyid sto dhi ṣ+ṭṛk+ta ye swāhā: dgra bgegs kyi 'byer ba mā ra ya phaṭa: nyer gcig gis yam shing phul rtsa sngags mthar 37 pañca a mṛ ta khāhi: dgra bgegs kyi dpal 'byer mā ra ya phaṭa: nyer gcig gas mar khu phul rtsa sngags mthar skyod sarba pa paṃ dha ha na ye swāhā: dgra bgegs gyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa mā ra ya phaṭa: nyer gcig gis til 'bul 31 sarba ar+sha sirnyi rtsa sngagasamathar nyer gcag gas yungs dkar bul rtsa sngags mthar 31 sarba saṃ bha bhe ye swā hā/ dgra bgegs kyi bde ba phun sum 31gas pa mā ra ya phaṭa: nyer gcig gis zas mchog phul rtsa sngags

mthar yo badz+ra〈spyo ye swāhā: dgra bgegs kyi 'o ngas spyod mā ra ya phaṭa nyer gcig gis rdzas phul rtsa sngags mthar 33 mahā bhe ga ye swāhā dgra bgegs kyi nor mā ra ya phaṭa: nyer gcig gis so ba phul rtsa sngags mthar (( badz+rabe+e dza ye swāhā: dgra bgegs kyi las myur ba'i shugs mā ra ya phaṭa: nyer gcig gis nas phul rtsa sngags mthar tshog badz+raghasma ri swāhā dgra bgegs kyi nad sna dzadzhags 'phel bar gyur cig: nyer gcig gis gro 'bul rtsa sngags mthar ces mahābā la ye swāhā: dgra bgegs kyi stobs mā ra ya phaṭa: nyer gcig gis gran ma 'bul rtsa sngags mthar oṃ badz+ra.a yu ṣe swāhā: dgra bgegs kyi srung ba mā ra ya phaṭa: nyer gcag gis ku sha 'bul rtsa sngags mthar oṃ gha ghanai gha gha ni bi 'o1 zhi te swāhā: dgra bgegs kyi rigs rgyud mā ra ya phaṭa: nyer gcig gis shing thog 'bul rtsa sngags mthar (( badz+ram le pū ṭa ye swāhā: dgra bgegs kyi shes rab mā ra ya phaṭa: nyer gcig gis dkar gsum 'bul rtsa sngags mthar tso( badz+rawaṣ+ṭa ye swāhā: dgra bgegs kyi gos dang rgyan mā ra ya phaṭa: nyer gcig gis rags bya phul rtsa sngags mthar dharma skyodagra bgegs kyi tshe bsod nams kha rje dbang thang mā ra ya phaṭa khāhi nyer gcig

bsgo/: gis sngags bya phul rtsa sngags mthar yin ān/: rdzas wag ma zhag 'bul skabs su 'dod gsol gdab pa ni / ༷ pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'dza ra du: drag po'i blugs phul ba'i mthus: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams dang: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs tshogs dang dus min 'chi brgyad ston byed pa'i: dgra 'dre rgyal bsen tshogs: mngon spyod drag pos tshar bcad nas: ming tsam med pa 'i phrin las mdzod: dgra bgegs mā ra ya ku ru ye swāhā: gzhung gi bstod pa bya bzlas pa yang ci 'thub gtong spro na mchod gsol da dga' ston gyi tshogs bska — 'bul lo de nas gar+ṣa rag gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni hūṃ ༷ ye shes taing 'dzen las byung ba'i: phyi nang gsang mchod rgya mtsho kun: pad+ma dbang che byir 'bul: bka' drin chen pos gtang rag bzhes: yin mahā tsu dza sarba sa ma ya ho: rtsa sngags nyer gcig gis mar khu phul ba gshegs skyem mo rdzas sngags bdun res mas sa rdzogs su gto 'bulab na yid ādza/: lan gsum gya spel la hūṃ ༷ thugs rje che ldan dbang gi sku: pad+ma rol ba'i lha tshogs la: drag po'i bskang rdzas ba lirnyi: gnag chu ba chu dug sna sbyar:

zangs til yungs ke shing tshe dri chen sbyar bas bshos nag 'di: bzhes la mngon spyod brin las kyis: zhing bcu'i dgra dang dug gsum bgegs ma lus bsgral zhing rlag par mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar oṃ mahā bha ling ta khāhi nyer gcig gis phul lo bstod pa ni hūṃ hrī: mi bzad bde chen 'bar ba'i sku rjes chags bzhad pa'i rta skad can: bde chen ye shes rgyas 'debs pa'i: pad+ma gar dbang la phyag 'tshal: bzod gsol ni ho: ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la: phyogs 'dzin 'khu ldog mi mnga' yang: bdag cag blo yi dri ma kun:yongs su dag phyir phyag bgyi'o: 31 badz+ra sa ma ya bi sdokhre ā: yag brgya lan gsum bzla me zhags spro ba ni ( hūṃ / bde chen chags pa bral ba'i gzi bya ba lhun gyis grub pa'i me khro chung bu yug 'tshubs bzhin du: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rnams su spro: 'di na ma rtog gnyis 'dzin gdon: dug gsum 'byung po rang rgyud can: ye shes me yis bsregs par byed: shes rab rlung gis gtor bar byed: rig pa'i chu yis bkru bar byed: khro bo khro mos rdul du rlog: glo bur nyon mongs 'khrul ba 'di: chos kyi dbyings su bsgral bar bya:

badz+ra: halarba durten mā ra ya phaṭa: bro brdung ni hūṃ hrī: ljang gsal 'od kyi dkyil 'khor nas: bya ba lhun gyis grub pa'i lha: thabs kyi rang bzhin khro la rngams: tharab rang mdangs zhi la 'dzum: zhi khro zung du 'jug pa'i sras dpa' bo dpa' mo sprin ltar gtibs: khro po'i bro ni g.yas su brdung: dgra rnams bye ba dum bur gtubs mo'i bro ni g.yon du brdung: bgegs rnams thal bar brlag par bya: zhi b.ligar nai mkha' la bsgyur: 'khrul ba'i rdzun mtshang stong par byed: khro bo'i gar ni sa gzhir ba nyon mongs 'khrul ba rming nas bshig: ye shes lnga dang ldan par byed ha bisne ta kṛta phaṭa: dam sri s+t+waṃm bha ya nan: bsdu rim ni hūṃ nyi snyemed chos skulidagongs klong zu'agags med gzigs pa'i thugs rje can: da ni mngon spyod lhun grub pa'i: zla gam dgu rdzogs klong dutsu: de nas me lha sngar bzhin du gsal la mchod pa 'bul gshegs skyems rgo sngagasabadun gyas phul lo rdzas sngags gsum mam re res kya 'thus so bstod pa gzhung ltar gtong gtor 'bul na a ka ros byin gyis brlabs te yin 'jig rten pa yi tshul 'dzin pa'i drang sgong chen po

'khor bcas: mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di 'bul bzhes: gang brtsam las te mthar phyin mdzod dgra bgegs ming gi lhag mar gyur: gsang sngags bstan pa dar bar mdzod bzod gsol bya bsdu rim ni:ho: drang srong chen po dbang dang ldan: sku drin bla na ma mchis pas: da ni shar lho'i gnas su gshegs phrin las zhu tshe gnang du gsol: badz+ra mu: me lha ye shes pa shar lhor gshegs: dam tshig pa 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur bsngo smon ni ho: pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor du: drag po'i bsregs blugs phul ba'i mthus: 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa'i dug lnga'i nad rnams zhi bar shog: rnam rtog gdon rnams grol ba dang bstan pa'i 'gab 'dre brlag gyur cig: bdud bzhi'i mtshan ma rang grol nas sku bzhi'i dgongs don rtogs par shog: chags sogs 'khrul ba ka dag ste: dbang chen gsang gsum spyod par shog: srid pa'i sgyu lus mtshang grol te: ye shes sgyu ma mngon gyur shog gzugs sku gnyis kyis gdul bya'i khams dong sprugs chos skur 'ub chub shog: lan gsum du gdab po shis brjod ni hūṃ hrī chos nyid zhi ba'i me klong du: ma rig nyon

'amatshu mongs bud shing kun: gnyis su med par bsregs pa'i mthus: zhi ba lhun grub shis pa stsol yod tan rgyas pa'i me klong du: snod bcud brtan g.yo'idapal yon kun: gnyis med mnyam par phul ba'i mthus: rgyas pa lhun grub shis pa stsol: khams gsum dbang bsdud me klong du: 'byung lnga'i dpal yon dwangs bcud kun gnyis med mnyam par bstabs pa'i mthus: dbang chen lhun grub shis pa stsol: mngon spyod drag po'i me klong du: rnam rtog bdud bzhi dug lnga'i gdon dgra bgegs ma lusabastab pa'i mthus: drag po lhun grub shis pa (skor: gzhan ya shis brjod ca rags su bya'o des ni maro na spyod lhun gyas grub pa dang gang la gzes pa' yul rnams tshar gcod par 'gyur ro sa ma yu me ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pa d+ma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi thig le zab gsang rdor snying skor grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la thob cigs ra bye mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs rgya sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma nad mtshon gzengs langs tshe rgyal tshab rig 'dzan gsung gi rdo rje dang bstan pa 'di 'phrad 'gro don bsam mtha' yas 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma

'od du 'god bka' 'di srung shig btsan rgod yang le ber dam nyams lag tu ma shor thub par srungs sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya drag po me ya las shin tu zab pa rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya orgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma sa bha la' bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda tham snyi zhes pa 'di' lung zan sku skyesapad+ma'i mtshan can gyis bkra shas dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas te nan tan chen po sa bskul ngor/ 7kho bo dbang chenagasung gi rdo rje rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa' ya ge pa ni chos bdag nyad kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga la/
badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:pad+ma dbang chen 'bar ba'i gsang lam:rtsa rlung gar gyi 'khrul 'khor shin tu zab pa'i bka' rgya bzhugs so:

ba:tshu na mo pad+ma kro dha rā dza ya za17skasgo mi bzad bde ba'i rang bzhin ches 'bar zhing:gdul dka'i nyon mongs skems pa'i ye shes mes shin tu dwangs ma zhu ba'i gzi byin gyis:rgyud lnga'i 'khor lo rigs lngar sad la 'dud:shin tu rgyud dag rnal 'byor dam tshig can:blo rno rigs bzang skyes bu dam pa yis:dben pa'i gnas su phyi nang dam rgya bsdams:rlung chas yo byad phun sum tshogs par bya:sngon 'gro sta gon cha bzhi'i gtor ma 'bul:bgegs skrad bsrung gur phub la byin chen dbab:bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol gdab thugs yid bsre:de dag sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa'o:sa ma yā:rgya rgya rgya:dang po snod kyi 'jig rten stug po bkod phyi nang rnam dag phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus:gzugs phung rang grol rnam par snang mdzad dkar longs sku'i rgyan rdzogs mtshan dpe'i 'od zer 'bar:thugs gar oX las spros pa'i gzi byin gyis:gti mug las byung bag chags gnyis snang gi dri ma mtha' dag chos kyi dbyings su sbyangs:rlung gi rnal 'byor bzhi rim gnad la 'bad:byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya lan

btsarnya gsum bca': rdo rje'i gshog brgyang lan gsum se gol gtogs: 'khor lo'i phyag rgya gnas lngar gtug bzhin du oṃ zhes brjod la chos dbyings ye shesaskyongs: gti mug 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo ka dag ngang rig ngar so ma yengs med skyongs bar bya: sa ma yā: yan lag dang po'o: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa snod kyi 'jig rten mngon dga'i zhing: dag pa'i rang bzhin rgyan gsum phun tshogs dbus: rnam shes rnam dag rdo rje mi bskyod pa: sku mdog mthing gsal be+eḍūr lhun po la: nyin byed 'bum gyis 'khyudapa'i bkrag mdangs 'bar: thugs sgog hūṃ ༷las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis: nyon mongs zhe sdang 'khrul ba rming nas rkem: kun la snyoms pa'i ye shes thad gar skyongs: rdo rje'i khutshur 'phen tshul lan gsum bya: rtse gcig phyag rgya spyi bo'i gnas su gtugs: rkang mthil sprad cing lus rgya rdo rjer bca': hi ya zhes sgrogs seng chen g.yu ral sprugs: rdo rje'abebs pa'i brdul zhugs gnad la brtson: me long ye shes ngang la hrig ger bzhag: sa ma yu: yan lag gnyis pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa snang srid dpal ldan bkod pa'i

zhing: dag pa'i rang bzhin yon tan phun tshogs dbus tshor phung rnam dag rin chen 'byung ldan sku btso ma'i mdangs 'bar rta bdun 'od 'byug bzhin sgog gi yi ge swāX yig las byung ba'i: 'od kyis nyon mongs nga rgyal rab sangs te: gnyam nyid thugs rje'i ngang las 'khrul 'khor ni: rdo rje'i khu tshur gdong brgyang lan gsum bya: g.yas g.yon gcu zhing rin chen gnas lngar gtugs kyi lang sgal 'dril sgal 'beb lan gsum sdebs: hi hi zhes sgogs mnyam nyid ye shes ngang: ma bcos rang grol rig pa thad gar skyongs:sa ma yā yan lag gsum pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: bzhi pa snang srid bde chen pad brtsegs zhing: chags bral yon tan bkod pa phun tshogs dbus 'du shes rnam dag snang ba mtha' yas ni: rā ga'i mdangs 'bar bcu gsum rgyan rdzogs shing: thugs ga'i sgog yig ā+oXlas 'od 'phros pas: nyon mongs 'dod chags 'khrul ba rab sangs nas: bde chen ye shes ngang las 'khrul 'khor ni: rdo rje'i khu tshur 'phar sdebs lan gsum bya: sku mnye sor bsnol phyag rgyas g.yas g.yon mnye rma bya'i gshog 'gyur lan gsum tshur du bya:

ba:tshu pad+ma 'thor bsdud ngang nas 'beb gsum bsdab: sa ma yā: yan lag bzhi pa'o: rgya rgya rgya lnga pa snang srid las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing: rten dang brten pa dag chen phun tshogs dbus: 'du byed rnam dag don yod grub pa ni ljang gsal bkrag mdangs 'od 'bar mtshan dpe'i 'khyud thugs srog hāḥlas spros pa'i gzi mdangs kyis nyon mongs phrag dog sa bon bag chags stong: ro mnyam rtogs pa'i brtul zhugs lus rgya ni: chun btsal lta zur shad bzhin gdong brgyangs bya: skyabs sbyin phyag rgya'i mgo cog g.yas g.yon bskor stong 'dren bya zhing rlung sems dbu mar btsud: rten 'brel lus bsgrig bde stong sems la 'char: skyil krung lus sprug dgu 'beb brdab par bya: rjes su bya grub ye shes ngang la bzhag: sa ma yā:yan lag lnga pa'o: rgya rgya rgya:drug pa snang srid me ri 'bar ba'i zhing: brda rtags bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus snatshogs pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i khar rig pa'i ngo bodabang chen he ru ga: dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis ral gri dang: thod dbyug 'dzin pa dur khrod dpal chas brgyan: rtsa

'khor lo lnga ldan hrī:yis gtam: ngag nas sgra bsgrags ma mo mkha' 'gro dang: pho nya thams cad rang dbang med par bskul: nga bdag mtshan 'dzin gdon tshogs ar la skye med dbyings las dgongs pa ma g.yos bzhin: rnam 'gyur rdo rje'i 'khrul 'khor bya ba ni: ldang ste khu tshur bskor rgyang bya ba dang: sdigs mdzub steng 'og bar gsum pa gzir thod dbyug ral gri g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab 'debs: gtegs 'phar gsum nas rdo rje'i lus rgya bca':rdo rje thog 'bebs lan gsum brdab par bya: rjes stong rjen pa'i ngang skyong ngo: sa ma yā: 'brul 'khor drug pa'o: rgya rgya rgya bdun pa snang srid mkha' spyod bde chen zhing: rab brjid bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus:sa pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i khar: rang lus rdo rje phag mo mthing gsal mdzes: phag gdong rus rgyan dar dpyang dril g.yer brgyan: rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan bkod pa sa rlung skul ba'i ye shes me sbar te: gnas lnga'i mtshan 'dzin bag chags dri ma bsregs: bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzhus bcu drug phyed phyed tshul: gnas su dga' ba bzhi bzhi nyams

ba tshu su myong 'od gsal zag dang zag med don la blta: yas dbab thabs la mas brtan shes rab tshul: rang bzhin ma 'dres sa ler gsal byas te: rdo rje gar gyi 'khrul 'khor bca' ba ni: ldang ste khu tshur bskor brgyang lan gsum bya: pad bskor phyag rgyas gnas lngar rigs rgya gtugs: khams gsum 'dren rol mchod tshul lan drug spel: phyag rgya bca' bzhin phag skad lan lnga ngur: bsgrad chung 'bebs gsum brdab la lus sprugs bya: rjes thob 'od gsal spro bsdu bral bar bzhag: sa ma yā: 'khrul 'khor bdun pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: brgyad pa snang srid khrag 'thung rol ba'i zhing: rngams brjed bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus: sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i khar: za byed khro bo byi la'i mgo can ni: dmar nag rdo rje phur pa gdengs thabs 'dzin: gzig sham thod phreng sbrul chun dar dpyangs brgyan ye shes me klong dwangs ma'i sku ru gsal: rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan gong ltar gsal: bde ba chen po'i ye shes gsal bar skyongs: 'khrul 'khor lus kyi phyag rgya rdo rjer bca': g.yas phyogs rgyas gdab gong ltar rdo rje bca'

g.yon phyogs rgyas gdab gong ltar bskyar ba'i rjes: khu tshur gong brgyang gcus 'beb lan gsum spel: phaṭaḥsgra gsum sgrogs rig gdangs rjen par skyongs sa ma yā: 'khrula'akhor brgyad pa'o: rgya rgya rgya dgu pa snang srid mkha' spyod bde chen zhing khrag 'thung rol ba'i dal du gsal gdab ste: pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i gdan gyi khar: gsod byed khro mo pu shud gdong ba can: pad+ma bhan+ta 'dzin cing rgyan gong ltar: dud rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus su dwangs gsal sku'i: gnas lngar rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan par: dbab sbar bzhu bde'i ngang la rab gnas te: gar bsgyur lus kyi phyag rgya pad+mar bca' g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab bde stong phyag rgyas gtab: bsgrad chen 'beb gsum bkra shis skor 'bebs bya: snang srid ro mnyam chos sku'i ngang la bzhag sa ma yā: 'khrul 'khor dgu pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: bcu pa snang srid he ru ka dpal zhing rten dang brten pa rab 'jigs bkod rdzogs dbus: sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i khar: che mchog smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: rdo rje thod khrag gdengs thabs tshul du 'dzin: dur khrod dpal chas dpa' ba'i

badz+ra rtags su bgo: sku dbyings rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan gsal bde stong 'bar ba 'dzag pa'i brtul zhugs bsgom: 'khor 'das brtan g.yos dpal yon dwangs bcud bskyil: langs te 'khrul 'khor sdigs mdzub steng dang 'og: bar du 'phen gdab phur pa 'dril stangs bya: rdo rje lus rgya bca' bzhin thal mo sdeb: khu tshur bskor brgyang 'beb chen gsum brdab pas: gti mug 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo stong byas te: chos dbyings ye shes ngang la mnyam par bzhag: sa ma yā 'khrul 'khor bcu pa'o: rgya rgya rgya:bcu gcig snang srid khrag 'thung rol pa'i zhing: rngam brjid 'bar ba chen por shar ba'i dbus: rdul bral pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i khar bdag lus dpal chen yang dag he ru ga:mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum sgeg dur khrod dpal chas rdo rje bhan dmar 'dzin: dwangs gsal sku dbyings rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga: ma 'dres gongs ltar gsal gdab 'bar 'dzag bsgom: ldang te shar gyi phyogs su gyad thabs bya: dri za'i tshogs la sdigs mdzub gzir zhing gdengs: g.yas g.yon spel mar gsum bskyar ru lu

sgrogs 'beb chen gsum bsdab dri za zil gyis gnon: me long ye shes ngang la mnyam par bzhag: sa ma yā: 'khrul 'khor bcu gcig pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: bcu gnyis snang srid dpal chen rol ba'i zhing: sku mchog yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus chags bral pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i khar: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi sku ru gsal g.yas g.yon ral gri zhags pa gdengs thabs 'dzin dur khrod dpal chas sna tshogs rgyan du bgo: sku dbyings rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan gsal rlung gis bskul te 'bar ba cher g.yos nas: zag med rgyun dbabs dga' bzhi'i mdangs bskyang ste: rdul bral ye shes ngang la lan zher bzhag ldang te lho yi phyogs su gyad thabs bya: ya ya zhes sgogs lus rgya de ltar bca': rgur 'bebs gsum bsdab gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor bzlog: mnyam nyid ye shes ngang la mnyam par bzhag: sa ma yā: 'khrul 'khor bcu gnyis pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: bcu gsum snang srid khrag 'thung rol pa'i zhing: 'bar 'khrug rol ba'i bkod pa rdzogs pa'i dbus rang lus bde mchog gu ru thod phreng rtsal: dkar dmar mdangs ldan

ba tshu zhi ma khro 'dzum sgeg g.yas g.yon rdo rje dril bu bsnol thabs 'dzin: rus rgyan dar dpyangs thod skam dbu rgyan mdzes sku dbyings rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan gsal: bde stong 'bar 'dzag rnal 'byor nan du bsgom: zag med ye shes don la cham gyis bzhag: yang cig ldang te nub phyogs gyad thabs bya: sdigs 'dzub gdengs thabs g.yas g.yon spel mar bya: hrī:sgra snyan la ring ba'i tshul du sgrogs: 'beb chen gsum bsdab klu dbang gdon tshogs gzir: sor rtog ye shes ngang la mnyam par bzhag sa ma yā: 'khrul 'khor bcu gsum pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: bcu bzhisnang srid he ru ka yi zhing: 'bar 'khrugs rngams brngid rol bar gsal gdab dbus: chags bral pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i khar: rang rig gsal snang rdo rje gzhen nu mthing: zhal gcig phyag gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dril dur khrod chas rdzogs me rlung 'tshubs dbus 'bying: sku dbyings rtsa gsuma'akhor lo lnga ldan gsal: bde stong zag med ngang la mnyam par bzhag: ldang te gar gyi 'khrul 'khor bsgyur ba ni byang gi phyogs su gyad kyi 'dor thabs bsgrad: phur pa

gdengs 'dril gzir tshul spel mar bya: phaṭaḥbarjod mtshan 'dzin rtog pa thad dkar gcod rdo rje'i lus rgya thog 'bebs gsum bsdab pas: gnod sbyin gdon tshogasazhing dam la 'dog: bya grub ye shes ngang la mnyam par bzhag: sa ma yā: 'khrul 'khor bcu bzhi pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: bco lnga snang srid rab 'bar khro bo'i zhing: rngam brjirtags bkod pa phun tshogs dbus rang nyid dpal chen bla med he ru ga: mthing gsal thod dbyug bhan dmar gdengs thabs 'dzin dur khrod chas rdzogs 'bar ba'i 'gyeng: sku dbyings rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan gsal: bde stong rnal 'byor bsgom la 'od gsal skyongs: rdo rje gar gyi 'khrul 'khor bsgyur ba ni ldang te shar lho'i masu gyad thabs bya: thod dbyug 'debs pa'i phyag rgya spel mar bya ma zhes brjod la 'gugs pa'i phyag rgya bca': nya ni bsdud pa'i sgra ste stong 'dren bya phaṭaḥni gtor bye mtshan 'dzin gcod: bsgrad chen 'bebs gsum brdab la drang sgong gi: gdon tshogs zil gyis gnon cing ar la gtad: ro mnyam ye shes ngang la mnyam par bzhag

badz+ra yā: zhabrul 'khor bco lnga pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: bcu drug snang srid he ru ka yi zhing: rab 'jigs dur khrod brgyad bkod rdzogs pa'i dbus: ma chags pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i khar: bdag lus khro rgyal sme bar brtsegs pa ni: smug nag skru gri g.yas la bum pa g.yon: dur khrod chas rdzogs gyad gyi thabs su bzhugs: me rlung dbus 'gying dwangs ba'i sku dbyings su: rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan gsal btab ste: bde stong rnal 'byor bsgom la 'od gsal skyongs: 'pho 'gyur bral bar ngab las ma g.yos bzhin: gegs sel lus kyis 'khrul 'khor bsgyur ba ni ldang de nub byang mtshams su gyad thabs bya: sdigs mdzub gzir zhing gdab stangs spel mar bya: dbab bkru sbyang ba'i dmigs pa nan du bya: 'beb chen gsum bsdab srin po'i gdon tshogs gzir: ro mnyam ye shes ngang la mnyam par bzhag: sa ma yā: 'khrul 'khor bcu drug pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: bcu bdun snang srid khrag 'thung rol pa'i zhing: rngam brjid 'jigs rung bkod pa phun tshogs dbus: rdul bral ge sar zla ba nyi ma'i steng bdag nyid dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul

g.yas g.yon ral gri thod khrag bsnol thabs 'dzin: sku dbyings rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan klong: bde stong dwangs ma'i thig le gnad la dbab: rjes su blo bral ye / par skyongs: slar yang gegs sel lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni: g.yas g.yon sgal 'beb spel mar bsdab pa'i rjes: nub byang mtshams su gyad kyi 'dor thabs bsgrad dzub gzir bzhin dregs pa'i sgog sngags te: brjod bzhin rdo rje rkang bas gnon stangs bya: gtegs 'beb gsum dang dgye rgu bar 'bebs bsdab rlung lha'i gdon la gnon dam la 'dog: rjes su rig stong ngang la mnyam par bzhag: sa ma yā: 'brul 'khor bcu bdun pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: bco brgyad snang srid dag chen khro bo'i zhing:rung dpa' brjid bzod par dka' ba'i dbus: rdul bral pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i khar: rang lus dpal chen stobs ldan nag po ni: sku la dur khrod dpal chas mdzes par rab 'bar me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus su 'gying sku dbyings rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan gsal: 'bar dang bskyod pas bskul te bdud rtsi'i sprin yongs khyab bde

ba tshu stong ngang la mnyam par bzhag: gegs sel lus kyi 'khrul 'khor bsgyur ba ni: ldang te byang shar mtshams su gyad thabs bya: sdigs mdzub gzir zhing gdengs ba'i tshul du bya: dregs pa'i sgog brjod phyag rgyas gdab par bya: 'beb chen gsum brdab dbang ldan gdon la gzir shes rig ma bcos ngang la lhug par bzhag sa ma yā: 'khrul 'khor bco brgyad pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: bcu dgu khro bo pra dz+nya ta kṛ kyi: sku ru gsal ba'i 'od zer rab spros te: snang srid 'byung khams gdon bgegs dam sri'i rigs: tshad med zhi ba chen por rgyas btab nas: dza zhes brjod la lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bca': gom stabs shar bsgyur ṇi mgo gdengs tshul bya: de ni tshad med zhi ba'i brin las so: drang srong rgyug 'beb brdab la mnyam par bzhag: sa ma yā: 'khrul 'khor bcu dgu pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: nyishu khro bo ya man+ta kṛta kyi: sku las spros pa'i 'od zer dpag yas kyis: snang srid 'khor 'das brtan gapo'i dpal yon kun: mi nub mnyam pa chen por rgyas btab nas: hūṃ:zhes brjod la zhags pa'i phyag rgya bca': stangs stabs lhor bsgyur

nor bus rgyas gdab bya: de ni tshad med rgyas pa'i brin las so: seng chen 'gyings stabs bde stong gar 'bebs bsdab: sa ma yā: 'khrul 'khor nyi shu pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: nyer gcig khro bo pad+marnya kṛta ni: dmar gsal bde ba'i rnam 'gyur ldan pa yi: sku las spros pa'i 'od zer mtha' yas pas: lha 'dre mi gsum snang zhing srid pa'i khams: tshad med bde chen klong du rgyas btab nas beḥzhes brjod la lcags sgog phyag rgya bca' gom stabs nub bsgyur pad+ma'i rgyas gdab bya: de ni tshad med dbang gi phrin las so: rma bya'i 'gyur thabs bar 'beb gsum bsdab nas shes rig ma bcos hrig ge rjen par skyongs: sa ma yā: 'khrul 'khor nyer gcig pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: nyer gnyis khro bo bisnan ta kṛta ni ljang gsal sku las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis mtha' yi dmag dang dam sri bstan pa'i bdud: ma lus mngon spyod drag pos zil mnan nas: hoḥzhes brjod la dril bu'i phyag rgya bca': stangs stabs byang bsgyur phur pa gdengs shing 'dril: de ni tshad med drag po'i brin las so: drang srong bzhengs bzhugs stabs dang 'beb chung gsum: brdab

ba tshu la shes rig ma bcos zang thal skyongs: sa ma yu: 'khrul 'khor nyer gnyis pa'o: rgya rgya rgya nyer gsum gzhom med go cha bgo ba ni: rang nyid sku mchog 'jam dpal gshin rjer gsal thugs ga'i 'od kyis mngon par dga' ba'i zhing rten dang brten pa 'od zhu rdo rje yi: go khrab tshul gyur rang gi lus la bgo nad gdon 'jigs tshogs 'phral rkyen ma lus zhi: byang chub bsgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe kun bral dmigs: ngag nas badz+ra ka pa tsa hūṃ brjod: rjes su chos nyid don la mnyam par bzhag: sa ma yā 'khrul 'khor nyer gsum pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: nyer bzhi 'dod 'byung go cha bgo ba ni: rang nyid yon tan che mchog he rur gsal thugs ga'i 'od kyis dpal ldan bkod pa'i zhing: rten dang brten pa 'od zhu rin po che'i: go khrab tshul gyur rang gi lus la bgo: 'phral snang gdon tshogs dur phag sogs kyis gzhom: tshe bsod nyams rtogs ye shes yonatan kun yar ngos zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par dmigs: ngag nas rat+na tsit+ta thu spyoḥbarjod rjes su blo bral don la mnyam par 'jog: sa ma yā: 'khrul 'khor nyer bzhi pa'o:

rgya rgya rgya nyer lnga rdul bral go cha bgo ba ni: rang nyid gsung mchog pad+ma he rur gsal: thugs ga'i 'od kyis bde chen bkod pa'i zhing: brten dang brten pa 'od zhu pad+ma yi: gokhrab tshul du rang gi lus la bgo: nyer 'tsher 'byung po khyung dmar sogs kyis gzhom: rlung sems ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob ste: lha 'dre mi gsum dregs pa zil gnon dmigs: ngag nas pad+ma tsakra hrīḥdzhaiḥbarjod rjes su zang thal don la mnyam par sbyor: sa ma yu 'khrul 'khor nyer lnga pa'o: rgya rgya rgya nyer drug phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu gsal thugs ga'i 'od kyis las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing: rten dang brten pa 'od zhu rgya gram gyi: go khrab tshul du rang gi lus la bgo: dam sri lcags sdig sogs kyis rngam zos nas: phyi nang gsang ba'i bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal: rig stong rdo rje gzhon nu mngon gyur dmigs: ngag nasachag shag hūṃ phaṭa he hūṃX brjod: rjes su ka dag ngang la mnyam par bzhag sa ma yā: 'khrul 'khor nyer drug pa'o rgya rgya rgya: nyer bdun thugs mchog yang dag he rur gsal: thugs ga'i 'od kyis stug po bkod pa'i zhing: rten dang brten pa 'od zhu

ba:tshu 'khor lo yi: go khrab tshul du rang gi lus la bgo: nyer 'che'i phyogs rnams khro chung sogs kyis brlag gzung dang 'dzin pa'i g.yul ngo las rgyal te:thugs mchog 'gyur med dgongs pa mngon gyur dmigs: ngag nas badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa brjod: rjes su bsgrad bsdu phyag rgya rnam lnga bca': 'bebs chen gsum bsdab rtog pa hur byung ste: ha he ho brjod spros bral ngang la bzhag: sa ma yu: 'khrul 'khor nyer bdun pa'o: rgya rgya rgya: nyer brgyad bskyed rim thabs kyi rnam pa kun shes rab yum gyi dbyings su bsdu ba'i phyir: snang srid dag mnyam bde chen zhing gi dbus: chags bral pad+ma bsal ldan zla ba dang rab 'bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal 'tsher dbus: rang nyid skad cig gsang ba ye shes sku: dmar gsal gzi 'od rab 'bar gri thod 'dzin: rin chen prog zhu pad+ma'i thod gdengs mdzes: rus rgyan ku mu ta yi do shal byas: 'ja' 'od 'khrigs klong bzhengs pa'i stabs su gsal: sku dbyings rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan dbus: khrag 'thung rig 'dzin zhi ba ma mkha' 'gro: dam can rgya mtsho ma 'dres gsal btab ste:

byin rlabs rlung gi dam tshig gtum mo bskul ye shes me g.yos bag chags mtshan ma bsregs: nam mkha'i thabs dang shes rab regs pa 'phrod: bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyisgyun babs te: khrag 'thung dgyes bskangs tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag snang stong dga' dang stong ba'i 'od gsal gyi: ngang la ma bcos tsan ner mnyam par bzhag slar yang bdud :'i rgyun gyis rig 'dzan bskangs: tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag gsal stong ye shes dang mngon dga' stong pa chen po'i 'od gsal gyi: ngang la ma bcos hrig ger mnyamapar bzhag: slar yang bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab zhi ba bskangs: tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag bde stong ye shes dang: khyad par dga' dang thams cad stong pa yi: 'od gsal ngang la mabacos rjen par bzhag: slar yang bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab ma tshogs mchod: tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag rig stong ye shes dang: lhan skyes dga' dang shin tu stong pa yi: 'od gsalangang la ma bcos mnyam par bzhag: slar yang bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dam can mchod tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag rdul bral ye shes dang zag med dga' ba spros bral stong pa yi

gtsaji: 'od gsal ngang la thad gar mnyam par bzhag slar yang mas brtan bdud rtsi phyir ldog ste:sngar thob ye shes 'od gsal 'phel zhing rgyas:thams cad mi dmigs dbu ma'i dbyings su bsdu:rdo rje gar gyi phyag rgya bca' bzhin du:hrīthaya:chos sku rdul bral ka dag yum gyi mkhar:lhun grub bkod pa 'gro 'ong rnam 'gyur can:'di na gnyis su snang ba'i chos med pas:ma chen nga phyir bu khyod blo bral shog spros bral dbyings la kun rdzob mtshan ma'i dben:ye nas spros bral rdo rje'i go ra las:gdul bya 'dul byed dmigs su ma mchis pas:ma chen nga phyir bu khyod dgongs pa'i re ga:kun bzang dgongs pa mkha' ltar dag pa la kun tu mdzad pa'i gzugs sku rnam gnyis dben:ro snyoms blo bde'i ngang la cham bzhag ste:ma chen mkha' ru bu khyod ro gcig shog:zhes brjod rdo rje thog 'bebs lan gsum bsdab:sgo gsum ma bcos gshis thog shig ger bzhag:bskyed pa 'i yang rtse shes rab rdzogs pa 'i rim spros pa'i yang rtse spros bral rdzo gas pa 'i lam rtsol bcas lam brten rtsol med bden pa mthong gar gyi 'khrul 'khor brten pa' rlung log zhi rtsa drangs rlung

gnad thig le lasasu rung: nyi zla' nyams myong 'pho bsgrod nam mkhar thim nam mkha' rang bzhin zig le gcag tu 'byel sgo gsum mtshan ma dben cing thad shar grol 'od gsal bum sku kha sbyor bdun ldan tshul gang yang mi nub kun mkhyen mgon por gzim phyogs ris ma mnga' bde chen rgyal por gzigs phrin las mtha' yas nyi ma'i zer bzhin brdal yon tan bsam yas brjod byas mthasami dpog 'di la mos rnams bsod nams skal ba bzang nye lam phyag rgya bde ba'i 'byung gnas te blo chung rtog ges nyams 'og mi tshud pas zeg rtse 'bras bu' rgyal po 'di spyod rnams tshe lus gcig gi zung 'jug ye shes grub dga' spro dang bcas skal ldan 'dir 'jug 'tshal sa ma yu 'khrul 'khor nyer brgyad pa dang smon lam phan yon gyi mtha' brgyan dang bcasapa'o rgya rgya rgya ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha pa' ma 'ongs 'gro la shan tu thugs brtse bas mi mjed mun bsal sa gzhi zhabs kyisabacag sgrub gnas byin rlabs rin chen gter gyis gtam dus dang dus su phrin las ma nub pa ra 'byung ba'i smon lam gtad rgya lus bstan gnang 'di yang snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus yo rgyan rgyal tshab rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gang dang mdo khams gsham nas zab bcud 'phrad sprul pa 'i chos bdag rnams la gnyer gtad nas 'gro don phrin las byang nas byang du 'byung 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god the tshom med do rdo rje pad+ma'i bka' zab bcud srung

gtsasdo: shag spu gri mched gsum mo bka' log lag tu ma shor thub pa ra mdzod dam ldan thugs sras rnams la legs pa ra sprod bshad sgrub phrin las mtha' rgyas gzha tshugs shig sa ma rwa rgya rgya rgya dbang chen rol pa'i gsang lam bde stong gar gyi 'khrul 'khor gyi rim pa rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gas rgya gu h+ya mo rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lu zin chos kya bdag po sogs sprul rin po che pa d+ma bsod nams grub pa 'i rdo rjes bkra shis lha reg bde bar gshegs 'i sku gsung thugs rten ya mtshan can dang dri med ras gzan dkar po kha tshar ma nyams pa' skyes bzang po dang bcas te 'bad stsol drag pos bskul ngor kho bo rgya mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyis mdo khams ca ri ṭa'i gnas mdun nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang ban zab mo dag pa ra phab pa'i yi ge pa na chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga la/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi gsang lam la nye bar mkho ba'i gtum mo me yi dbang bskur zab mo bzhugs rberngo: a: na mo gu ru kro dha rā dza ya: 〉〉〉mi7)ོ ma bzad bde ba'i rang bzhin 'bar ba' sku dbang chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo skal ldan bde stong gas spyod bsgom pa la smin byedalas drug gtum mo' me dbang bstan sa ma yu de yang ltang lo mi tshil zhun gyis gtam skye med yi ges yi dab skur nas slob ma'i sgo gsum khrus kyas sbya sa bar bya bar chad gegs bskrad bsrung ba' ra gur phub maṇ+ḍalaphul la gsol ba gdab pa ni e yo kun mkhyen mgon po bde ba'i dbang phyug dgongs: ye shes phung po grub pa'i smin byed dbang: dam tshig phyag rgya gsal bar rab mthong ba'i bde chen brda yi dbang bskur stsal du gsol: lan gsum zhu de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis kye ho: tshur shog dam ldan rig pa 'dzin pa rnams: yang gsang lam la spro ba ngo mtshar che sbyor sgrol dang len 'khor ba'i skyon bral na: tshe gcig sangs rgyas dngos grub bdag gis sbyin de nas slob ma lha ru gsal ba ni sa mahā shu bye ta dh+wa na badz+ra swā bha wa ad+ma ko3nya: slob

ma'i phung khams skye mched thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las: las byang ltar du lha bskyed rgyas pa ra gtong ye shes dbab pa'i dmigs pa 'ad ltar bya de ltar rdo rje slob ma rnams dbang chen he ru ka rtsa gnas kyi lha dang bcas pa thams cad til gyi gong bu phyur ba ltar gsal ba'i: thugs gar 'od lnga'i dga' 'khyil g.yung drung gi mtshan pa can du gsal gdab de yi steng du dbang chen he ru ka yab yum tshon gang ba bde stong snyoms zhugs mdzad par gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang chen 'bar ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs thams cad sku phyag rgya gsung yig 'bru thugs phyag mtshan yon tan phrin las thams cad 'ja' 'od zig le'i rnam par bun lang lang byin 'thib thib byon nas ye shes sems dpa' la sib sib thim par dmigs de yi tshe dga' 'khyil gyi 'og gi rlung g.yos g.yung drung drag tu 'khor: ye shes sems dpa' yab yum gyis bro gar mdzad nas slob ma'i sgo gsum la byin chen pheb pa'i rtags mtshan rmad du byung ba zon par bsam la: nyu hrī bde stong spros bral zla gam

gtsa/: dbang gi dal: ma chags 'od gsal rab 'bar 1nga yangs nas: rgyal kun gsung gi dbag phyug he ru ga: pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug bshad pa rtsal: ma tram̐ rū tra 'dul ba'i brtul zhugs can khro bo'i rgyal po gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs pa: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren ye shes gzugs skur ngom: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur rtogs pa sbor:gnyis snang rū tra dbu ma'i dbyings su sgrol: chos zad blo bral rig pa 'i gzi byin phob: 3 pad+ma kro ta sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: dz+nyā na dhartu a we sha ya a ā: zhes thod rnga dkrol brdung bya ye shes pa nan du dbab de tshe slob ma'i sgo gsum la rtags khyad pa ra can 'char ro pheb pa 'i ye shes pa de nyid brten pa ra bya phyir tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod la me tog 'thor ro de nas ting sgron sbar te hū trī:mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba'i rang bzhin can: gnyis snang za byed phag mo'i rnam rol dal: gnyis med mnyam pa'i bde stong dam rdzas 'di: skal ldan slob ma khyod kyis dgyes par spod: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya stam: a nu rā go nya: a nu rā ga ya mi: gho dri tsitā spra ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa tram̐: zhes brjod la bde stong brtsal zhugs rol ba'i gsang sbod la

gnas bzhin du: zhal chos nyid mnyam pa'i klong du ting sgron bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du dmigs te rol bas ste bar dam tshig gi rten gtum mo ye shes kyi me'i rnam rol du bzhugs par dmigs la: byin rlabs ye shes kyi rlung gis bskul te gtum mo dam tshig gi me rab tu sbar nas gnas lnga'i mtshan 'dzin gyi bag chags bsregs sbyang byas te kun+da byang chub gyi sems dang reg pa 'phrod pas bdud rtsi mu tig dkar po'i rgyun char ltar dbab ste gnas lnga'i lha tshogs rnams mchod par bsam la: e ma ho ro mnyam rdo rje gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: ma brtsal rdzogs ldan rang byung grub pa'i lha: zhi khro rab 'byams rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i dal pho nya dam can til gong phyur bzhin rdzogs:gnas yul dur khrod he ru gar 'brel ba'i: sna tshogs rigs kyi dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma: rig sngags zhing skyes 'du ba'i dbang phyug rnams: zag med byang chub sems kyi sprin spel bas: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dgyes pa bskangs bde stong nyams dgar spyod pa'i brtul zhugs kyis: ched 'dzin rtsa yi mdud pa bag chags grol rtog bral ye

btsa/: shes gzigs pa nang nas rgyas: sbyang gzhi ma rig dri ma dbyings su sangs spyong byed bde stong rtog pa mkha' ltar rgyas: sbyang 'bras sa lam nyams rtogs rtsal rdzogs nas: kun tu 'od dang ma chags pad+ma can: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la byang chub pa'i dbang mchog dam pa khyod la thob par shog: snye mahā a nu rā ga a bhi ṣiñca a we sha ya 55 yi/: dbang srog dam tshag khas len zhi yon du sgo gsum ltos med 'bul shis pa brjod cang bden tshag gdab dge ba bsngo zhi smon lam 'debs des ni nyams rtog 'phe la zhang rgyas bde stong rtogs pa gegs med zhabru sa ma mā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ ba wa'i ma 'ong sa 'gro la lag par thugs brtse bas snying gi yang bcud rdo rje snying po'i skor grub pa 'i dbang phyug rgyal mtshag khyod la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstims mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs bra sdoms ma 'ongs snyags ma sum cu kha ral dus dpa' bo khyod sprul reg 'arin 'dusapa rtsal skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas 'gro don phrin las byang nas byang du 'byung 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god de bar bka' 'di srung sa mdzod spu gri gsum bka' kun ris chod mkhan la 'di ma shor dam ldan rdo rje'i bu mchog rnams la sprod bshad sgrub phrin las dar zhing rgyas gyur cig sa ma

yu rgya rgya rgya dab chen pad+ma rol ba'i gsang lam smin byed gtum mo' me dab zab mo rdzogs so gter rgyaḥ gtad rgya sngas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gubyu o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chenabazas bkod pa'o bdo thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zan chosakyi bdag po pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shis dge ba'i skyes phun sum tshogs pa du mar bcas te bskul ngor kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i gsangabarda zab mo las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyad kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/
bsgo/ zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: rta phag bde sbyor rol pa'i gsang lam:bde stong rlung gi rdzogs rim chings lnga pa bzhugs so:

bsgo/: na mo gu ru pad+ma kro dha rā dza ya: tha(6) / bde ba'i mthar son rdo rje rdul 'thar dang stong nyid gar dbang ye shes rtser phyan pa zung 'jug gar gyas gnyis snang 'byung po za he ru ka dpal mchog la phyag 'tshal lo ma rung snyigs ma'i smag rum 'thug po ru las can skal ba bzang po re mchis na de yi bgo skal myur lam zab khyad can bde stong rlung gi rdzogs rim bstan par bya sa ma yu g.yang phun sum tshogs pa'igazhi bzung gnad gnas kyi khyad par shin tu dben pa'i sa dur khrod g.ya' gangs rgyu 'grul bral ba la rig 'dzin gong masazhabs bcag byin rlabs pa'i bkra shis dge ba'i gnas su btsan sa zin yo byad bsam gtan bsgom gzhi 'bol stan ni gru bzhi khod snyoms drod ldan rdzasakyis phyur gar kyi 'khrul 'khor gzha rung go stan bkod rlung chas e rag rgyal mtshan dargyabs su byas sgom thag dkar khra khong stong lus tshad bya dra med ras gzan dkar po rgyan du 'chang drod can zas dang skom gyi bye brag brten spang bya sha can gos dang tsiṭa ka dri ro nus pa bsil ldan thams cad dang nyi ma me 'od thams cad spang bar bya slob ma'i mtshan nyid dad mos brtson 'grus che snying rus sdug sran bzod thub sngags la mos the tshom log lta chung zhing gas spyod spro nyams rtogs 'byu sla shes rab nyi ltar gsal grogs la brtse zhing byams sems yang dag ldan de lta bu la gsang lam bstan du rung bzang po'i 'gal zla nyes

brte( pa 'i skyon can la snod nga na bcud blugs rdo rje dmyal ba'i rgyu gnyis ka nyams pa'i mkha' 'gros bka' chad 'bebs spang blang dam tshig gzhung bzhin ldan par bya de ltar phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhi 'dzom tshe dkar phyogs skyong rnam dkar gyi gtor mas brngan na ga phyogs dregs pa dmar gyi gtor mas bska sa ma ru tsung po 'bras chan glud kyis brngan bka' la 'khu rnams ye she mtshon chas bskrad bsrung ba' gur khang 'gyur med rim brgyad phub ye shes dbang bskur byin chen nan du dbab bzang shang bdug la mnol bsangs la khrus bya de dag sngon du 'gro ba' rim pa'o sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya sman byed dbang gi sgo gsum byin brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor rigs byed skal bzang pho mo rnams bde ba' stan la bab phab legs par gnas rlung chas bgo bzhan rdo rje' chos bdun bca' de nas rtsa bskyed lha sku'i gsal snang ni ā garja nga dang 'dzin pas bsdus pa yi: 31sa kun dbu ma chen por zhig: lhun grub dag mnyam snang cha ni: khrag 'thung rol ba'i rten brten pa: bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus: ma chags pad+ma 'dab stong khar bsil ldan zla ba nya gang steng: 'od 'bar nyi ma rab bzhad khar rang rig ma bcos ye shes sku: pad+ma dbang chen dmar gsal mdzes: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi ma khro: dmar ser

ral gseb rta zhal bzhad: thod skam dbu brgyan cod pan 'phur: nyi ma zla ba'i snyan cha mdzes: rus rgyan dar dpyangs stag sham klubs: dwangs gsal sku yi 'od klong du: chos nyid mnyam pa'i dbu ma ni: drang srab snub gsal mtshan nyid rdzogs: dkar dmar mthing ga'i kha dog 'char: yar sne spyi bor tha ler har: mar sne gsang bar tshigs bcas 'gags: g.yas su ro ma longs spyod rdzogs: dmar gsal rā ga'i gzi 'od 'khyug: g.yon du rkyang sda sprul pa'i sku dkar gsal shel gyi sbu gu bzhin: mar sna dbu mar tshud bzhin du yar sne rna ltag gnyis las gug: sna bug gnyis su ha rer zug: nyon mongs dug lnga dug gsum dang: 'brel ba'i las rlung bag chags kun: rten med nam mkha'i dbyings su thim rtsa zubs skyon dang bral bar bsam: rlung ro lan dgur bsal bar bya bag chags lus kyi dri ma sbyangs sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gnyis pa bum chen 'dzin pa ni hūṃ: snying po dran pa'i lha skur shar: mdun mkhar dus gsum rgyal kun gyi byin rlabs bcud rdzogs ye shes rlung 'od lnga'i kha dog lhun rdzogs pa: na kun chen po 'azib bzhin gsal de las spos ring

badz+ra dud pa bzhin ro rkyang lam brgyud dbu mar zhugs: byin rlabs gzhi 'dzin thig ler bstem: snyigs ma rlung gi gzhi ru gcun: bag chags dri ma phyir bsal te: dbang gi bye da dang ldan par dmigs: sbyor ba bzhi ldan la bslab te khug pa brgya cu la sogs 'dzin gom dang bstan dang mthar phyin bar brtson 'grus drag pos bsten gyur na lus ngag yid kyi zag pa zad khams dang bag chags las rgyun grol bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad las rgyal stong phrag brgyad cu' bgegs mi nye grub pa brgyad la mnga' dbang 'byor 'di ya yon tan bsam mtha' yas rlung gi mthu las 'byung ba'o mnangag gnad kyi dwangs ma ste srog dang sprel nas nyams su longs sa ma yā chings dang po 'o rgya rgya rgya e ma bde chen dbang gi gar la phyag 'tshal lo: las can skal ba bzang po'i tshogs rdzogs phyir rang lus lha snang pad+ma dbang chen gsal: khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs dpal chas brgyan: dwangs gsal dbyings su rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga: chos nyid mnyam par gnas pa'idabu ma'o ye shes nyams su myong ba'i ro ma dang: rtog bral rjen par 'char ba'i rkyang ma'o: bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo mthing gsal la: 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis tshul du

gye ro 'dus 'khor lo sor rtog rang bzhin dmar: 'dab ma bcu drug bde ba'i dal du rdzogs: chos kyi 'khor lo dwangs zhing dkar ba yi: 'dab ma brgyad ldan tshorang grol dal: sprul ba'i 'khor lo ser gsal 'od 'bar ba'i: 'dab ma so gnyis mnyam pa'i dal du gnas bde skyong 'khor lo iṇ+ḍa'i kha dog can: 'dab ma drubargyad cu'o de las gyes pa rtsa phran sa ya 'bum: mdor na lus 'di rtsa yi pa drwa bzhin: bsgom tshe rdul bral 'od kyi sbug gu can de dag la brten bde ba'i bcom phra rags ma nges dga' bzhi'i rol rtsed can rgyal ba dgyes pa'i sprin mchod dag par gnas: gnas yul mkha' 'gro'i bsrung bya'i dam tshig ste: gnas dmazubaka' yi chad pas gcod: rtsal sbyangs mkhas na dga' ston nyams rtogs 'phel: de dag thabs su 'gro ba'i 'gyu ba ni: rtog pa'i bzhon gyur brgyad khri bzhi stong ngo:stong drug brgyar rgyu ba dang: bdun khri bdun stong shin tu phra ba'i tshul: 'gyu ba che chung rnam pa mtha' yas so: 'khor 'das gnyis su 'gro ba'i kha lo ba: dwangs snyig

badz+ra: 'byed pa'i thabs mkhas pa: ye shes sgog tu shar ba'i dam tshig can: 'di dag gnas g.yo bkod pa'i tshul can te: sku gsum lhun gyi grub pa'i dam tshig dal: gnad du smin pa'i rang gnas 'bras bu sad khams gsum yongs grol mdzad phrin bsam mtha' yas shin tu spro ba dang bcas 'jug par 'tshal: sa ma yā: mi bzad dbang gi sku la phyag 'tshal lo lam dus rnal 'byor bsgom rim 'di ltar bya: gong ltar lha snang rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga: ma 'dres dwangs ba'i tshul can gsal ba yi: bde chen 'khor lor che mchog he ru ga: khrag 'thung rigs lnga ko'u seng bcu drug dang dbang phyug nyer brgyad phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs ma 'dres gsal bar a nu'i bskyed rim bsgom ro 'dus 'khor lor brgyud gsum bla ma dang: paṇa grub rig 'dzin rgya mtsho sa ler gsal: chos kyi 'khor lor bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ni: zhi tshul dgu dang mdzes pa'i rgyan cha lugs: phyag 'tshan la sogs ma 'dres 'od skur gsal: sprul ba'i 'khor lor sku gsum mkha' 'gro da : rigs lnga'i ḍāk+ki 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro sogs: nyi rdul 'khrigs

bzhin bde stong nyams dgar spyod:rgyan dang cha lugs ma 'dres gsal bar bskyed:bde skyong 'khor lor skyes bu ging gsum dang dbyings kyi ma lnga dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs:snyim las ni zer bzhin ma 'dres gsal:kun gyi gnas gsum yig 'bru sa bon las:'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa:spyan drangs ro gcig bstem la 'di skad do:hūṃ hrī rngam brjed srin po'i thod btegs pa'i:dpal ri mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas:o rgyan pad+ma thod phreng rtsal:rdo rje ging chen tshogs dang bcas:gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol rten pa rtsa dang g.yo ba rlung bkod pa byang chub sems mchog la sku gsum ye shes byin chen phob g.yas phyogs 'phags yul paṇa grub dang g.yon ngos bod yul rje 'bangs tshogs:mdun ngos sprul ba'i gter ston bcas:bshad sgrub nyams rtogs bgro gleng 'ur:thugs dgongs ro mnyam dpal ri nas o rgyan pad+ma'i phrin las 'dir:skad cig spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:brten pa rtsa dang g.yo ba rlung:bkod pa byang chub sems mchog la:sku gsum ye shes byin chen phob sgrub sde brgyad kyi

'a tshu zab mdzod brnyes: sprul ba'i gu ru mtshan brgyad grags: rig 'dzin brgyad dang tha mi dad: 'phrul mtshan nyer lnga'i mdzad phrin can 'gro ba 'dul ba'i gu ru drug: ya mtshan rmad byung thugs rje can: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol brten pa rtsa dang g.yo ba rlung: bkod pa byang chub sems mchog la sku gsum ye shes byin chen phob: zla gam dbang chen e 1nga nas: rū tra 'dul ba'i dpa' rtags can: bde stong mchog sbyin rta phag gar ye shes sgyu 'phrul 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol brten pa rtsa dang g.yo ba rlung: bkod pa byang chub sems mchog la: sku gsum ye shes byin chen phob: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gling dbus nas bde sbyin rigs lnga'i dam rtags 'chang: ma tshogs sprul pa g.yog dang bcas: bde stong rtog brjod glu dbyangs 'ur: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol brten pa rtsa dang g.yo ba rlung: bkod pa byang chub sems mchog la: sku gsum ye shes byin chen phob: dam chig gnyan srung bka' sdod pa: skyel bu ging drug ma lnga yum: rig sngags zhing

skyes rnal 'byer la: kun kyang bde stong rol ston la: skad cig spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol brten pa rtsa dang g.yo ba dang bkod pa byang chub sems mchog la: sku gsum yeshes byin chen phob: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki ni bud+dha bho dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: dz+nyā na a we sha ya a ā rtsa gsum dam can sprin rab 'byams rgya mtshor kha char bab pa bgo ye shes nanadu dbab par bya sam yu chings gnyisapa'o rgya rgya rgya bde ba'i dpal sbyin mchog la 'dus: de nas 'bar 'dzag bsgom pa ni: byin rlabs ye shes rlung rngub ste: sbyor ba bzhi ldan brtul zhugs kyis gtum mo ye shes me bskul te: 'bar ba'i 'od kyi mtshan 'dzin bsregs: bde chen 'khor lo'i byang sems dal: thabs kyi rang bzhin bcom ldan 'das: shes rab yum dang reg 'phrod pas: ku byang chub sems bcud babs: bde chen 'khor lo kun khyab ste: khrag 'thung lha tshogs dgyes pa bskangs: lus dang rtsa yi sgrib tshogs dag bum pa'i dbang gis smin grol nas snang stong ye shes nyams su myong: dga' dang stong ba'i 'od gsal 'bar rnam smin rig 'dzin rten 'brel bsgrig: sprul sku'i skal ba rgyud

bsgotshu la bzhag de lta bu yi dmigs 'dun skyongs:slar yang bdud rtsi mar dbab ste:longs spyod 'khor lo kun la khyab:rig 'dzin lha tshogs dgyes pa bskangs:ngag dang rlung gi sgrib tshogs dag:gsang ba'i dbang gis smin grol nas:gsal stong ye shes nyams su myong:mchog dga' stong chen 'od gsal 'bar:tshe dbang rig 'dzin rten 'brel bsgrigs:longs spyod rdzogs sku'i skal ba bzhag:de lta bu yi dmigs 'dun skyongs:slar yang bdud rtse mar bab ste:chos kyi 'khor lo kun khyab nas zhi ba'i lha tshogs dgyes pa bskangs:yid dang thig le'i sgrib tshogs dag:shes rab dbang gis smin cing sgrol:bde stong ye shes nyams su myong:khyad dga' thams cad stong pamathong:phyag chen rig 'dzin rten 'brel bsgrig:chos sku'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag:yon tan yongs rdzogs thob pa yi dmigs 'dun yang dag skyong bar bya slar yang bdud rtsimar dbab ste:sprul ba'i 'khor lo yongs khyab nas:dbyings gsum mkha' 'gro'i dgyes pa bskangs:sgo gsum cha mnyam sgrib pa dag:tshig dbang zab mos smin grol nas

rig stong ye shes nyams su myong lhan skyes dga' dang shin tu stong: gnyis med mnyam pa'i 'od gsal 'bar: chen po'i rig 'dzin rten 'brel bsgrig: ngo bo nyid sku mngon du bya de lta bu yi dmigs 'dun skyongs: slar yang bdud rtsi mar 'bab ste: bde skyong 'khor lo kun khyab nas: pho nya dam can dgyes pa bskangs snang gsum dri ma dag par byas rig pa rtsal gyi dbang gis smin: spros bral ye shes nyams su myong zag med 'od gsal rtsal chen 'bar: lhun grub rig 'dzin rten 'brel bsgrig: mi 'gyur rdo rje mngon du bya:slar yang sku yidakyil 'khor ni: nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam pa la dkyil 'khor lha yang de lta bu: byin rlabs ye shes rlung gi gzis: byang chub sgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe'i bdud:mtshan 'dzin gnyis snang bag chags kun chos nyid stong pa'i dbyings su gtor: bde stong ye shes gtum mo mes: bar chad bdud bzhi dam sri'i rigs: bag chags las nyon mtshan ma kun: rab gsal ye shes dbyings su bsregs: bde stong zag med bdud rtsi yis: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing mchod cing: 'gro drug 'khrul ba'i bag chags sbyangs:

badz+ra: gnyis snang chos kyi dbyings su brdal slar yang sku yi dkyil 'khor ni: tshon gang tsam du mar bsdus te: gnas g.yo bkod pa lha tshogasakyang: sku dang bstun te phra bar gsal: slar yang yar spro mar bsdu ba'i: dmigs pa lan grangs du mar bskyar rig pa ye shes rtsal sbyong ngo: mthar ni brtan g.yo sku la bsdu sku nyid brten pa rtsa la bsdu 'khor lo sgog shing gsum du bsdu: rkyang ma ro ma nyid la bsdu: ro ma dbu ma'i dbyings su bsdu: dbu ma mtha' bral chen po ste: yod min med min spros las 'das: kun khyab gsal 'grib bral ba yi zang thal ye shes gcer phyung nas: ma bcos shar 17la rjen par skyongs: des ni mtshan ma'i bag chags stong mtshan ma med pa'i sku gsum 'grub ye shes gzigs tshul nub pa med 'gro don phrin las thogs pa bral yon tan bsam yas e ma ho sa ma ā chings gsum pa'o rgya rgya rgya mi bzad gar dgu'i dpal la 'dud shin tu dag pa'i rnal 'byor ba shes rab rnonapo'i rigs can gyis sngags kyi spyod pa byad pa'i tshe lus ngag yid kyi rtsal sbyangasani pad+ma dbang chen he ru ga: dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhi ma khro 'dzum drang sgong rnams dbu sgra dmar

ser rgya chings bsdam: gtsug rgyan rta mgo ljang sngon bzhad phyag gnyis spyi gtsug thal mo sbyar: zhabs kyi sor mo sa la gshibs: gru mo pus mo thad gar bskyong: dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rjer dmigs: ru lu rngam pa'i 'dul dbyangs ni: trī: skye ba med las thams cad skye skyes pa nyid na skye ba med: skye med don 'di rtogs pa na: mtshan ma'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal hi ba: 'gags pa med las thams cad 'gags: 'gags pa nyid na 'gags pa med 'gags med don 'di rtogs pa na gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i g.yul las rgyal:ho ya gnas pa med las thams cad gnas: gnas pa nyid na gnas pa med: gnas med don dam rtogs pa na: ma rig gsum gyi rgong rgya grol: he ru lu ru lu a nu rā ga sa ma ya ho bde stong rtogs pa rab bskyang nas: blo sems 'dzan pa thad gar gcod: shes rab ye shes me bo ches: srid pa'i grim bag chags bsregs: yang cig sgo gsum bog 'don no: lus ni dbang chen he ru gsal: ngag gis lta ba'i rgyang glu 'don: sems ni rig stong sor bzhag ste:hrī: gdod nas dag chen chos sku'i klong: nga

btsasdo: bdag mtshan ma'i spros pa bral ka dag dgongs pa zang thal 'di: rtogs na sangs rgyas nyag gcig go: ha he ru lu ru lu phaṭa: rdo rje'i gar ni seng ni: hrī: gdod nas 'od gsal lhun grub klong sna tshogs mtshan ma'i spros pa bral: nyag gcig dgongs pa dri med 'di: rtogs na longs spyod rdzogs sku'o: he ru lu ru sdotrī: gar ni glang chen 'gying thabs bya: hrī gdod nas rab gsal ye shes klong: sna tshogs blo yi spros pa bral: klong yangs ye shes rdul bral 'di: rtogs na sprul paḍi 11la: he garma ru lu na lu bh+yo: drang srong lta bu'i gar bsgyur ro sgo gsum snang ba mi dmigs sha ye shes thad shar mtho ba'i nyams rnal 'byor dam pa rnams la 'char sa ma yā yang cig spyon spyod skyongs ba ni gan skyal tshul du nyalaḥ ngag gis glu dbyang sa sna tshogs brjod sems ni ched 'dzin med par yan de nas thad gar skyongs bzhin du yis: sangs rgyas ma snye/sa sems can ga la srid: sems 'di thugados po ga la srid sems can ma spyos bag chags ga la srid: (rdo byed mkhan po sangs rgyas nyid la thug: phaṭa phaṭa: rtogs pa btsan thabs thad shar gcod hoḥ ka dag zhes

tshig tsam ma yin nam: ma dag rang mtshang khyod la bstan med dam: thams cad blo yi tshig tsam rjes 'brang ba'i: kun btags mtshang rjes 'brang ngo nyams chung ba: phaṭa phaṭa rtogapa btsan thab thad gar bzhag e: tha snyad 'di la zhen pa'ang med: sgro gtags kyang med: 'ja' tshon mkha' las ngom kyang mkha' ru yal ba dang 'dra'o: don dam 'di la zhes pa'ang med sgro gtags kyang med: nam mkha' nam mkhar 'dres pa'i tshul du rnam par dag pa'o: gang la'ang re ltos med par ro snyoms su 'jog pa ni: rnal 'byor rgyu bde mchog bdag gis :snan spyod ngos: bde stong nyams la ma zhen cang ye shes thad gar skyongs ba ni rnal 'byor rnal 'byor sbyor kun khyab kun bzang dgongs pa mthong sa ma mā chi sa bzhi pa'o rgya rgya rgya khrag 'thung he ru ka la 'dud rlung gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa' tshe spyi bor mkha' rlung mthing ka ni zur brgyad 'khor lo'i rnam pa can mgrin par me rlung dmar po ni zla gam dbang gi tshul du gnas snying gar chu rlung dkar po ni gong bu dri bral tshul du gnas ste bar sa rlung ser po ni zur bzhi'am ni zlum por gnas gsang bar rlung gi rlung ljang gsal dbyibs ni gzhu brdu lta bu'o gom tshe 'khor lo lnga ru gsal dang po sprul ba' 'khor lor gcun rgyu dus da bstun man

—41: ga na dbyar dus chu rlung gnad du bsnun dgun dus me rlu kha dog 'dzan dpyi da dus rlung gi rlung la gnas ston dus sa rlung nyid la 'bad rgyun tu nam mkha' rlung la brtson rab tu gom pa'i rtags tshad la nam mkha'i rlu rtags 'a 'a 'od dang thig le thig phran rnam par 'char chu rlung zin rtags dkar 'od dang zla zhal mthong ba'i nyams mched do sa rlu zin rtags gser thags gi drwa ba drwa phyed rnam par 'char me rlung zin rtags dmar 'od da mar me nyi 'od rnam pa 'char rlung ga rlung zin rtags su ni du ba rmag rgyu'i rnam par mched de dag rtags kyi rim pa 'o srogs rtsol rlung la 'phel 'grib kyis sgo gsum rdzogs zhing rtog pa btsan dga' sdug ma nges sprin ltar g.yo thams cad rdo rje gar gyis gcod bag chags mdud rgya rang sar grol dang po'i sa yi yon tan 'char rim bzhin bde stong rtogs pa da rnal 'byor rtsal sbyangs ting 'dzan gyis gnyas gnyis mdud grol spang rtogs kyi yon tan ma lus rab rgyas te bcu gcag kun tu 'od la sbyor ye shes chen po 'a rlu sbyor 'ad bskyed rim bsgom pa'i grogs su 'gro rjo gas rim gnad kyi sbyi chings yin 'od gsal bsgom pa'i man ngag srog nyams rtogs spel ba'i grogs lta bu sa lam brgal ba' shi rta che 'di brten yon tan bsam ma tha' yas phyag rgya chen po' dngos grub ni tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'grur the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' bslu ba med do gtan tshag

yin sa ma yu ris su smon lamagadab pa ni na mo gu ru /: rnal 'byor chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis: nam mkha'i 'khor lor gnad bsnun pas: gti mug rtog pa rnam dag nas: chos dbyings ye shes mngon gyur te: dga' dang stong pa mthar phyin nas: sangs rgyas kun gyi sku thob shog: 'gyur med bde mchog ting 'dzin gyis: longs spyod 'khor lor gnad bsnun pas: 'dod chags rtogs pa rang grol te: sor rtog ye shes mngon gyur nas: mchog dga' stong chen mthar phyin te: sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung thob shog spros bral kun khyabating 'dzin gyis: chos kyi 'khor lor gnad bsnun pas zhe sdang rtogs pa rang sar grol: me long ye shes mngon gyur te: khyad dga' thams cad stong pa mthong: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs thob shog: bde chen mnyam nyid ting 'dzin gyis: sprul pa'i 'khor lor gnad bsnun pas: nga rgyal rtog pa rang sar grol: mnyam nyid ye shes mngon gyur te shin tu dga' ba mthar phyin nas: sangs rgyas yon tan mchog thob shog: rol pa chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis: bde skyong 'khor lor gnad bsnun pas: phrag dog rtog pa rang

badz+ra: sar grol: bya grub ye shes mngon gyur te: dga' bral 'od gsal mthar phyin nas: sangs rgyas phrin las mthu thob shog: brten pa rtsa yidakyil 'khor la:bde ba chen por gnad bsnun pas: mtshan 'dzin spros pa ka dag ste: sprul pa'i sku ru smin grol shog: g.yo ba rlung gi dkyil 'khor la rang mtshan rgyu ba rnam dag phyir: gnad bzhi'i brtul zhugs mthar phyin te: longs spyod rdzogs skur smin grol shog: bkod pa byang chub sems nyid la: chags sogs rdul gyis ma gos par bde stong rtsal sbyang mtharaphyin te: chos kyi sku ru smin grol shog snang cha dpa' bo rta mgrin yab stong nyid gar dbang phag mo yum: zung 'jug sgyu ma ye shes dbyings: he ru ka dpal mngon gyur shog phun tshogs 'og min zhing khams su: kha sbyor bdun ldan ston pa yis: gsang sngags bshad sgrub gzhi bzung nas: 'od mdangs phyogs bcur khyab brdal ro/ga: dbyings las ma gasku sa gzugs kyi skus: gdangs kyi 'khor ba'i kha lo bsgyur: gsang chen sgron me'i 'od lam la: drangs nas sku gsum mngon gyur shog: de ltar smon lam rgya yis btab bde stong brtul

zhugs bsgom pa'i mthu yar ngos zla ltar rab rgyas te rig 'dzin bzhi yi gsang lam bsgrod don gnyis rmad byung lhun grub pa chos kyi rgyal po dam par 'gyur sa ma yā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'o shin tu brtse sems kyis thugs kyi thag le shin tu zab pa'i skor grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog dbyangs la gtad da lta spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas ran chen brda la bstims shig sa ra bye mdo khams bkra sha dgongasapra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus dpa 'a bo khyod sprul rig 'dzin 'dusapa rtsal gdul bya'i lhag ma skyongs phyir bzhe sa pa'i tshe skyes bu de dang gdamasapa 'di 'phrad nas 'gro don phrin la byadu rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god chos bdag rig 'dzin nyi zla lta bur 'tshogs gdul bya'i mun khams sel ba'i rten 'bres yod bka' 'di thub par srungs shig sbu gri gsum dam nyams lag tu ma shorargyal rtag tu mel rtse'i skyongs shig ging dmar nag chos bdag rig pa 'dzin pa'i phyag tu sprod bshad sgrub phran las dar zhing rgyas gyur cig sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya rdzogs rim gnad kyi me long mdo chings lnga pa rdzogs so gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gurgya o rgyan gyi mkhan po pad+ma 'byu — gnasakyi bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bza'i bkod pa'o brda zim ñcā zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin chos kyi bdag popad+ma bsod namasagrub

btsar+sha bkra shis lha reg bde bar gshegs 'i sku gsu thugs kyi rten ya mtshan can da dri me da ras gzan dkar ngo kha tshar ma nyams pa 'i skyes bcas 'bad rtsol lhur len gyis bskul ngor kho bo rgyal mcho bshad pa rtsal gyis mdo khams tsa ri tra' gnas mdun nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda zab mo dag par phab pa' ya ge pa na chos kyi bdag po nyid kyi bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lo/
badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyis:dbang chen sgrub pa'i lde'u mig yig chung gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so:

'a tshu na mo gu ru pad+ma kro dha rā dza he ru ka ya: rmā/tsho mig shunadza skothasgomim ma/ṇ+ḍi1 'bar ba'i gze byin lug pa'i ste ru ka gar dgu'i gas ོgas khro rgyal ོ ngas 'dus zhal dbang gi rgyal po khams gsum zil gnon la mthon mthing ral bas btud de phyag bgyi'o ma 'o sa las can skal bzang pho mo yis thar lam byang chub sgrub pa' rnal 'byor gyi bar chad gegs zha dngos grub mchog thob phyir zab lam dbang gi rnal 'byor 'dir 'jug bya sa ma yu rig 'dzin gong ma'i zhabs bcag byin brlabs pa dur khrod g.ya' gangs nags khrod dben gnas su skye bo'i rgyu 'grul glags tshol nyung ba'i sa nyi ma zla ba 'char snga nub 'phyi zhang ting 'dzin rgyud la rang shugs 'byung pa 'i sar phyin la sa bslang yul gzhi'i bdag po brngan nag phyogs gdug pa' rigs la dmar gtor sbyan bar chad bgegs tshogs 'bras chan glud gtor bsngo bsrung ba'i gur khang rim pa brgyad du phub sgrub gnas gsangs khrus bya zhing chag chags gdab phya nang gsang ba'i dam rgya legs par bsdam sa ma wā gang zhig rnal 'byor dam tshig lan pa rnams dbang gis sman cing sgo gsum las rung pa 'i 'tsho ba zas dang rkyen bzlog sman la sogs gsos sbyor sna tshogs phun sum tshogs par bya sa ma yu maṇ+ḍal mda' gang gru bzha khod snyoms pa ba byung dri bzang chu yis chags chags gdab rtsa gsum gtor ma bla rdo

gtsakhri srog 'khor dang brten gtor ril bu sgrub phur lha grangs bkod sman gtor rak+ta nyer spyod 'dod yon lnga dam rdzas sman dang bum pa sku tsaka dang me long thod cha shel rdo rig ma sogs sapa'i sgrub rdzas yo byad bsags shin tu spro phyir dal sogs mjes pa ra bkod sa ma yā demang sgrub pa po rnams gdan la gnas shar du zhal gyu rdo rje slob dpo na dang rdo rje rgyal theb las kyi gi ka ra rdo rje 'chagadong 'khrugs sogs gtso 'khor rim par gral bsgrigs legs pa ra 'khod phyi na brda dbye rdo rje spyan po sogs rnal 'byor pho mo dgyes pa 'i thabs la spyod sa ma yā deltar phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhi bzung ste lag bzhi yi gzhung bsreng ba lta ba'i rdzong 'dzan sgom pa' 'phra bsal te spyod pa' srog bsdams dran shes bag yod gnas snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos skur khyer gang shar rang grol dgongs pa bdag nyid skad cig gi gzhi las bzhengs pa'i dbang chen he ru ka dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug pa nam mkha'i dbyings su phyar zhing g.yon bhal brten pa: dur khrod dpal chas gyis sku la mjes par brgyan cing: dmar ser ral pa gyen du 'khyil ba'i khrod durta mgo ljang zhus bzhad skad hi hi sgrogs pas dreg

du bsdud cing dam la btag ste bgegs tshogs 'byung po zil gyis gnon par gsal gdab: zhabs rdo rje gyad thabs su bsgrad cing sku la me ri dang me dpung khro chung gi tsha tshwa'aphros pas bdud bgegs dam sri 'byung po sgrub pa po la nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad rang dbang med par dbang du bsdad cing tshar bcad par bsam mo: de nas srung 'bar dmigs pa ni bdag nyid dbang chen he ru gar gsal ba'i sku las khro chung me 'od mtshon cha'i char spros te: bdud bgegs dam sri /khyung po thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus pa las steng chosadabyings ye shes kyi rang gdangs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rwa gur: shar me long ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rdo rje sna tshogs pa'i gur khang: lho mnyam nyid ye shes kyi rang bzhin rin pochen 'od 'bar ba'i gur khangaḥ nub sor rtog ye shes kyi rnam rol rdul bral pad+ma dang dbyug to gri gug 'bar ba'i ra gur: byang bya grub ye shes kyi gar bsgyur rgya gram dang ralagri mtshon cha sna tshogs pa'i gur khang: de dag gi bar mtshams rnams su ye shes kyi me dang rab tu gtor byed kyi rlung: bag chags bkru ba'i chu 'byung po rtsad gcod kyi pho nya sdig

badz+ra: phag khyung seng khro chung grangs med pas gtam te 'byung po nye mi nus pa'i rang bzhin du gyur gur khang gi nang du bzlog byed kyi khro bo rnam kyi zhal phyir phyogs shing/laṭaX bh+yobazlog gi sgra 'brug stong dus gcig la ldir ba ltar sgrogs par dmigs: dedag gi nang du srung byed kyis khro mo rnams kyi zhal nang du phyogs cingahūṃ hūṃ dngaru lu'i sgra go ltar sgogs par gsal gdab: sru ba'i gur khang la dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs shing rab tu gnas par sgom mo: de nasabarda sgo dbye phyag na bdag cag sgrub pa po rnams ye nas sangs rgyas nyag gcig gi dkyil 'khor du bzhugs kyang: 'phral byung ma rig pas sgrib cing du ma so sor gzung ba'i bag chags kyi mdud rgyas sor rtogs rdo rje rnon pos rab tu bshigs te: bdag med mnyam pa nyid kyi dkyil 'khor ci bzhin pa gzigs pa la lta ba mja' ba'i phyag spros pa dang bralabar phul lo: de nas byin 'bebs ni dam ldan pho re rnams kyis dad pa dang mos gus gdung shugs tshad med pa bskyed pa'i mthus phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa yi dam

rgyud sde rgya mtsho: ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis ye shes gzigs pas dgongs te: skye med kyi dbyi sa las thabs bde ba chen po dbang chen rta yi brtul zhugs dang:shes rab stong pa nyid yum rdo rje phag mo'i rol gar du bzhengs te: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams kyi rol bar rtogs pa'i gzi byin phab cing: blo bral ye shes lnga'i dgongs rgyud kyi byin chen dbab par bsam mo:mjug tu dbang chen gsung gi lha tshogs sku phyag rgya: gsung yig 'bru: thugs phyag mtshan kyi rnam par bdag gnas rdzas yo byad rnams la thim pas la dang dkyil 'khor myong grol bdud rtsi dag mnyam ye shes kyi rol pa chen por smin cing grol bar bsam mo: mchod rdzas byan brlabs na bdag nyid he ru ga'i thugs ka nas 'od zer spros pa'i gzi byin gyis tshogs drug rang sar dag pa'i byi mchod: 'dzin pa ka nas dag cing 'dod yon ro mnyam du shar ba'i nang mchod bde chen ye shes kyi rol gar du ngom pa'i rdo rje'i rig ma bcu drug dga' bzhi'i nyams 'gyur dang bcas pa'i gsang mchod: kun khyab rol ba'i ltad mo kun bzang rgyan gyi mchod

badz+ra: sprin bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid nor sna la sogs yid 'ong gi dga' ston nam mkha'i mtha' klas par spro'o: bdud rtsi byin brlabs ni bdag nyed teru ga'ithugs ka nas yeḥram̐ kedīspros te mdun du bab pa las rlung me thod skyed kyi khar:āḥspros te yongs su gyur ba las ka pā la rgya khyon stong gsum dang mnyam pa gcig tu gsal gdab: yangadabang chen gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dbang gi lcags kyu'i dbyibs can 'phros te snod bcud brtan g.yo'i dpal yon dwangs bcud ma lus par bsdus te thod pa'inang du bskyil ba na sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin du bzhugs par bsam:de dag gi steng du/ sdeḥbla lāḥswā tshuX.e byeḥhā rta rnams kyi mtshan par gyur:kha chod rdo rje rgyagram gyi byas shing steng zla ba dang 'og nyi ma la ār+ya lnga bcu'i mtshan par gyur: kha chod kyi sgog shing rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyi rtsa ba dam rdzas la reg cing rtse mo steng du har ba gcig tugasal gdab:'og gi rlung me mtha' pas thod pa'i rgyed pu dros:sha lnga dang bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pa rnams zhu zhing khol: rigs lnga yab yum gyi sa bon las 'od

zer byung ste bag chags kyi mtshan 'dzin dri ma thams cad bkru sbyang byas: slar bdud rtsi las 'od zer spros srog shing gi sbu gu las byung ste rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing thams cadal khyab par spel te dgyes pa bskangs: dbang byin dngos grub thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par byung ste slar bdud rtsi la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs: de'i 'od zer gyis nyi zla'i kha chod ār+ya lnga bcu dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas rigs lnga yab yum gyi sa bon la thim: sa bon rnams kyang 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsi dang 'dres pas dam ye gnyis kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po dkar mer gyis 'khrul bar bsam mo: rak+ta byin brlabs ni bdag nyid he ru ga'i mdun du bhaji ka pā la phyi dkar nang dmar lcang lo khral khrol du gnas pa rgya che zhing khyon yangs ba'i nang du sbyar dang rang byung 'byung ba'i rak+ta thams cad gnas par byas te bdag nyid kyi thugs ka nas ram̐ḥye khaṃ spros te bag chags mtshan 'dzin gyi dri ma thams cad bsreg sbyangs bkrus la dam tshig gi rdzas skyon bral du bsam mo: de'i steng gi nam mkhar gīrti ma dmar mo chags

ston dmar ltem mer 'khyil ba la gīrti ma yang 'od du zhu nas gnyis med du 'dres par bsam mo gtor ma byin brlabs ni bdag nyid kyi mdun du thod pa skam rlon rnyid gardosgyed pur ka pā la stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du snod bcud 'bru sman thams cad phun sum tshogs pa las byung ba'i dpal gyi mchod sdong rgya khyon che bar gsal gdab:'og tu gser gyi tsakra rtsibs lnga la snyetshutshwa byetshwa gi mtshan par gyur: steng du dngul gyi tsakra rtsibs lnga ba la hū 37 swā ye hā'i mtshan par bsam mo: yas kyi tsakra las 'o/dkar pos spro bsdu byas te rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i dgyes pa bskangs shing dbang byin thams cad bsdus te dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor la bstim:mi cag las 'ong zer ngamar pos so bas bas nge ngar song 'khor ba'i saras zams cang song par mdzang cing nge ngas bi ngapal yor ngangs bcang tshe bsong rams zams ca

dmar gyi rnam par bsdus te dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor la bstem: gser gyi tsakra sa bon dang bcas pa ye shes kyi me'i rnam par gyur te gtor ma'i rdzas 'bar ba chen po'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs: dngul gyi tsakra sa bon dang bcas pa bdud rtsa mu tig dkar po'i rnam par gyur te gtor ma'i rdzas bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur: bde stong kha sbyor ba'i sbubs su gtor ma 'dod yon gyi phung po kun khyab rol ba'i dga' ston zag med ye shes kyi rang bzhin du dmigs so: de nas dam bca' bzu ba ni gdod ma nas dbang chen he ru ka shin tu phra ba'i dkyil 'khor ye rdzogs kyi tshul du bzhugs pa nyid deng lhag ger mthong bas nam yang mi gtong bar srog gi gta' ru 'dzin pa'i dam bcas bzung ngo:de nas bshags pa ni bsgrub gzhi sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khe ra la ye rdzogs su bzhugs kyang: bdag nyid gcig pus rgyu byas lhan skyes kyi rtogs pas rkyen byas kun tu brtags pas bdag gzhan tha dad du 'phos te: yul zhen gyi rtogs pas so thar dang 'gal bdag zhen gyi rtogs pas byang sems dang 'gal: ris chad du bzung bas gsang sngags

'amatshu dang 'gal ba'i sgrib pa phra rags ci song ba thams cad rig pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang chen he ru ga'i dgongs klong rdul bral me long g.ya' dag pa'i rang bzhin du bshags par 'gyi'o de nas bskyed rim la'i gsal sna ni nang 'dzin par byed pa'i sems dang phyi bzung bar byed pa'i yul gnyis mi dmigs pa ka dag nam mkha' lta bu'i dgongs pa'i dbyings su bag chags kyi mtshan ma dang bcas pa sbyang ngo: stong pa nyid de'i ngang las rig pa'i rang 'od nyi ma 'bum dus gcig la shar ba lta bu lhun grub 'od gsal gyi 'khor lor 'byams klas: dbyings rig gnyis med kyi rang mdangs bde mchog dwangs ma'i sras yi ge hūṃ dmar po sgog hrī sa mtshan pa can 'od dang 'od zer mtha' yas pa'i rang bzhin du 'bar bar gsal gdab: snying po de las yi ge e ༷gcig chad pa las 'byung ba nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dbyings yum chen mo dbyings phyug ma'i mkha' klong gzugs med kyi spros pa ka nas dag pa'i brdal khyab chen por gsal: rgyu'i yi ge las ye gcig chad pa las 'byung ba rlung rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'i dbyings

yum chen mo dam tshig sgrol ma'i mkha' klong bya ba 'du byed kyi spros pa ka nas dag cing mnyam nyid bde ba chen po brten pa'i gzhir gyur bar dmigs: de'i steng du rgyu yi yi gelas rāḥgacig spros pa las 'byung ba chu khams rnam par dag pa'i dbyingasayum chen mo ma mā zhi'i mkha' klong rnam shes kyi zhen 'dzin ka nas dag kyang bde ba chen po'i rang bzhinasnyoms brdal du bzhugs pa'i rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil zhing rba 1nga rab tu 'phyo bar gsal gdab: de'i steng du rgyu yi yi ge las suḥgacig spros pa las 'byung ba sa khams rnam paradag pa'i dbyingasayum chen mo sangs rgyas spyan ma'i mkha' klong mtshan 'dzin tshor ba'i spros pa ka nas dag cing 'khor 'das ro mnyam chen por rol ba'i brdar zhing chen gyi sagazhi ba spu rdo rje'i 'od zer 'phro ba chen por gsal gdab: de'i stebhe du rgyu yi yi ge las keX gcig spros pa las tshogs yul gyi mtshan ma ka nas dag pa'i dbyingasasku lnga yeshes kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i dal rus pa'i ri rab zur brgyad pa gcig tu gsal gdab: de dag gi mtshams rnams su rgyu yi yi ge las ram̐ gcig spros pa las 'byung ba me khams

badz+ra rnam par dag pa'i dbyings yum chen mo gos dkar mo'i mkha' slo 'du shes dang yid kyi spros pa ka nas dag cing rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi 'khor lo ma 'dres bde ba chen po'i dal bskyed pa'i gzhir gsal gdab: de dag gi steng du tshogs brgyad rnam par dag pa'i dur khrod brgyad ldan gyi bkod pa ma 'dres yongs su gsal ba'i dbus su rgyu yi yi ge las hūṃḥgacig spros pa las: rab brjid thod pa'i sku mkhar rgya che la khyon yangs ba rak+ta'i spyin thabs su sbyar zhing gnam lcags 'ur mos gzer gdab pa:nang klu chen brgyad kyis ka gdan bting zhing lha chen brgyad kyis ka ba byas shing gza' chen brgyad kyis gdung ma btegs pa steng rgyu skar kyis gral kheb bkram zhing nyi zlas bar tshag bsgrigs pa: zhing chen gyi bla bre zhing chung gi rda ri gan tsit+ta'i pho lto rgyu mi lda ldi: mig 'bras kyi drwa ba: lag pa'i mdo 'dzin glo mchin gyi 'phan yab byas par gsal gdab pa'i dbus su rin po che' khri rkang brgyad pa btegs pa'i gdan mi 'jigs seṅge dpa' rngam stag gtum mo dom bkra ba gzig dpa' bo dred brjid pa ma he 'jigs pa chu srin zhe

sdang sbrul rnams kyis yongs su mdzes shing 'deg pa'i khar ma chags chags med bde ba chen po'i ye shes sbyin pa'i zhu bde'i gdan pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldan du bkra ba'i dbus su srid pa'i bag chags kyi dri ma bkru zhing thugs rje bsil ba'i rgyun 'bebs pa'i zla ba nya gang ba'i gdan: de'i steng du mtshan 'dzan gyi dri ma bsregs shing ye shes rang 'od 'bar ba'i rmongs tshogs ma rig gcod pa'i nyi ma'i gdan rgya che bar gsal gdab: de'i steng du rang byung ye shes kyi dbyings las 'gags med rigs pa'i sa bon hūṃ dmar hrīḥyi mtshan pa can khra thabs su bab ste spro bsdus zhu ba las pad+ma dmar po gri gug gi mtshan pa gcig tu gyur: de las 'od zer yar 'phros 'phags pa mchod thugs rje byin rlabs bskul mar 'phros sems can gyi don byas bsod nams dpal yon dwangs bcud gcig tu dril te yongs su gyur ba lasacan badz+ra pad+ma kro ta h+ya shrī wa ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa:zhes brjod pas bdag mdun dpal chen po pad+ma he ru ka dbang chen stobs kyi rgyal po sku mdog dmar nag dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad pa: g.yas zhal gsum chos sku'i don rtags

ga rte mthing ga spyan gsum gsum dmar zlum sdang mig tu g.yo ba:dbus zhal gsum longs sku'i don rtags dmar nag khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa g.yon zhal gsum sprul sku'i don rtags ljang ser dkar ba khro 'dzum sgeg bzhad kyi nyams dang ldan pa:kun kyang zhal rnams rab tu gdengs shing ljags glog dmar ltar 'dril ba:rno dkar gyi mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs shing:shangs nas chos nyid stongs pa'i glu dbyangs hūṃ sgra 'brug ltar ldir ba sma ra ser po las me 'bar zhing smin ma dmar ser las slog 'od 'khyug pa:spyan rnams rab tu bsgrad cing sdang mig khyug khyug tu gzigs pa:thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan la rin po che'i rtse phran 'od 'bar ba dang ldan pa:dar sna lnga yi cod paṇa bcings shing nyi ma dang zla ba'i snyan cha byas pa:dmar ser ral pa dbyings su 'khyil zhing sgra gseb tu rta mgo dmar gsal rdo rje bzhad pa'i glu dbyangs hi hi 'brug ltar sgrogs pa rngog ma le brgan me ltar 'bar zhing rdo rje'i tsha tshwa 'phro ba'o g.yas zhal gyi gtsug rgyan rdo rje phyed pa las byas shing g.yon zhal gyi gtsug rgyan rin chen 'od

'bar ba dbang gi rgyal po la byas pa'o:rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje'i yu ba byas pa'i gri gug dang bhan+ta lcang lo can khrag gis bkang ba bsnol thabs su 'dzin pa:g.yas 'og phyagabargyad kyis nyon mongs rgyun gcod ral gri:'byung po brdung byed kyi dbyug to:ging laṅka 'gyed pa'i thod dbyug:dam sri gtubs byed kyi spu gri:dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'ikha ṭ+wāṃ ga bde mchog thabs kyi mtshon cha rdo rje:gang 'dul gyi phrin las stsol ba'i bum pa thugs rjes 'gro khams skyongs ba'i me dpung 'dzin pa'o:g.yon 'og phyag brgyadakyis dpa' bo 'bod pa'i rnge'u chung:dam can bskul ba'i zhing dbyug log rtogs 'ching byed kyi sbrul zhags mtshan 'dzin bcom pa'i tho lum:'thar byed rdo rje'i gtun bu chos dbyings byang chub sems kyi don ston pa'i dril bu sna tshogs thabs la mkhas pa'i rdo rje rgya gram thugs rje sbyor sgol gyi las la myur ba'i lcags sdig nag po'i mgul nas bsdam pa'o:dpal chen po dbang chen he ru ga'i dpral bar thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod cing mkhur tshos la khrag thig byug cing 'ol sko la zhag gi zo ris bkra ba'o:nyon mongs zhe

gtsaji sdang ma spang rgyan du shar ba'i stag lngags rlon pa'i sham thabs 'dod chags ma spangs rgyan du shar ba'i mi lpags g.yang gzhi'i sked chings:rgyan du shar ba'i glang kos stod g.yog: gti mug ma spang rgyan du shar ba'i klu gdol ba nag po'i do shal kun rtogs brgyad cu gnas su dag pa'i brda rtags mi pa brgyad cu'i phreng ba se ral khar byas pa: thugs rje 'gro ba'i yul thogs med du bsgrod pa'i rdo rje dang rin po che'i gshog pa gdengs ba: phar phyin drug gis gapa'i brdar rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras shing: phrag dog ka nas dag cing bya ba lhun gyis grub pa'i brdar dar lja sngon gyi dpyangs pa 'phur ba: gzung 'dzin ma ma bsregs phyir ye shes kyi me lnga kun nas 'bar zhing rab tu 'phro ba'o: dpal chen po he ru ga'i pang du dgyes bskyed rdo rje phag mo zhal gsum phyag drug pa: ga/ba g.yon zhal dmar ba dbus zhal mthing gsal rab tu rngam pa: dmar la zlum pa' spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dral ba:rno

bzhi bzhi gtsigs shing:smin ma las me yi tsha tshwa 'phro zhing ral pa dmar ser du 'khyil ba:skra gsebs nas phag zhal ngur zhing khams gsum gyi 'gro ba ma rig pa'i gnyid las skrog par mdzad pa:rus pa'i rgyan drug dang mgo phreng gzigs sham sbrul chun dar gyi dpyangs pa 'phur ba'o:thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang dar sna'i cod pan rin po che'i snyan cha mdzes par bkra ba:phyag g.yas gri gug 'dzan cing yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa:lhag ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang spu gri 'dzin pa:g.yon gyis bhan dmar yab kyi zhal la stobs shing lhag ma gnyis kyis dril bu dang sri bdud kyi snying zhags 'dzin pa'o zhabs g.yon yab kyi sked la 'khyud cing g.yas pas 'khor ba'i sgo 'phar gnon pa:mkha' gsang rdo rje dang pad+mo mnyam par sbyor bas rgyal ba mchod cing 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'o:yab dbang chen he ru ga'i zhabs g.yas gnyis kyis phung po'i bdud dang lha'i bu bdud kha sbubs su gnon pa zhabs g.yon gnyis kyis nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang 'chi bdag gi bdud gan rkyal du gnon pa:sku sgeg brjid dpa' rngam 'jigs su ru ba:gsung rgod gshe drag

ba tshu shul bshad glu sgrogs pa: thugs snying rje rngam dang zhi tshul ldan pa: rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa chos sku dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor rol ba 'gags med du gzigs pa'i longs sku 'od gsal ba'i 'khor lo: thugs rje gzhan phan phrin las kyis phyug pa'i sprul sku gang 'dul rgyan cha lugs phyag mtshan ma 'dres yongs su gsal bar bskyed do: dpal chen po dbang chen he ru ka yab yum gyis bde ba'i sgra hū hū dang ru lu zhes sgrogs pas phrin las 'khor gyi rnams rol ngom pa ni: shar phyogs su rū tra pho mo bsgol ba'i khar rdo rje rta mgrin sku mdog dkar dmar mthing ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas gsum gri gug tho ba zhags pa 'dzin pa: g.yon gsum bhan dmar rnge'u chung rgyu zhags bsdam pa: khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams kyis 'byud cing yum rdo rje phag mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba: lho phyogs su dam sri pho mo bsnol ba'i khar rat+na rta mgrin sku mdog ser sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas gsum be con dgra sta kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin pa: g.yon gsum bhan dmar phur bu sbrul zhags bsdams pa dur khrod

dpal chas sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing yum rin chen phag mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba: nub phyogs su dgra bgegs pho mo bsnol ba'i khar pad+ma rta mgrin sku mdog dmar ser mthing ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas gsum lcags kyu spu gri kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin pa: g.yon gsum bhan dmar me long dril bu bsnams pa: khro tshul gar dgu'i nyams kyis 'khyud cing yum pad+ma phag mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par spyor ba: byang phyogs su rgyal bsen bsnol ba'i khar garma rta mgrin sku mdog ljang ser dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas gsum rgya gram ral gri rdo rje 'dzin pa g.yon gsum bhan dmar spu gri phur bu bsnams pa gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs shing dur khrod dpal chas kyis brgyan pa yum garma phag mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par spyor ba: kun kyang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum bsgrad cing zhal gdengs ljags 'dril rno dbal gyi mche ba gcigs shing: thod skam gyi dbu brgyan dar sna'i cod pan: rin po che'i snyan cha rus pa'i rgyan drug dur khrod dpal chas mdzes par spras pa'o: yab rnams kyi dbu gtsug tu rta

ba tshu zhal rigs bzhi bzhad cing: yum rnams kyi skra gseb tu phag zhal rnam bzhi ngur ba: bde ba chen po'i rol rtsed bsgyur zhing mnyam par sbyozasgrogs pa ye shes kyi me ri dang me dpung rab tu 'bar zhing 'phro ba'i slong du zhabs rnams gyad thabs su bsgrad pa'i tshul can du bskyed do: de'i phyi rol du dbang cheyum byi thugs srog hūṃ gis spro bsdu las:shar phyogs su dri za zil gnon gyi che nge dkar gsal zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad pa: g.yas mthing gaphya gdengs ljags 'dril rno dbal gyi mche ba gcigs pa phyag drug bar bas gri shul dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o:shar stod du dregs pazel garten gyi khro bo mthingadakar g.yon dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad pa: phyag drug bar ba gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o: lho phyogs su gshin rjedze+el ser nag g.yas ljang g.yon dkar zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad pa: phyag drug bar ba gnyis kyis dgra sta dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o:nub byedas su chu
