badz+ra pa: gshog drug rang chas 'phur rtsal ldan pa yi: phrin las stobs 'byor rgyal mtshan ming can te: bstan pa rin chen btegs pa'i snying nor yin rgyal sras 'dzum pa'i ge sar las byung ba'i: dug lnga rgyan spyod sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ba: mkha' lding dpe bzhin 'phur rtsal ldan pa yi: praṅge'i ming can yon tan mthu 'dzom pa: bstan pa rin chen 'dzin pa'i snying nor yin: mtsho rgyal 'dzum pa'i ge sar bzhad pa yi: gshog rtsal rmad byung 'phur stobs ldan pa yi: sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gzhi ka yi ming: bstan parin chen gsal byed dam pa te: gzhan don phan bde rgya cher spel bar 'gyur: gnas la nges med las 'phros dbang gis bskul: yul la 'jug pa'i phrin las stobs ldan pa gdul bya'i zhing bcas yongs su 'byung bar 'gyur: ma nges brda gsal shel gyi le long las: bu la rgyang sgrags 'od khyim zhin pa bstan: gurgya yinanam dug gorgya mcho chen po'akhyil ba'i klong: sna tshogs dug rnams brgyan du spyod pa yi: sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dam tshig dag pa yi rma bya lta bu'i bu chen bco lnga 'byung: gser la g.ya' yis ma 'byud pa'i

rnal 'byor bde ba'i ming can 'byung dung la 'bu yis ma zhugs pa'i:rnal 'byor tsakra'i ming can 'byung:mkhar rgong srin gyis ma zos pa'i:rnal 'byor dpal 'byung bya ba 'dzom:lcags la btsa' yi ma bslad pa'i:rnal 'byor bde rgyal bya ba 'byung:chab la snyog gis ma bslad pa:rnal 'byor garma'i ming can 'byung:shing la stu ris ma reg pa'i rnal 'byor sur+ya'i ming can 'byung mkha' la sprin gyis ma bslad pa rnal 'byor zla ba'i ming can 'byung:skar tshogs gza' yis ma zin pa:rnal 'byor don grub ming can 'byung ngang mo'i kha dog ma lad pa:rnal 'byor bkra shis rgya mtsho 'byung lcags kyu'i rno ngar ma nyams pa:rnal 'byor 'dul gyi ming can 'byung:zhags pa'i 'ching rgya ma bul ba'i:rnal 'byor dkon mchog ming can 'byung:padro'i 'dab ma ma nyams pa:rnal 'byor mthong ba'i ming can 'byung:tsan+tan bsil khyim ma ral ba:rnal 'byor kun dga'i ming can 'byung:shes rab ral gri 'od 'bar ba rnal 'byor 'jam dpal ming can 'byung:rin chen spar bu bcud ldan pa:rnal 'byor grags rgyal ming can 'byung:sna

badz+ra: tshogs dug gi bye brag kun: brgyan du spyod cing 'od 'bar ba: gang gi skyon gyis ma reg pa nyi zla skar tshogs 'dra ba'i dpal: bstan pa 'di yi gzhi ru'abyung: ma ngas brda gsal shel gyi me long las: bu la rgyang sgrags 'od khyim lnga pa bstan: gurgya: tso nam: kar (debabashar ba'i yul la: dus kyi 'jug pa ma yin: tsan+tanabasil khyim ldan pa kun gyi thun mong ma yin : pad+ma rā ga'i mda' gzhu: yongs la dbang bar mi 'gyur: rin chen shel gyi sgron me: gangs seng khrod la mdzes ya: be+eḍūr+ya yibum pa: 'phyong rtsal ldan pa'i spyi nor: g.yu yi bsgrang phreng brgya tshar rma bya'i mgul bar mdzes lags: nor bu rin chen dam pa: lha sman phyag mtshan mdzes skad: stobs kyiglang po rin chen: badz+ra pa ṇis gzhir gyur: rdzu 'phrul cang shes rgyu rtsal: rgyal mo'i 'dabs su 'byor srid: nai tso'i mgrin glu snyan pa: bkra shis pad mtshor legs dngar: bkrashis chos dung dkar po: 'gyuramad mos gus rgya mtshos: phyogs nas phyogs su sgrogs 'gro: la gzhi pad+ma 'dab brgyad: bsod nams rgya mtsho'i gzhir grub: shel gyi mchod

sdong mdzes pa: rdo dza'i skyabs kyi dam pa: shes rab ral gri 'od 'bar: 'jug yul garma kerte: bde ba'i bza' btung longs spyod: pad+ma'i yul la nges spro: rin chen rdobacud ldan: bzang po'i dpal du e ma: 'tsho byed bdud rtsi dwangs ma byang nas byang gi yol gor: rtag tu 'phel zhing rgyas 'gro: rta bdun dbang po'i lang tsho: shar nas 4bshad skad: sman gyi lha gzhi mdzes ma: lho nas lho ru gar bsgyur: dngul dkar dril bu gsung snyan skal bzang tshogs la legs gsal rin chen dpal gyi mdzod khang gsum 'phrod kyi mdzes pa: rang skal gdul bya'i dpal mtshor: rtag tu bkra ba e nam ma nges brda gsal shel gyi me long las: bu la rgyang grags 'od khyim drug pa ngagurgya: e nam: mkha' lding mkha' la lding ba'i dus tshigs la: rgyang grags dkar mo byang gi phyogs su 'bud: yal ga'i ri dwags gnam la lding ba'i tshe: gser rjegasum sgra sgrogs nub phyogs sbir: tasbu ra yi dbyangs snyan yid 'gugs pa: ngur ldan rgyal khams nyul tshe dbang la sgrogs: lce spyang sha zan gos sngon grags pa 'byung:

badz+ra: ser po'i tshe na gshed du brgyur: rin chen gling bu'i sgra snyan byang phyogs 'bud: stod nas dkar po'i 'gron po lnga byung tshe: rta mchog rol paligasang lam de ru 'gyed: byang nas dmar po lnga yi mgron sleb tshe: le brgan me dpung 'bar ba'i rgyud sde sbyin: lho nas khra bo can gyi sde lnga 'byung: de la rta mchog bskyed rdzogs gsang gnad bshad: lho mon 'dzum ldan gnyis 'gros 'byung ba'i tshe: zab lam phag mo' don khrid gsal bar byed: chos nyid lta ba'i mgur dbyangs zab mo ni: sbas pa'i rnal 'byor 'chol bo 'byung tshe gsal: sgrub pa zab mo brgya phrag 'dzug pa ni: da nas nges par gar 'byung gang legs bya: btsan po'i mi grags dug gi g.yo ma can: de yi gnas su ma yina.a tham rgya ri spyang khyi la gnas pa'i blo stobs can: gang gis bskul tshe ma yin dam tshig rgya: na bun 'tshubs pa'i khrod kyi bsod nams can: de yi lcags kyus bskul kyang dmargyas bzhugs: dbang sngon 'dabs ma'i rlung gis bskyod pa'i tshe: dmar po' ri la rtag tu g.yo med bzhugs: zla ba'i phyogs kyis pad mtsho'i ze'u 'brus bskul: bdud rtse'i

zil dngar thabs mkhas des dbab na rang gzhan phan pa'i lo 'bras 'phel rgyas 'gyur: sa cha gnas la nges pa tshad bzung dka': don gyi dgongs nyams spro ba'i sgrub gnas su: sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug pa'i skal ldan na: nyi zla mkha' la gsal zhing rtogs rtsal rgyas: don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung ngo gtan tshigs yin: ma nges brda gsal shel gyi me ma nga las: bu la rgyang grags 'od khyim bdun pa bstan: gurgya ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la thugs rje rjes chags pas thugs kyi thag le zab gsang snying po' chos grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da du spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas ran chen brda la thob cig sar bye mdo khams bkra shas rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs mar nad mtshon gzengs lang tshe dpa' bo khyod nyid bshad pa rtsal du 'gyur skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas bstan pa ran chen bya gi phyogs su spel 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god bsru ba med do pad+ma rgyal po' bka' zab chos srungs shig btsan rgod yang le ber dam nyams lag tu ma shor thub par bsrungs thugs sras rigs pa 'dzan pa'i dpal du sprod sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gsang ba'i gtam rgyang grags 'od khyam bdun pa rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang

gtsa/: rgya gurgya o rgyan gyis slo ba dngo na pa d+ma 'byu— gnas kyi bka' bdag 'dra mkhar pho bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi mar bcas te nan tan chen pos bskul ngor/7khopo dbang chen gsung gi rdo rje rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal gyas mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda lalegs 'phel/sabo ma le/
pa( zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:ma chog mkha' 'gro'i gsang gtam nyi zla phra bkod zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

ba tshu narmo gu ru padh+war ye dza)tsha tsamatsho steng nam mkha' sdeng ga bsil khyam du stag khra bo' lce mgo nub tu bskyangs glang ngar ma'i rwa rtse lho ru bsgyur bya khu byug gsung snyan byang nas ngoms 'ja' 'od kyi drwa gur 'khrigs pa'i klong ma lha mo dar dkar na bza' can rje pad+ma'i phran las gang de yis mi bdag la brda tshag 'di ltar gtams ye ma: pad+ma'i zab gter yid bzhin rin po che: dper na dug sbul mgo yi nor bu 'dra: thabs la mkhas pa'i dbul phongs rgud pa sel rten 'brel nyes na rin chen sgog dang bral: zab mo'i chos gter spyod la thabs mkhas mdzod pad+ma'i phrin las gdul byas bskul ba ni: nam zlas bskul ba'i rtsi thog rgyas pa bzhin: las 'phro u rgyan gter kyang de dang 'dra: 'jam rtsub lha 'dres cho 'phrul sna tshogs 'byung gang yang dgongs pa'i dbyings su dam rgyas thob: ngom pa snga na mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'ong: dang por rang gis sgrub pa rtags thon gyis: 'jig rten mi rnams cho rig rgod skyon gyis: blo gtad khel ba su yang mi 'byung bas: dper na ri mgo gang mtho'i nyi ma 'dra: su dang lta spyod mi bstun rang tshugs 'dzin: mang gseb chang ma 'thung la spyor ma

badz+ra 'jug: gdong lnga grong 'dabs spyos pa nyams re thag rgyal tshab chang gis myos pa de dang 'dra dkor gyis ma bslu sgrub pa rem la gyis: 'jig rten sgyu mar g.yeng na zog po yin: sa cha ga 'dug gnas la nges pa med stag mos ri sul 'grim bzhin nges med mdzod bud mid bya blo shes rtog cho rig rgod: gang yang phrin las bsgrub pa'i grogs tsam las: nye ma drag la snying yang gtug ma che chos brgyad bya ba rtsa mgo'i zil ba 'dra: zin dang grub pa med pas cham gyis zhog: togasapa mtho yang rgyu 'bras zhib rgya bskyed: chos brgyud legs par 'byung ba'i don gtam yin: rang bzhin lung gis bstan pa'i gnas rnams su: bsnyen sgrub bsags spel dgos nges dam tshig yin: dusal ma bab mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan 'di spel rgya che na rang gi srog la 'bab: pad+ma'i phrin las ci 'byung ci lcogs byos: sems can mgu ma nus yang ci bya zad: 'di phyi'i re ltos o rgyan rje la bcol: baspu ba gang yang med do dam tshig yin: yar mar tshogasabasagasadus mchod skyon bral gyis: nyams rtogs brin las rgyas pa'i thabs su 'gro: bstan

pa'i dgra sde brlag pa'i las la brtson:chos kyi che ba bskyed phyir drag sngags sgrubs:dge 'dun dkor ma 'bag la sgrub gnas nyul:ma bcos gsum 3 don rtags rgyan du 'chong:thol byung spyod pa brtul zhugs gang byung bya:lta ba'i rol rtsed sgom pa'i bog 'don ni:rkyen dang sprod la thugs 'phrad rjes med kyis:mkha' 'gro'i brda mardzod rigapa'i ring bsrel ni:rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs brgyud byin rlabs can:rig 'dzin yongs kyi rig pa'i brgyud tshul can:rten 'brel tsam du snyan rgyud brda thabs sogs brgyud pa gsum gyi byin rlabs cig rdzogs pa rang byung ga ga ma brda yi sgrom bu las:shes nyams yid dpyod las 'das shog ser ngor:chu bo drug gi brda ris 'gags med pa:shes rab phra ba'i phyag rgya'i lde'u mig gis:ye shesayongasasu gsal ba'i chos mdzod 'di:rin chen nang nas bsam 'phel dbang rgyal 'dra:skar tshogs khyu nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mtshungs:dper na gangs seng dkar po'i 'o ma bzhin rno nus byin bcud yon tan thob dbang gis:rin chen gser gyi snod las gzhan du min:de bzhin ma dang mkha'

ba 'tshu 'gro'i brda mdzod 'di:the tshom log lta shes chung mos gus can:dad pa dam tshig gtsang la ya mtshan 'bar:chu snod dwangs na snyog ma can la 'od mdangs tsam las med:pad+ma'iphrin las tshechung mi dmigs kyang:gdul bya'i dbang gi phrin las du mar 'byung:nyi ma'i snyingakyang glo bur sprin gyis sgrib dang ma sgrib khyad:lagazhodon gyisangs rgyas bla ma'i zhal:gol sgrib dug lnga'i spros pa mi dmigs kyang gdul bya snang ba ris chad shes ngor log par mthong:rgyalatshabarig 'ardzan pad+ma'i thugs rje'i mdangs:skye dang 'chi ba'i spros pa mi dmigs kyang:gdul byabyed kyang:tshul mthun rten 'brel tsam du ma 'gags pa:zhing ri'i phrin las zhing rer 'jug pa ni:nyi zla gnyis kyis gling bzhi bskor ba bzhin:mnga' bar:yul gru re la 'char nub rten 'brel tsam nyi zla skar gsum dus gcig 'char ba dang:re 'ga' phyogs rer 'char ba'i rnam pa can:

rten 'brel ma : 31 rgyan sprul ba'i zhing khams bye phrag brgyar: pad+ma 'byung gnas bye ba phrag brgyas skyobs yang sprul zhing khams nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam la: gu ru'i sprul ba'i grangs kyang de 'dra'o: mdzad pa phrin las che chung ma nges par: rnam thar bsam mi khyab pa'i tshul du 'byung don te phyogs dang ris su ma chad par: nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor por shes par gyis: e ma u rgyan chen po'i pha nor zab gter la: phyi nang gsang ba dbye ba'i bco brgyad do: de yang spyi don rnam pa lnga lnga'i bstan gter gyi ngo bo chos nyid nam mkha' mdzod gter gyi rang bzhin zad pa med pa'i sgo: gter gyi phrin las yongs la 'jug pa can: gter gyi rnam pa chu bo bdun du 'dus: gter gyi yon tan bka' las khyad par 'phags: gter rgya mchog gi ston pa phun tshogs te: gu ru'i sku gsung thugs yon phrin las lngas gang yang rung ba'i mdzad pa dus bab pa: gtad rgya zab mo chos gter rin po che: man ngag kun 'dus yon tan kun tshang ba theg dman kun gyi phyogs su ma chad pa zeg chen kun gyi rtse mo phul phyin pa'i: yang zab yid bzhin nor bu lta

bsgotshu bu'o: sbas rgya phyi nang rnam pa gnyis su'o: phyi ni 'byung ba'i khams la sbas pa'i gter: sa cha dus tshigs rten 'brel bkod pa can: nang gi sbas rgya gnyu ga ma'i brda mdzod de: 'pho dang 'gyur ba mi mnga' de bzhin nyid: dus la bab tshe phrin las 'gags med pa gdul bya'i khams dbang yongs la 'jug pa'o: zab rgya dam tshig can gyi srung ma ni: phyi ru 'byung ba lnga yis drod 'dzin pa: spu gri mched gsum ma gza' gnyis dang lnga: nang gi drod 'dzin ye shes lnga yi gsang: mkha' 'gro sde lnga 'bum phrag 'ub chub pa: gsang rgya ye shes gsal ba'i lde'u mig ni: phyi rgya 'byed pa rigs lnga'i dam rtags 'dzin: nang rgya 'byed pa bde ba chen po'i zhal: gsang rgya grol ba ga ga ma'i ye shes zhal rtag gsum tshogs pa'i don rnam phun sum tshogs: e ma dbang chen pad+ma gsung mchog rol ba'i rgyud: 'gros dgu rta yi brtul zhugs kun tshang ba: rtsa gsum yongs kyi byin rlabs bcud rdzogs pa: gdul bya tshe gcig rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i lam: sa lam rim pa ma lus kun tshang ba: yon tan kun 'byung yid bzhin nor bu bzhin: phun sum tshogs

pa'i chos 'di 'dzin pa'o:u rgyan gsung gi rdo rje pad+ma'i rigs rgyal ba mchog dbyangs mi yi blos gar 'dzin:pad+ma 'bum sprin 'byil ba'i rdo rje 'byung:bka' 'di'i phyi rgya tsa ritra nas 'byed:nang rgya gnyug ma'i klong du gab pa bkrol:bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin phrin las 'byed mdzad pa'i:rigs kyi myu gu be+e ro'i dngos snang gar:dkon mchog 'byung gnasagayu sgra'i gar du gsal ska ba dpal brtsegs sngags kyi rnal 'byor ba:pad+ma'i rigs can ming gi cod pan 'chang:ldan ma rtse mang sngags kyi rnal 'byor ba dam tshig dag cing mos gus mchog thob 'byung:a tsar swā le sngags kyi dbang phyug pa:dh+wa dza'i ming can shes rab thogs pa med:dpal gyi rdo rje sngags spyod rnal 'byor ba:dpa' bo'i rigs su gtogs pa'i phrin las pa 'bri ban purmye bzang po shi la'i ming:yongs la phrin las 'jug pa'i skal ba bzang rma thog rin chen sku skyes btsun pa'i gzugs:pad+ma ma ji 'dul khrims gtsang ba 'byung:rgyal ba byang chub sku skyes thugs bskyed can:pad+ma'i ming can yon tan nor 'byor 'byung:'o bran dbang phyug rnal 'byor dam gtsang ba:byung

badz+ra rgyal brtul zhugs bog thon dam pa 'byung: dbang gi bka' bab mi rje dam pa ni: 'dab chags la zhon pa shaṃ ming can 'byung: dz+nya na ku ma rtogs pa'igadengs tshad can: sbas pa'i rnal 'byor nyams myong mthu ldan 'byung:nam snying sprul ba bstan pa'i mdzod 'dzin pa : pad+ma'i zab chos zhabs tog byed pa 'byung:dpal seng sprul pa rigs pa'i ming can pa: chos kyi spyan ldan grub pa'i rtags thon 'byung rtsa ba'i chos bdag rigs can bco lnga la pad+ma dbang chen bstan 'di 'phrod pa na: sku tshe mdzadaphrin ga ma mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: gzhan don phan bde nyi ma bsam yas gsal:'grel tshad dag ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god: mtha' yi dmag bzlog dus kyi rgud pa sel bstanapa'i dgra zhi bdud kyis rgol ba 'joms: ma tshogs mkha' 'gro'i zhal ni nye bar 'gyur: bstan 'dzin yongs kyi nyams rtogs 'phel bar byed dbang bsdud che zhing dregs pazil gyis gnon: lha 'dre mi gsum bran bzhin 'dud par byed: byang nas byang zhol byang rong sgog shing 'di: ral bar ma gyur rang la 'phrod pa'i tshe: don gnyis yid bzhin

'byung ngo sa ma yā e ma legs nyes snang ba sgyu ma'i rol rtsed de sna tshogs ma nges ya ma brla ru 'byung: rkang yang 'gros dang ldan pa'i rta mchog la: lcags kyi phur pa bzhiyis rang bstod byas: da ni nam mkha' lding ba'i bya bzhin du: gnod sbyin dar thod can 'di mi bskyod dam gser bya mgo zlum mjug bsdud lto ba yang: sran khog bra byis rolaba'i 'bab ma la: rgya dar dkar po bsor ba'i dus med pa'i: rlung gi dam tshig drangs gar bde bar bskyod rma bya dmar po dug gi brgyag pa'i yul: skad gnyis smra ba shin tu cheba'i gnas: de ru rgyang grags dang po g.yas 'khyil 'di: yun du mi bde 'phral du spo na legs: ldon shing rtse mo brgya yi ba gam steng chu bya skad mdzes gnyis kyi glu dbyangasaldeb: bzhin bzang de la mi dga' phrag dog 'byung pham rgyal rtsod pa'i gzhi ni 'byung nges pa'i: 'byung ba shing la mi brten lcags la gnas rin chen nor bu spungs 'dra'i dga' tshal gnas: lto na tsan+tan bsil khyim 'dzom pa'i dpal: nub na rma bya dmar po 'ja' yis 'khyug: byang phyogs ru sbal rgyal po brjid cing brten: shar phyogs grogs

badz+ra dkar chu bo 'byug ltar 'khyil: de na sbas gnas pad+ma rol ba'i rdzongs: rgyal ba mchog dbyangs nyid kyi byin rlabs pa'i: sgrub phug nub nas shar du kyu ba la: rten 'brel dbang gis phun tshogs gzhi bzung na: mdzad pa phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: grub pa'i rtags tshad chos kyi che ba 'byung: bsod nams lhun po ma brtsams shugs la 'khrungs: snyan grags dbyar rnga ma bsgrags bzhin du ldir: rig rgyud phrin las bcu gsum bar du 'phel: rgyal mo'i gnas su sngags kyi pad+mo 'khrung: rdzogs pa chen po'i chos kyi nyi ma 'char: phan bde'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab po: e ma dngul dkar rdo rje'i gser gyi thag pa can: rang bzhi'i pho nya rnams kyis rtag tu bskul: bde stong mkha' 'gro'i rtogs pa'i gshog rtsal bskyed: nye rgyud rā dza 'byung pos bsod nams rku: de yi dngos gnyen drag po phur mjug can: tshe 'dzin yid bzhin 'khor lo grub rgyal mo: seng ha ḍāk+ki gnod sbyin shan dmar la phrin las bcol na bkra shis dge mtshan 'bar: e ma gser gyi ral gri zangs kyi kha bad can: dam grib

nag g.ya' yis 'khyud pa na: grib bsal rme bar brtsegs dang smra seng ge: rta khyung drag po las kyi byed por bsngags: btsan rgod yang le ber gyis phrin las bsgrub: rdul dengs tshe rang 'od phyogs bcur rgyas e ma lcags nag phur pamatshal gyi byugs pa la: nyi 'dab rā dza me yi kha dog can: glang dmar 'bag seng tshogs kyis 'khri ba drag po gnam lcags me 'bar phrin las zab gtsug tor rnam rgyal bdud 'dul drag mo dang: 'chi med grub pa'i byin rlabs bskul na legs: e ma thod pa khrag gi zhing 'khyel ba na: dbang phyug ma mo'i tshogs rnams rtag tu nye rdo rje phra men tshogs kyis dgyes par spyod yang cig bdud nag kha rlangs dug btab 'khyugs: de tshe dpal badz+ra ku ma ra: rta mchog rol pa bdud gcod nyams len la: nges par brtson na dge mtshan 'od stong 'bar: e ma: gser gyi pad+ma 'byungalnga'i yu ba can: nyi zla kha spyor re sgrom las gsal: dgyes sde'i 'dzum gyi ge sar las byung ba'i: yid bzhin dpal 'bar las dbang la 'byor dka': rkyen gyis g.yo ba mkha' spyod dbang mo dang: rta

ba tshu mgrin yang khros phur nag phrin las la:nges par brten na 'tsho ba'i rten 'brel yod yi ma g.yu yipar bu ljon shing tshal na mdzes:dkar po'i bcud kyis yongs su gang ba la:nyer 'tshe bse rag 'gong po 'khri ba 'byung:de bsal rje btsun sgrol ba'i phrin las dang:o rgyan nor lha btsan rgod yang le ber:brin las bskul na don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung:ye ma 'dab kyi tshal bzang rin chen sgrom rgya rnams:mi nyams dbang thang dpal dang ldan pa'i phyir:pha nor zab gter yid bzhin rin po che'i:rtsa ba gsum gyi bsnyen bsgrub rtag thon bya:dgongs pa'i dbang bskur rtogs pa'i sgron me'i 'od:nam yang nub med rab tu gsal bar bya:zab don bdud gcod don gyi nye lam la:nges par brten nas rgyu mar rtsal chen sbyangs rigs gyi myu gu ring mun nye bar 'tsho:tshom bu dpung bzhi'i yan lag dag gis bstod:'o bran dbang phyug rma rgyal phyogasasu bzhad:ldan ma rtse mang nya zla'i zhal dang 'grogs:rma thog rin chen rang gnas gegs ma 'byung:shud pu dpal seng yar stod phyogs su 'phen ska ba dpal btsugs dbang

tha don gegs med 'grub: gzhan pa kha cig dben gnas sgrub phug tu: dbang chen bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug nus na: 'di bde phyi skyid don gyi dam pa 'byung: bsgru ba do ma tshogs gsang gtam yin: e nam nam mkha' lding gi gshog pa'i bsil grib rtsa 'byung khams me la zhen pa'i mi mo ni: nga yi gsang ba bco lnga nyi shu'i bar 4 gyi so dkar sa yi mtshan pa can las 'phro don gyi rgyal tshab rigs mar bsngags: shing gnyis 'dab ma me dag 'phrad pa'i tshe: g.yu yi thod brgyan 'dzum pa'i dge bsnyen legs pa'i blo gros 'byung ba'i re smos bcol: re zhig 'grogs pa'i gnas mgron tshul du bya: de nas rgyu skar 'byung ba'i yul la gzigs gnod sbyin phyogs char na bun ljongs 'thibs: gser gyi mchod sdong bzhad pa'i ba gam steng: rin chen g.yu yi srog shing gsum dang ldan: de ru brten na re zhig dge bar 'gyur: yang cig gsal byed

'am: me long ngos la gzigs: dge bsnyen mi dkar rta dkar zhon pa dang: bdud po khro gtum che ba rnam gnyis kyis: yar mar gnyis su bskul zhing phrag rtsod: zung de cham zhog zangs ri can la brten: gnas skabs legs pa'i dpal 'bar bde zhing skyid: a ma bsdod pa mang du ma mchis don dam som dga' tshal mtshor ma rol zug rngu'i gzeb: grong brgyad yul la ma gnas dben par song: mda' lnga yul thog ma 'phen rgyan du 'chong: gnas la re ltos ma che nang gnas skyongs: 'a rten 'du 'dzi'i ma brgyag gud yang gyisaḥ zin pa'i 'phro med las mang skyug re log: ngo dga' kha gsag 'phral gyi jag pa ste: gang nas byung kyang gar song cha med kyis: cha sdang rtsod mtha' 'dab kyi dam sri las: gang gi mtha' rgya mi chod cham gyis zhog: shug 'byung bab bcol spyod pa thol byung 'di: rang nyams sbyar rgyu gzhan la ngom pa min: /byung lta ba gol sa tshar gcod 'di: mos gus spyan ldan rigs kyi bu la spel: rang bab 'od gsal yangs dog med pa'i lam: rnal 'byor dbang phyug dam pa rnams la sprod

dor spyod pa nyer len mtha' grol ba: don dang ldan te yongs la ngo sprod gdams sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sems gyi gsang ba mazong: mi rtog ye shes gzigs pa'i byin drod can dug lnga'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dgra bo che:shesarab mtshon chen 'chang ba brtul zhugs ldan: bzod pa'i go cha bgo ba'i dpa' snying rgyas: bsam bstan yul sa gcod pa'i'agros mgyogs can: sbyin pa gsum gyi nor sna gdul byar 'bebs: yongs su dag pa'i tshul khrims rgyan cha 'chang: gang 'dul brtson la mi zhus phan bde'i gzhi: bde stongagrogs dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig can: chos can yul la chos nyid rgyas 'debs dpal: pad+ma'i rgyal tshabs bu la 'di don ldan: don gnyis 'byung ba'i gzhi ma nor bu 'dra 'phral snang tshar gcod seṅge'i nga ro can: don thog pheb tshe mkha' lding gshog rtsal 'bar: yul la 'jug tshe nam mkha'i rang bzhin can: o rgyan chen po'i rgyal tshab khyad chosayin: e ma 'jig rten srid pa rlung gis bskyod pa'i tshul: mkha' lding gshog panyi zhabs nas mtshon cha 'khor: log pa 'dud kyi dpung yang de ru 'du: dngos gnyen pad+ma rta

badz+ra mgrin brtul zhugs kyis mtshon cha'i 'khor lo du ma 'thor bar 'gyur:meyisug pa can la dug skyal 'byed:'phro tshad ma nges thog babs 'jig pa 'byung:rkyen de tshar gcod rta mchog me yi las:yongs su grub na re zhig gzhom kyang srid zangs kyi ngur sgra 'don pa rgyal khams su:mu ge'i rgud pa 'byung ba'i dus tshags ste:na ngos gnyen pad+ma rta mchog bzlog sgrub gzab:phun tshogs gyur na 'phral snang de las skyobs:a phyi rgya yi bu mo g.yu rmig can grong khyer tsi nas yul khams bco brgyad la:mnga' dbang byed cing 'jam dpal dmar po dang thabs shes grwa bsdab dmar po sngon po' tshogs:mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i rten 'brel mchis gyur na sems can gnas skabs bde ba'i dge mtshan 'bar:mizanalcags kyi yul khams gnas skabs 'tsho:gser dang spang ljongs dga' tshal nges par 'tsho:bde skyid sgon me'i 'od ni nges par 2phel don de gegs med mtha' ru phyan pa' phyir:rgyalatshabarig pa 'dzin pa'i thugs bskyed dang:dam bca' bskul ba'i phrin las gsol ba gdab:'phral gyi rkyen gegs

sgrub gzab: bka' sdod dregs pa'i tshogs la gnyer du bcol de lta bu yi phun tshogs lang tsho gsal: bstan pa'i che ba bskyed do sa ma yā e ma pad+ma dbang ) gu rdzogs la: brin las phun tshogs 'byung ba'i dam pa dzasgyu mu 'khyud bcu gnyis zhon pa'i rkang pa can rigs can bco lnga phun tshogs dpal du 'bar 'di yi bu'i nyi shu lnga: ba 'i ming dang kun bzang ming can gnyis: rong sngags yul gru chen po'i phyogs nas 'byung: bsam gtan ming dang rig pa'i ming can gnyis /da nas sngon smon dbang gis 'dzom: brtson 'grus ming dang rdo rje'i ming can gnyis: sbra nag yul rmad phyogs nas nges par 'byung: rgya mtsho'i ming dang shā ra'i ming khro chen rgyal rong phyogs nas rnams par 'byung: shrī'i ming dang marje'i ming can gnyis: a lcags 'bru yi phyogs nas legs par 'byung: rab kyi ming can don gyi sa: rma dang smra gyi cha nas nges par 'byung kirti'i ming dang ka ra'i ming can gnyis: bar gyi tsho brgyad yul nas rnam par 'byung: 'gyur med ming dang rak+ta'i ming

badz+ra— can gnyis: rin chen gser gyi yul gru'i cha nas 'byung: sman gyi ming dang nor bu'i ming can gnyis: zla rgyud phyogs nas nges par 'byung ba'o: nges don ming dang chos rgyal ming can gnyis: rdo stod phyogs nas bstan pa'i dpal du 'byung chos legs ming dang chos mchog ming can gnyis: snyi stod zla dang 'brel ba'i 'tshams nas 'byung bsod nams ming dang yang dag ming can gnyis: grwa sa chen po'i phyogs nas nges par 'byung phun tshogs rgyal mtshan dge ba'i 'byung gnas ni: rong sngags yul gru a khyung gnam rdzong nas: dus su nges par 'byung ngo sa ma yu: rang rang dbang skal rta mchog zab pa'i chos: shin tu dwangs ma snying khrag lta bu'i skor: mkha' 'gro'i lung gis bsngags ltar legs par sprod: rang gzhan don 'byung bstan pa'i mnga' thang bskyed: dgos pa bsam mtha' yas so snying gi bu: e ma: mi zan lcags kyi yul gru la: srin mo dug sbal lta bu skye: bar gyi phung shing nag po dang: zung 'brel yul khams kha lo bsgyur: de yi dngos gnyen ku ma ra: seng ha nag mo'i phrin las myur: rje la shan pa'i 'bras bu

ga gi lo 'bras 'dabs su 'khor: yul la sdug bsngal sna tshogs bskyed: dngos gnyen dbang chen rta mgrin dang: seng ha nag mo phul du phyin: chu lha'i gar rtseri mo'i me tog g.yo ba'i tshe: se phung sprul pa lcags la skye: dom nag khrag gis myos pa 'dra: dngos gnyen gu ru drag po dang: seng ha'i rno nus byung na thub: lcag shar du yo: wa yi dar 'phru rlung gis bskyod: de tshe lcags kyi spu gri 'khor dngos gnyen dbang chen rta mgrin dang seng ha ḍarge'i nus mthus gzhom rgya / nas rgyu dom bu phul gzhan 'byin pa'i tshe: mi 'dod 'tshubs ma sprin ltar g.yo: dngos gnyen pad+ma rta mgrin dang 'chol bor khros pa'i thugs rjes skyobs: 'bu yis g.yeng: gtsug lag rin chen me ru 'khyil: mgo yi cod pan gcod srid pas: de tshe dngos gnyen rta khyung rgyal: dbang chen rta mgrin phul du phyin: da 'khyol na: dge mtshan 'od stong 'bar bar 'gyur: ye nam srin po'i ral ba gcod pa'i phyir rgya stag ngar ma la zhon nas: sngags skyes ral khur bcu ga

badz+ra 'brel nas bdud po'i rdzong la cha: dam rtags rdo rje gtsug la bkod: 'chor med lcags kyi rno yis 'dzin: dam tshig de lta phul byung na: bstan pa'i srung mar de 'gyur ro: srin mo'i gdug rtsub gzhom pa'i phyir: g.yu 'brug sdon po la zhon nas: shes rab grogs ni cha shas bcas: srin mos rdzong la pheb tsa na: gnam lcags thog ni mdzub mos bsgyur: lcags kyi ser ba khol bur bcad srin mo'i snying nas phyag rgyas bkugs: mgo la dam rtags phur bu bcing: bstan pa'i zhabs tog des byed do grong rgyugs 'byung po 'tshogs pa'i yul: rā dza mngon sum mthong ba'i gzhir: dam tshig chen pos pheb pa'i tshe: 'cholabor khros pa'i gzugs skur bzhengs: stong nyid snying rje'i phyag rgyas gzir: thod rkam 'bar ba mgo la bcing: bstan pa'i grogs su 'byung ba'i tshe: 'gal rkyen dgra sde thal bar rlog: mthu yi grags pas yul kun 'dar: don de nges par 'byung ba ni: bslu ba med do gtan tshigs yin: yi ma lcags dkar 'khor lo dus su 'khor: 'jab mkhas yos bu'i gar dang ldeb: ru sbal khog pa srin gyis za: mi 'dod na

bun bzhin du g.yo: rkyen 'jams dbang chen he ru ga'i: gtsug lag snang brnyan gsal bar bkod: dug lce ldan pa mig tshor gyis: rgyal khams yongs la bskor ba'i tshe: re'abyams sngon mo'i dug tshang gtor: mi snyan skad kyis rgyal khams slong: de yi dngos gnyen he ru ga'i: bsgrub pa zab mo tshad du 'byol: khyad par shing gi rkang ba can: chu yimajug nas yar la slebs: 'byung ba lcags kyi cang shes la: dngos gnyen bdud 'dul 'bar ba'i rdzong: sgrub pa chen po tshad du 'khyol: rtags dang rten 'brel phun tshogasa'agyur: shar phyogs ba dan rlung gis bskyod: rje yi rigs dang phra ma 'byung: g.yang mo lug dkar snang ba'i dus: bsrung rim seng ha nag mo dang: chos skyong rdo rje yang le ber drag tu gsol bas rgud pa sel: sman phor dug dang bral ba'i phyir: 'byung khams lho nas g.yo ba'i tshe: rje btsun g.yu be+e rdzong gur phub: 'chi med tshe yi sgrub la brtson: bdudartsi sman gyi sgrub pa bya: de 'bras shel dkar me long bkra: sna tshogs mdzes pa'i gzugs brnyan 'byung stod nas lcags dkar mda' mo g.yo: 'tshams kyi thig le glo bur

badz+ra: thebs de bzlog seng gdong bzlog sgrub dang: 'khor lo 'bar ba grangs ldan 'byel: gzhom med rdo rje'i srog sgrub dang: tā re la brten maṇ+ḍal bsags:yang cig gser gyi thag pa ni: yal ga'i ri dwags lag nas 'phen: mdzes pa lho mon mdangs la theb: rkyen 'joms phyag rdor bzlog sgrub dang: thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas gsur dang sbyin sregs lan chags bsngo: gdugs dkar khri bzlog tshad du 'khyol: yang cig mi nag dung so can: rgyu skar phyogs nas rnam pa ra rgyu: mar gad lang tsho nyi mas bzhu: rkyen 'jom tshe yi bsgrub pa bya: dpal chen 'chol khros gzi byin bskul: phrin las de sgrub 'phral snang zhi: yang dag dge ba'i snang ba 'byung: rtsal ldan rma bya'i zlos gar dang: rgya stag ngar ma'i mchong rtsal sdeb: de yang thabs kyis 'dzin byas na: bstan pa'i ba dan gsal bar byed: gdong lnga'i dbang po nyis 'gros dang: rtsal ldan rma bya'i grogs mo bcas: bstan pa'i 'dabs su 'byor ba'i tshe: dge mtshan dpal gyi nor sbyin na: don gnyis lhun grub e ma rmad: yang cig ka la pad+ma'i glu: rgyal mo'i kha nas

nges par gsal: legs nyes snang ba gar bzhin 'khyug: de yi dngos gnyen mkha' 'gro lnga'i sun ma bzlog cing bskang mdos gtong: thabs des 'ja' 'khyug snang ba yal 'brong nag ngar ma'i rwa rtsed bsgyur: lce spyang 'gros mgyogs snga nas slebs: mi mthun skad gnyis sgra ru mngon: de yi dngos gnyen khros nag la: brten nas bdud gcod nyamasalen gzab: 'phral gyi jag pa dbyings su zhi: bsod nams dpal gyi bum pa 'byor yang cig mkha' ldeng rtsal ldan la: zhon pa'i ro langs pho mo gnyis: sku dang bstan pa'i dgra ru 'gyur: de yang dgongs pa'i phyag rgyas bcing sgog chu bslang la rkang mthil bkod: gdug pa bran du khol ba na: phrin las shin tu nye zhing myur: yang cig spu gri'i 'khor lo ni: zhe sdang bdud kyi lag na thogs: glang nag rwa cor brten te 'byung: de yi dngos gnyen drag po che'i sgrub pa zab mor brtson mkhas kyis: rten 'brel ldan na dge mtshan 'char: rma bya'i lag na nor bu thogs: g.yu 'brug zhal chab bdud rtsi 'byed: dngos gnyen 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed drag sgrub zab pa'i 'khor lo bskor: de nas thabs

ba tshu mkhas gyis bslang na: don chen 'byung ngo dam tshig yin 'thor ba'i me tog cha shas ni: bgegs kyi phyogs na nges par 'byung: de tshe 'dul byed dbang chen gyi sgrub pa zab mo dus gnad yin: zhal byang snying la phan pa'i sman: dam tshig nyi zla'i gsal snang can: ston 'khor bsam pa 'byung ba dang: phan bde'i dge mtshan dar rgyas phyir: yang dag rig pa'i ga'ur chug: dus gnad dus las mi g.yel bar: sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug nus na: legs snang shel dkar rdo rje bkra ljon shing pad+ma'i tshal rab bzhad: skyid kyi nyi ma shar nas gsal: phyogs mgron mang po lho la cha: skal ldan padre'i tshal rab dngar: yid bzhin nor bu 'od stong ldan: gdul bya'i rgyud kyi dbul ba sel:yon tan bgrangs 'das nam mkhar mnyam: don de nges par phun tshogs 'gyur: zhes gsungs nas dgongs pa'i dbyings su 'byam klas so e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi thig le rdo rje snying po'i skor grub pa' dab phyug rgyalamatshag dbyangs la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen bdo la bstims mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma

/zengs lang skabs grub pa 'i dbaja phyug rgyal mchog gshad pa rtsal gang da 'phrad nas gdul bya'i lag ma skyo sa 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god bslu ba ma chis pad+ma rgyal po'i bka' don tshegs yin sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshigs nyi zla khra bkod rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gurgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin chosakyi bdag po sku skyes pa d+ma bsod nams dga' ba' rdo rjes bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas te nan tan chen po sa bskul ngor/ 7 kho bo rgyalamachag bzhad ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa 'a yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyas pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/
badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi gsang tshig lung byang shel dkar me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

na mo gu ru padh+wa ka ra ye: rgan1)dza/3)/ rang bzhin rnam dag 'od gsal dpal gyi ri ye shes dag chen bkod pa rdzogs pa'i dbus rig pa'i ngo bo bla ma rdo rje 'chang ba 'du 'bral ma mchis gnyug ma'i ngo bor shar bslu med lung byang shel dkar phreng ba 'di bcu bdun rgyud kyi bdag mos 'phrin du bcug snying dbus nyi zla kha sbyor ga'ur sim cas nam:'phrul gyi gsal snang: khri rkang bzhi'i btegs pa'i yul chen gyi lho ngos: mkha'i grags stong rol mo ljon shing las ldir tshe dbang 'od khyams ) : de nag po bdud kyi rkyen dbang las rgyal na: stag ser khrar zhen pa'i yon tan ni rgyas 'ong: mdangs chu smad 'khor los pad+ma'i bcud rol tshe da ngas de gsal 'ong: thabs nyi zla'i 'od kyis gcig grogs te gcig byed grangs 'khor lo bcu bdun mu 'byud kyi 'dab mar: lha dbang chen sgyu skad lcags mi zan dom nag khros 'dra yi khyu nas: dpal dbang chen bshad pa'i cod paṇa zhig 'byung tshe: shar yangs mo'i gzugs 'dzin nā

ba:tshu 'dres skad:'dabs khyi nag gcan spyang dug blo las rgyal tshe:dpe srid pa'i gong shing yul kun la mdzes skad:zhing gangs kyi rwa ba chen po yi khrod nas lha 'khor lo 'dzin pa'i thugs rje yi 'od zer dpal rig sngags grub pa gsum ldan gyi dbang phyug: yul bam ri thod mkhar o ṭaṃ yi mnga' 'og: sngon las smon 'phro 'dzom ral khur de mched lnga:dpal lcags nag rdo rje'i gzi ngar las byung ba'i: gser rang 'od 'bar ba'i rdo rje yi tsha tshwa: grangs bdun nam lnga ru ma tshogs kyis bskul 'ong:gdabang chen pad+ma 'bum rdzogs su bzhad tshe:yul nyer bzhi'i dga' ston chen brjod kyang 'byung 'ong: gnas he ru'i gsang rgya sgo 'phar yang grol 'gro:rdo lcags gnyis gser nag zhun ma ru bsgyur skad rwa shing gnyis tsha ngar nus pa yis gzhom mo:tsha mar gnyis rgya mtsho khol ma ru zhu 'ong:mtha'i lcags nag ser ba dum chad du 'thor 'gro:stabs las dbang chen po'i bskyed pa yi mi dpon: blo dug nag rgya mtsho 'khyil ba yi gnas su: gser rang byung rdo rje bzhad pa yi gnas med: mgon lu u ser po'i thod brgyan du

pa pad+ma'i phrin las bskul ba yang byed 'ong yul 'ja' lnga'i lang tsho lha sman gyis ngom tshe: khyod zhen med ro snyoms dgongs pa la bzhugs 'tshal: dug zhun ma'i ga gis 'dzin tshe dpal drag khros me yi 'khor lo rang bskor na dbal nus pa'i rkyen snang rang dbyings su yal 'gro phyogs pad+ma'i tshal gyi ngang mo yi 'du ba gukag cing 'phral rkyen 'ga' byed 'ong: lha cit+ta dmar po'i phrin las la bab pas: stobs yang yang bskul ba dam tshig gi gnad yin brag 'gyur med sra brtan dpal khyung tshang gnyan po'i nor bu yi dpal kha: gsung pad+ma'i rigs can mched lnga yi spyod tshe: don rang 'od gsal ba'i sgron me te 'char skad: yul rgyang grags / shis kyi mig bur: shel brag mdangs ldan pa'i mchod sdong de mdzes pa phyogs drug nag g.ya' yis 'khyud pa'i skyen 'byung 'ong: der dbang chen rol ba'i sa gzir dgos: yul grong bdun 'dabs ma 'brong nag gi nga ro lcags zhun ma'i ngar dang phan tshun gnyis 'thab tshe: dpal gshom med rdo rje'i sgrub chen la

pa(: brtson dgos: shar me long dkyil gyi gser nag gi rdo rje: lha 'jam dpal ser po'i phyag mtshan ru ngom tshe: rkyen sabha'i dug nag snang ba yis 'byud srid de 'jam dpal gshin rje'i mngon spyod la drangs dgos: shar dri zas glu dbyangs rmar mkhas su 'byung tshe: mdangs ma smad bdun gyi mngal khrag de bskul nas mibasod nams dpal 'dzom lang tsho la reg skad: des dngos gnyen dpal ldan re ma ti gsol dgos: skabs chu lha'i zhags pa glog ltar du 'khyud cing: mdangs ne tso'i lang tsho lho phyogs la gshog 'gro gser ngang mo'i rang tshugs 'dzin dka' ru 'byung ba'i: dzapad+ma'iphron las ya mtshan du bsngags lags stobs phrin las bzhi pa'i yan lag gi me tog: mi shingabya chen pa'i nyer 'tshe yis reg skabs: phyogs rlung nag 'tshubs ma khol chad du rdol srid des dngos gnyen khyung nag 'bar ba de ya mtshan: mgo gcig la tog gsum nor bu yi 'byud der mi phra ma mkhan gyi la yog la brten nas gsar bya khyi dkrogs pa'i nyer 'tshe yi dug snang: rkyen mi 'tshams la yog du ma ru ngom srid: de'i dngos gnyen sgrub

sde'i dkyil 'khor 'di e ma: rma gser gyi chos khri pad 'dabs kyi ste bar: dus smon lam 'bras smin btso ba yi mchod sdong: phyogs re 'byams 'ga' yis dug zer gyis snubasrid skyabs g.yu yi lding gur 'bum phrag grangs phun tshogs: mkha'i glog zhags sa mdos grong khyer la bsnun tshe: mi sku skyes bsngags pa srin bu yi khung ldan bdud ha ros kharlangs nges pa ru gdab ba'i: lha gzhom med rdo rje'i phrin las drangs dgos: shing dug sbal steng gi lo 'bras mdangs mdzes pa: bu khyod kyi phrin las byed po ru 'byung yang thabs mkhas pa'i brtul zhugs dam tshig la brten rgyu: sgog gcig tu mi bsre man ngag gi khu byug: sa 'dam nag yul du 'khrungs ba yi ge sar: me dmar po'i 'od kyis tsha regadang bral na: skabs bde ba'i bsil char rtsol med du 'khrungs te chos zab gter bshad pa'i gzhi ma ru 'byung 'ong bsil 'dzom pa'i ldeng ka ku mud kyi 'khrung gzhi: phyogasarlung nag 'byud pa'i nyer 'tshe dang bral na: lha dbang po'i me tog phyogs med du brdal zhing: rje pad+ma'i phrin las nam mkha' ru bteg go: sman mdzes pa'i sgod bzang spar bu ru

ba tshu bkod der lcags rang byung rdo rje brten pa yi gzhi ma der gser ldan ral gri rang 'od dang ldan tshe:mgon rje matsun tā re'i phrin las de myur nges bsil ldan khrod kyi brag dmar gyi gzhi la stag 'dzum drug bkra ba'i gcan gzan te ngar ma:phyogs yul rkyen 'brong nag khyu tshogs kyis bskul tshe:stag dmar po'i sa bkrag mdangs de nyams 'gro:stod lha ldan gser khri'i ge sar de dkar po:zer dmar po'i 'od dang 'thab rtsod du byed tshe:khri gnyis ga'i zur nyams dkar sngon gyi khyu der phul byung lha 'di'i brin las rang zab skad:skyen las dbang rngo ga pa'i phrin las sgo bkag srid:dpal rten 'brel nyes sel grangs ldan du sgrog dgos:dpal pad+masnye las ya mtshan du bsngags pa'i:lho gong po'i yul gyi chos dgon te mdzes par mi dpal gyi rdo rje'i bstan pa 'di der spel:dpal grub pa'i rig 'dzin brgyad cu ru 'a byang re bsgreng yul gyi cod pan du gyur ba'i:sngags sna nam ye shes bstan pa 'di'i gzhi ma:bdud shing khri nag po'i rkyen snang las rgyal na:skabs mi rabs bdun du ba

'i rgyal mtshan 'di bsgreng ngo shar rma rgyal g.yas zur gsar byung gi yul sder: rje bzod pa'i ming can smon lam gyi 'phro 'dzom: bstan 'di la lhag par mos gus dang yul de ru sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog 'dzug go sprel yan lag can gyi sa mig gi dpal khar: rje 'jam dbyangs sprul ba rang grol gyi ming can: bstan 'di yi gdul mchog tu bsngags pa'i: sgo phun tshogs gyur na yun ring du bstan dar rta dkar po zhon pa'i yul gru yi me long: rje pad+ma'i rgyal tshab rog rgyal zhes bya ba: yul nges mas pa'i bya btang gi rnal 'byor: khong bstan pa 'di yi gzhi ma ru phun tshogs lha ser po'i sde ru gso dkar gyi lang tsho: sngon las smon 'phro 'dzom thub bstan gyi rdo rje yi gdul bya'i zhing sa ru bsngags pa'i: de ma sring mkha' 'gro'i thugs rje yis bskul 'ong rong sngags glu snying po'i thig le yi khyu nas: rje sangs rgyas ming can stag

badz+ra dkar la zhon nas bcud bdud rtsi spyod cing rgyal khams la rgyas 'debs de'i phrin las rtsod med yongs grags su 'byung ngo: der yiring nye ba'i ka zharagyi yul nas khong smon lam 'phro 'dzom klu rgyal zhes bya ba: bya dmar po'i lding gur gshog pa la brten nas: dbang 'od 'khyil bdud rtsi a mṛ ta spyod de: rang gzhi ru bdudartsi'i char rgyun kyang 'beb 'ong: yang mi rigs rta zhes bya ba yi dgon nas: rje thugs gtsang chos kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba khong smon lam las 'phro bzang po yis bskul nas bstana'adi la zhabs tog nges pa ru byed do yulakhyungazhes bya ba'i sngags dgon gyi gzhi la: khong dran nam sprul ba me tri yi mtshan can: bstan 'di yi phun tshogs gzhi ma ru bsngagasapas ma mkha' 'gro'i thugs rjes nges pa ru bskul 'ong: seng ge'i ming dgon gyi cod pan du bsngags pa'i: ser po'i gzhir dmar po'i thig le ru mngon pa'i:g.yu sgra 9sprulab dharmā yi ming can: zab gsang gi gdul zhing dam pa ru 'byung ste: bstan pa 'di dbang ldan yul phyogs la spel 'gro g.yu 'brug goltas khug mkha' lding gi dgon par: rong

de ka la gser bya ser po yi rtsal ldan rdorje be+e ming can ma bcos pa'i rtags 'chang: bstan pa 'di'i gdul zhing phun tshogs su bsngags so: smra yul gyi g.yang 'khyil spug poyi gzhi la: rtsal ldan gyi gzhen nu dpal seng zhes bya ba: las 'phro yis bskul tshe bstan pa 'di rab spel: 'brel tshad kun don ldan nges pa ru byed do lho rong gi phyogs nasashing rta la zhen pa'i: gzhon nu de rig pa'i ming can zhig 'byung tshe: zab gsang gi dpal kha sbyin thabs la mkhas tshe: rang gzhan la don chen nges pa ru yod do:mkhar dzaX gyi gni nas sbrang char gyis bskul te rgya stag gi grogs po cha shas dang bcas nas: bstan pa 'dir dad cing gus pa yis 'byor tshe zab bcud kyi sgron me khyab brdal du speladagos: rin chen gyi sgon me rang 'od dang ldan pa: rang yul gyi rta pho mgyogs pa la bcibs nas yos dkar gyi dar dang zung ldeb nas 'byung tshe: grong khams der bdud rtsi

badz+ra 'bebs snga rang ma byed: rnam rgyal zhesalho stod chos dgon nas bskul kyang: nye rgyud kyi rwa dza'i cho rol te rtsub pas: dgos med kyi dam tshig thabs mkhasal brten te: re zhig nas lcags kyus 'dzin skabs zhig yod do chos dgon gyi'abras bu gser nag gi rtsibs stong: smon lam gyi thugs rjes lcags kyu yis bskul tshe: rtena'abrel gyi sgo bskyed nyes sel gyi gnad bcas phun tshogs su grub na bde legs kyi dpal 'phel shes bya yilang tshor shing khams kyi gzhon nu: chu stod nas byung zhing chu smadanas yar 'khyil: smin grol gyi lam la thabs mkhas kyis drangs na re zhig nas zhabs tog byed mkhan sogs gsal 'ong: 'dab chags ni43 tu ma rungs ba'i rigs can mdo smad gyi bstan pa'i nor bu de cha shas: rang gzhi la rgyud pa'i nyes pa yang 'byung srid: thams cad la phan byed rta mgrin 'di e ma: gdong lnga yigayu ral phyogs phyogs susprugs kyang: seng chung ni mang po byang phyogs la yan 'gro: bdud rtsi yi 'od rgyun sgod bzang la 'byil nas: bde legs la 'khyil ba'i rtel 'brel de yod do: g.yu 'brug go

nor bu phyogs phyogs su ngom kyang bkrag mdangs kyi lang tsho lho nub tu 'bar tshe:cha shas kyi dbul ba nges pa ru bsal nas: bsod nams kyi dpal la spyod skabs kyang 'byung nges rgyamaphyo yi zhalachengs bdud rtsi yi gzeg ma:chu 'dzin gyi sbubs nas ltad mo 'gas ngom kyang: re 'byams kyi sbubs su nub pa de ma rtog: legs spyod kyi dbang skal bsod nams sgo zung phra:chushel gyi nor bu dbang po yis ngom nas:pad+ma'i mda' thabs mkhas gzhu mo la drangs nas:rang yul du 'jes pa'i skal ba dang ldan tshe grogs khyera'aga' bsod nams dbang skal du 'dzom 'ong zlorgyudakyi rin chen me long gi dpal kha gzung 'dzin gyi gzhi ma pad+mo yi dga' ston:bkra shis pa'i ngag gi gsal sgo dang bstunan bde legs kyi dpal 'di dar rgyas su byed do rdo rgyud kyi gshon nu g.yu 'brug la zhon pa: brag cha yis bskul nas 'du ba la pheb kyang: re zhig tu smin pa'i skal ba rang med pa'i: lugs gnyis kyi bya ba'i bkrag mdangs de ma 31ra:smra yul gyi gzhen nu khu byug gi sgra ldan:legs nyes kyi 'ja' 'khyug rma bya ltar mdzes kyang: nam phug ni mi thub

badz+ra g.yel dus zhig gda' ba'i: drang don las nges don snying po ni ma shor: lcags nag gi mi pho glang snying zhig 'byung nas bkrag mdangs kyi lang tsho nyer 'tshe re g.yo skabs: dbang phyug gi brin las maro na spyod sgo bskul dgos: rje yi rigs khyi yi lo rtsa la brten pas: dme sdig gi bya ba sna tshogs su 'gyed pa'i: las dbang can thabs kyis 'dzin pa ru mi bya/ /tsan rgod kyi phrin las zab mo la drangs dgos: rong rgyud kyi me stag rtsi shing gi gshed ma: sbrul nag gi khog pa lcags zhun gyi skang ba: sna tshogs kyi 'gros can nye ba ru sleb hūṃ: yul gzhan du bskrad kyis brten pa ni ma yin pad+mo thagadaga' tshal dpal yon gyis brgyan par: je tso yi gtam snyan 'phral myur du 'byung phyir: rje btsun ma'i lding gur brngan pa yis btags dgos: cang shes kyi sgyu rtsal glang po dang ldeb nas: shing rta yi 'khor lo'i phyogs gzhan du bskyod tshe sngar gzhi la mun pa'i grib so re 'byung kyang: 'phel 'grib ni ma nges kun gyi yul som zhig: lcags dkar gyiral gri rlung nag dang bsdab nas yul khams kyi rtsi shing cha shas re gcod tshe: sku

skyes kyi gzhon nu thabs mkhas su 'byung ste: nyes pa kun sel ba'i rten 'brel zhig yod do g.yu lo yi tshal chen nai seng gi dga' ston: skang drug gi rgyu ba bsil grib la 'tsho yang: ston rgyal gyis nyer 'tshe glo bur du 'byung srid: 'tsho ba'i skyabs pad+ma rgyal po las ci zhig: dbang sngon gyi lang tsho gser nag gi mtshan ma: thabs shes kyi 'brel ban bzhin bzang gis byed tshe: legs nyes kyi khong dug glo bur la 'byung srid: dngos gnyen du gu ru drag po te e ma: ba gam la brten pa'i rin chen gyi khang pa nyer 'tshe yis rlung gis dum bu ru gcod srid mi dbang de'i thod brgyan rta mchog dpal mdzes na re zhig la bde ba'i rten 'brel de yod do: mkhar sngon la lcags kyi bya sngon tshogs lding zhing sa gzhi la dug gi me tog rnams btab cing: mi 'tshams kyi sdig las sna tshogs su spyod tshe: nad mug dang mtshon chas char ba yang 'bebs so: khrims med kyi bya ba ja sig bzhin spyod tshe las ngan gyi 'phel kha na bun bzhin 'thibs pas bsrung bzlog la dbang chen gzir na'ang bsgyur dka':sha khrag gi nyo tshong gser ltar du byed cing: dme

badz+ra: mkhon gyi gzhi ma phu nu la 'dog tshe: mi 'dod kyi bya ba thog ser ltar 'khrugs kyang: bzlog thabs la 'bad pa shin tu'ang dka'o: grong khyer gyisgo nas tsinadha yi bu mo: yul khams la ltad mor nges pa ru rgyu bas: lugs gnyis kyi bya ba zhib dra du ston rnams: po phyogs gyi mgron la 'gro thabs su brtson pas: dngos gnyen ni sengaha ḍāk+ki de mchog gyur: lce spyang ni sha zan dam log gi lang tsho: bsam spyod kun sdig pa kho na la 'da' ba': nyes pa yi 'byung gnas na bun ltar 'tshubs pa: dngos gnyen la rtanag yang khros te phun tshogs ri bo yi 'dab su 'brung ba yi spu gri gzhan dbang gi lo ma nag po yis bsgyur nas: gra gcod kyi spyod ngan rang gzhi la 'beb 'gyur 'chol khrosapa'i brin las bskul ba la brtson 'tshal: gtam snyan midaga' tshal pad+mo yi dpal bzang: khā ta yi skad ngan glo bur du g.yo tshe: mi 'dod pa'i 'tshubs ma rlung nag bzhin sdanga'agyur: dngos gnyen la pad+ma drag po te phun tshogs: ñca spyang ni sha zan glog dmar bzhin 'khyug kyang: sngon dbang gis 'dren pa'i phrin las la bul bas: ngom byed kyi sbyin

gtong bsags spel la brtson na: re zhig la gsod nams lo 'bras de mi za yang cig ni srid pa'i legs nyes ni sna tshogs: sngon dbang gi las kyi rnam smin ni mtha' yas brjod pa yang ngal ba don med kyi bya ba: de tsam las mi spro dgongs pa'i mthil gab rgya: e nam: dbang sngon 'dab ma rlung gi g.yo: ru rbal khog pa srin gyis za: rgya stag ngar ma'i mche ba bskul: dug 'dzin sbrul nag rab tu g.yo mi zan lcags kyi lang tsho de: rgud cing mnar ba'i dus su 'byung: de la brten bya'i man ngag ni: dbang chen khro rgyal 'dus pa'i mdzod pad+ma rta mgrin rgyal po ni: yul gzhi chos kyi 'byung gnas de: legs par brten na dge mtshan 'char: yang cig srin bya ser po yis: nyes pa'i bya ba sna tshogs brtson zab mo'i rten 'brel sna khar 'tshe: gdams pa'i dwangs bcud gtor srid pas: btsan rgod rdo rje yang le ber drag tu gsol zhing brin las bskul: sa mdo dam sri rgyu ba'i lam: ri nag sog po khros 'dra'i yar la blta: btsan dmar dom gzhol lta bu'i mar la phyogs: the'u rang rkang gcig gnas mal nye sar gab: phung rdo nag po ma mo'i

ba tshu mchin pa tsam: phung shing bdud kyi kha spu can phung lam mtshal gyi thig pa zag: de la bdud 'dul thugs kyi rten: phun tshogs tshad ldan 'dom lnga ba: dam sri mnan pa'i cho ga dang: dbang na nyi ru'i sgrub pa mchog: tshad 'byol rtags dang rten 'brel dge: rgyal kha blon gyis bsgyur mi btub: rje kha 'bangs kyi g.yo mi 'gyur: sngon po'i tshogs kyi za kha bcing: mi zan gyi dmag tshogs phyir la gyes: rten 'brel dus gnad mang du mchis: 'gal zla byed pa'i chom po mang: kha brgya'i bshad pa ya la la: lce brgya'i 'don pa 'u ru phu gang gis bsgyur du mi btub par dpal na rol ba'i rdzong du bsgrub: 'jam dbal rnon po'i mtshon du brten: las kyi dbang chen dpal du bkod:phun tshogs skal ba de ldan na: yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab po yulakhams stag tshang bya ba dza srin po nyal thabs su 'gyel ba'i lto ba la rnam par rgyal ba'i rten snang bkod:log pa bdud kyis ma bkags na: sku 'jam dpal bzhad pa'i thod brgyan rgyal mdangs 'od kyi yul khams mang po 'tsho: sbrul nag 'dam zan rgyu ba'i gnas: hang nga bya ba'i

grags pa can gyi mtsho: 'dabs la rgya 'dre 'tshogs pa'i gnas: the'u rang rkang gcig lus po'i steng: rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod rten bkod: smon log rkyen gyis ma bkags na:rong sngags chos dgon mkha' dang mnyam: sa stod rma rgyal nye ba'i gnas: lha sman 'tshogs pa'i 'dab ma la: sprel kyi lag stong rgyab tu phyogs: de yi snying gi me long ngor: rnam par rgyal ba'i thugs rten bkod: log pa bdud kyis ma bkags na: mgo gsum gyi sde srid dge bar 'tsho: snye nam dpal gyi yar stod du sdon shing spel ma'i ming gzhi can sngar gyi gnas la dang dus sgod mdo smad srin mo lag bzed kyi sa mig tu: rnam par rgyal ba'i rten snang bkod: log pa bdud kyis ma bkags na: skyang 'brong gi sa la rten pa'i sde tshogs skyid: nyi zla gnyis ka brgal ba'i rgyab: rdza chu dal 'bab rgyu ba'i 'dabs: sa ming gser gzhong bya ba dza srin po'i mgo chad lta bu'i 'bur steng du: rnam par

'amatshu rgyal ba'i rten snang bkod: log pa bdud kyis ma 'phrogs na: rdza rgyud stod med kyi chos dgon rkyen las rgyal rgyal bo'i brag la gri bo btsan: gnasasha yi rwa dar 'dzom: de yi yar stod pang gi thang: nya mgo bo skam la mjug ma rlon: de ru rnam rgyal thugs rten bkod: bar chad bdud kyis ma 'phrogs na: log 'dren ‘po'i kha gnon 'gyur: bstan gzhi mang po nyi ltar gsal rin chen gser gyi yul ljongs kyi: 'jug ma gser chen thang zhes par: bdud btsan rnam ni rgyug 'thab byed mang po 'du zhing 'tshogs: de ༄ rnam rgyal gzhu 'dom bdun pa bya: bar chad bdud kyis ma 'phrog na: rgya sa bcud len pa'i 'du ba g.yel dbang thang dar gyi ba dan mtho pa mi bde'i zug rngu chu mjug 'gro: yo 'bog gtsang ma'i thang chen du: rin chen gser gyi phye ma brdal: de steng g.yu yi phor pa stong pa bzed: de 〈 rnam rgyal thugs rten badrag po kha bzhis ma bkag na gtsug lag mang po phun tshogs 'gyur: bstan gzhi mang po dar rgyas 'gyur: zhwa brag smra mdo bya ba na sa dbyibs pad+ma 'dabs brgyad steng:

chen nor bu thur bstan la:rnam par rgyal ba'i thugs rten bkod:yul gye rgyal pos ma bkag na pad+ma'e phrin las glog ltar 'khyug:mdzad pa'i yon tan bsam mthagaḥyi chos dgon mdzes pa dza shar nas g.yang 'khyil lam gyi 'og:srin mo'i mchi ma 'bab pa'i 'gram:gcan gzan sder mo 'akram pa'i steng:rnam par rgyal ba'i thubabakod:bstan bdag glen pa'i ma bkag na:yar ngos zla ltar 'phel rgyas 'gyur:dpal yul chos dgon mdzes pa yi:g.yas phyogs rgyang grags 'das pa dzasgyurgya'athur bstan lta bu'i steng:rnam par rgyal ba'i thugs rten bkod:drag bzhi rnams kyis ma bkag na:bstan pa yar ngos zla ltar 'phel:rdzogs zhes bya ba'i me long ngor:lung ba nag po'i 'dabs:sa 'dabs bzhi ru gyes pa'i steng:srin po'i snying 'dra'i brag dmar yod de la rnam rgyal thugs rten bkod dam sri rnams kyis ma bkag na:pa gong nas gong 'phel gyur:rdo brag smin gyi chos dgon la:bdud kyis rgol ba bsal ba'i phyir shar phyogs sa mar bya ba'i yul:'dab chags 'phur 'dra'i brag na

badz+ra: g.yas g.yon re 'byams thur brgyug sna: de 'tshams rdo nag ri bong tsam: dam sri kun gyi sa mig ste: de ru rnam rgyal thugs rten bkod: chos bzhin yul gyis ma bsgyur na: pham lhung rgud pa re zhig dben: bshad sgrub nyin mo'i 'od stong 'bar: 'di ni bstan pa phyi khyab la: phan byed dus gnad bstan pa'o: yinam zhesdang sbrul gyi rgyu lam la: sdig pa rwa tsa'i tshang bcas nas: g.yag gi dpa' snying gzhan la shor dngos gnyen gnyan za'i bla rdo mchod: lha chu gtsang ma gyen la phyogs: bdud chu nag po thur du 'bo: lha bdud 'thab pa'i nyer 'tshe yis: rma yi bkrag mdangs bslad par 'gyur: mgo gsum tog tebasgyur la khad: bya yi bde ga pas bskyod la khad: dngos gnyen rta mchog rol ba yi: sgrub pa bdud dpung zil gnon gnad: shan pa mi zan dgra la gshe: btsan rgod shan pa gdug rtsub che de gnyis blo rtse bdud kyis bskyod g.yu yi ri lakhrag char 'bebs: chab kyi nya mo'i mjug ma snyem de yi dngos gnyen dbang chen po'i: bdud dpung zil gnon phrin las bskul:shar phyogs rgyu skar grong khyer de: nub nas

go le'i thabs kyi bskul:legs nyes lag pas gar bsgyur bzhin:dngos gnyen pad+ma rta mgrin legs:dza nga khyer yangs mo'i lcags zhun khol 1 rigs stobs ldan ser bgayo:'go yi lan tshwa zhu la cha:rkyen bzlog dbang chen yang khros bsngags:mi zan lcags kyi mche ba can:mi lpags rta lpags khyi lpags bgo:de dag sha la za bar byed skye'agro mi bde sdug gis mnar:de yi dngos gnyen rta mgrin lags:byang phyogs khrag mtsho 'bar ba'i 'gram bdud kyi rigs la gnod sbyin sde:shan pa mi zan 'byung po'i tshogs:nam mkha'i rdul dang mnyam par g.yo:de yi dngos gnyen dbang chen rgyal:pad+ma bdud dpung zil gnon dang lha chen dbang phyug chen po bsngags:ri spyang ngar ma'i blostobs kyis rgya yi grong khams slong bar byed:rang nas chas pa'i sri rigs kyis:rgol pa mang po 'byung bar byed:bdud mo'i kha rlang me stag gis:gtsug lag mang po ram du 'gyur:de yi dngos gnyen dbang chen rgyal:ma hā de wa'i brin las bsngags:nor bu mtshal dang brje ba'i dus:spyang gi rgyab ser khrims la phung:'bag seng mang pos dmag

ba:tshu las byed: de tshe mtha' yi dmag 'khrug slongs: dngos gnyen dbang chen rgyal po dang: mahā dowa mchog tu bsngags shi 'dre gson 'dre grong 'dre 'tshogs the'u rang 'byung po'i dmag g.yos te: mtha' yi 'tshubs ma 'khrug par byed de tshe rta mchog rol ba dang: mahā dhe wa mchog tu zab: gser gyi mdog khams lcags kyis bsgyur lcags la dom mgo glang snying 'byung: de yis yul gnyis khrag tu byed dngos gnyen gshed shar rta mgrin dang: dbangaphyug mahā de wa yin bdud kyi nyi ma thod du bcing: de nidabang chen lcags phrug brjod: btsan gyi zhags pa lag tu thogs: de ni dge slong blo bzang 'bod: klu yis dug rkyal snying la 'chang: sog gi rje bo a drag 'bod: de gsumayul gyi sri bdud de: dngos gnyen dab chen rgyal po dang: mahā dhe wa shan tu zab: chu lha'i phyogs kyi smon log pa: dam sri me khyer bya ba 'byung: dbang po'i yul gyi rā dza ni: blorgod dmar po'i ming can 'byung: lce sprang zhon pa'i bse mo ni: dorapog nag mo zhes pa 'byung: sngags pa'i dam la ma zhog na: rgya bod gnyis ka phung bar byed: dngos gnyen

gshed shar rta mgrin dang: drag khros yang gsang sgrub pa dang: dbang phyug 'char byed nag po bsngags: shar nas mjam dbyangs sprul pa ni: rin chen gser ldongs thod dubasngags: de yi 'bangs rigs 'khor gtogs pa'i rta mchog rol ba lam khyer na: bsam pa yar ngos zla ltar 'phel: byang nas phyag rdor sprul pa ni: bkra shis rma yi lungabar 'byung: de dang 'brel ba thob tshad kun: pad+ma 'od du the mi tshom: nag po rgya yi yul khams su: 'jam dpal smra seng sprul ba 'byung: skyes bu de yi bde skyid 'ong gangs canabod yul re zhig 'tsho lha ldan thod kyi brgyan cha phu spyan gzegs mi tri'i ming can 'byung: log pa bdud kyis ma bsgyur na: 'dzam gling yul gru chos la 'god jo bo dpalaldan a ti sha'i: sprul ba nyag gi phyogs su 'byung khrims bsrung dam tshig dag pa yis 'jig rten khams 'di bde la bkod: bsil ldan khrod kyi yal ka la: ru sbal mdzesapa'i lang tsho bzhad: de la 'jam dpal thugs rje 'khyil: yul khams bdun gyi mun pa sel: bsod nams phun sum tshogs thob 'gyur rat+na lnga yi bye ma brdal: de ru gser

badz+ra gyi rta pho yis: o rgyan pad+ma'i phrin las bskul: mdzad pa 'jig rten khams na mdzes lcags kyi spul gru chen po rtsa rang byung gnam lcags rdo rje ni: bdud 'joms dpal gyi rdo rje 'byung: mtha' mi'i rma ni phab par byed: lho rgyud yangs mo'i gzhi ma la: mi drag chos 'khor bya ba'i bu: don 'grub rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba: rgod ldem sprul pa cha shas te: gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgron me sbar: sangs rgyas gling pa'i rnam rol gar: sbas pa'i rnal 'byer rig pa'i ming: sngags kyi dbang phyug dam pa 'byung: snga 'gyur bstan la bya ba byed: khyung po'i rnal 'byor dpal dge yi: rgyal tshab rdo rje grags pa'i ming: mdo khams 'di ru 'byung ba'i tshe: rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa sgogs: sman pa nyi 'od blos gar ba: nyag gi phyog su nges par 'byung: thugs bskyed dam tshig dag pa yis: gzhan don nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam byed/ mkhas grub chen po 'jig med gling bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa ste: rdzogs chen lha gzhi mdzes par gsal: gsang sngags bshad sgrub gzhi 'dzug go: chu bo ri yi nye 'dabs su: thang stong grub rgyal 'dzum

rnam 'byor byang chub rdo rje 'byung: zab don yum gyi bstan pa spel: nub phyogs glang po'i rgang zhol du: bde ba mchog rtsol 'khor lo'i sdom: gang gi thugs rje'i da : gdul bya'i bde stong kha sbyor bsgom: tshom bu 'bum 'bum mkha' spyod 'god: lags lab byang chub rdo rje yi: sku yi 'od zer las byung ba'i: rnal 'byor nyi byung: lcags mo'i yul khams kha lo bsgyur: thal 'byin dgongs pa'i phrin las 'gyed: rog rje gling ba'i ge sar las: byung ba'i rnal 'byor tshul bzang po: bla brems ldan pa 'byung: gang 'brel pad+ma 'od du 'god khye'u chung lo tsa'i gar bsgyur ba: nus ldan khrag 'thung rdo rje 'byung: rdzong mda'i zab gter sgo yang 'byed: sde rnams mnga' dbang byed smin grol chos kyi zam pa 'dzug: the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka': e nam lcags khro nag gi sgog shing rta mchog dpal: khong lha mi de bkur na: da 'di nas bgrangs bya bcu phrag bar: nges pa ru dge ba'i rten 'brel yod: gser ro nyal gyi srog shing khro bo lod: bstan bdag po 'ga' yis dang

badz+ra: blang nas: dgon kun la sgrub zab 'dzug gyur na: dus re zhig mtha' mi'i g.yul las rgyal: rdo col chung gi sgog shing seng gdong ma: mi gyis dang blang na: sgrub zab kyis phan bde'i lang tsho gsal: dge mtshan de 'char nges dam tshig yin: khro lcags nag gi sgog shing phur pa ste dpal phrin larasgrub na: bdud smon log rgya 'dre'i g.yul las rgyal: rang chas la rang gi phan bde spel: rma dal 'jam gyi sgog shing drag khros skor: mi mchog dman kun gyidapal bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug nus na: yul de ru bde skyid nyi ma 'char: snyi mjes pa'i yul gyis srog shing la: ma rje btsun sgrol ma mchog tu bsngags:kun gyi dang blang nas: dpal bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug nus na: zhing de ru bde skyid dpal dang ldan: yang zla rgyud dal 'jam sgog shing ni: lha o rgyan pad+madapal nges don chos kyi nyi ma yis: bstan pa yi rgyal mtshan bsgrengs gyur na rang gzhan la bde skyid nyi ma 'char: byang rong sngags yul gyi sgog shing la: da

nag po'i sgrub pa dang: gza' dug sdong 'bar ba'i drag sgrub la: brten mkhas na byad zor g.yul las rgyal: bstan pa la rgol rnams tshar gcod 'gyur: yangs mo yi lha gzhi du ma yis: sgog shing ni 'jam dpal gshin rje dang ma mkha' spyod dbang mo'i dam tshig la brten mkhas na bde legs dpal thob 'gyur: yul gru re bzhin du rang rang gi:sgog shing ni dpa' bo'i zhal lung bzhin: brtson pa dang ldan pas dang blang na: tshe 'di ru dge zhing phyi mar skyid: don gnyis kyis dpal dang ldan par 'gyur: e nam yul mda' lnga'i 'ching rgya ral gris chod: don shes rab mda' mo gdul byar 'debs: 'dabs khyi nag mang po phyogs su bsal: de kun gyi 'ching rgya chod nges bya: grogs nai tso'i gtam la nyan mi bya: 'dzum lho mon mdangs la zhen pa bor: dpal brag dkar dkyil la rang tshugs 'dzin: gos sgrub khang gyon la sgrub pa 'khyol zas sha chang spyod cing dam tshig dag: grogs mkha' 'gro chos skyong bran du bkol: las gsang sngags bstan pa rin chen srung: nor mchog gyur 'phags pa'i nor bdun dang: snag shog dkar dri ma bral

'a:tshu ba brten: mgon o rgyan pad+ma gtsug tu bkur: dus rtag par thugs yid ro gcig bsre: thabs mkhas pa'i zab gter rin po che: bsdam ma drag spel ma che ba ༄/ don gdul bya'i yul la stsol mkhas kyis: skabs brin las 'jug pa re rdzogs tshe: yul re la brin las ma nges spo: don 'khor ba dbyings su ma rdzogs par: bu khyod kyi phrin las nub pa med: yang re rer gab kyang re rer gsal: yang re rer sbas kyang re rer rdol: dpal 'di la tshad bzung ma mchis pas: rje o rgyan nga yis gzigs bya'o:zhes gsungs so e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma sa bha wa'i ma 'o sa'agro la brtse ba chen po yas thugs kyi zig le zab gsang rdor snying skor grub pa' dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da drung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas ran chen brda la bstims shig sar bye mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs rgya sdoms ma 'ongs snyags ma nad mtshon gze sa la tshe dpa 'a bo khyod nyid dbang chen bshad par 'gyur skyes bu de dang gdam pa 'di 'phrad nas bstan pa'i 'gro don byang gi phyogs su 'byu 'brel tshad don ldan pa d+ma 'od du 'god bka' gsang sru sa shag btsan rgod ya le ber dam nyams lag tu ma shor a tham rgya las can snyi gi bu yi dpa la du shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya

lung byang shel dkar me long zhes bya ba rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gurgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda zims snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin pad+ma dga'aba'i rdo rjes bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas te yang yang bskul ba don dang ldan phyir/ 7 kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul bdo las phal bshusate dag par shad pa'i yi gi pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legasa'aphel/ sarba ma le/

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi brin las sgrub phrin phyag bzhes kyi skor gtor ma'i phrin las bsod nams phung po bzhugs so: a na mo gu ru pad+ma kro dha h+ya snyi wa ye ga76 9rjermi—1 gam dgu rdzogs dkyil 'khor dbus: dbang chen he ru bzhugs pa'i gnas: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad rtsibs rnams su: zil gnon khro bo yab yum rnams: rtsibs mchan za gsod pho nya'i gnas: dbang mo'i khrag khyim gnas yul ma ma tshogs bzhugs pa'i da la'o: khyams la bka' sdod rlung ltar 'tshubs: sgo la khro bo chen po bzhi: rtsigs pa 'dod snam pha gu dang: drwa ba drwa byed shar bu dang: mda' yab rnams la phyi nang gi: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs ni sprin ltar gtibs: rta skang chu skyes rin chen sgrom: za ra tshag la dga' ston 'phel: dar dang yol ba bla bre gdugs dar 'phan sgo kheb ru mtshod mda': rgyan drug lcags phur stag sham sogs: sku gsum mtshon pa'i brgyan gyis klubs: bla ma'i gtor ma 'bras dang ni: gzang po drug gi phye mas bya: yi dam sngon mo

nas dang ni: rin chen lnga yi phye mas bya: mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma so ba dang: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yis bya: chos skyong gtor ma sran ma dang: snying po lnga yi phye mas bya: kun kyang chang dang ja bzang po zhun mar kho nas 'dag par bya dang po dkar gyi thig gdab nas zhal shes bzhin du legs par brtsam de nas dmar gyi gur phub nas rin chen tsit+ta blang ltar bya: snying po dkar rtsi dmar rtsi sogs sum cu rtsa gnyis gtor ma'i rdzas: phun sum tshogs par 'dzom gyur na de la rtsa gsum 'ja' ltar 'khyug dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rlung ltar 'tshubs: pho nya dam can dbang med 'du: zla ba dkar tshogs tshes pa la: 'byung ba lnga yi mdangs dang ldan: tsan+ta sur+ya ma ṇi spud: dar gyi yol ba rma bya'i gdugs: 'ja' yi 'phan dang pad+ma'i tshal: ri rab ri bdun tshul du bkod: 'chi med lha yi bdud rtsi'i skyems: pañca a mṛ g.yas su bkod: pho nya las la basbran pa'i phyir:tshal gsum rak+ta g.yon du bskyil: nyams pa bskang phyir dga' ston tshogs: rab la zas sna brgya ru bsags: 'bring la lnga bcu rtsa gsum mo: tha ma nyi shu rtsa lnga dang: shin tu tha

badz+ra ma bcu phrag go:da la bza' ba tshogs zhes brjod:rnam rtog gcod pa'i 'khor lor grags:rgyun gtor nal ma phud kyis bca' rtsog 'ab mnol mi phab:dkar la zla ba'i gos bzang bskon:dmar la nyi ma'i na bza' gsol:rdzas la zla phrom mang po'o:skyems la 'od phud ja chang khrag rten gshertsi can:dza gad gal phye snang gsal dang:zla tshes zla phyed ga ṇa'i dpal:phyi nang mchod pa mtha' yas pa:dar gyi mtha' nas g.yo med bkod:drag po'i gtor lcags phye zangs phye yungs dkar nag:gnag chu ba lci btsan dug sbyar:dri chen dri chu sha lnga bsre:kha dog nag po zur gsum bya:yang na dmar po me ltar bya:da ma yin no dpal gtor brngan gtor bskang gtor rnams:dang po la ni sha lnga bsre:gnyis pa la ni 'bru sman sbyar gsum pa dkar gsum mngar gsum mo:rdzas a dṛ ta:rnal 'byer nang gi mchod pa ste:gzhan gyi bsgyur bkod bya ba min:rdo rje g.yab dar bya ba ni:dpa' bo 'bod pa'i rdzas su 'chang:sngags kyi sgrol

zhing bcu dang du len phyir brten: thabs shes rdor dril ḍā ma rba gsang sngags thabs kyi lam la bsngags: sna tshogs dar gyi g.yab mo ni: rig 'dzin gnad la 'bes phyir 'chang: zhing chen g.yang gzhi khrag thig can: ma sring mkha' 'gro 'bod phyir g.yab: thun rdzas zor rdzas sna tshogs ni: drag po'i phrin las 'grub phyir bsags: nus ldan btsod kyigator ma la dri ro nus pa tsha ba'i rigs: chu dang sngags pa bdug pa'i rdzas: thams can kun la mnyam par sbyar: thog mar dbang chen he ru ga'i: bskyed rdzogs rtags tshad them pa'i rdzas: yang khros zhi bar sgrub pa dang: drag por bsnyen cing las la sbyor: btsod kyi phrin las gzhan don bya: gtor ma rdzas dang ldan gyur na: lha tshogs rnams ni shin tu nye: grub pa'i rtags mtshan rmad byung 'byung rdo rje pho nya'i phrin las sgrub he ru ka dang skal pa mnyam pad+ma dbang chen sa la spyod: gnas yul nyer bzhi'i mkha' 'gro 'du: bde ba chen po'i ye shes 'char: 'di yi byin rlabs zad mtha' yas: rno nus lag tu longs dang gsal: sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gtor ma'i phran las bsod namasaphung po rdzogs so gter rgya
/ dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i ba
